<file path=".env.production.db.example">
 1: # ==============================================================================
 2: # PostgreSQL — Production Credentials
 3: # ==============================================================================
 4: # Bu fayl `docker-compose.prod.yml` tərəfindən `env_file` kimi oxunur.
 5: # Format MÜTLƏQ `KEY=VALUE` olmalıdır — shell script, here-string və ya
 6: # başqa sintaksis Docker tərəfindən başa düşülmür.
 7: #
 8: # İstifadə:
 9: #   1. Bu faylı kopyalayın:
10: #        cp .env.production.db.example .env.production.db
11: #   2. Aşağıdakı dəyərləri REAL production dəyərləri ilə əvəz edin.
12: #   3. .env.production.db faylını HEÇ VAXT git-ə commit etməyin.
13: #      (.gitignore-da artıq var)
14: # ==============================================================================
15: 
16: POSTGRES_DB=fleet_maintenance_production
17: POSTGRES_USER=fleet_prod
18: POSTGRES_PASSWORD=CHANGE_ME_WITH_STRONG_RANDOM_PASSWORD
19: 
20: # ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
21: # BACKUP RETENTION
22: # ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
23: # How many days of database backups to keep on disk. Older files
24: # are removed automatically by the nightly retention sweep.
25: #
26: # Sizing hint: a compressed dump of a mid-sized fleet database is
27: # typically 5-50 MB. 14 days of daily backups is well under 1 GB.
28: #
29: # For long-term retention, snapshot the ./backups directory to
30: # off-site storage (S3, Backblaze, rsync) — see README.
31: BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS=14
32: 
33: # Hour of the day (00-23) when the backup runs. The host's timezone
34: # (usually UTC inside the container) determines the wall-clock time.
35: BACKUP_HOUR=02
36: 
37: # Parol yaratmaq üçün:
38: #   openssl rand -base64 32
39: # və ya
40: #   php -r "echo bin2hex(random_bytes(24)) . PHP_EOL;"
</file>

 15: # ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 16: # TRUSTED PROXIES
 17: # ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 18: # Laravel yalnız bu IP-lərdən gələn X-Forwarded-* header-lərinə inanır.
 19: # Boş buraxsan (lokal dev/test üçün düzgündür) — heç bir header etibarlı
 20: # sayılmır və rate-limiting real müştəri IP-si əvəzinə proxy-nin IP-sini
 21: # görür.
 22: #
 23: # Ssenariyə uyğun DƏYƏRLƏR:
 24: #   • Nginx eyni serverdə:        TRUSTED_PROXIES=127.0.0.1
 25: #   • Nginx ayrı Docker-də:       TRUSTED_PROXIES=172.16.0.0/12,10.0.0.0/8
 26: #   • Cloudflare:                 TRUSTED_PROXIES=173.245.48.0/20,103.21.244.0/22,103.22.200.0/22,103.31.4.0/22,141.101.64.0/18,108.162.192.0/18,190.93.240.0/20,188.114.96.0/20,197.234.240.0/22,198.41.128.0/17,162.158.0.0/15,104.16.0.0/13,104.24.0.0/14,172.64.0.0/13,131.0.72.0/22
 27: #   • AWS ALB / GCP LB:           TRUSTED_PROXIES=10.0.0.0/8
 28: #
 29: # ⚠️  HEÇ VAXT "*" yazma production-da. Bu, istənilən istifadəçinin real
 30: #     IP-ni saxtalaşdırmasına imkan verir və rate-limiting-i tamamilə
 31: #     sıradan çıxarır.
 32: # Docker bridge default: nginx container's gateway IP falls in 172.16.0.0/12.
 33: # Change to 127.0.0.1 ONLY if nginx runs on the same host as the app (non-Docker).
 34: TRUSTED_PROXIES=172.16.0.0/12
 35: APP_TIMEZONE=Asia/Baku
 36: APP_LOCALE=az
 37: APP_FALLBACK_LOCALE=en
 38: 
 39: # ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 40: # HEALTH ENDPOINT
 41: # ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 42: # /health is public in the application (no auth) so external monitoring
 43: # tools can reach it. Restrict it at the reverse-proxy level so anonymous
 44: # visitors cannot read your queue driver, disk usage, and backup age.
 45: #
 46: # See docker/nginx/fleet.conf.example for a ready-to-adapt Nginx config
 47: # with an "allow <private ranges>; deny all;" block on /health.
 48: #
 49: # If your monitor runs from a dynamic IP (UptimeRobot free tier,
 50: # Cloudflare health checks), whitelisting is impossible — use a shared
 51: # secret query string instead and add an nginx `if ($arg_token != ...)`
 52: # guard.
 53: #
 54: # Disable the individual backup-freshness probe (e.g. if you do not run
 55: # the backup sidecar) by setting HEALTH_BACKUP_MAX_AGE_HOURS=0.
 56: HEALTH_BACKUP_MAX_AGE_HOURS=25

134: # SENTRY — ERROR TRACKING
135: # ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
136: # Sentry captures unhandled exceptions and slow requests so the team
137: # is notified of production bugs before users report them.
138: #
139: # The SDK is a no-op when the DSN is empty — no network calls, no
140: # overhead — so it is safe to leave unset in environments that should
141: # not report.
142: #
143: # Get the DSN from: https://sentry.io → Project Settings → Client Keys
144: #
145: # ── Sample rate ──
146: # SENTRY_SAMPLE_RATE=1.0 sends 100% of error events. Errors are rare
147: # enough that this is the correct default — a missed error is worse
148: # than a duplicate one.
149: #
150: # SENTRY_TRACES_SAMPLE_RATE is the fraction of requests traced for
151: # performance monitoring. 0.1 = 10%, which is plenty to spot slow
152: # endpoints without paying for every request. Set to 0.0 to disable
153: # performance monitoring entirely.
154: #
155: # SENTRY_SEND_DEFAULT_PII MUST stay false unless your privacy policy
156: # explicitly permits sending user emails and IPs to a third party.
157: #
158: # ── Self-hosted alternative ──
159: # Sentry is open source. `docker-compose` for the self-hosted version:
160: # https://develop.sentry.dev/self-hosted/
161: #
162: SENTRY_LARAVEL_DSN=
163: SENTRY_ENVIRONMENT=production
164: SENTRY_RELEASE=
165: SENTRY_SAMPLE_RATE=1.0
166: SENTRY_TRACES_SAMPLE_RATE=0.1
167: SENTRY_SEND_DEFAULT_PII=false
</file>

<file path="app/Actions/Complaints/CloseComplaintAction.php">
 1: <?php
 2: 
 3: namespace App\Actions\Complaints;
 4: 
 5: use App\Models\Complaint;
 6: use App\Services\Complaint\ComplaintPdfService;
 7: use App\Services\Complaint\ComplaintService;
 8: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Context;
 9: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;
10: use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
11: 
12: /**
13:  * Closes a complaint and generates the corresponding PDF.
14:  *
15:  * Extracted from ComplaintController::close() and
16:  * Api\ComplaintController::close() — both controllers were
17:  * orchestrating the same five steps:
18:  *
19:  *   1. Guard against closing an already-completed complaint
20:  *   2. Delegate the state transition to ComplaintService
21:  *   3. Generate the PDF
22:  *   4. Log PDF failures without rolling back the close
23:  *   5. Return the fresh model
24:  *
25:  * HTTP concerns (route, redirect, response) stay in the controllers.
26:  */
27: class CloseComplaintAction
28: {
29:     public function __construct(
30:         protected ComplaintService $complaintService,
31:         protected ComplaintPdfService $pdfService
32:     ) {}
33: 
34:     /**
35:      * Close the complaint and try to generate its PDF.
36:      *
37:      * The PDF step is best-effort: if generation fails, the complaint
38:      * remains closed and the failure is logged. PDF failures never
39:      * prevent the business operation from completing.
40:      *
41:      * @param  array{end_date: string, end_time: string, work_done: string}  $data
42:      *
43:      * @throws ValidationException when the status transition is illegal
44:      *                             (e.g. closing a cancelled complaint).
45:      */
46:     public function execute(Complaint $complaint, array $data): Complaint
47:     {
48:         if ($complaint->status?->isCompleted()) {
49:             throw ValidationException::withMessages([
50:                 'status' => __('messages.flash.already_closed'),
51:             ]);
52:         }
53: 
54:         // Delegates to ComplaintService::close() which validates the
55:         // transition and persists the change.
56:         $this->complaintService->close($complaint, $data);
57: 
58:         $this->generatePdf($complaint);
59: 
60:         return $complaint->fresh() ?? $complaint;
61:     }
62: 
63:     /**
64:      * Generate the PDF as a side effect. Any failure is logged but
65:      * does not propagate — the complaint is already closed.
66:      *
67:      * If generation fails AND a stale PDF from a previous state still
68:      * exists on disk, we attempt to remove it so the operator cannot
69:      * accidentally download a pre-close version. This cleanup is also
70:      * best-effort.
71:      */
72:     protected function generatePdf(Complaint $complaint): void
73:     {
74:         try {
75:             $this->pdfService->save($complaint);
76:         } catch (\Throwable $e) {
77:             // Best-effort cleanup of any stale PDF left over from a
78:             // previous (pre-close) state.
79:             try {
80:                 $this->pdfService->delete($complaint);
81:             } catch (\Throwable $deleteFailure) {
82:                 Log::warning('Failed to clean up stale complaint PDF after generation failure', [
83:                     'complaint_id' => $complaint->id,
84:                     'error' => $deleteFailure->getMessage(),
85:                     'request_id' => Context::get('request_id'),
86:                 ]);
87:             }
88: 
89:             Log::error('PDF generation failed', [
90:                 'complaint_id' => $complaint->id,
91:                 'error' => $e->getMessage(),
92:                 'request_id' => Context::get('request_id'),
93:                 'user_id' => auth()->id(),
94:             ]);
95:         }
96:     }
97: }
</file>

<file path="app/Console/Commands/ArchiveAuditLogs.php">
 1: <?php
 2: 
 3: namespace App\Console\Commands;
 4: 
 5: use App\Models\AuditLog;
 6: use Carbon\Carbon;
 7: use Illuminate\Console\Command;
 8: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
 9: 
10: class ArchiveAuditLogs extends Command
11: {
12:     protected $signature = 'audit:archive {--months=6 : How many months of records to keep before archiving} {--dry-run : Only report how many rows would be archived, do not delete anything}';
13: 
14:     protected $description = 'Archive audit log entries older than the retention window';
15: 
16:     public function handle(): int
17:     {
18:         $months = (int) $this->option('months');
19:         $cutoffDate = Carbon::now()->subMonths($months);
20:         $dryRun = $this->option('dry-run');
21: 
22:         $this->info("📅 Records older than {$months} months will be archived (cutoff: {$cutoffDate->format('Y-m-d H:i:s')})");
23: 
24:         // Number of rows that will be archived
25:         $count = AuditLog::where('created_at', '<', $cutoffDate)->count();
26: 
27:         if ($count === 0) {
28:             $this->info('✅ No records to archive.');
29: 
30:             return Command::SUCCESS;
31:         }
32: 
33:         $this->warn("⚠️  {$count} records will be archived.");
34: 
35:         if ($dryRun) {
36:             $this->info('✅ Dry-run mode: nothing was deleted.');
37: 
38:             return Command::SUCCESS;
39:         }
40: 
41:         // Archive
42:         $this->info('📦 Starting archive...');
43: 
44:         DB::transaction(function () use ($cutoffDate) {
45:             // 1. Copy old rows into the archive table
46:             DB::statement('
47:                 INSERT INTO audit_log_archives (user_id, garage_id, company_id, auditable_type, auditable_id, event, old_values, new_values, original_created_at, archived_at)
48:                 SELECT user_id, garage_id, company_id, auditable_type, auditable_id, event, old_values, new_values, created_at, NOW()
49:                 FROM audit_logs
50:                 WHERE created_at < ?
51:             ', [$cutoffDate]);
52: 
53:             // 2. Delete the old rows
54:             DB::statement('DELETE FROM audit_logs WHERE created_at < ?', [$cutoffDate]);
55:         });
56: 
57:         $this->info('✅ Archive complete.');
58:         $this->info("📊 Deleted records: {$count}");
59: 
60:         return Command::SUCCESS;
61:     }
62: }
</file>

<file path="app/Enums/ComplaintStatus.php">
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: namespace App\Enums;
  4: 
  5: enum ComplaintStatus: string
  6: {
  7:     case Pending = 'pending';
  8:     case InProgress = 'in_progress';
  9:     case Completed = 'completed';
 10:     case Cancelled = 'cancelled';
 11: 
 12:     /**
 13:      * Human-readable label, translated via lang/{locale}/enums.php.
 14:      */
 15:     public function label(): string
 16:     {
 17:         return __('enums.complaint_status.'.$this->value);
 18:     }
 19: 
 20:     /**
 21:      * Bootstrap 5 color name — used for `badge bg-{color}`.
 22:      */
 23:     public function bootstrapColor(): string
 24:     {
 25:         return match ($this) {
 26:             self::Pending, self::Cancelled => 'secondary',
 27:             self::InProgress => 'warning',
 28:             self::Completed => 'success',
 29:         };
 30:     }
 31: 
 32:     /**
 33:      * CSS modifier for the project's custom `.badge-status.{modifier}`
 34:      * component — underscores become dashes.
 35:      */
 36:     public function cssModifier(): string
 37:     {
 38:         return str_replace('_', '-', $this->value);
 39:     }
 40: 
 41:     public function isOpen(): bool
 42:     {
 43:         return match ($this) {
 44:             self::Pending, self::InProgress => true,
 45:             self::Completed, self::Cancelled => false,
 46:         };
 47:     }
 48: 
 49:     public function isCompleted(): bool
 50:     {
 51:         return $this === self::Completed;
 52:     }
 53: 
 54:     public function isCancelled(): bool
 55:     {
 56:         return $this === self::Cancelled;
 57:     }
 58: 
 59:     /**
 60:      * @return array<int, self>
 61:      */
 62:     public function allowedTransitions(): array
 63:     {
 64:         return match ($this) {
 65:             self::Pending => [
 66:                 self::Pending,
 67:                 self::InProgress,
 68:                 self::Completed,
 69:                 self::Cancelled,
 70:             ],
 71:             self::InProgress => [
 72:                 self::InProgress,
 73:                 self::Pending,
 74:                 self::Completed,
 75:                 self::Cancelled,
 76:             ],
 77:             self::Completed => [self::Completed],
 78:             self::Cancelled => [self::Cancelled],
 79:         };
 80:     }
 81: 
 82:     public function canTransitionTo(self $next): bool
 83:     {
 84:         return in_array($next, $this->allowedTransitions(), true);
 85:     }
 86: 
 87:     /**
 88:      * @return array<int, string>
 89:      */
 90:     public static function values(): array
 91:     {
 92:         return array_map(static fn (self $case) => $case->value, self::cases());
 93:     }
 94: 
 95:     /**
 96:      * @return array<int, self>
 97:      */
 98:     public static function creatableCases(): array
 99:     {
100:         return [self::Pending, self::InProgress];
101:     }
102: 
103:     /**
104:      * @return array<int, string>
105:      */
106:     public static function creatableValues(): array
107:     {
108:         return array_map(static fn (self $case) => $case->value, self::creatableCases());
109:     }
110: }

<file path="app/Enums/ComplaintType.php">
 1: <?php

<file path="app/Enums/TransferStatus.php">
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: namespace App\Enums;
  4: 
  5: enum TransferStatus: string
  6: {
  7:     /**
  8:      * Created by the source garage but not yet dispatched.
  9:      * Warehouse stock has not been touched yet.
 10:      */
 11:     case Draft = 'draft';
 12: 
 13:     /**
 14:      * Dispatched. Source stock was reduced immediately.
 15:      * Destination has not accepted or rejected yet.
 16:      */
 17:     case Dispatched = 'dispatched';
 18: 
 19:     /**
 20:      * Accepted by the destination. Quantities match the declared
 21:      * totals and destination stock was increased.
 22:      */
 23:     case Received = 'received';
 24: 
 25:     /**
 26:      * Destination counted fewer (or different) quantities than the
 27:      * declared totals. The difference is "in limbo" until the source
 28:      * garage chooses a resolution.
 29:      */
 30:     case Disputed = 'disputed';
 31: 
 32:     /**
 33:      * Destination refused the transfer entirely. All quantities were
 34:      * returned to the source garage and the source stock was restored.
 35:      */
 36:     case Rejected = 'rejected';
 37: 
 38:     /**
 39:      * Cancelled by the source garage while still in draft state.
 40:      * Stock was never touched.
 41:      */
 42:     case Cancelled = 'cancelled';
 43: 
 44:     /**
 45:      * A disputed transfer has been resolved — either by re-sending
 46:      * the missing quantities or by writing them off as lost.
 47:      */
 48:     case Resolved = 'resolved';
 49: 
 50:     public function label(): string
 51:     {
 52:         return __('enums.transfer_status.'.$this->value);
 53:     }
 54: 
 55:     public function bootstrapColor(): string
 56:     {
 57:         return match ($this) {
 58:             self::Draft => 'secondary',
 59:             self::Dispatched => 'info',
 60:             self::Received => 'success',
 61:             self::Disputed => 'warning',
 62:             self::Rejected => 'danger',
 63:             self::Cancelled => 'secondary',
 64:             self::Resolved => 'success',
 65:         };
 66:     }
 67: 
 68:     public function isDraft(): bool
 69:     {
 70:         return $this === self::Draft;
 71:     }
 72: 
 73:     public function isDispatched(): bool
 74:     {
 75:         return $this === self::Dispatched;
 76:     }
 77: 
 78:     public function isReceived(): bool
 79:     {
 80:         return $this === self::Received;
 81:     }
 82: 
 83:     public function isDisputed(): bool
 84:     {
 85:         return $this === self::Disputed;
 86:     }
 87: 
 88:     public function isRejected(): bool
 89:     {
 90:         return $this === self::Rejected;
 91:     }
 92: 
 93:     public function isCancelled(): bool
 94:     {
 95:         return $this === self::Cancelled;
 96:     }
 97: 
 98:     public function isResolved(): bool
 99:     {
100:         return $this === self::Resolved;
101:     }
102: 
103:     /**
104:      * True while the transfer still needs action from one of the
105:      * two garages. Used by the dashboard to highlight pending items.
106:      */
107:     public function isPending(): bool
108:     {
109:         return in_array($this, [self::Draft, self::Dispatched, self::Disputed], true);
110:     }
111: 
112:     /**
113:      * True once no further state changes are possible.
114:      */
115:     public function isFinal(): bool
116:     {
117:         return in_array($this, [self::Received, self::Rejected, self::Cancelled, self::Resolved], true);
118:     }
119: 
120:     /**
121:      * @return array<int, string>
122:      */
123:     public static function values(): array
124:     {
125:         return array_map(static fn (self $case) => $case->value, self::cases());
126:     }
127: }

<file path="app/Exceptions/MissingGarageContextException.php">
 1: <?php
 2: 
 3: namespace App\Exceptions;
 4: 
 5: use App\Models\Model;
 6: use Exception;
 7: 
 8: /**
 9:  * Thrown when a garage-scoped model is being created without an
10:  * active garage context.
11:  *
12:  * This is a hard failure by design. Silently creating orphan rows
13:  * with `garage_id = NULL` corrupts the multi-tenant data model:
14:  * the rows become invisible to every garage, excluded from every
15:  * report, and impossible to reconcile without direct DB access.
16:  *
17:  * Recognized contexts (in order of precedence):
18:  *   - GarageContext::set()/has()      — normal web request flow
19:  *   - session('current_garage_id')    — post-login session
20:  *   - auth()->user()->current_garage_id — persisted user preference
21:  *
22:  * If none of those are present, the operation must be blocked and
23:  * the user redirected to garage selection.
24:  */
25: class MissingGarageContextException extends Exception
26: {
27:     public function __construct(
28:         public readonly string $modelClass,
29:         string $message = '',
30:         int $code = 500,
31:         ?\Throwable $previous = null
32:     ) {
33:         parent::__construct(
34:             $message ?: sprintf(
35:                 'Garage context is not set for model [%s]. '
36:                 .'Set it via GarageContext::set(), session("current_garage_id") '
37:                 .'or auth()->user()->current_garage_id.',
38:                 $modelClass
39:             ),
40:             $code,
41:             $previous
42:         );
43:     }
44: }
</file>

<file path="app/Exports/BusDailyStatusesExport.php">
 1: <?php
 2: 
 3: namespace App\Exports;
 4: 
 5: use App\Models\BusDailyStatus;
 6: use App\Support\Excel\SafeCell;
 7: use Maatwebsite\Excel\Concerns\FromQuery;
 8: use Maatwebsite\Excel\Concerns\WithColumnWidths;
 9: use Maatwebsite\Excel\Concerns\WithHeadings;
10: use Maatwebsite\Excel\Concerns\WithMapping;
11: 
12: /**
13:  * Exports the currently-filtered bus-daily-statuses list to Excel.
14:  *
15:  * The filters accepted here mirror BusDailyStatusController::index():
16:  *   - $date   (Y-m-d, null = all dates)
17:  *   - $dqn    (partial match, case-insensitive)
18:  *   - $status (exact value)
19:  *
20:  * Uses FromQuery rather than FromCollection so Laravel-Excel streams
21:  * the rows in chunks — the dataset can grow to hundreds of thousands
22:  * of rows after a year of daily imports.
23:  */
24: class BusDailyStatusesExport implements FromQuery, WithColumnWidths, WithHeadings, WithMapping
25: {
26:     public function __construct(
27:         protected ?string $date,
28:         protected ?string $dqn,
29:         protected ?string $status,
30:     ) {}
31: 
32:     public function query()
33:     {
34:         $query = BusDailyStatus::query()->with('bus');
35: 
36:         if ($this->date) {
37:             $query->whereDate('date', $this->date);
38:         }
39: 
40:         if ($this->dqn) {
41:             $query->whereHas('bus', fn ($q) => $q->where('dqn', 'ILIKE', "%{$this->dqn}%"));
42:         }
43: 
44:         if ($this->status) {
45:             $query->where('status', $this->status);
46:         }
47: 
48:         return $query
49:             ->orderBy('date', 'desc')
50:             ->orderBy('id', 'desc');
51:     }
52: 
53:     public function headings(): array
54:     {
55:         return [
56:             'DQN',
57:             'Route',
58:             'Date',
59:             'Status',
60:             'Notes',
61:         ];
62:     }
63: 
64:     /**
65:      * Every string field goes through SafeCell so a malicious value
66:      * such as "=cmd|..." cannot turn into a formula when the file is
67:      * opened in Excel (CSV/Excel injection defense).
68:      */
69:     public function map($row): array
70:     {
71:         return [
72:             SafeCell::sanitize($row->bus?->dqn ?? ''),
73:             SafeCell::sanitize($row->bus?->route_number ?? ''),
74:             $row->date ? \Carbon\Carbon::parse($row->date)->format('Y-m-d') : '',
75:             SafeCell::sanitize($row->status ?? ''),
76:             SafeCell::sanitize($row->notes ?? ''),
77:         ];
78:     }
79: 
80:     public function columnWidths(): array
81:     {
82:         return [
83:             'A' => 20,  // DQN
84:             'B' => 10,  // Route
85:             'C' => 12,  // Date
86:             'D' => 25,  // Status
87:             'E' => 40,  // Notes
88:         ];
89:     }
90: }
</file>

61:             $row->date ? \Carbon\Carbon::parse($row->date)->format('Y-m-d') : '',
62:             (int) $row->km,
63:             SafeCell::sanitize($row->notes ?? ''),

<file path="app/Http/Controllers/Api/AuthController.php">
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api;
  4: 
  5: use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
  6: use App\Models\User;
  7: use App\Support\Auth\TimingAttackDefense;
  8: use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
  9: use Illuminate\Http\Request;
 10: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
 11: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;
 12: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\RateLimiter;
 13: use Illuminate\Support\Str;
 14: use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
 15: 
 16: class AuthController extends Controller
 17: {
 18:     /**
 19:      * Authenticate via email + password and issue a Sanctum token.
 20:      *
 21:      * ─── SUPERADMIN MFA ENFORCEMENT ────────────────────────────────
 22:      * The web login flow forces SuperAdmin through a TOTP challenge
 23:      * (see AuthenticatedSessionController). The API must enforce the
 24:      * same rule — otherwise a leaked password grants full platform
 25:      * access via /api without ever touching MFA.
 26:      *
 27:      * Two-step flow:
 28:      *
 29:      *   1. First call: password only → if SuperAdmin has MFA enabled,
 30:      *      return {requires_2fa: true} and DO NOT issue a token.
 31:      *
 32:      *   2. Second call: password + two_factor_code → verify the TOTP
 33:      *      code (or a recovery code), then issue the token.
 34:      *
 35:      * The `two_factor_code` parameter is ignored for every other user
 36:      * role, so the standard flow is unchanged for regular users.
 37:      *
 38:      * @throws ValidationException
 39:      */
 40:     public function login(Request $request): JsonResponse
 41:     {
 42:         $request->validate([
 43:             'email' => ['required', 'email'],
 44:             'password' => ['required', 'string'],
 45:             'device_name' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:255'],
 46:             'two_factor_code' => ['nullable', 'string'],
 47:         ]);
 48: 
 49:         $this->ensureIsNotRateLimited($request);
 50: 
 51:         $user = User::where('email', $request->email)->first();
 52: 
 53:         // Timing-attack defense: always run a bcrypt comparison, even
 54:         // when the user does not exist.
 55:         $hashToCheck = $user?->password ?? TimingAttackDefense::DUMMY_HASH;
 56:         $passwordValid = Hash::check($request->password, $hashToCheck);
 57: 
 58:         // Generic error to prevent user enumeration. The same message
 59:         // covers "no user" and "wrong password".
 60:         if (! $user || ! $passwordValid) {
 61:             RateLimiter::hit(
 62:                 $this->throttleKey($request),
 63:                 (int) config('rate_limits.login_decay_seconds', 900)
 64:             );
 65: 
 66:             Log::warning('API login failed', [
 67:                 'email' => $request->email,
 68:                 'ip' => $request->ip(),
 69:                 'user_agent' => $request->userAgent(),
 70:                 'request_id' => \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Context::get('request_id'),
 71:             ]);
 72: 
 73:             throw ValidationException::withMessages([
 74:                 'email' => [__('auth.failed')],
 75:             ]);
 76:         }
 77: 
 78:         // Reject deactivated accounts (matches web login behavior).
 79:         if (! $user->is_active) {
 80:             RateLimiter::hit(
 81:                 $this->throttleKey($request),
 82:                 (int) config('rate_limits.login_decay_seconds', 900)
 83:             );
 84: 
 85:             Log::warning('API login blocked — inactive account', [
 86:                 'user_id' => $user->id,
 87:                 'ip' => $request->ip(),
 88:                 'request_id' => \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Context::get('request_id'),
 89:             ]);
 90: 
 91:             throw ValidationException::withMessages([
 92:                 'email' => [__('auth.failed')],
 93:             ]);
 94:         }
 95: 
 96:         // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 97:         // SUPERADMIN MFA GATE
 98:         // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 99:         if ($user->isSuperAdmin()) {
100:             // SuperAdmin MUST have 2FA configured before receiving an API token.
101:             // A freshly seeded account that has never set up 2FA must not be
102:             // able to bypass MFA by hitting the API directly.
103:             if (! $user->hasTwoFactorEnabled()) {
104:                 Log::warning('API login blocked — SuperAdmin has no 2FA configured', [
105:                     'user_id' => $user->id,
106:                     'ip' => $request->ip(),
107:                     'request_id' => \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Context::get('request_id'),
108:                 ]);
109: 
110:                 throw ValidationException::withMessages([
111:                     'email' => [__('messages.two_factor.setup_required_api')],
112:                 ]);
113:             }
114: 
115:             $code = trim((string) $request->input('two_factor_code', ''));
116: 
117:             if ($code === '') {
118:                 // Step 1: password was correct, but MFA is required.
119:                 // Do NOT issue a token yet. The client must retry with
120:                 // the TOTP code in the `two_factor_code` field.
121:                 Log::info('API login requires 2FA', [
122:                     'user_id' => $user->id,
123:                     'ip' => $request->ip(),
124:                     'request_id' => \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Context::get('request_id'),
125:                 ]);
126: 
127:                 return response()->json([
128:                     'requires_2fa' => true,
129:                     'message' => __('messages.two_factor.subtitle'),
130:                 ], 200);
131:             }
132: 
133:             // Step 2: verify the TOTP code or a recovery code.
134:             $verified = false;
135: 
136:             if (preg_match('/^\d{6}$/', $code)) {
137:                 $verified = $user->verifyTwoFactorCode($code);
138:             }
139: 
140:             if (! $verified && str_contains($code, '-')) {
141:                 $verified = $user->useRecoveryCode($code);
142:             }
143: 
144:             if (! $verified) {
145:                 RateLimiter::hit(
146:                     $this->throttleKey($request),
147:                     (int) config('rate_limits.login_decay_seconds', 900)
148:                 );
149: 
150:                 Log::warning('API login failed — invalid 2FA code', [
151:                     'user_id' => $user->id,
152:                     'ip' => $request->ip(),
153:                     'request_id' => \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Context::get('request_id'),
154:                 ]);
155: 
156:                 throw ValidationException::withMessages([
157:                     'two_factor_code' => [__('messages.two_factor.invalid_code')],
158:                 ]);
159:             }
160:         }
161: 
162:         // Successful login — clear the limiter.
163:         RateLimiter::clear($this->throttleKey($request));
164: 
165:         $deviceName = $request->device_name
166:             ?? Str::limit($request->userAgent() ?? 'unknown', 100, '');
167: 
168:         $token = $user->createToken($deviceName)->plainTextToken;
169: 
170:         Log::info('API login successful', [
171:             'user_id' => $user->id,
172:             'device' => $deviceName,
173:             'ip' => $request->ip(),
174:             'request_id' => \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Context::get('request_id'),
175:         ]);
176: 
177:         return response()->json([
178:             'access_token' => $token,
179:             'token_type' => 'Bearer',
180:             'user' => $user->only(['id', 'name', 'email', 'role']),
181:         ]);
182:     }
183: 
184:     /**
185:      * Revoke the current access token.
186:      */
187:     public function logout(Request $request): JsonResponse
188:     {
189:         $request->user()->currentAccessToken()->delete();
190: 
191:         return response()->json(['message' => 'Logged out successfully']);
192:     }
193: 
194:     /**
195:      * Return the authenticated user with their current garage.
196:      */
197:     public function user(Request $request): JsonResponse
198:     {
199:         return response()->json(
200:             $request->user()->load('currentGarage')
201:         );
202:     }
203: 
204:     /**
205:      * Ensure the login request is not rate-limited.
206:      *
207:      * @throws ValidationException
208:      */
209:     private function ensureIsNotRateLimited(Request $request): void
210:     {
211:         $maxAttempts = (int) config('rate_limits.login_attempts', 5);
212: 
213:         if (! RateLimiter::tooManyAttempts($this->throttleKey($request), $maxAttempts)) {
214:             return;
215:         }
216: 
217:         $seconds = RateLimiter::availableIn($this->throttleKey($request));
218: 
219:         Log::warning('API login rate limit hit', [
220:             'email' => $request->email,
221:             'ip' => $request->ip(),
222:             'retry_in' => $seconds,
223:             'request_id' => \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Context::get('request_id'),
224:         ]);
225: 
226:         throw ValidationException::withMessages([
227:             'email' => [
228:                 trans('auth.throttle', [
229:                     'seconds' => $seconds,
230:                     'minutes' => (int) ceil($seconds / 60),
231:                 ]),
232:             ],
233:         ]);
234:     }
235: 
236:     /**
237:      * Build a unique throttle key for the current request.
238:      *
239:      * Combines email + IP address so that an attacker cannot lock out
240:      * a legitimate user by hammering their email from a different IP,
241:      * nor bypass the limit by rotating emails from a single IP.
242:      */
243:     private function throttleKey(Request $request): string
244:     {
245:         return 'api_login:'.Str::transliterate(
246:             Str::lower((string) $request->input('email')).'|'.$request->ip()
247:         );
248:     }
249: }

<file path="app/Http/Controllers/Auth/AuthenticatedSessionController.php">
 1: <?php
 2: 
 3: namespace App\Http\Controllers\Auth;
 4: 
 5: use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
 6: use App\Http\Requests\Auth\LoginRequest;
 7: use App\Services\GarageContext;
 8: use App\Services\PostLoginRedirector;
 9: use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
10: use Illuminate\Http\Request;
11: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;
12: use Illuminate\View\View;
13: 
14: class AuthenticatedSessionController extends Controller
15: {
16:     public function create(): View
17:     {
18:         return view('auth.login');
19:     }
20: 
21:     /**
22:      * Handle an incoming email/password authentication request.
23:      *
24:      * SuperAdmin handling is a two-step flow:
25:      *
26:      *   1. If MFA is already configured, the password step stores the
27:      *      user id in the session and redirects to the TOTP challenge.
28:      *      The user is only logged in after the code is verified.
29:      *
30:      *   2. If MFA is NOT yet configured (a freshly seeded account, or
31:      *      one whose secret was reset), the user is logged in immediately
32:      *      and sent to the setup wizard. Without this branch the flow
33:      *      deadlocks: the challenge needs a secret, the setup screen
34:      *      needs an authenticated session.
35:      */
36:     public function store(LoginRequest $request): RedirectResponse
37:     {
38:         $request->authenticate();
39: 
40:         $request->session()->regenerate();
41: 
42:         $user = Auth::user();
43: 
44:         if (! $user) {
45:             return redirect()->route('login');
46:         }
47: 
48:         // ─── SuperAdmin branch ───
49:         if ($user->isSuperAdmin()) {
50:             $remember = (bool) $request->boolean('remember');
51: 
52:             // First-time SuperAdmin: no confirmed MFA secret yet.
53:             // The user is already authenticated by LoginRequest::authenticate()
54:             // (Auth::attempt + remember flag), so we only need to redirect.
55:             if (! $user->hasTwoFactorEnabled()) {
56:                 return redirect()
57:                     ->route('super-admin.security.2fa.setup')
58:                     ->with('warning', __('messages.two_factor.setup_required'));
59:             }
60: 
61:             // MFA is configured — defer login until the code is verified.
62:             // Log out the session started by authenticate() so the user is
63:             // NOT authenticated while we wait for the TOTP code.
64:             Auth::guard('web')->logout();
65: 
66:             $request->session()->put('two_factor.user_id', $user->id);
67:             $request->session()->put('two_factor.remember', $remember);
68: 
69:             return redirect()->route('two-factor.challenge');
70:         }
71: 
72:         return PostLoginRedirector::redirect($user);
73:     }
74: 
75:     public function destroy(Request $request): RedirectResponse
76:     {
77:         Auth::guard('web')->logout();
78: 
79:         GarageContext::clear();
80: 
81:         $request->session()->invalidate();
82:         $request->session()->regenerateToken();
83: 
84:         return redirect('/')->with('success', __('messages.flash.auth_logged_out'));
85:     }
86: }

<file path="app/Http/Controllers/Auth/ChangePinController.php">
 1: <?php
 2: 
 3: namespace App\Http\Controllers\Auth;
 4: 
 5: use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
 6: use App\Services\GarageContext;
 7: use App\Services\PostLoginRedirector;
 8: use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
 9: use Illuminate\Http\Request;
10: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
11: use Illuminate\View\View;
12: 
13: class ChangePinController extends Controller
14: {
15:     /**
16:      * Show the change PIN form.
17:      */
18:     public function show(): View
19:     {
20:         return view('auth.change-pin');
21:     }
22: 
23:     /**
24:      * Update the PIN.
25:      *
26:      * This controller is reached from two flows:
27:      *
28:      *   1. Forced PIN change after a fresh PIN login (when
29:      *      `pin_is_default` is still true). In this case the user has
30:      *      just logged in but has NOT yet selected a garage — the
31:      *      post-login redirector handles director / auto-select /
32:      *      multi-garage cases.
33:      *
34:      *   2. Voluntary PIN change from the profile page. The user is
35:      *      already logged in with a garage in context; re-running the
36:      *      post-login flow would needlessly re-evaluate membership and
37:      *      could bounce the user away from where they were.
38:      *
39:      * We branch on the presence of a resolved garage context rather
40:      * than on the source of the request, because the redirector is
41:      * the correct answer only in the first case.
42:      */
43:     public function update(Request $request): RedirectResponse
44:     {
45:         $validated = $request->validate([
46:             'current_pin' => ['required', 'string', 'digits_between:4,6'],
47:             'pin' => ['required', 'string', 'digits_between:4,6', 'confirmed', 'different:current_pin'],
48:             'pin_confirmation' => ['required', 'string', 'digits_between:4,6'],
49:         ], [
50:             'pin.different' => __('messages.pin_change.same_as_current'),
51:         ]);
52: 
53:         $user = $request->user();
54: 
55:         if (! $user->pin || ! Hash::check($validated['current_pin'], $user->pin)) {
56:             return back()->withErrors([
57:                 'current_pin' => __('messages.pin_change.incorrect_current'),
58:             ]);
59:         }
60: 
61:         $user->update([
62:             'pin' => Hash::make($validated['pin']),
63:             'pin_is_default' => false,
64:         ]);
65: 
66:         // If a garage is already active, the user came from the
67:         // profile flow — send them straight to the dashboard.
68:         // Otherwise fall back to the post-login redirector, which
69:         // handles director / auto-select / multi-garage cases.
70:         if (GarageContext::resolveGarageId()) {
71:             return redirect()->intended(route('dashboard'))
72:                 ->with('success', __('messages.pin_change.success'));
73:         }
74: 
75:         return PostLoginRedirector::redirect($user);
76:     }
77: }

<file path="app/Http/Controllers/Auth/NewPasswordController.php">

 3: namespace App\Http\Controllers\Auth;

 5: use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
 6: use App\Models\User;
 7: use Illuminate\Auth\Events\PasswordReset;
 8: use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
 9: use Illuminate\Http\Request;
10: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;

24:     {

26:             'token' => ['required'],

30:

44:             ? redirect()->route('login')->with('status', __($status))
45:             : back()->withInput($request->only('email'))
46:                 ->withErrors(['email' => __($status)]);

<file path="app/Http/Controllers/Auth/TwoFactorChallengeController.php">
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: namespace App\Http\Controllers\Auth;
  4: 
  5: use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
  6: use App\Models\User;
  7: use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
  8: use Illuminate\Http\Request;
  9: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;
 10: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Context;
 11: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;
 12: use Illuminate\View\View;
 13: 
 14: /**
 15:  * Second step of the SuperAdmin login flow.
 16:  *
 17:  * The password step stores the authenticated user id in the session
 18:  * under 'two_factor.user_id' and redirects here. Until the TOTP code
 19:  * (or a recovery code) is verified, the user is NOT logged in — this
 20:  * avoids the "authenticated but locked" state that is easy to get
 21:  * wrong with middleware.
 22:  */
 23: class TwoFactorChallengeController extends Controller
 24: {
 25:     /**
 26:      * Show the challenge page.
 27:      */
 28:     public function show(Request $request): View|RedirectResponse
 29:     {
 30:         $userId = $request->session()->get('two_factor.user_id');
 31: 
 32:         if (! $userId) {
 33:             return redirect()->route('login');
 34:         }
 35: 
 36:         return view('auth.two-factor-challenge');
 37:     }
 38: 
 39:     /**
 40:      * Verify the submitted code and complete login.
 41:      */
 42:     public function store(Request $request): RedirectResponse
 43:     {
 44:         $userId = $request->session()->get('two_factor.user_id');
 45: 
 46:         if (! $userId) {
 47:             return redirect()->route('login');
 48:         }
 49: 
 50:         $request->validate([
 51:             'code' => ['required', 'string'],
 52:         ]);
 53: 
 54:         /** @var User|null $user */
 55:         $user = User::find($userId);
 56: 
 57:         // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 58:         // INACTIVE-USER GUARD
 59:         //
 60:         // The password step verified that this account was active at
 61:         // that moment, but an administrator can deactivate the account
 62:         // in the window between the password POST and this TOTP POST.
 63:         //
 64:         // Without this check the user would be logged in one more time
 65:         // (the next request would then trigger EnsureActiveUser to log
 66:         // them out). Closing the gap here avoids that needless session.
 67:         // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 68:         if (! $user || ! $user->is_active) {
 69:             $request->session()->forget('two_factor.user_id');
 70: 
 71:             if ($user && ! $user->is_active) {
 72:                 Log::warning('Inactive user blocked at 2FA challenge', [
 73:                     'user_id' => $user->id,
 74:                     'ip' => $request->ip(),
 75:                     'request_id' => Context::get('request_id'),
 76:                 ]);
 77: 
 78:                 return redirect()->route('login')
 79:                     ->with('error', __('auth.inactive'));
 80:             }
 81: 
 82:             return redirect()->route('login');
 83:         }
 84: 
 85:         $code = trim($request->input('code'));
 86: 
 87:         // Accept either a TOTP code (6 digits) or a recovery code (X-XXXXX-XXXXX).
 88:         $verified = false;
 89: 
 90:         if (preg_match('/^\d{6}$/', $code)) {
 91:             $verified = $user->verifyTwoFactorCode($code);
 92:         }
 93: 
 94:         if (! $verified && str_contains($code, '-')) {
 95:             $verified = $user->useRecoveryCode($code);
 96:         }
 97: 
 98:         if (! $verified) {
 99:             return back()->withErrors([
100:                 'code' => __('messages.two_factor.invalid_code'),
101:             ]);
102:         }
103: 
104:         // Code accepted — complete the login.
105:         Auth::login($user, remember: (bool) $request->session()->pull('two_factor.remember', false));
106: 
107:         $request->session()->forget('two_factor.user_id');
108:         $request->session()->regenerate();
109: 
110:         return redirect()->intended(route('super-admin.dashboard'));
111:     }
112: 
113:     /**
114:      * Abort the challenge and return to login.
115:      */
116:     public function destroy(Request $request): RedirectResponse
117:     {
118:         $request->session()->forget(['two_factor.user_id', 'two_factor.remember']);
119:

 66:     public function show(Request $request, int $id): View
 67:     {
 68:         $bus = Bus::with(['brand', 'latestDailyStatus'])->findOrFail($id);
 69:         $this->authorize('view', $bus);
 70: 
 71:         // ─── KM records (paginated) ───
 72:         $kmRecords = $bus->dailyKmRecords()
 73:             ->paginate(30, ['*'], 'km_page')
 74:             ->withQueryString();
 75: 
 76:         $kmItems = $kmRecords->items();
 77:         $oldestOnPage = ! empty($kmItems) ? $kmItems[count($kmItems) - 1] : null;
 78:         $previousOfOldest = $oldestOnPage
 79:             ? $bus->dailyKmRecords()->where('date', '<', $oldestOnPage->date)->first()
 80:             : null;
 81: 
 82:         foreach ($kmItems as $index => $record) {
 83:             $previous = $kmItems[$index + 1] ?? $previousOfOldest;
 84:             $record->daily_km = $previous !== null
 85:                 ? max(0, $record->km - $previous->km)
 86:                 : null;
 87:         }
 88:         $kmRecords->setCollection(collect($kmItems));
 89: 
 90:         // ─── Status records — filtered by month ───
 91:         $statusMonth = $request->input('status_month');
 92: 
 93:         if (! is_string($statusMonth) || ! preg_match('/^\d{4}-\d{2}$/', $statusMonth)) {
 94:             $statusMonth = now()->format('Y-m');
 95:         }
 96: 
 97:         try {
 98:             $monthStart = Carbon::parse($statusMonth.'-01')->startOfMonth();
 99:         } catch (\Throwable $e) {
100:             $statusMonth = now()->format('Y-m');
101:             $monthStart = now()->startOfMonth();
102:         }
103: 
104:         $monthEnd = $monthStart->copy()->endOfMonth();
105: 
106:         $statusRecords = $bus->dailyStatuses()
107:             ->whereBetween('date', [$monthStart->toDateString(), $monthEnd->toDateString()])
108:             ->paginate(31, ['*'], 'status_page')
109:             ->withQueryString();
110: 
111:         $monthlySummary = $bus->dailyStatuses()
112:             ->reorder()
113:             ->whereBetween('date', [$monthStart->toDateString(), $monthEnd->toDateString()])
114:             ->select('status', DB::raw('COUNT(*) as days'))
115:             ->groupBy('status')
116:             ->orderByDesc('days')
117:             ->get();
118: 
119:         return view('buses.show', compact(
120:             'bus',
121:             'kmRecords',
122:             'statusRecords',
123:             'statusMonth',
124:             'monthStart',
125:             'monthEnd',
126:             'monthlySummary',
127:         ));
128:     }

190:     public function import(Request $request): RedirectResponse
191:     {
192:         // Garage context must be resolved BEFORE authorization.
193:         $garageId = GarageContext::resolveGarageId();
194: 
195:         if ($garageId === null || $garageId <= 0) {
196:             return redirect()
197:                 ->route('garage.selection')
198:                 ->with('error', __('messages.flash.no_current_garage'));
199:         }
200: 
201:         $this->authorize('import', Bus::class);
202: 
203:         $request->validate([
204:             'file' => 'required|mimes:xlsx,xls,csv|max:10240',
205:             'brand_id' => [
206:                 'nullable',
207:                 \Illuminate\Validation\Rule::exists('bus_brands', 'id')->where('garage_id', $garageId),
208:             ],
209:         ]);
210: 
211:         try {
212:             $import = new BusesImport(
213:                 $garageId,
214:                 GarageContext::resolveCompanyId(),
215:                 $request->filled('brand_id') ? (int) $request->input('brand_id') : null,
216:             );
217: 
218:             Excel::import($import, $request->file('file'));
219: 
220:             $skipped = $import->skipped;
221:             $imported = $import->importedCount;
222: 
223:             if (empty($skipped)) {
224:                 return redirect()->route('buses.index')
225:                     ->with('success', __('messages.flash.import_success', [
226:                         'count' => $imported,
227:                         'items' => 'buses',
228:                     ]));
229:             }
230: 
231:             return redirect()->route('buses.index')
232:                 ->with('warning', __('messages.flash.import_partial'))
233:                 ->with('import_report', $this->buildImportReport($imported, $skipped, collect()));
234: 
235:         } catch (\Throwable $e) {
236:             report($e);
237: 
238:             return redirect()->route('buses.index')
239:                 ->with('error', __('messages.flash.import_error'));
240:         }
241:     }

253:     private function bulkUpdateStatus(Request $request, bool $isActive): RedirectResponse
254:     {
255:         $this->authorize('update', Bus::class);
256: 
257:         $ids = $this->normalizeIds($request->input('ids', []));
258: 
259:         if (empty($ids)) {
260:             return back()->with('error', __('messages.flash.none_selected'));
261:         }
262: 
263:         $this->busService->bulkUpdateStatus($ids, $isActive);
264: 
265:         $key = $isActive ? 'bulk_activated' : 'bulk_deactivated';
266: 
267:         return redirect()->route('buses.index')
268:             ->with('success', __('messages.flash.'.$key, [
269:                 'count' => count($ids),
270:                 'items' => 'buses',
271:             ]));
272:     }

274:     public function bulkDelete(Request $request): RedirectResponse
275:     {
276:         $this->authorize('delete', Bus::class);
277: 
278:         $ids = $this->normalizeIds($request->input('ids', []));
279: 
280:         if (empty($ids)) {
281:             return back()->with('error', __('messages.flash.none_selected'));
282:         }
283: 
284:         $this->busService->bulkDelete($ids);
285: 
286:         return redirect()->route('buses.index')

293:     /**
294:      * Bulk soft-delete ALL buses matching the current filter.
295:      */
296:     public function bulkDeleteAll(Request $request): RedirectResponse
297:     {
298:         $this->authorize('delete', Bus::class);
299: 
300:         @set_time_limit(300);
301: 
302:         $filters = $request->only([
303:             'brand_id', 'bus_project', 'vin', 'uzunluq', 'route_number', 'dqn', 'engine_number',
304:         ]);
305: 
306:         $filters = array_filter($filters, fn ($v) => filled($v));
307: 
308:         $count = $this->busService->bulkDeleteAllByFilters($filters);
309: 
310:         if ($count === 0) {
311:             return redirect()
312:                 ->route('buses.index')
313:                 ->with('error', __('messages.flash.none_selected'));
314:         }
315: 
316:         return redirect()
317:             ->route('buses.index')
318:             ->with('success', __('messages.flash.bulk_deleted', [
319:                 'count' => $count,
320:                 'items' => 'buses',
321:             ]));
322:     }
323: 
324:     private function normalizeIds(mixed $ids): array
325:     {
326:         if (is_string($ids)) {
327:             $ids = json_decode($ids, true) ?? [];
328:         }
329: 
330:         if (! is_array($ids)) {
331:             return [];
332:         }
333: 
334:         return array_values(array_filter(array_map('intval', $ids)));
335:     }

 17: class BusDailyStatusController extends Controller
 18: {
 19:     public function index(Request $request)
 20:     {
 21:         $this->authorize('viewAny', BusDailyStatus::class);
 22: 
 23:         // `date` defaults to today for display purposes.
 24:         // However, `dateWasExplicit` records whether the user actually
 25:         // supplied a date filter — this drives the "delete all" button,
 26:         // which wipes every date when no explicit filter is applied.
 27:         $dateWasExplicit = $request->filled('date');
 28:         $date = $dateWasExplicit ? $request->input('date') : now()->toDateString();
 29: 
 30:         $dqn = $request->input('dqn');
 31:         $status = $request->input('status');
 32: 
 33:         $query = BusDailyStatus::with('bus');
 34: 
 35:         // The date filter is applied in both cases (explicit filter or
 36:         // default-to-today). The `dateWasExplicit` flag only affects
 37:         // the "delete all" button's scope, not the listing itself.
 38:         if ($date) {
 39:             $query->whereDate('date', $date);
 40:         }
 41: 
 42:         if ($dqn) {
 43:             $query->whereHas('bus', fn ($q) => $q->where('dqn', 'ILIKE', "%{$dqn}%"));
 44:         }
 45: 
 46:         if ($status) {
 47:             $query->where('status', $status);
 48:         }
 49: 
 50:         $statuses = $query
 51:             ->orderBy('date', 'desc')
 52:             ->orderBy('id', 'desc')
 53:             ->paginate(config('settings.pagination', 15))
 54:             ->withQueryString();
 55: 
 56:         // Select only the `status` column before DISTINCT — otherwise
 57:         // PostgreSQL would sort by the full row, which is wasteful on
 58:         // large tables.
 59:         $availableStatuses = BusDailyStatus::query()
 60:             ->select('status')
 61:             ->distinct()
 62:             ->orderBy('status')
 63:             ->pluck('status')
 64:             ->filter()
 65:             ->values();
 66: 
 67:         // Total record count across ALL dates (used when no explicit
 68:         // date filter is applied — the "delete all" button then wipes
 69:         // the entire garage's status history, not just today's).
 70:         $totalAll = BusDailyStatus::count();
 71: 
 72:         return view('bus-daily-statuses.index', compact(
 73:             'statuses',
 74:             'date',
 75:             'dqn',
 76:             'status',
 77:             'availableStatuses',
 78:             'dateWasExplicit',
 79:             'totalAll',
 80:         ));

259:     /**
260:      * Bulk soft-delete bus daily statuses matching the current filter.
261:      *
262:      * If no explicit date filter is present in the request, the date
263:      * filter is IGNORED — the operation then wipes every status
264:      * record for the current garage, not just today's.
265:      *
266:      * AUDIT NOTE
267:      * ----------
268:      * See DailyKmRecordController::bulkDeleteAll() for the full
269:      * rationale. A raw `$query->delete()` skips Eloquent events and
270:      * therefore the Auditable trait's `deleted` handler — no audit
271:      * log would be written. This method streams IDs in chunks and
272:      * writes the audit snapshot before each chunk's delete, mirroring
273:      * BusService::bulkDeleteAllByFilters().
274:      */
275:     public function bulkDeleteAll(Request $request): RedirectResponse
276:     {
277:         $this->authorize('delete', BusDailyStatus::class);
278: 
279:         @set_time_limit(300);
280: 
281:         $date = $request->filled('date') ? $request->input('date') : null;
282:         $dqn = $request->input('dqn');
283:         $status = $request->input('status');
284: 
285:         $query = BusDailyStatus::query();
286: 
287:         if ($date) {
288:             $query->whereDate('date', $date);
289:         }
290: 
291:         if ($dqn) {
292:             $query->whereHas('bus', fn ($q) => $q->where('dqn', 'ILIKE', "%{$dqn}%"));
293:         }
294: 
295:         if ($status) {
296:             $query->where('status', $status);
297:         }
298: 
299:         $count = 0;
300:         $buffer = [];
301: 
302:         foreach ($query->select('id')->cursor() as $row) {
303:             $buffer[] = $row->id;
304: 
305:             if (count($buffer) >= 500) {
306:                 BusDailyStatus::auditBulkDelete($buffer);
307:                 BusDailyStatus::whereIn('id', $buffer)->delete();
308:                 $count += count($buffer);
309:                 $buffer = [];
310:             }
311:         }
312: 
313:         if (! empty($buffer)) {
314:             BusDailyStatus::auditBulkDelete($buffer);
315:             BusDailyStatus::whereIn('id', $buffer)->delete();
316:             $count += count($buffer);
317:         }
318: 
319:         if ($count === 0) {
320:             return redirect()
321:                 ->route('bus-daily-statuses.index')
322:                 ->with('error', __('messages.flash.none_selected'));
323:         }
324: 
325:         return redirect()
326:             ->route('bus-daily-statuses.index')
327:             ->with('success', __('messages.flash.bulk_deleted', [
328:                 'count' => $count,
329:                 'items' => 'statuses',
330:             ]));
331:     }
332: }

244:     /**

246:      *
247:      * Memory-safe: the ID stream is pulled from the database in
248:      * fixed-size chunks via ComplaintService::bulkDeleteByQuery().
249:      *
250:      * If a chunk fails partway through, the earlier chunks stay
251:      * committed and the controller reports the partial count with an
252:      * explicit warning — otherwise the operator would see a clean
253:      * "N deleted" success message while a large remainder was left
254:      * untouched.
255:      */
256:     public function bulkDeleteAll(Request $request): RedirectResponse
257:     {

268:                 ->route('complaints.index')
269:                 ->with('error', __('messages.flash.none_selected'));
270:         }
271: 
272:         // Partial failure: report both the count and the fact that the
273:         // operation stopped early.
274:         if ($result['error'] !== null) {
275:             return redirect()
276:                 ->route('complaints.index')
277:                 ->with('warning', __('messages.flash.bulk_delete_partial', [
278:                     'count' => $result['deleted'],

280:                 ]));
281:         }
282: 
283:         return redirect()
284:             ->route('complaints.index')
285:             ->with('success', __('messages.flash.bulk_deleted', [
286:                 'count' => $result['deleted'],
287:                 'items' => 'cards',
288:             ]));

362:         }

365: 
366:         if (! file_exists($filePath)) {
367:             abort(404, __('messages.flash.pdf_not_found'));

369:

383:     public function import(Request $request): RedirectResponse
384:     {
385:         $garageId = GarageContext::resolveGarageId();
386: 
387:         if ($garageId === null || $garageId <= 0) {
388:             return redirect()
389:                 ->route('garage.selection')
390:                 ->with('error', __('messages.flash.no_current_garage'));
391:         }
392: 
393:         $this->authorize('import', Complaint::class);
394: 
395:         $request->validate([
396:             'file' => 'required|mimes:xlsx,xls,csv|max:10240',
397:             'historical' => 'nullable|boolean',
398:         ]);
399: 
400:         $deductStock = ! $request->boolean('historical');
401: 
402:         try {
403:             $import = new ComplaintsImport(
404:                 $garageId,
405:                 GarageContext::resolveCompanyId(),
406:                 deductStock: $deductStock,
407:             );
408: 
409:             Excel::import($import, $request->file('file'));
410: 
411:             $skipped = $import->skipped;
412:             $failures = method_exists($import, 'failures') ? $import->failures() : collect();
413:             $imported = $import->importedCount;
414: 
415:             if (empty($skipped) && $failures->isEmpty()) {
416:                 $message = $deductStock
417:                     ? __('messages.flash.import_success', [
418:                         'count' => $imported,
419:                         'items' => 'cards',
420:                     ])
421:                     : __('messages.complaints.import_success_historical', [
422:                         'count' => $imported,
423:                     ]);
424: 
425:                 return redirect()->route('complaints.index')->with('success', $message);
426:             }
427: 
428:             return redirect()->route('complaints.index')
429:                 ->with('warning', __('messages.flash.import_partial'))
430:                 ->with('import_report', $this->buildImportReport($imported, $skipped, $failures));
431: 
432:         } catch (\Throwable $e) {
433:             report($e);
434: 
435:             return redirect()->route('complaints.index')
436:                 ->with('error', __('messages.flash.import_error'));
437:         }
438:     }
439: 
440:     // ==================== HELPERS ====================
441: 
442:     /**
443:      * Build the complaint query with every filter applied.
444:      *
445:      * Shared between index() and search() so that the filter rules
446:      * stay in sync no matter how the list is requested.
447:      */
448:     private function buildFilteredQuery(Request $request): Builder
449:     {
450:         $query = Complaint::with(['bus', 'items', 'details', 'serviceVehicle']);
451: 
452:         // ─── Free-text search ───
453:         // Matches bus DQN, bus route, or any complaint item description.
454:         if ($request->filled('search')) {
455:             $search = $request->search;
456: 
457:             $query->where(function ($q) use ($search) {
458:                 $q->whereHas('bus', function ($bq) use ($search) {
459:                     $bq->where('dqn', 'ILIKE', "%{$search}%")
460:                         ->orWhere('route_number', 'ILIKE', "%{$search}%");
461:                 })->orWhereHas('items', function ($iq) use ($search) {
462:                     $iq->where('description', 'ILIKE', "%{$search}%");
463:                 });
464:             });
465:         }
466: 
467:         // ─── Status ───
468:         if ($request->filled('status')) {
469:             $query->where('status', $request->status);
470:         }
471: 
472:         // ─── Complaint type ───
473:         if ($request->filled('complaint_type')) {
474:             $query->where('complaint_type', $request->complaint_type);
475:         }
476: 
477:         // ─── Location (road / garage) ───
478:         if ($request->filled('yer')) {
479:             $query->where('yer', $request->yer);
480:         }
481: 
482:         // ─── Date range ───
483:         // Prefer the operator-supplied work date. Falls back to
484:         // start_date, then created_at, using COALESCE at the SQL level
485:         // so the fallback is evaluated per row.
486:         if ($request->filled('date_from') || $request->filled('date_to')) {
487:             $effectiveDate = 'COALESCE(reported_date, start_date, created_at::date)';
488: 
489:             if ($request->filled('date_from')) {
490:                 $query->whereRaw("{$effectiveDate} >= ?", [$request->date_from]);
491:             }
492: 
493:             if ($request->filled('date_to')) {
494:                 $query->whereRaw("{$effectiveDate} <= ?", [$request->date_to]);
495:             }
496:         }
497: 
498:         return $query;
499:     }
500: 
501:     /**
502:      * Normalize an array of IDs coming from the bulk-selection form.
503:      *
504:      * Handles both JSON strings (submitted by the browser) and plain
505:      * arrays, and strips anything that is not a positive integer.
506:      *
507:      * @return array<int>
508:      */
509:     private function normalizeIds(mixed $ids): array
510:     {
511:         if (is_string($ids)) {
512:             $ids = json_decode($ids, true) ?? [];
513:         }
514: 
515:         if (! is_array($ids)) {
516:             return [];
517:         }
518: 
519:         return array_values(array_filter(
520:             array_map('intval', $ids),
521:             fn (int $id) => $id > 0
522:         ));
523:     }
524: }

  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: namespace App\Http\Controllers;
  4: 
  5: use Illuminate\Database\QueryException;
  6: use Illuminate\Foundation\Auth\Access\AuthorizesRequests;
  7: use Illuminate\Http\Request;
  8: 
  9: abstract class Controller
 10: {
 11:     use AuthorizesRequests;
 12: 
 13:     /**
 14:      * Ensure the authenticated user is a super admin.
 15:      *
 16:      * Note: Super-admin routes are already protected by the
 17:      * `super.admin` middleware. This method is a defense-in-depth
 18:      * guard for code paths that may not be behind that middleware.
 19:      */
 20:     protected function ensureSuperAdmin(): void
 21:     {
 22:         abort_unless(
 23:             auth()->user()?->isSuperAdmin() === true,
 24:             403,
 25:             __('messages.flash.permission_denied')
 26:         );
 27:     }
 28: 
 29:     /**
 30:      * True when the given throwable is a PostgreSQL unique-violation
 31:      * (SQLSTATE 23505). Used to turn a race condition between an
 32:      * "is this unique?" pre-check and the subsequent insert into a
 33:      * friendly validation error instead of a raw 500 stack trace.
 34:      */
 35:     protected function isUniqueViolation(\Throwable $e): bool
 36:     {
 37:         return $e instanceof QueryException
 38:             && ($e->errorInfo[0] ?? null) === '23505';
 39:     }
 40: 
 41:     /**
 42:      * True when the request should receive a partial view instead of
 43:      * the full page.
 44:      *
 45:      * The project has two AJAX detection conventions:
 46:      *   1. The standard `X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest` header
 47:      *      (sent automatically by jQuery/Axios/Alpine).
 48:      *   2. A fallback `_ajax=1` query/body parameter used by a few
 49:      *      legacy front-end scripts that do not set the header.
 50:      *
 51:      * `$request->ajax()` is deprecated in Laravel 11+, so we check
 52:      * the header directly.
 53:      *
 54:      * Centralized here so every AJAX-aware controller shares the
 55:      * exact same detection rule. Before this refactor the same
 56:      * 3-line method was duplicated across five controllers.
 57:      */
 58:     protected function isAjaxRequest(Request $request): bool
 59:     {
 60:         return $request->header('X-Requested-With') === 'XMLHttpRequest'
 61:             || $request->boolean('_ajax');
 62:     }
 63: 
 64:     /**
 65:      * Build a structured import report.
 66:      *
 67:      * @param  int  $imported  Successful rows count
 68:      * @param  array<int, array{row: int, dqn: string, reason: string}>  $skipped  Manually skipped rows
 69:      * @param  \Illuminate\Support\Collection  $failures  Validation failures
 70:      * @return array{imported: int, skipped: array, failed: array}
 71:      */
 72:     protected function buildImportReport(int $imported, array $skipped, $failures): array
 73:     {
 74:         $report = [
 75:             'imported' => $imported,
 76:             'skipped' => [],
 77:             'failed' => [],
 78:         ];
 79: 
 80:         foreach ($skipped as $row) {
 81:             $report['skipped'][] = [
 82:                 'row' => $row['row'] ?? '—',
 83:                 'dqn' => $row['dqn'] ?? '—',
 84:                 'reason' => $row['reason'] ?? 'Unknown reason',
 85:             ];
 86:         }
 87: 
 88:         foreach ($failures as $failure) {
 89:             $values = $failure->values();
 90:             $report['failed'][] = [
 91:                 'row' => $failure->row(),
 92:                 'dqn' => $values['bus_dqn']
 93:                     ?? $values['dqn']
 94:                     ?? $values['kodu']
 95:                     ?? $values['code']
 96:                     ?? $values['ad']
 97:                     ?? $values['first_name']
 98:                     ?? '—',
 99:                 'reason' => implode(', ', $failure->errors()),
100:             ];
101:         }
102: 
103:         return $report;
104:     }
105: }

 69:     public function store(DailyKmStoreRequest $request)
 70:     {
 71:         $this->authorize('create', DailyKmRecord::class);
 72: 
 73:         $validated = $request->validated();
 74: 
 75:         $bus = Bus::findOrFail($request->bus_id);
 76: 
 77:         $previousKm = $bus->dailyKmRecords()
 78:             ->whereDate('date', '<', $request->date)
 79:             ->orderByDesc('date')
 80:             ->first();
 81: 
 82:         $nextKm = $bus->dailyKmRecords()
 83:             ->whereDate('date', '>', $request->date)
 84:             ->orderBy('date')
 85:             ->first();
 86: 
 87:         if ($previousKm && $request->km <= $previousKm->km) {
 88:             return back()->withErrors([
 89:                 'km' => __('messages.flash.km_must_be_greater', ['km' => $previousKm->km]),
 90:             ])->withInput();
 91:         }
 92: 
 93:         if ($nextKm && $request->km >= $nextKm->km) {
 94:             return back()->withErrors([
 95:                 'km' => __('messages.flash.km_must_be_less', ['km' => $nextKm->km]),
 96:             ])->withInput();
 97:         }
 98: 
 99:         $exists = DailyKmRecord::where('bus_id', $request->bus_id)
100:             ->whereDate('date', $request->date)
101:             ->whereNull('deleted_at')
102:             ->exists();
103: 
104:         if ($exists) {
105:             return back()->withErrors([
106:                 'date' => __('messages.flash.km_already_recorded', ['date' => $request->date]),
107:             ])->withInput();
108:         }
109: 
110:         try {
111:             DailyKmRecord::create($validated);
112:         } catch (\Throwable $e) {
113:             // Race-condition guard: another request may have inserted
114:             // the same (bus, date) between our exists() check and the
115:             // create(). The partial unique index rejects the second
116:             // insert with SQLSTATE 23505; surface it as a normal
117:             // validation error instead of a raw 500.

119:                 throw $e;
120:             }

124:             ])->withInput();
125:         }

128:             ->with('success', __('messages.flash.created', ['Item' => 'KM record']));

294:     /**
295:      * Bulk soft-delete daily KM records matching the current filter.
296:      *
297:      * If no explicit date filter is present in the request, the date
298:      * filter is IGNORED — the operation then wipes every KM record
299:      * for the current garage, not just today's.
300:      *
301:      * AUDIT NOTE
302:      * ----------
303:      * A raw `$query->delete()` bypasses Eloquent per-model events,
304:      * so the Auditable trait's `deleted` handler never runs and no
305:      * audit log is written. We mirror the pattern used by
306:      * BusService::bulkDeleteAllByFilters():
307:      *
308:      *   1. Stream IDs from the database via cursor() in chunks of 500.
309:      *   2. Write the audit snapshot BEFORE each chunk's delete.
310:      *   3. Delete the chunk in one query.
311:      *
312:      * Chunking keeps memory usage flat for very large datasets (a
313:      * garage can accumulate hundreds of thousands of KM rows) and
314:      * keeps the audit snapshot in sync with what was actually deleted.
315:      */
316:     public function bulkDeleteAll(Request $request): RedirectResponse
317:     {
318:         $this->authorize('delete', DailyKmRecord::class);
319: 
320:         @set_time_limit(300);
321: 
322:         $date = $request->filled('date') ? $request->input('date') : null;
323:         $dqn = $request->input('dqn');
324: 
325:         $query = DailyKmRecord::query();
326: 
327:         if ($date) {
328:             $query->whereDate('date', $date);
329:         }
330: 
331:         if ($dqn) {
332:             $query->whereHas('bus', fn ($q) => $q->where('dqn', 'ILIKE', "%{$dqn}%"));
333:         }
334: 
335:         $count = 0;
336:         $buffer = [];
337: 
338:         foreach ($query->select('id')->cursor() as $row) {
339:             $buffer[] = $row->id;
340: 
341:             if (count($buffer) >= 500) {
342:                 DailyKmRecord::auditBulkDelete($buffer);
343:                 DailyKmRecord::whereIn('id', $buffer)->delete();
344:                 $count += count($buffer);
345:                 $buffer = [];
346:             }
347:         }
348: 
349:         if (! empty($buffer)) {
350:             DailyKmRecord::auditBulkDelete($buffer);
351:             DailyKmRecord::whereIn('id', $buffer)->delete();
352:             $count += count($buffer);
353:         }
354: 
355:         if ($count === 0) {
356:             return redirect()
357:                 ->route('daily-km-records.index')
358:                 ->with('error', __('messages.flash.none_selected'));
359:         }
360: 
361:         return redirect()
362:             ->route('daily-km-records.index')
363:             ->with('success', __('messages.flash.bulk_deleted', [
364:                 'count' => $count,
365:                 'items' => 'KM records',
366:             ]));
367:     }
368: }
