  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: namespace App\Http\Controllers;
  4: 
  5: use App\Enums\OilType;
  6: use App\Enums\TransferStatus;
  7: use App\Models\Bus;
  8: use App\Models\Complaint;
  9: use App\Models\ComplaintItem;
 10: use App\Models\Warehouse;
 11: use App\Models\WarehouseTransfer;
 12: use App\Services\GarageContext;
 13: use App\Services\OilChange\OilChangeStatusService;
 14: use Illuminate\Support\Collection;
 15: 
 16: class DashboardController extends Controller
 17: {
 18:     /**
 19:      * Dashboard for the currently selected garage.
 20:      *
 21:      * Access control is enforced by the route middleware:
 22:      *   - auth              — user must be logged in
 23:      *   - garage.selected   — user must have an active garage context
 24:      */
 25:     public function index()
 26:     {
 27:         // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 28:         // KPI aggregation — one query instead of two separate COUNTs.
 29:         // The CASE/SUM pattern is well supported by PostgreSQL and
 30:         // avoids a second full scan on the buses table.
 31:         // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 32:         $busStats = Bus::query()
 33:             ->selectRaw('COUNT(*) as total')
 34:             ->selectRaw('SUM(CASE WHEN is_active THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as active')
 35:             ->first();
 36: 
 37:         $totalBuses = (int) ($busStats->total ?? 0);
 38:         $activeBuses = (int) ($busStats->active ?? 0);
 39: 
 40:         $activeComplaints = Complaint::open()->count();
 41:         // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 42:         // Quarantine guard
 43:         // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 44:         // Quarantine rows represent DEFECTIVE / unusable stock —
 45:         // see Warehouse::scopeQuarantine() and the migration
 46:         // 2026_09_16_110930. They must not contribute to the active
 47:         // stock KPI, and they must not appear in the low-stock
 48:         // alert list (which is a restocking signal for usable
 49:         // parts). Both queries therefore go through the
 50:         // activeStock() scope.
 51:         $totalWarehouseItems = Warehouse::activeStock()->sum('quantity');
 52: 
 53:         $recentBuses = Bus::orderBy('id', 'desc')->limit(5)->get();
 54: 
 55:         // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 56:         // Low-stock panel: two separate queries.
 57:         //
 58:         // The DISPLAY list is capped at 10 rows for the dashboard
 59:         // panel, but the COUNT shown to the user must reflect the
 60:         // total number of low-stock items — otherwise a garage with
 61:         // 42 low-stock items would only see "10 items at critical
 62:         // level" and underestimate the problem.
 63:         // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 64:         $lowStockItemsQuery = Warehouse::activeStock()
 65:             ->whereColumn('quantity', '<=', 'minimum_quantity');
 66: 
 67:         $lowStockItemsCount = $lowStockItemsQuery->count();
 68: 
 69:         $lowStockItems = (clone $lowStockItemsQuery)
 70:             ->orderBy('quantity', 'asc')
 71:             ->limit(10)
 72:             ->get();
 73: 
 74:         // NOTE: `$busesWithoutKmTodayQuery` is intentionally NOT
 75:         // computed here. It depends on `$today`, which is defined
 76:         // later in this method. An earlier (orphaned) block used to
 77:         // reference it before its definition — a leftover from an
 78:         // incomplete refactor that caused a 500 on every dashboard
 79:         // load. The correct block lives below, right after `$today`.
 80: 
 81:         $recentComplaints = Complaint::with('bus', 'items')
 82:             ->open()
 83:             ->orderBy('id', 'desc')
 84:             ->limit(10)
 85:             ->get();
 86: 
 87:         $recurringIssues = ComplaintItem::recurring(30)->get();
 88: 
 89:         // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 90:         // Oil change stats + alerts — ONE bus query, ONE pass.
 91:         // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 92:         [$oilStats, $oilAlerts] = $this->computeOilChangeData();
 93: 
 94:         $today = now()->toDateString();
 95: 
 96:         // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 97:         // Inactive-bus guard
 98:         // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 99:         // An inactive bus (in repair, sold, retired) does not need
100:         // a daily KM entry — same reasoning as the oil-change
101:         // panel above and DailyKmReportService::missing(), both of
102:         // which already filter to active buses only.
103:         //
104:         // Without this filter the dashboard counted every bus in
105:         // the garage and reported a number larger than the one
106:         // the "missing KM" report showed on the next click.
107:         // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
108:         $busesWithoutKmTodayQuery = Bus::where('is_active', true)
109:             ->whereDoesntHave('dailyKmRecords', function ($query) use ($today) {
110:                 $query->whereDate('date', $today);
111:             });
112: 
113:         $busesWithoutKmTodayCount = $busesWithoutKmTodayQuery->count();
114:         $busesWithoutKmToday = (clone $busesWithoutKmTodayQuery)->limit(10)->get();
115:         // ─── Transfer notifications ───
116:         $garageId = GarageContext::getGarageId();
117: 
118:         $outboundPending = WarehouseTransfer::query()
119:             ->visibleToGarage($garageId)
120:             ->outbound($garageId)
121:             ->where('status', TransferStatus::Dispatched->value)
122:             ->count();
123: 
124:         $inboundPending = WarehouseTransfer::query()
125:             ->visibleToGarage($garageId)
126:             ->inbound($garageId)
127:             ->where('status', TransferStatus::Dispatched->value)
128:             ->count();
129: 
130:         $disputedCount = WarehouseTransfer::query()
131:             ->visibleToGarage($garageId)
132:             ->where('status', TransferStatus::Disputed->value)
133:             ->count();
134: 
135:         // Only fetch the pending list when there is something to show.
136:         $pendingTransfers = ($outboundPending + $inboundPending + $disputedCount) > 0
137:             ? WarehouseTransfer::query()
138:                 ->visibleToGarage($garageId)
139:                 ->with(['fromGarage', 'toGarage', 'toServiceVehicle'])
140:                 ->pending()
141:                 ->orderByDesc('id')
142:                 ->limit(5)
143:                 ->get()
144:             : collect();
145: 
146:         return view('dashboard', compact(
147:             'totalBuses',
148:             'activeBuses',
149:             'activeComplaints',
150:             'totalWarehouseItems',
151:             'recentBuses',
152:             'lowStockItems',
153:             'lowStockItemsCount',
154:             'recentComplaints',
155:             'recurringIssues',
156:             'busesWithoutKmToday',
157:             'busesWithoutKmTodayCount',
158:             'outboundPending',
159:             'inboundPending',
160:             'disputedCount',
161:             'pendingTransfers',
162:             'oilStats',
163:             'oilAlerts',
164:         ));
165:     }
166: 
167:     /**
168:      * Compute both oil-change statistics and the alert list in a single
169:      * pass over the active bus list.
170:      *
171:      * MEMORY NOTE
172:      * -----------
173:      * The buses are eager-loaded with three dedicated "latest"
174:      * relations — one per oil type — instead of the full `oilChanges`
175:      * history. This keeps memory usage flat as the fleet grows:
176:      *
177:      *   - Before: `with('oilChanges')` → N buses × M history rows.
178:      *   - After:  three `latestOfMany` relations → N buses × 3 models.
179:      *
180:      * The OilChangeStatusService::forBus() call transparently picks
181:      * up whichever relation is loaded — see resolveLastChange() for
182:      * the priority chain.
183:      *
184:      * @return array{0: array<string,int>, 1: Collection<int, array{bus: Bus, statuses: Collection, min_remaining: int}>}
185:      */
186:     private function computeOilChangeData(int $alertLimit = 15): array
187:     {
188:         $stats = [
189:             'overdue' => 0,
190:             'critical' => 0,
191:             'due-soon' => 0,
192:             'ok' => 0,
193:             'no-history' => 0,
194:             'total_attention' => 0,
195:         ];
196: 
197:         // ONE eager-loaded query for the whole request. See the
198:         // method docblock for why we load the three "latest" relations
199:         // instead of the full `oilChanges` history.
200:         $buses = Bus::with([
201:             'latestMotorOilChange',
202:             'latestGearboxOilChange',
203:             'latestAxleOilChange',
204:             'latestKmRecord',
205:         ])
206:             ->where('is_active', true)
207:             ->get();
208: 
209:         if ($buses->isEmpty()) {
210:             return [$stats, collect()];
211:         }
212: 
213:         $service = app(OilChangeStatusService::class);
214:         $alerts = collect();
215: 
216:         foreach ($buses as $bus) {
217:             $busStatuses = collect();
218:             $minRemaining = PHP_INT_MAX;
219: 
220:             foreach (OilType::cases() as $type) {
221:                 $status = $service->forBus($bus, $type);
222: 
223:                 if (isset($stats[$status->status])) {
224:                     $stats[$status->status]++;
225:                 }
226: 
227:                 if (in_array($status->status, ['overdue', 'critical'], true)) {
228:                     $busStatuses->push($status);
229:                     $minRemaining = min($minRemaining, (int) $status->remainingKm);
230:                 }
231:             }
232: 
233:             if ($busStatuses->isNotEmpty()) {
234:                 $alerts->push([
235:                     'bus' => $bus,
236:                     'statuses' => $busStatuses,
237:                     'min_remaining' => $minRemaining,
238:                 ]);
239:             }
240:         }
241: 
242:         $stats['total_attention'] = $stats['overdue']
243:             + $stats['critical']
244:             + $stats['due-soon'];
245: 
246:         $alerts = $alerts
247:             ->sortBy('min_remaining')
248:             ->take($alertLimit)
249:             ->values();
250: 
251:         return [$stats, $alerts];
252:     }
253: }
</file>

<file path="app/Http/Controllers/Director/DirectorController.php">
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: namespace App\Http\Controllers\Director;
  4: 
  5: use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
  6: use App\Models\Bus;
  7: use App\Models\Company;
  8: use App\Models\Complaint;
  9: use App\Models\Garage;
 10: use App\Models\Warehouse;
 11: use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
 12: use Illuminate\View\View;
 13: 
 14: /**
 15:  * Read-only, company-scoped controller for Company Directors.
 16:  *
 17:  * Directors do NOT have garage context and cannot modify data.
 18:  * All queries are explicitly filtered by the Director's company.
 19:  */
 20: class DirectorController extends Controller
 21: {
 22:     /**
 23:      * Company-wide dashboard: aggregated KPIs + garage list.
 24:      */
 25:     public function dashboard(): View|RedirectResponse
 26:     {
 27:         $company = $this->resolveCompany();
 28: 
 29:         if (! $company) {
 30:             return redirect()->route('login')
 31:                 ->with('error', __('messages.flash.director_no_company'));
 32:         }
 33: 
 34:         $garageIds = $company->garages()->pluck('id');
 35: 
 36:         $stats = [
 37:             'total_garages' => $garageIds->count(),
 38:             'active_garages' => $company->garages()->where('is_active', true)->count(),
 39:             'total_buses' => $this->busQuery($garageIds)->count(),
 40:             'active_buses' => $this->busQuery($garageIds)->where('is_active', true)->count(),
 41:             'open_complaints' => $this->complaintQuery($garageIds)->open()->count(),
 42: 
 43:             // Only active (non-quarantine) stock counts toward the KPI.
 44:             // Mirrors DashboardController::index() — see the quarantine
 45:             // guard comment there. Quarantine rows represent defective /
 46:             // unusable stock and must not inflate the total.
 47:             'total_warehouse_items' => $this->warehouseQuery($garageIds)
 48:                 ->activeStock()
 49:                 ->sum('quantity'),
 50:         ];
 51: 
 52:         $garages = $company->garages()
 53:             ->withCount([
 54:                 'buses',
 55:                 'complaints as open_complaints_count' => fn ($q) => $q->open(),
 56:             ])
 57:             ->orderBy('name')
 58:             ->get();
 59: 
 60:         return view('director.dashboard', compact('company', 'stats', 'garages'));
 61:     }
 62: 
 63:     /**
 64:      * Read-only list of all garages under the Director's company.
 65:      */
 66:     public function garages(): View|RedirectResponse
 67:     {
 68:         $company = $this->resolveCompany();
 69: 
 70:         if (! $company) {
 71:             return redirect()->route('login')
 72:                 ->with('error', __('messages.flash.director_no_company'));
 73:         }
 74: 
 75:         $garages = $company->garages()
 76:             ->withCount(['buses', 'complaints', 'warehouses', 'employees', 'drivers'])
 77:             ->orderBy('name')
 78:             ->get();
 79: 
 80:         return view('director.garages.index', compact('company', 'garages'));
 81:     }
 82: 
 83:     /**
 84:      * Read-only summary of a specific garage.
 85:      */
 86:     public function showGarage(Garage $garage): View|RedirectResponse
 87:     {
 88:         $company = $this->resolveCompany();
 89: 
 90:         // Security: ensure the garage belongs to the Director's company.
 91:         if (! $company || $garage->company_id !== $company->id) {
 92:             abort(403);
 93:         }
 94: 
 95:         $stats = [
 96:             'total_buses' => $this->busQuery([$garage->id])->count(),
 97:             'active_buses' => $this->busQuery([$garage->id])->where('is_active', true)->count(),
 98:             'open_complaints' => $this->complaintQuery([$garage->id])->open()->count(),
 99:             'total_employees' => $garage->employees()->count(),
100:             'total_drivers' => $garage->drivers()->count(),
101:         ];
102: 
103:         return view('director.garages.show', compact('company', 'garage', 'stats'));
104:     }
105: 
106:     // ==================== HELPERS ====================
107: 
108:     /**
109:      * Resolve the active Director company for the authenticated user.
110:      */
111:     private function resolveCompany(): ?Company
112:     {
113:         return auth()->user()?->activeDirectorCompany();
114:     }
115: 
116:     /**
117:      * Bus query builder — explicitly company-scoped, ignoring the garage global scope.
118:      *
119:      * @param  \Illuminate\Support\Collection|array<int>  $garageIds
120:      */
121:     private function busQuery($garageIds)
122:     {
123:         return Bus::withoutGlobalScope('garage')->whereIn('garage_id', $garageIds);
124:     }
125: 
126:     /**
127:      * Complaint query builder — explicitly company-scoped.
128:      *
129:      * @param  \Illuminate\Support\Collection|array<int>  $garageIds
130:      */
131:     private function complaintQuery($garageIds)
132:     {
133:         return Complaint::withoutGlobalScope('garage')->whereIn('garage_id', $garageIds);
134:     }
135: 
136:     /**
137:      * Warehouse query builder — explicitly company-scoped.
138:      *
139:      * @param  \Illuminate\Support\Collection|array<int>  $garageIds
140:      */
141:     private function warehouseQuery($garageIds)
142:     {
143:         return Warehouse::withoutGlobalScope('garage')->whereIn('garage_id', $garageIds);
144:     }
145: }

 13: /**
 14:  * Read-only transfer reports for Company Directors.
 15:  *
 16:  * Reuses the exact same report service and Blade views as the
 17:  * garage-level TransferReportController. The only differences are:
 18:  *
 19:  *   - Route prefix: `director.reports.transfer.*`
 20:  *   - Scope: ReportScope::for($director, 'transfer') returns every
 21:  *     garage in the director's company, so the same service methods
 22:  *     produce company-wide aggregates without any code change here.
 23:  *   - Shell detection: the layout reads the route prefix and adjusts
 24:  *     the tab route names, so the same Blade views render correctly
 25:  *     for both audiences.
 26:  *
 27:  * EXPORT SUPPORT
 28:  * --------------
 29:  * Every method accepts `?export=xlsx` on the query string. When set,
 30:  * the same rows that would be rendered in the HTML table are written
 31:  * to an .xlsx file via GenericReportExport. This matches the pattern
 32:  * already used by DirectorWarehouseReportController and
 33:  * DirectorComplaintReportController.
 34:  */
 35: class DirectorTransferReportController extends ReportController
 36: {
 37:     public function __construct(
 38:         protected TransferReportService $service
 39:     ) {}
 40: 
 41:     // ==================================================================
 42:     // 1. SUMMARY — headline counters + status / type breakdown
 43:     // ==================================================================
 44: 
 45:     public function summary(Request $request): View|BinaryFileResponse
 46:     {
 47:         $period = $this->period($request);
 48:         $scope = $this->scope('transfer');
 49: 
 50:         $summary = $this->service->summary($period, $scope);
 51: 
 52:         if ($export = $this->maybeExport(
 53:             request: $request,
 54:             basename: 'director-transfer-summary',
 55:             headings: [
 56:                 __('messages.reports.content.total'),
 57:                 __('messages.transfers.report.outbound'),
 58:                 __('messages.transfers.report.inbound'),
 59:                 __('messages.transfers.report.items_moved'),
 60:                 __('messages.transfers.report.received'),
 61:                 __('messages.transfers.report.disputed'),
 62:                 __('messages.transfers.report.dispute_rate'),
 63:             ],
 64:             rows: [[
 65:                 (int) $summary['total'],
 66:                 (int) $summary['outbound'],
 67:                 (int) $summary['inbound'],
 68:                 (int) $summary['items_moved'],
 69:                 (int) $summary['received'],
 70:                 (int) $summary['disputed'],
 71:                 $summary['dispute_rate'].'%',
 72:             ]],
 73:         )) {
 74:             return $export;
 75:         }
 76: 
 77:         return $this->render('summary', $period, $scope, [
 78:             'summary' => $summary,
 79:         ]);
 80:     }
 81: 
 82:     // ==================================================================
 83:     // 2. DETAILED — one row per transfer line item
 84:     // ==================================================================
 85: 
 86:     public function detailed(Request $request): View|BinaryFileResponse
 87:     {
 88:         $period = $this->period($request);
 89:         $scope = $this->scope('transfer');
 90: 
 91:         $rows = $this->service->detailed($period, $scope);
 92: 
 93:         if ($export = $this->maybeExport(
 94:             request: $request,
 95:             basename: 'director-transfer-detailed',
 96:             headings: [
 97:                 __('messages.transfers.report.summary'),
 98:                 __('messages.reports.content.date'),
 99:                 __('messages.transfers.from_garage'),
100:                 __('messages.transfers.to_garage'),
101:                 __('messages.transfers.type'),
102:                 __('messages.complaints.part_code'),
103:                 __('messages.complaints.part_name'),
104:                 __('messages.transfers.declared_qty'),
105:                 __('messages.transfers.received_qty'),
106:                 __('messages.transfers.status'),
107:             ],
108:             rows: $rows->map(function ($row) {
109:                 // Destination label — garage name OR service vehicle.
110:                 $to = $row->to_garage_name
111:                     ? $row->to_garage_name.($row->to_garage_code ? ' ('.$row->to_garage_code.')' : '')
112:                     : ($row->to_vehicle_name ? '🚐 '.$row->to_vehicle_name : '—');
113: 
114:                 // Human-readable type / status labels (falls back to
115:                 // the raw enum value if the enum case was removed).
116:                 try {
117:                     $typeLabel = TransferType::from($row->type)->label();
118:                 } catch (\Throwable $e) {
119:                     $typeLabel = $row->type;
120:                 }
121: 
122:                 try {
123:                     $statusLabel = TransferStatus::from($row->status)->label();
124:                 } catch (\Throwable $e) {
125:                     $statusLabel = $row->status;
126:                 }
127: 
128:                 return [
129:                     '#'.$row->transfer_id,
130:                     \Carbon\Carbon::parse($row->created_at)->format('d.m.Y H:i'),
131:                     $row->from_garage_name.($row->from_garage_code ? ' ('.$row->from_garage_code.')' : ''),
132:                     $to,
133:                     $typeLabel,
134:                     $row->code,
135:                     $row->part_name,
136:                     (int) $row->declared_quantity,
137:                     $row->received_quantity !== null ? (int) $row->received_quantity : '',
138:                     $statusLabel,
139:                 ];
140:             })->all(),
141:         )) {
142:             return $export;
143:         }
144: 
145:         return $this->render('detailed', $period, $scope, [
146:             'rows' => $rows,
147:         ]);
148:     }

 73:     public function serviceTemplates(int $busId)
 74:     {
 75:         $bus = Bus::findOrFail($busId);
 76: 
 77:         // Cache key MUST include garage_id AND brand_id — otherwise
 78:         // the first brand's template list would be served to every
 79:         // other brand in the same garage for the next hour.
 80:         $brandKey = $bus->brand_id ?? 'none';
 81:         $cacheKey = "service_templates:garage:{$bus->garage_id}:brand:{$brandKey}";
 82: 
 83:         $templates = Cache::remember($cacheKey, 3600, function () use ($bus) {
 84:             return ServiceTemplate::where('brand_id', $bus->brand_id)
 85:                 ->orderBy('default_km_interval')
 86:                 ->get();
 87:         });
 88: 
 89:         $intervals = BusServiceInterval::where('bus_id', $bus->id)
 90:             ->whereIn('service_template_id', $templates->pluck('id'))
 91:             ->get()
 92:             ->keyBy('service_template_id');
 93: 
 94:         return response()->json($templates->map(fn (ServiceTemplate $template) => [
 95:             'id' => $template->id,
 96:             'name' => $template->name,
 97:             'km_interval' => $intervals->get($template->id)?->custom_km_interval ?? $template->default_km_interval,
 98:             'details' => $template->details,
 99:         ])->values());
100:     }

102:     public function motorOilServices(int $busId)
103:     {
104:         $bus = Bus::findOrFail($busId);
105: 
106:         $allDetails = MotorOilDetail::where('brand_id', $bus->brand_id)
107:             ->orderBy('km')
108:             ->get();
109: 
110:         $is18m = $bus->uzunluq && (float) $bus->uzunluq >= config('settings.vehicle_intervals.bus_18m.min_length');
111:         $newBaseKm = $is18m
112:             ? config('settings.vehicle_intervals.bus_18m.base_km')
113:             : config('settings.vehicle_intervals.default.base_km');
114:         $ratio = $newBaseKm / 36000;
115: 
116:         if ($is18m) {
117:             $allDetails = $allDetails->map(function ($d) use ($ratio) {
118:                 $d->km = (int) round($d->km * $ratio);
119: 
120:                 return $d;
121:             });
122:         }
123: 
124:         return response()->json(
125:             $allDetails->groupBy('km')
126:                 ->map(fn ($details, $km) => [
127:                     'km' => (int) $km,
128:                     'details' => $details->map(fn (MotorOilDetail $detail) => [
129:                         'kodu' => $detail->part_code,
130:                         'adi' => $detail->part_name,
131:                         'miqdar' => $detail->quantity,
132:                         'say' => $detail->count,
133:                         'olcu_vahidi' => $detail->unit,
134:                     ])->values(),
135:                 ])->values()
136:         );
137:     }

139:     public function motorOilIntervals(int $busId)
140:     {
141:         $bus = Bus::findOrFail($busId);
142: 
143:         $currentKm = (int) ($bus->dailyKmRecords()->value('km') ?? $bus->km ?? 0);
144: 
145:         // Filter intervals by the bus's brand — see class docblock.
146:         $intervals = MotorOilDetail::where('brand_id', $bus->brand_id)
147:             ->select('km')
148:             ->distinct()
149:             ->orderBy('km')
150:             ->pluck('km')
151:             ->map(fn ($km) => (int) $km)
152:             ->all();
153: 
154:         // Closest interval in the past
155:         $past = null;
156:         foreach ($intervals as $km) {
157:             if ($km <= $currentKm) {
158:                 $past = $km;
159:             } else {
160:                 break;
161:             }
162:         }
163: 
164:         // Next interval in the future
165:         $next = null;
166:         foreach ($intervals as $km) {
167:             if ($km > $currentKm) {
168:                 $next = $km;
169:                 break;
170:             }
171:         }
172: 
173:         $result = [];
174: 
175:         if ($past !== null) {
176:             $result[] = [
177:                 'km' => $past,
178:                 'label' => __('messages.complaints.motor_oil_service_label', ['km' => number_format($past, 0, '', '')]),
179:             ];
180:         }
181: 
182:         if ($next !== null) {
183:             $result[] = [
184:                 'km' => $next,
185:                 'label' => __('messages.complaints.motor_oil_service_label', ['km' => number_format($next, 0, '', '')]),
186:             ];
187:         }
188: 
189:         return response()->json([
190:             'current_km' => $currentKm,
191:             'intervals' => $result,
192:         ]);
193:     }
194: 
195:     public function motorOilParts(Request $request, int $busId)
196:     {
197:         $bus = Bus::findOrFail($busId);
198:         $km = (int) $request->query('km');
199: 
200:         if ($km <= 0) {
201:             return response()->json(['parts' => []]);
202:         }
203: 
204:         // Filter parts by the bus's brand.
205:         $parts = MotorOilDetail::where('brand_id', $bus->brand_id)
206:             ->where('km', $km)
207:             ->orderBy('part_name')
208:             ->get()
209:             ->map(function (MotorOilDetail $part) use ($bus) {
210:                 $warehouse = Warehouse::withoutGlobalScopes()
211:                     ->where('code', $part->part_code)
212:                     ->where('garage_id', $bus->garage_id)
213:                     ->whereNull('deleted_at')
214:                     ->first();
215: 
216:                 return [
217:                     'part_code' => $part->part_code,
218:                     'part_name' => $part->part_name,
219:                     'unit' => $part->unit,
220:                     'quantity' => (float) $part->quantity,
221:                     'stock_quantity' => $warehouse?->quantity ?? 0,
222:                 ];
223:             });
224: 
225:         return response()->json(['parts' => $parts]);
226:     }

  2: 
  3: namespace App\Http\Controllers;
  4: 
  5: use App\Models\Company;
  6: use App\Models\Garage;
  7: use App\Services\GarageContext;
  8: use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
  9: use Illuminate\Http\Request;
 10: use Illuminate\View\View;
 11: 
 12: class GarageSelectionController extends Controller
 13: {
 14:     public function index(Request $request): View|RedirectResponse
 15:     {
 16:         $user = auth()->user();
 17: 
 18:         // Directors operate at the company level and never hold a
 19:         // garage membership. Redirect them to their own dashboard
 20:         // instead of showing the "no access" screen, which is only
 21:         // correct for regular users with zero garage memberships.
 22:         // This mirrors the behavior already enforced by the
 23:         // EnsureGarageSelected middleware.
 24:         if ($user->isDirector()) {
 25:             return redirect()->route('director.dashboard');
 26:         }
 27: 
 28:         // Optional case-insensitive substring filter applied to both
 29:         // company names and garage names. When empty, the full list is
 30:         // shown — the previous behaviour, kept for backwards
 31:         // compatibility and for the SuperAdmin "show everything" case.
 32:         $search = trim((string) $request->input('q', ''));
 33: 
 34:         if ($user->isSuperAdmin()) {
 35:             $companies = $this->superAdminCompanies($search);
 36:         } else {
 37:             $companies = $this->userCompanies($user, $search);
 38:         }
 39: 
 40:         // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 41:         // FIX P0-2: Infinite redirect loop
 42:         // (şərh saxlanılır, dəyişmir)
 43:         // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 44:         $hasNoGarages = $companies->isEmpty()
 45:             || $companies->every(fn ($c) => $c->garages->isEmpty());
 46: 
 47:         if ($hasNoGarages && ! $user->isSuperAdmin() && $search === '') {
 48:             return view('garage-no-access');
 49:         }
 50: 
 51:         return view('garage-selection', compact('companies', 'search'));
 52:     }
 53: 
 54:     public function selectGarage(Request $request): RedirectResponse
 55:     {
 56:         $request->validate([
 57:             'garage_id' => 'required|integer|exists:garages,id',
 58:         ]);
 59: 
 60:         $user = auth()->user();
 61: 
 62:         if ($user->isSuperAdmin()) {
 63:             $garage = Garage::with('company')
 64:                 ->whereKey($request->garage_id)
 65:                 ->where('is_active', true)
 66:                 ->firstOrFail();
 67:         } else {
 68:             $garage = $user->garages()
 69:                 ->whereKey($request->garage_id)
 70:                 ->wherePivot('is_active', true)
 71:                 ->with('company')
 72:                 ->first();
 73: 
 74:             if (! $garage) {
 75:                 return redirect()->route('garage.selection')
 76:                     ->with('error', __('messages.flash.garage_access_denied'));
 77:             }
 78:         }
 79: 
 80:         session([
 81:             'current_garage_id' => $garage->id,
 82:             'current_garage_name' => $garage->name,
 83:             'current_company_id' => $garage->company_id,
 84:             'current_company_name' => $garage->company?->name,
 85:         ]);
 86: 
 87:         GarageContext::set($garage->id, $garage->company_id);
 88: 
 89:         $user->update([
 90:             'current_garage_id' => $garage->id,
 91:             'current_company_id' => $garage->company_id,
 92:             'last_selected_garage_at' => now(),
 93:         ]);
 94: 
 95:         return redirect()->route('dashboard')
 96:             ->with('success', __('messages.flash.garage_selected', ['name' => $garage->name]));
 97:     }
 98: 
 99:     // ==================== HELPERS ====================
100: 
101:     /**
102:      * Companies visible to a SuperAdmin: every company that has at
103:      * least one active garage, with optional name filter.
104:      *
105:      * When $search is non-empty, both the company list and the nested
106:      * garage list are narrowed by an ILIKE substring match. This keeps
107:      * the rendered HTML size bounded on large platforms without
108:      * breaking the "select any garage" workflow — the user simply
109:      * types the target name to filter.
110:      */
111:     private function superAdminCompanies(string $search)
112:     {
113:         return Company::query()
114:             ->whereHas('garages', function ($query) use ($search) {
115:                 $query->where('is_active', true);
116: 
117:                 if ($search !== '') {
118:                     $query->where('name', 'ILIKE', "%{$search}%");
119:                 }
120:             })
121:             ->when($search !== '', fn ($q) => $q->where(function ($q) use ($search) {
122:                 // Keep companies whose own name matches, even when
123:                 // the matched garage list below is a subset.
124:                 $q->where('name', 'ILIKE', "%{$search}%")
125:                     ->orWhereHas('garages', function ($gq) use ($search) {
126:                         $gq->where('is_active', true)
127:                             ->where('name', 'ILIKE', "%{$search}%");
128:                     });
129:             }))
130:             ->with(['garages' => function ($query) use ($search) {
131:                 $query->where('is_active', true)
132:                     ->when($search !== '', fn ($q) => $q->where('name', 'ILIKE', "%{$search}%"))
133:                     ->orderBy('name');
134:             }])
135:             ->orderBy('name')
136:             ->get();
137:     }
138: 
139:     /**
140:      * Companies visible to a regular user: only garages the user is
141:      * actively a member of. Optional name filter applied the same way
142:      * as for the SuperAdmin list.
143:      */
144:     private function userCompanies($user, string $search)
145:     {
146:         $garageAccessFilter = function ($query) use ($user, $search) {
147:             $query->where('is_active', true)
148:                 ->whereHas('users', function ($q) use ($user) {
149:                     $q->where('user_id', $user->id)
150:                         ->where('garage_user.is_active', true);
151:                 });
152: 
153:             if ($search !== '') {
154:                 $query->where('name', 'ILIKE', "%{$search}%");
155:             }
156:         };
157: 
158:         return Company::query()
159:             ->whereHas('garages', $garageAccessFilter)
160:             ->with(['garages' => function ($query) use ($garageAccessFilter) {
161:                 $garageAccessFilter($query);
162:                 $query->orderBy('name');
163:             }])
164:             ->orderBy('name')
165:             ->get();
166:     }
167: }

<file path="app/Http/Controllers/HealthController.php">
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: namespace App\Http\Controllers;
  4: 
  5: use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
  6: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;
  7: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
  8: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;
  9: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
 10: use Throwable;
 11: 
 12: class HealthController extends Controller
 13: {
 14:     public function check(): JsonResponse
 15:     {
 16:         // Cache the health check result for 10 seconds to prevent a DoS
 17:         // where repeated calls hammer the database, cache, and disk on
 18:         // every request. Monitoring tools typically poll every 30–60 s
 19:         // anyway, so a 10 s cache has no practical effect on alerting.
 20:         $ttl = (int) config('health.cache_ttl_seconds', 10);
 21: 
 22:         [$status, $statusCode] = Cache::remember('_health_check_result', $ttl, function () {
 23:             return $this->runChecks();
 24:         });
 25: 
 26:         return response()->json($status, $statusCode);
 27:     }
 28: 
 29:     private function runChecks(): array
 30:     {
 31:         $status = [
 32:             'status' => 'ok',
 33:             'timestamp' => now()->toIso8601String(),
 34:             'services' => [],
 35:         ];
 36: 
 37:         $isHealthy = true;
 38: 
 39:         // 1. Database
 40:         try {
 41:             DB::connection()->getPdo();
 42:             DB::select('SELECT 1');
 43:             $status['services']['database'] = ['status' => 'up'];
 44:         } catch (Throwable $e) {
 45:             $isHealthy = false;
 46:             Log::error('HealthCheck DB Error: '.$e->getMessage());
 47:             $status['services']['database'] = ['status' => 'down', 'error' => 'Database connection failed.'];
 48:         }
 49: 
 50:         // 2. Cache
 51:         try {
 52:             Cache::put('_health_check', 'ok', 10);
 53:             $cacheVal = Cache::get('_health_check');
 54:             Cache::forget('_health_check');
 55: 
 56:             if ($cacheVal === 'ok') {
 57:                 $status['services']['cache'] = ['status' => 'up'];
 58:             } else {
 59:                 throw new \Exception('Cache read verification failed');
 60:             }
 61:         } catch (Throwable $e) {
 62:             $isHealthy = false;
 63:             Log::error('HealthCheck Cache Error: '.$e->getMessage());
 64:             $status['services']['cache'] = ['status' => 'down', 'error' => 'Cache service unavailable.'];
 65:         }
 66: 
 67:         // 3. Storage
 68:         try {
 69:             Storage::disk('local')->put('_health_check.txt', 'ok');
 70:             $storageVal = Storage::disk('local')->get('_health_check.txt');
 71:             Storage::disk('local')->delete('_health_check.txt');
 72: 
 73:             if (trim($storageVal) === 'ok') {
 74:                 $status['services']['storage'] = ['status' => 'up'];
 75:             } else {
 76:                 throw new \Exception('Storage read verification failed');
 77:             }
 78:         } catch (Throwable $e) {
 79:             $isHealthy = false;
 80:             Log::error('HealthCheck Storage Error: '.$e->getMessage());
 81:             $status['services']['storage'] = ['status' => 'down', 'error' => 'Storage service unavailable.'];
 82:         }
 83: 
 84:         // 4. Queue
 85:         //
 86:         // Reports the configured driver and — for database-backed
 87:         // queues — verifies the `jobs` table is actually reachable.
 88:         // A reachable DB (step 1) does not imply the jobs table
 89:         // exists: a fresh deployment that skipped migrations would
 90:         // pass the DB check but fail every queued job silently.
 91:         try {
 92:             $queueDriver = (string) config('queue.default', 'sync');
 93: 
 94:             if ($queueDriver === 'database') {
 95:                 DB::table('jobs')->limit(1)->count();
 96:             }
 97: 
 98:             $status['services']['queue'] = [
 99:                 'status' => 'up',
100:                 'driver' => $queueDriver,
101:             ];
102:         } catch (Throwable $e) {
103:             $isHealthy = false;
104:             Log::error('HealthCheck Queue Error: '.$e->getMessage());
105:             $status['services']['queue'] = [
106:                 'status' => 'down',
107:                 'error' => 'Queue service unavailable.',
108:             ];
109:         }
110: 
111:         // 5. Disk space
112:         //
113:         // disk_free_space() and disk_total_space() are disabled on
114:         // some hardened PHP builds (open_basedir, disable_functions).
115:         // When that is the case we report `skipped` rather than
116:         // `down` — the check is informational, not a hard signal.
117:         try {
118:             if (! function_exists('disk_free_space') || ! function_exists('disk_total_space')) {
119:                 $status['services']['disk'] = [
120:                     'status' => 'skipped',
121:                     'reason' => 'disk_free_space() disabled',
122:                 ];
123:             } else {
124:                 $path = storage_path();
125:                 $freeBytes = @disk_free_space($path);
126:                 $totalBytes = @disk_total_space($path);
127: 
128:                 if ($freeBytes === false || $totalBytes === false || $totalBytes <= 0) {
129:                     $status['services']['disk'] = [
130:                         'status' => 'skipped',
131:                         'reason' => 'Unable to read disk stats',
132:                     ];
133:                 } else {
134:                     $freePercent = ($freeBytes / $totalBytes) * 100;
135:                     $criticalPercent = (float) config('health.disk_critical_percent', 5);
136: 
137:                     if ($freePercent < $criticalPercent) {
138:                         $isHealthy = false;
139: 
140:                         $status['services']['disk'] = [
141:                             'status' => 'down',
142:                             'free_percent' => round($freePercent, 1),
143:                             'error' => 'Low disk space.',
144:                         ];
145: 
146:                         Log::error('HealthCheck Disk Error: low disk space', [
147:                             'free_percent' => round($freePercent, 1),
148:                             'threshold' => $criticalPercent,
149:                             'path' => $path,
150:                         ]);
151:                     } else {
152:                         $status['services']['disk'] = [
153:                             'status' => 'up',
154:                             'free_percent' => round($freePercent, 1),
155:                         ];
156:                     }
157:                 }
158:             }
159:         } catch (Throwable $e) {
160:             $isHealthy = false;
161:             Log::error('HealthCheck Disk Error: '.$e->getMessage());
162:             $status['services']['disk'] = ['status' => 'down', 'error' => 'Disk check failed.'];
163:         }
164:         // 6. Backup freshness
165:         //
166:         // A stale backup is a data-loss risk that no other probe
167:         // catches — the app can be perfectly healthy while its last
168:         // successful backup is three weeks old. The backup sidecar
169:         // touches a marker file after every successful dump; we alert
170:         // when that marker is older than the configured window.
171:         //
172:         // Skipped gracefully when the marker does not exist: local
173:         // development has no backup sidecar, and a fresh production
174:         // deployment has not yet taken its first backup.
175:         try {
176:             $maxAgeHours = (int) config('health.backup_max_age_hours', 25);
177:             $markerPath = (string) config('health.backup_marker_path');
178: 
179:             if ($maxAgeHours <= 0) {
180:                 $status['services']['backup'] = [
181:                     'status' => 'skipped',
182:                     'reason' => 'check disabled',
183:                 ];
184:             } elseif ($markerPath === '' || ! file_exists($markerPath)) {
185:                 $status['services']['backup'] = [
186:                     'status' => 'skipped',
187:                     'reason' => 'marker not found',
188:                 ];
189:             } else {
190:                 $ageHours = (time() - filemtime($markerPath)) / 3600;
191: 
192:                 if ($ageHours > $maxAgeHours) {
193:                     $isHealthy = false;
194: 
195:                     $status['services']['backup'] = [
196:                         'status' => 'down',
197:                         'age_hours' => round($ageHours, 1),
198:                         'error' => 'Backup is stale.',
199:                     ];
200: 
201:                     Log::error('HealthCheck Backup Error: stale backup', [
202:                         'age_hours' => round($ageHours, 1),
203:                         'threshold_hours' => $maxAgeHours,
204:                         'marker' => $markerPath,
205:                     ]);
206:                 } else {
207:                     $status['services']['backup'] = [
208:                         'status' => 'up',
209:                         'age_hours' => round($ageHours, 1),
210:                     ];
211:                 }
212:             }
213:         } catch (Throwable $e) {
214:             // Never fail health on a backup-probe bug. Log and move on.
215:             Log::warning('HealthCheck Backup Error: '.$e->getMessage());
216:             $status['services']['backup'] = [
217:                 'status' => 'skipped',
218:                 'reason' => 'probe error',
219:             ];
220:         }
221: 
222:         $statusCode = $isHealthy ? 200 : 503;
223:         $status['status'] = $isHealthy ? 'healthy' : 'unhealthy';
224: 
225:         return [$status, $statusCode];
226:     }
227: }

<file path="app/Http/Controllers/OilChangeController.php">
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: namespace App\Http\Controllers;
  4: 
  5: use App\Enums\OilType;
  6: use App\Http\Requests\OilChangeStoreRequest;
  7: use App\Http\Requests\OilChangeUpdateRequest;
  8: use App\Models\Bus;
  9: use App\Models\BusOilChange;
 10: use App\Services\OilChange\OilChangeService;
 11: use App\Services\OilChange\OilChangeStatusService;
 12: use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
 13: use Illuminate\Http\Request;
 14: use Illuminate\Support\Collection;
 15: use Illuminate\View\View;
 16: 
 17: class OilChangeController extends Controller
 18: {
 19:     public function __construct(
 20:         protected OilChangeService $service,
 21:         protected OilChangeStatusService $statusService,
 22:     ) {}
 23: 
 24:     /**
 25:      * Combined view: one section per oil type.
 26:      *
 27:      * Delegates filter resolution and data collection to
 28:      * collectFilteredData() so that both the initial page load
 29:      * (index) and the AJAX search endpoint share the exact same
 30:      * filtering rules.
 31:      */
 32:     public function index(Request $request): View
 33:     {
 34:         return view('oil-changes.index', $this->collectFilteredData($request));
 35:     }
 36: 
 37:     /**
 38:      * AJAX search endpoint. Returns only the results partial when
 39:      * called via XMLHttpRequest, and falls back to the full index
 40:      * view for direct URL visits or middle-click navigation.
 41:      *
 42:      * Mirrors the BusController::search() and WarehouseController
 43:      * ::search() pattern.
 44:      */
 45:     public function search(Request $request): View|string
 46:     {
 47:         $data = $this->collectFilteredData($request);
 48: 
 49:         if ($this->isAjaxRequest($request)) {
 50:             return view('oil-changes.partials.results', $data)->render();
 51:         }
 52: 
 53:         return view('oil-changes.index', $data);
 54:     }
 55: 
 56:     /**
 57:      * Resolve every filter from the request, build the full row set,
 58:      * then apply status and KM filters.
 59:      *
 60:      * ── FILTER LAYERS ──────────────────────────────────────────────
 61:      * 1. DB-level (in buildStatusRows):
 62:      *      - dqn          → buses.dqn ILIKE
 63:      *      - route_number → buses.route_number ILIKE
 64:      *
 65:      * 2. Collection-level (here):
 66:      *      - km_min / km_max → current km of the active oil type
 67:      *      - status          → worst-match status of the active type
 68:      *
 69:      * KM and status filters run in PHP because both depend on
 70:      * computed values (OilChangeStatus), not on raw columns.
 71:      */
 72:     private function collectFilteredData(Request $request): array
 73:     {
 74:         $this->authorize('viewAny', BusOilChange::class);
 75: 
 76:         $statusFilter = (string) $request->input('status', 'all');
 77:         $validStatuses = ['all', 'overdue', 'critical', 'due-soon', 'ok', 'no-history'];
 78: 
 79:         if (! in_array($statusFilter, $validStatuses, true)) {
 80:             $statusFilter = 'all';
 81:         }
 82: 
 83:         $activeType = OilType::tryFrom((string) $request->input('type', OilType::Motor->value))
 84:             ?? OilType::Motor;
 85: 
 86:         $filters = [
 87:             'dqn' => trim((string) $request->input('dqn', '')),
 88:             'route_number' => trim((string) $request->input('route_number', '')),
 89:             'km_min' => $request->filled('km_min') ? max(0, (int) $request->input('km_min')) : null,
 90:             'km_max' => $request->filled('km_max') ? max(0, (int) $request->input('km_max')) : null,
 91:         ];
 92: 
 93:         $rows = $this->buildStatusRows($filters);
 94: 
 95:         // ─── KM range filter (on the active oil type's current km) ───
 96:         if ($filters['km_min'] !== null || $filters['km_max'] !== null) {
 97:             $rows = $rows->filter(function (array $row) use ($activeType, $filters) {
 98:                 $currentKm = $row['statuses'][$activeType->value]->currentKm ?? 0;
 99: 
100:                 if ($filters['km_min'] !== null && $currentKm < $filters['km_min']) {
101:                     return false;
102:                 }
103:                 if ($filters['km_max'] !== null && $currentKm > $filters['km_max']) {
104:                     return false;
105:                 }
106: 
107:                 return true;
108:             })->values();
109:         }
110: 
111:         $typeCounts = collect(OilType::cases())->mapWithKeys(function (OilType $t) use ($rows, $statusFilter) {
112:             $count = $rows->filter(function (array $row) use ($t, $statusFilter) {
113:                 if ($statusFilter === 'all') {
114:                     return true;
115:                 }
116: 
117:                 return $row['statuses'][$t->value]->status === $statusFilter;
118:             })->count();
119: 
120:             return [$t->value => $count];
121:         });
122: 
123:         $sectionRows = $rows
124:             ->filter(function (array $row) use ($activeType, $statusFilter) {
125:                 if ($statusFilter === 'all') {
126:                     return true;
127:                 }
128: 
129:                 return $row['statuses'][$activeType->value]->status === $statusFilter;
130:             })
131:             ->sortBy(fn (array $row) => $row['statuses'][$activeType->value]->remainingKm ?? PHP_INT_MAX)
132:             ->values();
133: 
134:         $urgentCount = $sectionRows->filter(
135:             fn (array $row) => in_array($row['statuses'][$activeType->value]->status, ['overdue', 'critical'], true)
136:         )->count();
137: 
138:         return [
139:             'rows' => $sectionRows,
140:             'statusFilter' => $statusFilter,
141:             'activeType' => $activeType,
142:             'typeCounts' => $typeCounts,
143:             'urgentCount' => $urgentCount,
144:             'filters' => $filters,
145:         ];
146:     }
147: 
148:     /**
149:      * Urgent-only view.
150:      */
151:     public function urgent(): View
152:     {
153:         $this->authorize('viewAny', BusOilChange::class);
154: 
155:         $rows = $this->buildStatusRows()
156:             ->map(function (array $row) {
157:                 $row['urgent_statuses'] = $row['statuses']
158:                     ->filter(fn ($s) => in_array($s->status, ['overdue', 'critical'], true));
159: 
160:                 return $row;
161:             })
162:             ->filter(fn (array $row) => $row['urgent_statuses']->isNotEmpty())
163:             ->sortBy('min_remaining')
164:             ->values();
165: 
166:         $overdueCount = $rows->sum(
167:             fn (array $r) => $r['urgent_statuses']->where('status', 'overdue')->count()
168:         );
169: 
170:         $criticalCount = $rows->sum(
171:             fn (array $r) => $r['urgent_statuses']->where('status', 'critical')->count()
172:         );
173: 
174:         return view('oil-changes.urgent', [
175:             'rows' => $rows,
176:             'overdueCount' => $overdueCount,
177:             'criticalCount' => $criticalCount,
178:         ]);
179:     }
180:

197:     public function create(Request $request): View
198:     {
199:         $this->authorize('create', BusOilChange::class);
200: 
201:         $buses = Bus::active()->orderBy('dqn')->get();
202: 
203:         $selectedBusId = $request->integer('bus_id') ?: null;
204: 
205:         $selectedOilType = OilType::tryFrom((string) $request->input('type', OilType::Motor->value))
206:             ?? OilType::Motor;
207: 
208:         // ✅ Pre-fill the "Scheduled km" field with the catalog
209:         // milestone shown on the index page ("YAĞDƏYİŞMƏ NÖVÜ" column).
210:         //
211:         // Priority:
212:         //   1. nextCatalogKm — the exact value the operator saw on
213:         //      the index page (a real catalog milestone, tied to a
214:         //      parts list).
215:         //   2. nextDueKm     — the mathematically computed next due
216:         //      (used only when the catalog has no milestone beyond
217:         //      the current due point — e.g. a bus already past the
218:         //      last catalog entry).
219:         //   3. null          — no bus selected yet; field stays empty.
220:         $suggestedScheduledKm = null;
221: 
222:         if ($selectedBusId) {
223:             $bus = Bus::with(['latestKmRecord', 'oilChanges'])
224:                 ->find($selectedBusId);
225: 
226:             if ($bus) {
227:                 $status = $this->statusService->forBus($bus, $selectedOilType);
228: 
229:                 $suggestedScheduledKm = $status->nextCatalogKm
230:                     ?? $status->nextDueKm;
231:             }
232:         }
233: 
234:         return view('oil-changes.create', [
235:             'buses' => $buses,
236:             'selectedBusId' => $selectedBusId,
237:             'selectedOilType' => $selectedOilType->value,
238:             'suggestedScheduledKm' => $suggestedScheduledKm,
239:         ]);
240:     }
241: 
242:     /**
243:      * ✅ P1 FIX: FormRequest injection.
244:      *
245:      * ƏVVƏL:
246:      *   public function store(Request $request) {
247:      *       $validated = app(OilChangeStoreRequest::class)->rules();
248:      *       $data = $request->validate($validated);
249:      *   }
250:      *
251:      * Bu pattern prepareForValidation()-u və Rule::requiredIf() closure-unu
252:      * sındırırdı, çünki Laravel FormRequest lifecycle-ı tam işlədilmirdi.
253:      *
254:      * İNDİ: Tip-hint ilə FormRequest inject olunur → Laravel hər şeyi
255:      * (authorize, prepareForValidation, rules, messages) düzgün işə salır.
256:      */
257:     public function store(OilChangeStoreRequest $request): RedirectResponse
258:     {
259:         $this->authorize('create', BusOilChange::class);
260: 
261:         $data = $request->validated();
262: 
263:         $bus = Bus::findOrFail($data['bus_id']);

266:

305:         $this->service->delete($oilChange);
306:

308:             ->route('oil-changes.show', $busId)
309:             ->with('success', __('messages.flash.deleted', ['Item' => 'Oil change']));
310:     }
311: 
312:     /**
313:      * Build one row per active bus, with all three oil-type statuses.
314:      *
315:      * MEMORY NOTE
316:      * -----------
317:      * The `with([...])` block loads the three dedicated "latest"
318:      * relations (one per oil type) instead of the full `oilChanges`
319:      * history. Each `latestOfMany('actual_km')` relation costs one
320:      * query for the whole collection, so we pay 3 queries total
321:      * regardless of fleet size or history depth.
322:      *
323:      * The previous `with('oilChanges')` approach loaded every
324:      * historical change for every bus — see Bus::latestMotorOilChange()
325:      * for the full rationale.
326:      *
327:      * `OilChangeStatusService::forBus()` transparently picks up
328:      * whichever relation is loaded via resolveLastChange().
329:      *
330:      * @param  array{dqn?: string, route_number?: string}  $filters
331:      *                                                               DQN and route filters are applied at the DB level so
332:      *                                                               PostgreSQL does the work before Laravel collects rows.
333:      *                                                               KM and status filters are applied later in PHP because
334:      *                                                               they depend on computed OilChangeStatus values.
335:      */
336:     private function buildStatusRows(array $filters = []): Collection
337:     {
338:         $buses = Bus::with([
339:             'latestKmRecord',
340:             // ✅ Eager-load the latest daily status so the index page
341:             // can render it in a dedicated column without an N+1.
342:             // `latestDailyStatus()` is defined on the Bus model using
343:             // latestOfMany('date') — a single subquery for the whole
344:             // collection.
345:             'latestDailyStatus',
346:             // ✅ Latest oil change per type — three relations total,
347:             // NOT the full history. See the method docblock.
348:             'latestMotorOilChange',
349:             'latestGearboxOilChange',
350:             'latestAxleOilChange',
351:         ])
352:             ->where('is_active', true)
353:             ->when(
354:                 ! empty($filters['dqn']),
355:                 fn ($q) => $q->where('dqn', 'ILIKE', '%'.$filters['dqn'].'%')
356:             )
357:             ->when(
358:                 ! empty($filters['route_number']),
359:                 fn ($q) => $q->where('route_number', 'ILIKE', '%'.$filters['route_number'].'%')
360:             )
361:             ->orderBy('dqn')
362:             ->get();
363: 
364:         $priority = [
365:             'no-history' => 5,
366:             'ok' => 4,
367:             'due-soon' => 3,
368:             'critical' => 2,
369:             'overdue' => 1,
370:         ];
371: 
372:         return $buses->map(function (Bus $bus) use ($priority) {
373:             $statuses = collect(OilType::cases())
374:                 ->mapWithKeys(fn (OilType $t) => [$t->value => $this->statusService->forBus($bus, $t)]);
375: 
376:             $worstPriority = collect($statuses->values())
377:                 ->map(fn ($s) => $priority[$s->status] ?? 99)
378:                 ->min();
379: 
380:             $minRemaining = collect($statuses->values())
381:                 ->map(fn ($s) => $s->remainingKm)
382:                 ->filter(fn ($v) => $v !== null)
383:                 ->min() ?? PHP_INT_MAX;
384: 
385:             return [
386:                 'bus' => $bus,
387:                 'statuses' => $statuses,
388:                 'worst_priority' => $worstPriority,
389:                 'min_remaining' => $minRemaining,
390:             ];
391:         });
392:     }
393: }

 23: 
 24:     public function store(Request $request): RedirectResponse
 25:     {
 26:         // Garage context must be resolved BEFORE authorization.
 27:         // If no garage is active, redirect to the selection page
 28:         // instead of triggering a 403 in the policy.
 29:         $garageId = GarageContext::resolveGarageId();
 30: 
 31:         if ($garageId === null || $garageId <= 0) {
 32:             return redirect()
 33:                 ->route('garage.selection')
 34:                 ->with('error', __('messages.flash.no_current_garage'));
 35:         }
 36: 
 37:         $this->authorize('import', BusOilChange::class);
 38: 
 39:         $validated = $request->validate([
 40:             'type' => ['required', \Illuminate\Validation\Rule::in(OilType::values())],
 41:             'bus_length' => ['nullable', 'integer', \Illuminate\Validation\Rule::in([12, 18])],
 42:             'file' => ['required', 'mimes:xlsx,xls,csv', 'max:10240'],
 43:         ]);
 44: 
 45:         $type = OilType::from($validated['type']);
 46: 
 47:         // The bus length only applies to motor oil imports — the
 48:         // gearbox and axle schedules are brand-driven and do not
 49:         // depend on the bus's physical length.
 50:         $busLengthM = $type === OilType::Motor
 51:             ? (int) ($validated['bus_length'] ?? 12)
 52:             : null;
 53: 
 54:         // Debug-level: useful when diagnosing a failed import in
 55:         // development. Hidden in production because LOG_LEVEL=warning
 56:         // (see .env.production.example).
 57:         Log::debug('Oil import started', [
 58:             'type' => $type->value,
 59:             'bus_length' => $busLengthM,
 60:             'file' => $request->file('file')->getClientOriginalName(),
 61:             'garage_id' => $garageId,
 62:         ]);
 63: 
 64:         try {
 65:             $import = new BusOilChangesImport(
 66:                 $garageId,
 67:                 GarageContext::resolveCompanyId(),
 68:                 $type,
 69:                 $busLengthM,
 70:             );
 71: 
 72:             Excel::import($import, $request->file('file'));
 73: 
 74:             $skipped = $import->skipped;
 75:             $imported = $import->importedCount;
 76: 
 77:             Log::debug('Oil import finished', [
 78:                 'type' => $type->value,
 79:                 'imported' => $imported,
 80:                 'skipped' => count($skipped),
 81:             ]);
 82: 
 83:             if (empty($skipped)) {
 84:                 return redirect()
 85:                     ->route('oil-changes.index', ['type' => $type->value])
 86:                     ->with('success', __('messages.flash.import_success', [
 87:                         'count' => $imported,
 88:                         'items' => $type->label(),
 89:                     ]));
 90:             }
 91: 
 92:             return redirect()
 93:                 ->route('oil-changes.index', ['type' => $type->value])
 94:                 ->with('warning', __('messages.flash.import_partial'))
 95:                 ->with('import_report', $this->buildImportReport($imported, $skipped, collect()));
 96: 
 97:         } catch (\Throwable $e) {
 98:             // ERROR level: the import failed and the operator needs
 99:             // to know. The full stack trace is NOT logged here —
100:             // Laravel's exception handler already forwards it to
101:             // Sentry (config/sentry.php), and duplicating a multi-KB
102:             // trace into the local log file adds noise without value.
103:             Log::error('Oil import failed', [
104:                 'type' => $type->value,
105:                 'file' => $request->file('file')?->getClientOriginalName(),
106:                 'garage_id' => $garageId,
107:                 'error' => $e->getMessage(),
108:                 'exception_file' => $e->getFile(),
109:                 'exception_line' => $e->getLine(),
110:             ]);
111: 
112:             report($e);
113: 
114:             return redirect()
115:                 ->route('oil-changes.import')
116:                 ->with('error', __('messages.flash.import_error'));
117:         }
118:     }
119: }

 44:     {

 73:                     $status,
 74:                     $changes,
 75:                 ];
 76:             })->all(),
 77:         )) {
 78:             return $export;
 79:         }
 80: 
 81:         return $this->render('changes', $period, $scope, [
 82:             'logs' => $logs,
 83:         ]);

<file path="app/Http/Controllers/Reports/ReportController.php">
 1: <?php
 2: 
 3: namespace App\Http\Controllers\Reports;
 4: 
 5: use App\Exports\Reports\GenericReportExport;
 6: use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
 7: use App\Services\Reports\ReportPeriod;
 8: use App\Services\Reports\ReportScope;
 9: use Illuminate\Http\Request;
10: use Maatwebsite\Excel\Facades\Excel;
11: use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\BinaryFileResponse;
12: 
13: abstract class ReportController extends Controller
14: {
15:     /**
16:      * Resolve the report period from the request.
17:      */
18:     protected function period(Request $request): ReportPeriod
19:     {
20:         return ReportPeriod::fromRequest($request);
21:     }
22: 
23:     /**
24:      * Resolve the report scope for the given domain.
25:      *
26:      * Domains: 'complaint', 'warehouse', 'daily_km', 'daily_status', 'transfer'.
27:      *
28:      * The optional $request is used to read the `brand_id` filter.
29:      * Only the three bus-related domains use it; passing null keeps
30:      * the previous behavior (no brand filter).
31:      */
32:     protected function scope(string $domain, ?Request $request = null): ReportScope
33:     {
34:         $brandId = null;
35: 
36:         if ($request && $request->filled('brand_id')) {
37:             $brandId = (int) $request->input('brand_id');
38:         }
39: 
40:         $scope = ReportScope::for(auth()->user(), $domain, $brandId);
41: 
42:         abort_unless($scope->hasAccess(), 403, __('messages.reports.no_scope'));
43: 
44:         return $scope;
45:     }
46: 
47:     /**
48:      * Return an Excel download when the request carries ?export=xlsx,
49:      * or null otherwise. Controllers call this immediately after
50:      * computing their data and short-circuit when a download object
51:      * is returned.
52:      *
53:      * Contract:
54:      *   - $basename is a short slug (no extension); a timestamp and
55:      *     .xlsx extension are appended automatically.
56:      *   - $headings is an ordered list of translated column labels.
57:      *   - $rows is an ordered list of row arrays; each row array must
58:      *     have the same length as $headings.
59:      *
60:      * This keeps the export shape 1:1 with what the operator sees on
61:      * screen, so no separate "export logic" can drift out of sync.
62:      */
63:     protected function maybeExport(
64:         Request $request,
65:         string $basename,
66:         array $headings,
67:         array $rows,
68:     ): ?BinaryFileResponse {
69:         if ($request->input('export') !== 'xlsx') {
70:             return null;
71:         }
72: 
73:         $filename = $basename.'-'.now()->format('Y-m-d-His').'.xlsx';
74: 
75:         return Excel::download(
76:             new GenericReportExport($rows, $headings),
77:             $filename
78:         );
79:     }
80: }
</file>

 86:                 $to = $row->to_garage_name
 87:                     ? $row->to_garage_name.($row->to_garage_code ? ' ('.$row->to_garage_code.')' : '')
 88:                     : ($row->to_vehicle_name ? '🚐 '.$row->to_vehicle_name : '—');
 89: 
 90:                 try {
 91:                     $typeLabel = TransferType::from($row->type)->label();
 92:                 } catch (\Throwable $e) {
 93:                     $typeLabel = $row->type;
 94:                 }
 95: 
 96:                 try {
 97:                     $statusLabel = TransferStatus::from($row->status)->label();
 98:                 } catch (\Throwable $e) {
 99:                     $statusLabel = $row->status;
100:                 }
101: 
102:                 return [
103:                     '#'.$row->transfer_id,
104:                     \Carbon\Carbon::parse($row->created_at)->format('d.m.Y H:i'),
105:                     $row->from_garage_name.($row->from_garage_code ? ' ('.$row->from_garage_code.')' : ''),
106:                     $to,
107:                     $typeLabel,
108:                     $row->code,
109:                     $row->part_name,
110:                     (int) $row->declared_quantity,
111:                     $row->received_quantity !== null ? (int) $row->received_quantity : '',
112:                     $statusLabel,
113:                 ];
114:             })->all(),
115:         )) {
116:             return $export;
117:         }
118: 
119:         return $this->render('detailed', $period, $scope, [
120:             'rows' => $rows,
121:         ]);
122:     }
123: 
124:     // ==================================================================
125:     // 3. BY ROUTE

244:     {
245:         $period = $this->period($request);
246:         $scope = $this->scope('transfer');
247: 
248:         $transfers = $this->service->disputed($period, $scope);
249: 
250:         if ($export = $this->maybeExport(
251:             request: $request,
252:             basename: 'transfer-disputed',
253:             headings: [
254:                 __('messages.transfers.details'),
255:                 __('messages.transfers.from_garage'),
256:                 __('messages.transfers.to_garage'),
257:                 __('messages.transfers.declared_total'),
258:                 __('messages.transfers.received_total'),
259:                 __('messages.transfers.discrepancy'),
260:                 __('messages.transfers.status'),
261:             ],
262:             rows: $transfers->map(function ($transfer) {
263:                 $diff = ($transfer->received_total ?? 0) - $transfer->declared_total;
264: 
265:                 return [
266:                     '#'.$transfer->id,
267:                     $transfer->fromGarage?->name ?? '—',
268:                     $transfer->toGarage?->name
269:                         ?? ($transfer->toServiceVehicle ? '🚐 '.$transfer->toServiceVehicle->name : '—'),
270:                     (int) $transfer->declared_total,
271:                     $transfer->received_total !== null ? (int) $transfer->received_total : '',
272:                     ($diff > 0 ? '+' : '').$diff,
273:                     $transfer->status->label(),
274:                 ];
275:             })->all(),
276:         )) {
277:             return $export;
278:         }
279: 
280:         return $this->render('disputed', $period, $scope, [
281:             'transfers' => $transfers,
282:         ]);
283:     }

291:      *
292:      * The `exportUrl` variable is what makes the "Export to Excel"
293:      * button in the report shell work — it captures the current
294:      * period + brand filter (if any) plus `?export=xlsx`.
295:      */
296:     private function render(string $view, $period, $scope, array $data): View
297:     {
298:         return view("reports.transfer.{$view}", array_merge($data, [
299:             'domain' => 'transfer',
300:             'activeReport' => $view,
301:             'period' => $period,
302:             'scope' => $scope,
303:             'exportUrl' => request()->fullUrlWithQuery(['export' => 'xlsx']),
304:         ]));
305:     }

215:         }
216: 
217:         return $this->render('service-vehicle-usage', $period, $scope, [
218:             'rows' => $rows,
219:         ]);
220:     }
221: 
222:     private function render(string $view, $period, $scope, array $data): View
223:     {
224:         return view("reports.warehouse.{$view}", array_merge($data, [
225:             'domain' => 'warehouse',
226:             'activeReport' => $view,
227:             'period' => $period,
228:             'scope' => $scope,
229:             'exportUrl' => request()->fullUrlWithQuery(['export' => 'xlsx']),
230:         ]));
231:     }
232: }

<file path="app/Http/Controllers/SuperAdmin/AssignmentController.php">
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: namespace App\Http\Controllers\SuperAdmin;
  4: 
  5: use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
  6: use App\Models\Company;
  7: use App\Models\User;
  8: use App\Services\PivotAuditService;
  9: use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
 10: use Illuminate\Http\Request;
 11: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
 12: 
 13: class AssignmentController extends Controller
 14: {
 15:     public function __construct(
 16:         protected PivotAuditService $pivotAuditor
 17:     ) {}
 18: 
 19:     /**
 20:      * Assign a user as a Company Director.
 21:      *
 22:      * Business rule: a company has AT MOST one active director. When a
 23:      * new director is assigned, the currently active director (if any)
 24:      * is automatically deactivated — the pivot row is preserved with
 25:      * `is_active = false` for audit purposes, not detached.
 26:      */
 27:     public function assignDirector(Request $request, Company $company): RedirectResponse
 28:     {
 29:         $this->ensureSuperAdmin();
 30: 
 31:         $validated = $request->validate([
 32:             'user_id' => ['required', 'integer', 'exists:users,id'],
 33:         ]);
 34: 
 35:         $newDirector = User::findOrFail($validated['user_id']);
 36: 
 37:         if ($newDirector->isSuperAdmin()) {
 38:             return back()->with('error', __(
 39:                 'messages.super_admin.assignments.super_admin_cannot_be_director'
 40:             ));
 41:         }
 42: 
 43:         $isAlreadyActive = $company->directors()
 44:             ->whereKey($newDirector->id)
 45:             ->exists();
 46: 
 47:         if ($isAlreadyActive) {
 48:             return back()->with('error', __(
 49:                 'messages.super_admin.assignments.already_director',
 50:                 ['name' => $newDirector->name]
 51:             ));
 52:         }
 53: 
 54:         $deactivatedDirector = null;
 55: 
 56:         DB::transaction(function () use ($company, $newDirector, &$deactivatedDirector) {
 57:             $currentDirector = $company->directors()->first();
 58: 
 59:             if ($currentDirector) {
 60:                 $deactivatedDirector = $currentDirector;
 61: 
 62:                 $company->users()->updateExistingPivot($currentDirector->id, [
 63:                     'is_active' => false,
 64:                 ]);
 65:             }
 66: 
 67:             $alreadyAttached = $company->users()
 68:                 ->whereKey($newDirector->id)
 69:                 ->exists();
 70: 
 71:             if ($alreadyAttached) {
 72:                 $company->users()->updateExistingPivot($newDirector->id, [
 73:                     'role' => 'director',
 74:                     'is_active' => true,
 75:                 ]);
 76:             } else {
 77:                 $company->users()->attach($newDirector->id, [
 78:                     'role' => 'director',
 79:                     'is_active' => true,
 80:                 ]);
 81:             }
 82: 
 83:             // Audit: transaction DAXİLİNDƏ — audit yazıla bilməzsə,
 84:             // pivot dəyişikliyi də geri qaytarılır (atomiklik).
 85:             $this->pivotAuditor->log(
 86:                 subject: $company,
 87:                 event: $deactivatedDirector ? 'director_changed' : 'director_assigned',
 88:                 oldValues: $deactivatedDirector
 89:                     ? ['director_id' => $deactivatedDirector->id, 'director_name' => $deactivatedDirector->name]
 90:                     : null,
 91:                 newValues: ['director_id' => $newDirector->id, 'director_name' => $newDirector->name],
 92:                 companyId: $company->id,
 93:             );
 94:         });
 95: 
 96:         // Invalidate the cached isDirector() result on both affected
 97:         // users so any subsequent check within this request sees the
 98:         // new state.
 99:         $newDirector->forgetDirectorCache();
100: 
101:         if ($deactivatedDirector) {
102:             $deactivatedDirector->forgetDirectorCache();
103:         }
104: 
105:         $message = $deactivatedDirector
106:             ? __('messages.super_admin.assignments.director_changed', [
107:                 'new' => $newDirector->name,
108:                 'old' => $deactivatedDirector->name,
109:                 'company' => $company->name,
110:             ])
111:             : __('messages.super_admin.assignments.director_assigned', [
112:                 'name' => $newDirector->name,
113:                 'company' => $company->name,
114:             ]);
115: 
116:         return back()->with('success', $message);
117:     }
118: 
119:     /**
120:      * Remove a user from Company Directors.
121:      */
122:     public function removeDirector(Company $company, User $user): RedirectResponse
123:     {
124:         $this->ensureSuperAdmin();
125: 
126:         DB::transaction(function () use ($company, $user) {
127:             $company->users()->detach($user->id);
128: 
129:             // Audit: transaction DAXİLİNDƏ — detach və audit bir yerdə.
130:             $this->pivotAuditor->log(
131:                 subject: $company,
132:                 event: 'director_removed',
133:                 oldValues: ['director_id' => $user->id, 'director_name' => $user->name],
134:                 newValues: null,
135:                 companyId: $company->id,
136:             );
137:         });
138: 
139:         $user->forgetDirectorCache();
140: 
141:         return back()->with('success', __(
142:             'messages.super_admin.assignments.director_removed',
143:             ['name' => $user->name, 'company' => $company->name]
144:         ));
145:     }
146: }

 67:                 'email' => $validated['director_email'],

 69:                 'pin' => $validated['director_pin'],

 74:             ->route('super-admin.companies.show', $company)
 75:             ->with('success', __('messages.super_admin.companies.created_with_director', [

 77:                 'director' => $validated['director_email'],
 78:             ]));

 80: 
 81:     /**
 82:      * Display the specified company with garages and directors.
 83:      */
 84:     public function show(Company $company): View
 85:     {
 86:         $this->ensureSuperAdmin();
 87: 
 88:         $company->load([
 89:             'garages' => fn ($q) => $q->orderBy('name'),
 90:             'directors',
 91:         ]);
 92: 
 93:         // Users not already directors of this company
 94:         $directorIds = $company->directors->pluck('id')->toArray();
 95: 
 96:         $availableUsers = User::where('role', 'user')
 97:             ->whereNotIn('id', $directorIds)
 98:             ->orderBy('name')
 99:             ->get();
100: 
101:         return view('super-admin.companies.show', compact('company', 'availableUsers'));
102:     }
103: 
104:     /**
105:      * Show the form for editing the specified company.
106:      */
107:     public function edit(Company $company): View
108:     {
109:         $this->ensureSuperAdmin();
110: 
111:         return view('super-admin.companies.edit', compact('company'));
112:     }
113: 
114:     /**
115:      * Update the specified company in storage.
116:      */
117:     public function update(CompanyUpdateRequest $request, Company $company): RedirectResponse
118:     {
119:         $validated = $request->validated();
120:         $validated['is_active'] = $request->boolean('is_active');
121:

123:
