125:             ->route('super-admin.companies.index')
126:             ->with('success', __('messages.super_admin.companies.updated'));
127:     }
128: 
129:     /**
130:      * Soft delete the specified company.
131:      *
132:      * Only allowed if there are no active garages under this company.
133:      */
134:     public function destroy(Company $company): RedirectResponse
135:     {
136:         $this->ensureSuperAdmin();
137: 
138:         // Block deletion if company has active garages
139:         $activeGarages = $company->garages()->where('is_active', true)->count();
140: 
141:         if ($activeGarages > 0) {
142:             return back()->with('error', __('messages.super_admin.companies.cannot_delete_active_garages', [
143:                 'count' => $activeGarages,
144:             ]));
145:         }
146: 
147:         $company->delete();
148: 
149:         return redirect()
150:             ->route('super-admin.companies.index')
151:             ->with('success', __('messages.super_admin.companies.deleted'));
152:     }
153: 
154:     /**
155:      * Generate a unique slug from the given name.
156:      */
157:     private function generateUniqueSlug(string $name): string
158:     {
159:         $base = Str::slug($name);
160:         $slug = $base;
161:         $counter = 1;
162: 
163:         while (Company::where('slug', $slug)->exists()) {
164:             $slug = $base.'-'.$counter;
165:             $counter++;
166:         }
167: 
168:         return $slug;
169:     }

50:             ->limit(5)

55:             ->withCount('buses')
56:             ->where('is_active', true)
57:             ->orderByDesc('buses_count')

59:             ->get();

<file path="app/Http/Controllers/SuperAdmin/TwoFactorSetupController.php">
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: namespace App\Http\Controllers\SuperAdmin;
  4: 
  5: use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
  6: use App\Support\TwoFactor\TwoFactorManager;
  7: use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
  8: use Illuminate\Http\Request;
  9: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
 10: use Illuminate\View\View;
 11: 
 12: /**
 13:  * Handles MFA setup for the SuperAdmin account.
 14:  *
 15:  * Three-step flow:
 16:  *   1. GET  /super-admin/security/2fa/setup
 17:  *      → generates a pending secret, shows QR code
 18:  *   2. POST /super-admin/security/2fa/setup/confirm
 19:  *      → verifies the first code, marks the secret as confirmed,
 20:  *        generates and shows recovery codes
 21:  *   3. GET  /super-admin/security/2fa/recovery-codes
 22:  *      → shows the codes once (from session), then forgets them
 23:  */
 24: class TwoFactorSetupController extends Controller
 25: {
 26:     public function __construct(
 27:         protected TwoFactorManager $twoFactor
 28:     ) {}
 29: 
 30:     /**
 31:      * Step 1: Show QR code and first-code input.
 32:      *
 33:      * Generates a fresh secret if none is pending. This replaces any
 34:      * pending secret on refresh — the user must complete the flow in
 35:      * one sitting.
 36:      */
 37:     public function show(Request $request): View|RedirectResponse
 38:     {
 39:         $this->ensureSuperAdmin();
 40: 
 41:         $user = $request->user();
 42: 
 43:         if ($user->hasTwoFactorEnabled()) {
 44:             return redirect()
 45:                 ->route('super-admin.settings.index')
 46:                 ->with('info', __('messages.two_factor.already_enabled'));
 47:         }
 48: 
 49:         // Generate a fresh pending secret on each visit.
 50:         $secret = $this->twoFactor->generateSecret();
 51: 
 52:         $user->forceFill(['two_factor_secret' => $secret])->save();
 53: 
 54:         return view('super-admin.security.two-factor-setup', [
 55:             'secret' => $secret,
 56:             'qrCodeUri' => $this->twoFactor->qrCodeDataUri($user, $secret),
 57:         ]);
 58:     }
 59: 
 60:     /**
 61:      * Step 2: Confirm the first TOTP code.
 62:      */
 63:     public function confirm(Request $request): RedirectResponse
 64:     {
 65:         $this->ensureSuperAdmin();
 66: 
 67:         $validated = $request->validate([
 68:             'code' => ['required', 'string', 'digits:6'],
 69:         ]);
 70: 
 71:         $user = $request->user();
 72: 
 73:         if (! $user->two_factor_secret) {
 74:             return redirect()
 75:                 ->route('super-admin.security.2fa.setup')
 76:                 ->with('error', __('messages.two_factor.secret_missing'));
 77:         }
 78: 
 79:         if (! $user->verifyTwoFactorCode($validated['code'])) {
 80:             return back()->withErrors([
 81:                 'code' => __('messages.two_factor.invalid_code'),
 82:             ]);
 83:         }
 84: 
 85:         // Mark as confirmed and generate recovery codes.
 86:         $recovery = $this->twoFactor->generateRecoveryCodes();
 87: 
 88:         $hashed = array_map(
 89:             fn (string $plain) => Hash::make($plain),
 90:             $recovery['hashed'],
 91:         );
 92: 
 93:         $user->forceFill([
 94:             'two_factor_confirmed_at' => now(),
 95:             'two_factor_recovery_codes' => $hashed,
 96:         ])->save();
 97: 
 98:         // Store the plain codes in session — shown ONCE on the next page.
 99:         $request->session()->put('two_factor_recovery_codes_plain', $recovery['plain']);
100: 
101:         return redirect()->route('super-admin.security.2fa.recovery-codes');
102:     }
103: 
104:     /**
105:      * Step 3: Show the recovery codes once.
106:      */
107:     public function showRecoveryCodes(Request $request): View|RedirectResponse
108:     {
109:         $this->ensureSuperAdmin();
110: 
111:         $codes = $request->session()->pull('two_factor_recovery_codes_plain');
112: 
113:         if (! is_array($codes) || empty($codes)) {
114:             return redirect()
115:                 ->route('super-admin.settings.index')
116:                 ->with('info', __('messages.two_factor.recovery_codes_gone'));
117:         }
118: 
119:         return view('super-admin.security.two-factor-recovery-codes', [
120:             'codes' => $codes,
121:         ]);
122:     }
123: }

<file path="app/Http/Controllers/SuperAdmin/UserController.php">
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: namespace App\Http\Controllers\SuperAdmin;
  4: 
  5: use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
  6: use App\Http\Requests\SuperAdmin\UserStoreRequest;
  7: use App\Http\Requests\SuperAdmin\UserUpdateRequest;
  8: use App\Models\User;
  9: use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
 10: use Illuminate\Http\Request;
 11: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
 12: use Illuminate\Support\Str;
 13: use Illuminate\View\View;
 14: 
 15: class UserController extends Controller
 16: {
 17:     /**
 18:      * List all users with their garage/company count.
 19:      */
 20:     public function index(Request $request): View
 21:     {
 22:         $this->ensureSuperAdmin();
 23: 
 24:         $query = User::withCount(['garages']);
 25: 
 26:         // Filter by role
 27:         if ($request->filled('role')) {
 28:             $query->where('role', $request->role);
 29:         }
 30: 
 31:         // Filter by status
 32:         if ($request->filled('status')) {
 33:             $query->where('is_active', $request->status === 'active');
 34:         }
 35: 
 36:         // Search by name, email, or employee code
 37:         if ($request->filled('search')) {
 38:             $search = $request->search;
 39:             $query->where(function ($q) use ($search) {
 40:                 $q->where('name', 'ILIKE', "%{$search}%")
 41:                     ->orWhere('email', 'ILIKE', "%{$search}%")
 42:                     ->orWhere('employee_code', 'ILIKE', "%{$search}%");
 43:             });
 44:         }
 45: 
 46:         $users = $query->orderBy('name')->paginate(config('settings.pagination', 25));
 47: 
 48:         return view('super-admin.users.index', compact('users'));
 49:     }
 50: 
 51:     /**
 52:      * Show the form for creating a new user.
 53:      */
 54:     public function create(): View
 55:     {
 56:         $this->ensureSuperAdmin();
 57: 
 58:         return view('super-admin.users.create');
 59:     }
 60: 
 61:     /**
 62:      * Store a newly created user.
 63:      */
 64:     public function store(UserStoreRequest $request): RedirectResponse
 65:     {
 66:         $validated = $request->validated();
 67: 
 68:         $employeeCode = $validated['employee_code'] ?? $this->generateEmployeeCode();
 69:         $pinWasGenerated = empty($validated['pin']);
 70:         $pin = $validated['pin'] ?? $this->generatePin();
 71: 
 72:         $user = new User;
 73:         $user->forceFill([
 74:             'name' => $validated['name'],
 75:             'email' => $validated['email'],
 76:             'password' => Hash::make($validated['password']),
 77:             'employee_code' => $employeeCode,
 78:             'pin' => Hash::make($pin),
 79:             'pin_is_default' => $pinWasGenerated,
 80:             'is_active' => $request->boolean('is_active', true),
 81:             'email_verified_at' => now(), // ✅ Auto-verified: SuperAdmin yaradıb
 82:         ])->save();
 83: 
 84:         // All user-supplied values are escaped before being placed
 85:         // into the flash message: the translation keys contain HTML
 86:         // (<code> and <strong>) and the blade renders it raw, so
 87:         // escaping here is mandatory.
 88:         return redirect()
 89:             ->route('super-admin.users.index')
 90:             ->with('success', __('messages.super_admin.users.created', [
 91:                 'name' => e($user->name),
 92:                 'code' => e($employeeCode),
 93:                 'pin' => e($pin),
 94:             ]));
 95:     }
 96: 
 97:     /**
 98:      * Show the form for editing the specified user.
 99:      */
100:     public function edit(User $user): View
101:     {
102:         $this->ensureSuperAdmin();
103: 
104:         $user->load(['garages', 'currentGarage']);
105: 
106:         return view('super-admin.users.edit', compact('user'));
107:     }
108: 
109:     /**
110:      * Update the specified user.
111:      */
112:     public function update(UserUpdateRequest $request, User $user): RedirectResponse
113:     {
114:         // Domain rule that is not expressible as a validation rule:
115:         // a super admin may not edit another super admin.
116:         if ($user->isSuperAdmin() && $user->isNot(auth()->user())) {
117:             return back()->with('error', __('messages.super_admin.users.cannot_edit_other_super_admin'));
118:         }
119: 
120:         $validated = $request->validated();
121: 
122:         $updateData = [
123:             'name' => $validated['name'],
124:             'email' => $validated['email'],
125:             'is_active' => $request->boolean('is_active', true),
126:         ];
127: 
128:         if (! empty($validated['employee_code'])) {
129:             $updateData['employee_code'] = $validated['employee_code'];
130:         }
131: 
132:         if (! empty($validated['password'])) {
133:             $updateData['password'] = Hash::make($validated['password']);
134:         }
135: 
136:         if (! empty($validated['pin'])) {
137:             $updateData['pin'] = Hash::make($validated['pin']);
138:             $updateData['pin_is_default'] = false;
139:         }
140: 
141:         // Token revocation on the is_active true → false transition is
142:         // handled automatically by UserObserver — see
143:         // app/Observers/UserObserver.php for the full rationale.
144:         $user->update($updateData);
145: 
146:         return redirect()
147:             ->route('super-admin.users.index')
148:             ->with('success', __('messages.super_admin.users.updated', ['name' => e($user->name)]));
149:     }
150: 
151:     public function destroy(User $user): RedirectResponse
152:     {
153:         $this->ensureSuperAdmin();
154: 
155:         // Prevent deleting self
156:         if ($user->is(auth()->user())) {
157:             return back()->with('error', __('messages.super_admin.users.cannot_delete_self'));
158:         }
159: 
160:         // Prevent deleting a super admin
161:         if ($user->isSuperAdmin()) {
162:             return back()->with('error', __('messages.super_admin.users.cannot_delete_super_admin'));
163:         }
164: 
165:         // Revoke all API tokens BEFORE the soft delete so no orphaned
166:         // token can survive the deactivation.
167:         $user->tokens()->delete();
168: 
169:         $user->delete();
170: 
171:         return redirect()
172:             ->route('super-admin.users.index')
173:             ->with('success', __('messages.super_admin.users.deleted', ['name' => e($user->name)]));
174:     }
175: 
176:     /**
177:      * Generate a unique employee code.
178:      */
179:     private function generateEmployeeCode(): string
180:     {
181:         do {
182:             $code = 'EMP-'.strtoupper(Str::random(6));
183:         } while (User::where('employee_code', $code)->exists());
184: 
185:         return $code;
186:     }
187: 
188:     /**
189:      * Generate a random 4-digit PIN.
190:      */
191:     private function generatePin(): string
192:     {
193:         return (string) random_int(1000, 9999);
194:     }
195: }

<file path="app/Http/Controllers/UserManagementController.php">
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: namespace App\Http\Controllers;
  4: 
  5: use App\Enums\RoleEnum;
  6: use App\Models\User;
  7: use App\Services\GarageContext;
  8: use App\Services\UserService;
  9: use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
 10: use Illuminate\Http\Request;
 11: use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;
 12: use Illuminate\Validation\Rules\Password;
 13: use Illuminate\View\View;
 14: 
 15: class UserManagementController extends Controller
 16: {
 17:     public function __construct(
 18:         protected UserService $userService
 19:     ) {}
 20: 
 21:     public function index(): View|RedirectResponse
 22:     {
 23:         $this->authorize('viewAny', User::class);
 24: 
 25:         $garageId = $this->requireCurrentGarageId();
 26: 
 27:         if ($garageId === null) {
 28:             return redirect()->route('garage.selection')
 29:                 ->with('error', __('messages.flash.no_garage'));
 30:         }
 31: 
 32:         $users = User::query()
 33:             ->whereHas('garages', fn ($query) => $query->whereKey($garageId))
 34:             ->with(['garages' => fn ($query) => $query->whereKey($garageId)])
 35:             ->orderBy('name')
 36:             ->paginate(config('settings.pagination', 25));
 37: 
 38:         return view('users.index', compact('users'));
 39:     }
 40: 
 41:     public function create(): View
 42:     {
 43:         $this->authorize('create', User::class);
 44: 
 45:         return view('users.create', [
 46:             'roles' => RoleEnum::garageRoleLabels(),
 47:         ]);
 48:     }
 49: 
 50:     public function store(Request $request): RedirectResponse
 51:     {
 52:         $this->authorize('create', User::class);
 53: 
 54:         $garageId = $this->requireCurrentGarageId();
 55: 
 56:         if ($garageId === null) {
 57:             return back()->with('error', __('messages.flash.no_current_garage'));
 58:         }
 59: 
 60:         $data = $this->validateUser($request, null, true);
 61: 
 62:         $this->userService->createUserWithGarageRole($data, $garageId, true);
 63: 
 64:         return redirect()->route('users.index')
 65:             ->with('success', __('messages.flash.user_created'));
 66:     }
 67: 
 68:     public function edit(User $user): View|RedirectResponse
 69:     {
 70:         $this->authorize('update', $user);
 71: 
 72:         $garageId = $this->requireCurrentGarageId();
 73: 
 74:         if ($garageId === null) {
 75:             return redirect()->route('garage.selection')
 76:                 ->with('error', __('messages.flash.no_garage'));
 77:         }
 78: 
 79:         $garageRole = $this->garageRoleFor($user, $garageId);
 80: 
 81:         if ($garageRole === null && auth()->user()->isSuperAdmin()) {
 82:             $garageRole = (object) [
 83:                 'role' => 'admin',
 84:                 'is_active' => true,
 85:             ];
 86:         }
 87: 
 88:         if ($garageRole === null) {
 89:             return redirect()->route('users.index')
 90:                 ->with('error', __('messages.flash.user_not_in_garage'));
 91:         }
 92: 
 93:         return view('users.edit', [
 94:             'user' => $user,
 95:             'roles' => RoleEnum::garageRoleLabels(),
 96:             'garageRole' => $garageRole,
 97:         ]);
 98:     }
 99: 
100:     public function update(Request $request, User $user): RedirectResponse
101:     {
102:         $this->authorize('update', $user);
103: 
104:         $garageId = $this->requireCurrentGarageId();
105: 
106:         if ($garageId === null) {
107:             return back()->with('error', __('messages.flash.no_current_garage'));
108:         }
109: 
110:         $garageRole = $this->garageRoleFor($user, $garageId);
111: 
112:         if ($garageRole === null && $user->is(auth()->user()) && $user->isSuperAdmin()) {
113:             $garageRole = (object) ['role' => 'admin', 'is_active' => true];
114:         }
115: 
116:         if ($garageRole === null) {
117:             return back()->with('error', __('messages.flash.user_not_in_garage'));
118:         }
119: 
120:         $data = $this->validateUser($request, $user, false);
121: 
122:         if ($user->is(auth()->user())) {
123:             if ($data['role'] !== 'admin') {
124:                 return back()
125:                     ->withErrors(['role' => __('messages.flash.self_role_change')])
126:                     ->withInput();
127:             }
128:             if (! $data['is_active']) {
129:                 return back()
130:                     ->withErrors(['is_active' => __('messages.flash.self_deactivate')])
131:                     ->withInput();
132:             }
133:         }
134: 
135:         $this->userService->updateUserWithGarageRole($user, $data, $garageId);
136: 
137:         return redirect()->route('users.index')
138:             ->with('success', __('messages.flash.user_updated', ['name' => $user->name]));
139:     }
140: 
141:     private function validateUser(Request $request, ?User $user = null, bool $creating = true): array
142:     {
143:         // Password rules: use Laravel's default strength (min 8, letters + numbers).
144:         // On update, the password is optional — leave blank to keep the current one.
145:         $passwordRules = $creating
146:             ? ['required', 'confirmed', Password::defaults()]
147:             : ['nullable', 'confirmed', Password::defaults()];
148: 
149:         return $request->validate([
150:             'name' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
151:             'email' => [
152:                 'required',
153:                 'email',
154:                 'max:255',
155:                 // Ignore the current user AND only check active rows —
156:                 // mirrors the partial unique index users_email_active_unique
157:                 // so that emails belonging to soft-deleted accounts can
158:                 // be reused.
159:                 Rule::unique('users', 'email')
160:                     ->ignore($user?->id)
161:                     ->whereNull('deleted_at'),
162:             ],
163:             'role' => ['required', Rule::in(RoleEnum::garageRoles())],
164:             'password' => $passwordRules,
165:             'is_active' => [$creating ? 'nullable' : 'required', 'boolean'],
166:         ]);
167:     }
168: 
169:     private function garageRoleFor(User $user, int $garageId): ?object
170:     {
171:         $garage = $user->garages()
172:             ->whereKey($garageId)
173:             ->first();
174: 
175:         return $garage?->pivot;
176:     }
177: 
178:     private function requireCurrentGarageId(): ?int
179:     {
180:         $id = GarageContext::resolveGarageId();
181: 
182:         return $id !== null ? (int) $id : null;
183:     }
184: }

  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: namespace App\Http\Controllers;
  4: 
  5: use App\Http\Requests\WarehouseStoreRequest;
  6: use App\Http\Requests\WarehouseUpdateRequest;

 14: 
 15: class WarehouseController extends Controller
 16: {
 17:     public function index(Request $request): View
 18:     {
 19:         $this->authorize('viewAny', Warehouse::class);
 20: 
 21:         $search = $request->search;
 22:         $view = $request->input('view', 'active');
 23: 
 24:         $query = Warehouse::query();
 25: 
 26:         // Quarantine is a separate view — never shown alongside
 27:         // active stock, because the two are conceptually different
 28:         // (usable vs defective).
 29:         if ($view === 'quarantine') {
 30:             $query->quarantine();
 31:         } elseif ($view === 'all') {
 32:             // no filter
 33:         } else {
 34:             $query->activeStock();
 35:         }
 36: 
 37:         $warehouses = $this->applySearch($query, $search)
 38:             ->orderBy('id', 'desc')
 39:             ->paginate(config('settings.pagination', 15));
 40: 
 41:         $quarantineCount = Warehouse::query()->quarantine()->count();
 42: 
 43:         return view('warehouses.index', compact('warehouses', 'search', 'view', 'quarantineCount'));
 44:     }
 45: 
 46:     public function search(Request $request): View|string
 47:     {
 48:         $this->authorize('viewAny', Warehouse::class);
 49: 
 50:         $search = $request->search;
 51:         $view = $request->input('view', 'active');
 52: 
 53:         $query = Warehouse::query();
 54: 
 55:         if ($view === 'quarantine') {
 56:             $query->quarantine();
 57:         } elseif ($view !== 'all') {
 58:             $query->activeStock();
 59:         }
 60: 
 61:         $warehouses = $this->applySearch($query, $search)
 62:             ->orderBy('id', 'desc')
 63:             ->paginate(config('settings.pagination', 15));
 64: 
 65:         // Mirror the pattern used by BusController::search() and
 66:         // ComplaintController::search(): an AJAX request receives the
 67:         // partial only, everything else gets the full page with
 68:         // layout, sidebar and pagination. Without this fallback a
 69:         // direct URL visit (or a middle-click "open in new tab")
 70:         // rendered a bare table fragment with no navigation.
 71:         if ($this->isAjaxRequest($request)) {
 72:             return view('warehouses.partials.table', compact('warehouses', 'search', 'view'))->render();
 73:         }
 74: 
 75:         $quarantineCount = Warehouse::query()->quarantine()->count();
 76: 
 77:         return view('warehouses.index', compact('warehouses', 'search', 'view', 'quarantineCount'));
 78:     }
 79: 
 80:     public function create(): View
 81:     {
 82:         $this->authorize('create', Warehouse::class);
 83: 
 84:         return view('warehouses.create');
 85:     }
 86: 
 87:     public function store(WarehouseStoreRequest $request): RedirectResponse
 88:     {
 89:         $this->authorize('create', Warehouse::class);
 90: 
 91:         Warehouse::create($request->validated());
 92: 
 93:         return redirect()->route('warehouses.index')
 94:             ->with('success', __('messages.flash.created', ['Item' => 'Warehouse item']));
 95:     }
 96: 
 97:     public function show(int $id): View
 98:     {
 99:         $warehouse = Warehouse::findOrFail($id);
100: 
101:         $this->authorize('view', $warehouse);
102: 
103:         return view('warehouses.show', compact('warehouse'));
104:     }
105: 
106:     public function edit(int $id): View
107:     {
108:         $warehouse = Warehouse::findOrFail($id);
109: 
110:         $this->authorize('update', $warehouse);
111: 
112:         return view('warehouses.edit', compact('warehouse'));
113:     }
114: 
115:     public function update(WarehouseUpdateRequest $request, int $id): RedirectResponse

142:

144:     }

146:     public function import(Request $request): RedirectResponse
147:     {
148:         // Garage context must be resolved BEFORE authorization — see
149:         // ComplaintController::import() for the full rationale.
150:         $garageId = GarageContext::resolveGarageId();
151: 
152:         if ($garageId === null || $garageId <= 0) {
153:             return redirect()
154:                 ->route('garage.selection')
155:                 ->with('error', __('messages.flash.no_current_garage'));
156:         }
157: 
158:         $this->authorize('import', Warehouse::class);
159: 
160:         $request->validate([
161:             'file' => 'required|mimes:xlsx,xls,csv|max:10240',
162:             'mode' => 'nullable|in:overwrite,add',
163:         ]);
164: 
165:         // Default to OVERWRITE so the historical behaviour is preserved
166:         // for any client that does not send the mode field.
167:         $mode = $request->input('mode', WarehouseImport::MODE_OVERWRITE);
168: 
169:         try {
170:             Excel::import(
171:                 new WarehouseImport(
172:                     $garageId,
173:                     GarageContext::resolveCompanyId(),
174:                     $mode,
175:                 ),
176:                 $request->file('file')
177:             );
178: 
179:             return redirect()->route('warehouses.index')
180:                 ->with('success', __('messages.flash.import_success', [
181:                     'count' => '',
182:                     'items' => 'Warehouse items',
183:                 ]));
184:         } catch (\Throwable $e) {
185:             report($e);
186: 
187:             return redirect()->route('warehouses.index')
188:                 ->with('error', __('messages.flash.import_error'));
189:         }
190:     }
191: 
192:     /**
193:      * Apply search to query.
194:      *
195:      * CRITICAL: `orWhere` must be inside a closure. Otherwise the garage
196:      * global scope is lost due to SQL operator precedence, and other
197:      * garages' data leaks.
198:      *
199:      * @param  \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder<Warehouse>  $query
200:      * @return \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder<Warehouse>
201:      */
202:     private function applySearch($query, ?string $search)
203:     {
204:         if (! $search) {
205:             return $query;
206:         }
207: 
208:         return $query->where(function ($q) use ($search) {
209:             $q->where('code', 'ILIKE', "%{$search}%")
210:                 ->orWhere('name', 'ILIKE', "%{$search}%");
211:         });
212:     }
213: }

<file path="app/Http/Middleware/EnforcePinChange.php">
 1: <?php
 2: 
 3: namespace App\Http\Middleware;
 4: 
 5: use Closure;
 6: use Illuminate\Http\Request;
 7: use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;
 8: 
 9: /**
10:  * Forces users to change their default PIN before accessing any
11:  * other page.
12:  *
13:  * Rules:
14:  *   - Skip for guests, super admins, and users without a PIN.
15:  *   - Allow access to a small whitelist of routes so the forced
16:  *     PIN-change flow cannot trap the user:
17:  *       * the change flow itself
18:  *       * logout
19:  *       * email verification screens
20:  *       * password re-confirmation
21:  *       * 2FA challenge screens
22:  *
23:  * Note: the PIN change requirement is on the user, not the session,
24:  * so it survives across requests until the user sets a new PIN.
25:  */
26: class EnforcePinChange
27: {
28:     /**
29:      * Route name patterns that must remain reachable while a PIN
30:      * change is pending. Trailing ".*" is treated as a prefix match
31:      * by Laravel's routeIs() helper.
32:      *
33:      * @var array<int, string>
34:      */
35:     private const ALLOWED_ROUTE_PATTERNS = [
36:         'pin.change.*',        // The change flow itself
37:         'logout',              // Always available
38:         'password.confirm',    // Password re-entry for sensitive actions
39:         'password.confirm.store',
40:         'verification.notice', // Email verification screens
41:         'verification.verify',
42:         'verification.send',
43:         'two-factor.*',        // TOTP challenge screens
44:     ];
45: 
46:     public function handle(Request $request, Closure $next): Response
47:     {
48:         $user = $request->user();
49: 
50:         if (! $user
51:             || $user->isSuperAdmin()
52:             || ! $user->pin
53:             || ! $user->pin_is_default) {
54:             return $next($request);
55:         }
56: 
57:         foreach (self::ALLOWED_ROUTE_PATTERNS as $pattern) {
58:             if ($request->routeIs($pattern)) {
59:                 return $next($request);
60:             }
61:         }
62: 
63:         return redirect()->route('pin.change.show');
64:     }
65: }

<file path="app/Http/Middleware/EnsureActiveUser.php">
 1: <?php
 2: 
 3: namespace App\Http\Middleware;
 4: 
 5: use Closure;
 6: use Illuminate\Http\Request;
 7: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;
 8: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;
 9: use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;
10: 
11: /**
12:  * Ensures that an authenticated user has an active account.
13:  *
14:  * Two scenarios are covered:
15:  *
16:  *   1. WEB — the user was deactivated by an admin while their session
17:  *      was still alive. The session cookie keeps working even after
18:  *      `users.is_active = false`, because Laravel's session guard does
19:  *      not re-validate the user on every request. This middleware
20:  *      closes that gap: on the next request the user is logged out,
21:  *      the session is invalidated, and they are redirected to /login.
22:  *
23:  *   2. API — the user holds a valid Sanctum token but the account has
24:  *      since been deactivated. The token is revoked and the response
25:  *      is a 401 JSON error, matching what a fresh (rejected) login
26:  *      would return.
27:  *
28:  * Runs as part of the `web` middleware group AFTER StartSession, so
29:  * `auth()->check()` is available. On API routes it must be applied
30:  * after `auth:sanctum`.
31:  */
32: class EnsureActiveUser
33: {
34:     public function handle(Request $request, Closure $next): Response
35:     {
36:         $user = $request->user() ?? Auth::user();
37: 
38:         // No authenticated user → nothing to check.
39:         if (! $user) {
40:             return $next($request);
41:         }
42: 
43:         // Active users pass through unchanged.
44:         if ($user->is_active) {
45:             return $next($request);
46:         }
47: 
48:         // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
49:         // API: revoke the current token and return JSON 401.
50:         // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
51:         if ($request->is('api/*') || $request->expectsJson()) {
52:             try {
53:                 $user->currentAccessToken()?->delete();
54:             } catch (\Throwable $e) {
55:                 // Never let a token-revoke failure mask the 401.
56:             }
57: 
58:             Log::warning('Inactive user blocked (API)', [
59:                 'user_id' => $user->id,
60:                 'ip' => $request->ip(),
61:                 'request_id' => \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Context::get('request_id'),
62:             ]);
63: 
64:             return response()->json([
65:                 'message' => __('auth.inactive'),
66:             ], 401);
67:         }
68: 
69:         // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
70:         // Web: log out, invalidate the session, redirect to login.
71:         // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
72:         Log::warning('Inactive user session invalidated (web)', [
73:             'user_id' => $user->id,
74:             'ip' => $request->ip(),
75:             'request_id' => \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Context::get('request_id'),
76:         ]);
77: 
78:         Auth::guard('web')->logout();
79:         $request->session()->invalidate();
80:         $request->session()->regenerateToken();
81: 
82:         return redirect()
83:             ->route('login')
84:             ->with('error', __('auth.inactive'));
85:     }
86: }

<file path="app/Http/Middleware/EnsureDirector.php">
 1: <?php
 2: 
 3: namespace App\Http\Middleware;
 4: 
 5: use Closure;
 6: use Illuminate\Http\Request;
 7: use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;
 8: 
 9: /**
10:  * Restricts access to /director/* routes to users holding an active
11:  * Company Director role (via the company_user pivot).
12:  *
13:  * Super Admins are allowed through so they can inspect director
14:  * dashboards while debugging. Every other authenticated user gets a
15:  * 403 — matching the fail-closed behaviour used elsewhere.
16:  *
17:  * Why middleware instead of a controller check:
18:  *   - The role check runs BEFORE the controller is instantiated,
19:  *     so no page-specific query is wasted on an unauthorized user.
20:  *   - Reuses the cached isDirector() result on the User model,
21:  *     so the per-request cost is one EXISTS query at most.
22:  */
23: class EnsureDirector
24: {
25:     public function handle(Request $request, Closure $next): Response
26:     {
27:         $user = $request->user();
28: 
29:         if (! $user) {
30:             return redirect()->route('login');
31:         }
32: 
33:         // Super Admin bypasses — matches the pattern used by
34:         // RoleMiddleware and every policy.
35:         if ($user->isSuperAdmin()) {
36:             return $next($request);
37:         }
38: 
39:         if (! $user->isDirector()) {
40:             abort(403, __('messages.flash.permission_denied'));
41:         }
42: 
43:         return $next($request);
44:     }
45: }

<file path="app/Http/Middleware/EnsureGarageSelected.php">
 1: <?php
 2: 
 3: namespace App\Http\Middleware;
 4: 
 5: use App\Models\Garage;
 6: use App\Services\GarageContext;
 7: use Closure;
 8: use Illuminate\Http\Request;
 9: 
10: class EnsureGarageSelected
11: {
12:     public function handle(Request $request, Closure $next)
13:     {
14:         $user = $request->user();
15: 
16:         if (! $user) {
17:             return redirect()->route('login');
18:         }
19: 
20:         $garageId = $request->session()->get('current_garage_id');
21:         $companyId = $request->session()->get('current_company_id');
22: 
23:         // Directors have no garage context. If they somehow reach a
24:         // garage-scoped route without a selected garage, send them to
25:         // their company dashboard.
26:         if (! $garageId && $user->isDirector()) {
27:             return redirect()->route('director.dashboard');
28:         }
29: 
30:         // No garage in session — redirect with a clear message so the
31:         // user understands why they were sent to the selection screen.
32:         if (! $garageId) {
33:             return redirect()
34:                 ->route('garage.selection')
35:                 ->with('error', __('messages.flash.no_garage'));
36:         }
37: 
38:         // Super admin — verify garage exists and is active, set context
39:         if ($user->isSuperAdmin()) {
40:             $garage = Garage::find($garageId);
41: 
42:             if (! $garage || ! $garage->is_active) {
43:                 $this->clearGarageSession($request);
44: 
45:                 return redirect()
46:                     ->route('garage.selection')
47:                     ->with('error', ! $garage ? __('messages.flash.garage_not_found') : __('messages.flash.garage_access_denied'));
48:             }
49: 
50:             GarageContext::set($garage->id, $garage->company_id);
51: 
52:             return $next($request);
53:         }
54: 
55:         // Regular user — verify membership and garage is active
56:         $membership = $user->garages()
57:             ->whereKey($garageId)
58:             ->where('garages.is_active', true)
59:             ->wherePivot('is_active', true)
60:             ->first();
61: 
62:         if (! $membership) {
63:             $this->clearGarageSession($request);
64:             GarageContext::clear();
65: 
66:             // If they are also a Director (no membership), send them to
67:             // the director dashboard instead of back to selection.
68:             if ($user->isDirector()) {
69:                 return redirect()->route('director.dashboard');
70:             }
71: 
72:             return redirect()
73:                 ->route('garage.selection')
74:                 ->with('error', __('messages.flash.garage_access_denied'));
75:         }
76: 
77:         GarageContext::set((int) $membership->id, $membership->company_id);
78: 
79:         return $next($request);
80:     }
81: 
82:     /**
83:      * Remove garage-related entries from the session.
84:      */
85:     private function clearGarageSession(Request $request): void
86:     {
87:         $request->session()->forget([
88:             'current_garage_id',
89:             'current_garage_name',
90:             'current_company_id',
91:             'current_company_name',
92:         ]);
93:     }
94: }

<file path="app/Http/Middleware/IdempotencyMiddleware.php">
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: namespace App\Http\Middleware;
  4: 
  5: use App\Services\GarageContext;
  6: use Closure;
  7: use Illuminate\Contracts\Cache\LockTimeoutException;
  8: use Illuminate\Http\Request;
  9: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;
 10: use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;
 11: 
 12: class IdempotencyMiddleware
 13: {
 14:     private const CACHE_TTL_HOURS = 12;
 15: 
 16:     private const LOCK_SECONDS = 30;
 17: 
 18:     private const MAX_KEY_LENGTH = 255;
 19: 
 20:     /**
 21:      * Responses larger than this are not cached. Guards against
 22:      * PDF/Excel exports and binary downloads bloating the cache
 23:      * store. 512 KB is generous for JSON payloads while keeping
 24:      * the cache fast.
 25:      */
 26:     private const MAX_CACHEABLE_RESPONSE_BYTES = 512 * 1024;
 27: 
 28:     private const STRIPPED_HEADERS = [
 29:         'set-cookie',
 30:         'cookie',
 31:         'date',
 32:         'content-length',
 33:         'transfer-encoding',
 34:     ];
 35: 
 36:     public function handle(Request $request, Closure $next): Response
 37:     {
 38:         if (! in_array($request->method(), ['POST', 'PUT', 'PATCH', 'DELETE'], true)) {
 39:             return $next($request);
 40:         }
 41: 
 42:         $idempotencyKey = $this->extractIdempotencyKey($request);
 43: 
 44:         if ($idempotencyKey === null) {
 45:             return $next($request);
 46:         }
 47: 
 48:         $cacheKey = $this->buildCacheKey($request, $idempotencyKey);
 49:         $lockKey = $cacheKey.':lock';
 50: 
 51:         // 1. CACHE HIT
 52:         $cached = Cache::get($cacheKey);
 53:         if (is_array($cached) && isset($cached['status'])) {
 54:             return $this->buildCachedResponse($cached);
 55:         }
 56: 
 57:         // 2. ATOMİK LOCK
 58:         $lock = Cache::lock($lockKey, self::LOCK_SECONDS);
 59: 
 60:         try {
 61:             // block() waits up to LOCK_SECONDS for the lock. If another request
 62:             // holding the lock doesn't finish in time, throw 409 (not 500) so
 63:             // the client can retry rather than receiving a generic server error.
 64:             try {
 65:                 $lock->block(self::LOCK_SECONDS);
 66:             } catch (LockTimeoutException) {
 67:                 return response()->json([
 68:                     'message' => 'Request is already being processed. Please retry.',
 69:                     'error' => 'lock_timeout',
 70:                 ], 409);
 71:             }
 72: 
 73:             $cached = Cache::get($cacheKey);
 74:             if (is_array($cached) && isset($cached['status'])) {
 75:                 return $this->buildCachedResponse($cached);
 76:             }
 77: 
 78:             // 3. REAL SORĞU
 79:             $response = $next($request);
 80: 
 81:             // 4. UĞURLU CAVABI KEŞLƏ
 82:             $status = $response->getStatusCode();
 83:             $hasValidationErrors = $this->responseHasValidationErrors($response);
 84: 
 85:             if ($status >= 200 && $status < 400 && ! $hasValidationErrors) {
 86:                 $content = (string) $response->getContent();
 87: 
 88:                 // Skip caching oversized responses (PDFs, Excel
 89:                 // exports, binary downloads). Writing them would
 90:                 // bloat the cache store and slow down every later
 91:                 // request that touches the same key.
 92:                 if (strlen($content) <= self::MAX_CACHEABLE_RESPONSE_BYTES) {
 93:                     Cache::put($cacheKey, [
 94:                         'status' => $status,
 95:                         'headers' => $this->filterHeaders($response->headers->all()),
 96:                         'content' => $content,
 97:                     ], now()->addHours(self::CACHE_TTL_HOURS));
 98:                 }
 99:             }
100: 
101:             return $response;
102:         } finally {
103:             optional($lock)->release();
104:         }
105:     }
106: 
107:     private function extractIdempotencyKey(Request $request): ?string
108:     {
109:         $key = $request->header('X-Idempotency-Key')
110:             ?? $request->header('Idempotency-Key')
111:             ?? $request->input('_idempotency_key');
112: 
113:         if (! is_string($key) || $key === '') {
114:             return null;
115:         }
116: 
117:         $key = trim($key);
118: 
119:         if (mb_strlen($key) > self::MAX_KEY_LENGTH) {
120:             return null;
121:         }
122: 
123:         return $key;
124:     }
125: 
126:     private function buildCacheKey(Request $request, string $idempotencyKey): string
127:     {
128:         $userId = $request->user()?->getKey() ?? 'guest';
129:         $garageId = GarageContext::getGarageId() ?? 'none';
130:         $method = $request->method();
131:         $path = $request->path();
132:         $query = $request->getQueryString() ?? '';
133:         $keyHash = hash('sha256', $idempotencyKey);
134: 
135:         // ✅ YENİ: include the request body hash.
136:         //
137:         // Without this, two POSTs with the same key but different
138:         // bodies would collide and the second would receive the first
139:         // response. That is arguably correct per RFC 7231 (idempotency
140:         // keys must not be reused for different payloads), but in
141:         // practice a UI bug that reuses a key is far more likely than
142:         // a deliberate replay, and the failure is silent.
143:         //
144:         // By including the body hash, the second request simply gets
145:         // a fresh idempotency slot and executes normally.
146:         $bodyHash = hash('sha256', (string) $request->getContent());
147: 
148:         return "idempotency:{$userId}:{$garageId}:{$method}:{$path}:{$query}:{$keyHash}:{$bodyHash}";
149:     }
150: 
151:     private function buildCachedResponse(array $cached): Response
152:     {
153:         return response(
154:             $cached['content'] ?? '',
155:             $cached['status'] ?? 200,
156:             array_merge(
157:                 $cached['headers'] ?? [],
158:                 ['X-Cache-Lookup' => 'HIT-IDEMPOTENT']
159:             )
160:         );
161:     }
162: 
163:     /**
164:      * @param  array<string, array<int, string>>  $headers
165:      * @return array<string, array<int, string>>
166:      */
167:     private function filterHeaders(array $headers): array
168:     {
169: 
170:         $filtered = [];
171: 
172:         foreach ($headers as $name => $values) {
173:             if (in_array(strtolower($name), self::STRIPPED_HEADERS, true)) {
174:                 continue;
175:             }
176:             $filtered[$name] = $values;
177:         }
178: 
179:         return $filtered;
180:     }
181: 
182:     /**
183:      * Response-da validation error olub-olmadığını yoxlayır.
184:      *
185:      * `RedirectResponse::getSession()` — bu, controller-in `withErrors()`
186:      * ilə yazdığı session instansiyasının EYNİSİDİR. Request-dən oxumaq
187:      * əvəzinə response-dan oxumaq 100% etibarlıdır.
188:      */
189:     private function responseHasValidationErrors(Response $response): bool
190:     {
191:         if (! method_exists($response, 'getSession')) {
192:             return false;
193:         }
194: 
195:         try {
196:             $session = $response->getSession();
197: 
198:             if (! $session) {
199:                 return false;
200:             }
201: 
202:             $errors = $session->get('errors');
203: 
204:             return $this->errorsBagHasContent($errors);
205:         } catch (\Throwable $e) {
206:             return false;
207:         }
208:     }
209: 
210:     /**
211:      * Error bag-in boş olub-olmadığını universal şəkildə yoxlayır.
212:      */
213:     private function errorsBagHasContent(mixed $errors): bool
214:     {
215:         if ($errors === null) {
216:             return false;
217:         }
218: 
219:         if (is_object($errors)) {
220:             if (method_exists($errors, 'any')) {
221:                 return (bool) $errors->any();
222:             }
223:             if (method_exists($errors, 'isNotEmpty')) {
224:                 return (bool) $errors->isNotEmpty();
225:             }
226:             if (method_exists($errors, 'isEmpty')) {
227:                 return ! $errors->isEmpty();
228:             }
229:             if (method_exists($errors, 'count')) {
230:                 return $errors->count() > 0;
231:             }
232:         }
233: 
234:         if (is_array($errors)) {
235:             return count($errors) > 0;
236:         }
237: 
238:         return false;
239:     }
240: }

<file path="app/Http/Middleware/RequestIdMiddleware.php">
 1: <?php
 2: 
 3: namespace App\Http\Middleware;
 4: 
 5: use Closure;
 6: use Illuminate\Http\Request;
 7: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Context;
 8: use Illuminate\Support\Str;
 9: use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;
10: 
11: /**
12:  * Ensures every request carries a valid, unique X-Request-ID that is
13:  * propagated to logs (via Context) and back to the client.
14:  *
15:  * The incoming header is accepted ONLY if it is a valid UUID. This
16:  * prevents log injection and correlation poisoning — an attacker
17:  * cannot send "X-Request-ID: anything" and end up with that value
18:  * showing up in every log line for the request.
19:  */
20: class RequestIdMiddleware
21: {
22:     public function handle(Request $request, Closure $next): Response
23:     {
24:         // Only accept an incoming header if it is a valid UUID.
25:         // Otherwise generate our own UUID.
26:         $incoming = $request->header('X-Request-ID');
27: 
28:         $requestId = (is_string($incoming) && Str::isUuid($incoming))
29:             ? $incoming
30:             : Str::uuid()->toString();
31: 
32:         // Laravel Context — this value is automatically attached to
33:         // every log entry produced during the request.
34:         Context::add('request_id', $requestId);
35: 
36:         // Write it back onto the request headers so controllers can
37:         // access it if needed.
38:         $request->headers->set('X-Request-ID', $requestId);
39: 
40:         $response = $next($request);
41: 
42:         // Add it to the response headers too — for frontend and
43:         // monitoring tools.
44:         $response->headers->set('X-Request-ID', $requestId);
45: 
46:         return $response;
47:     }
48: }

<file path="app/Http/Middleware/RoleMiddleware.php">
 1: <?php
 2: 
 3: namespace App\Http\Middleware;
 4: 
 5: use App\Services\GarageContext;
 6: use Closure;
 7: use Illuminate\Http\Request;
 8: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;
 9: 
10: class RoleMiddleware
11: {
12:     public function handle(Request $request, Closure $next, ...$roles)
13:     {
14:         if (! Auth::check()) {
15:             return redirect()->route('login');
16:         }
17: 
18:         $user = Auth::user();
19: 
20:         // Super admin bypasses all role checks
21:         if ($user->isSuperAdmin()) {
22:             $garageId = $request->session()->get('current_garage_id');
23:             $companyId = $request->session()->get('current_company_id');
24:             if ($garageId) {
25:                 GarageContext::set((int) $garageId, $companyId ? (int) $companyId : null);
26:             }
27: 
28:             return $next($request);
29:         }
30: 
31:         // Garage selected?
32:         $garageId = $request->session()->get('current_garage_id');
33:         if (! $garageId) {
34:             return redirect()->route('garage.selection');
35:         }
36: 
37:         // User must belong to the current garage
38:         $membership = $user->garages()
39:             ->whereKey($garageId)
40:             ->wherePivot('is_active', true)
41:             ->first();
42: 
43:         if (! $membership) {
44:             $request->session()->forget([
45:                 'current_garage_id',
46:                 'current_garage_name',
47:                 'current_company_id',
48:                 'current_company_name',
49:             ]);
50:             GarageContext::clear();
51: 
52:             return redirect()->route('garage.selection')
53:                 ->with('error', __('messages.flash.garage_access_denied'));
54:         }
55: 
56:         GarageContext::set(
57:             (int) $garageId,
58:             $request->session()->get('current_company_id')
59:                 ? (int) $request->session()->get('current_company_id')
60:                 : null
61:         );
62: 
63:         if (empty($roles)) {
64:             return $next($request);
65:         }
66: 
67:         if ($user->hasGarageRole($roles, $garageId)) {
68:             return $next($request);
69:         }
70: 
71:         abort(403, __('messages.flash.permission_denied'));
72:     }
73: }

<file path="app/Http/Middleware/SetLocale.php">
 1: <?php
 2: 
 3: namespace App\Http\Middleware;
 4: 
 5: use Closure;
 6: use Illuminate\Http\Request;
 7: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\App;
 8: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Session;
 9: use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;
10: 
11: class SetLocale
12: {
13:     public function handle(Request $request, Closure $next): Response
14:     {
15:         $supported = array_keys(config('app.supported_locales', ['en']));
16: 
17:         // Priorities:
18:         // 1. Explicit user request (?lang=ru)
19:         // 2. Session (user previously chose)
20:         // 3. User preference (future: users.locale column)
21:         // 4. Browser preference (Accept-Language header)
22:         // 5. App default (env APP_LOCALE)
23:         $locale = $request->query('lang')
24:             ?? Session::get('locale')
25:             ?? $request->getPreferredLanguage($supported)
26:             ?? config('app.locale');
27: 
28:         if (! in_array($locale, $supported, true)) {
29:             $locale = config('app.fallback_locale', 'en');
30:         }
31: 
32:         // Persist choice in session so next request remembers it
33:         if ($request->query('lang')) {
34:             Session::put('locale', $locale);
35:         }
36: 
37:         App::setLocale($locale);
38: 
39:         return $next($request);
40:     }
41: }

<file path="app/Http/Requests/Auth/LoginRequest.php">
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: namespace App\Http\Requests\Auth;
  4: 
  5: use Illuminate\Auth\Events\Lockout;
  6: use Illuminate\Contracts\Validation\ValidationRule;
  7: use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;
  8: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;
  9: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\RateLimiter;
 10: use Illuminate\Support\Str;
 11: use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
 12: 
 13: class LoginRequest extends FormRequest
 14: {
 15:     /**
 16:      * Determine if the user is authorized to make this request.
 17:      */
 18:     public function authorize(): bool
 19:     {
 20:         return true;
 21:     }
 22: 
 23:     /**
 24:      * Get the validation rules that apply to the request.
 25:      *
 26:      * @return array<string, ValidationRule|array<mixed>|string>
 27:      */
 28:     public function rules(): array
 29:     {
 30:         return [
 31:             'email' => ['required', 'string', 'email'],
 32:             'password' => ['required', 'string'],
 33:         ];
 34:     }
 35: 
 36:     /**
 37:      * Attempt to authenticate the request's credentials.
 38:      *
 39:      * @throws ValidationException
 40:      */
 41:     public function authenticate(): void
 42:     {
 43:         $this->ensureIsNotRateLimited();
 44: 
 45:         if (! Auth::attempt($this->only('email', 'password'), $this->boolean('remember'))) {
 46:             RateLimiter::hit(
 47:                 $this->throttleKey(),
 48:                 (int) config('rate_limits.login_decay_seconds', 900)
 49:             );
 50: 
 51:             throw ValidationException::withMessages([
 52:                 'email' => trans('auth.failed'),
 53:             ]);
 54:         }
 55: 
 56:         // Reject deactivated accounts AFTER the password check so that
 57:         // the response time profile is identical to a wrong-password
 58:         // attempt (account-status enumeration defense). The error
 59:         // message is the generic credentials error, not a specific
 60:         // "account disabled" message.
 61:         $user = Auth::user();
 62: 
 63:         if ($user && ! $user->is_active) {
 64:             Auth::guard('web')->logout();
 65: 
 66:             RateLimiter::hit(
 67:                 $this->throttleKey(),
 68:                 (int) config('rate_limits.login_decay_seconds', 900)
 69:             );
 70: 
 71:             throw ValidationException::withMessages([
 72:                 'email' => trans('auth.failed'),
 73:             ]);
 74:         }
 75: 
 76:         RateLimiter::clear($this->throttleKey());
 77:     }
 78: 
 79:     /**
 80:      * Ensure the login request is not rate limited.
 81:      *
 82:      * @throws ValidationException
 83:      */
 84:     public function ensureIsNotRateLimited(): void
 85:     {
 86:         $maxAttempts = (int) config('rate_limits.login_attempts', 5);
 87: 
 88:         if (! RateLimiter::tooManyAttempts($this->throttleKey(), $maxAttempts)) {
 89:             return;
 90:         }
 91: 
 92:         event(new Lockout($this));
 93: 
 94:         $seconds = RateLimiter::availableIn($this->throttleKey());
 95: 
 96:         throw ValidationException::withMessages([
 97:             'email' => trans('auth.throttle', [
 98:                 'seconds' => $seconds,
 99:                 'minutes' => ceil($seconds / 60),
100:             ]),
101:         ]);
102:     }
103: 
104:     /**
105:      * Get the rate limiting throttle key for the request.
106:      */
107:     public function throttleKey(): string
108:     {
109:         return Str::transliterate(Str::lower($this->string('email')).'|'.$this->ip());
110:     }
111: }

<file path="app/Http/Requests/Auth/PinLoginRequest.php">
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: namespace App\Http\Requests\Auth;
  4: 
  5: use App\Models\User;
  6: use App\Support\Auth\TimingAttackDefense;
  7: use Illuminate\Auth\Events\Lockout;
  8: use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;
  9: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
 10: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\RateLimiter;
 11: use Illuminate\Support\Str;
 12: use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
 13: 
 14: class PinLoginRequest extends FormRequest
 15: {
 16:     /**
 17:      * Determine if the user is authorized to make this request.
 18:      */
 19:     public function authorize(): bool
 20:     {
 21:         return true;
 22:     }
 23: 
 24:     /**
 25:      * Validation rules for PIN login.
 26:      */
 27:     public function rules(): array
 28:     {
 29:         return [
 30:             'employee_code' => ['required', 'string', 'max:50'],
 31:             'pin' => ['required', 'string', 'digits_between:4,6'],
 32:         ];
 33:     }
 34: 
 35:     /**
 36:      * Attempt to authenticate using employee code + PIN.
 37:      *
 38:      * @throws ValidationException
 39:      */
 40:     public function authenticate(): User
 41:     {
 42:         $this->ensureIsNotRateLimited();
 43: 
 44:         $code = mb_strtoupper(trim((string) $this->input('employee_code')));
 45:         $pin = (string) $this->input('pin');
 46: 
 47:         $user = User::where('employee_code', $code)->first();
 48: 
 49:         // Timing-attack defense: always run bcrypt, even when the
 50:         // employee code does not exist. Same cost as a real check.
 51:         $hashToCheck = $user?->pin ?? TimingAttackDefense::DUMMY_HASH;
 52:         $pinValid = Hash::check($pin, $hashToCheck);
 53: 
 54:         // Generic error messages to prevent user/account enumeration.
 55:         if (! $user) {
 56:             $this->failAndRateLimit('employee_code');
 57:         }
 58: 
 59:         // Only role='user' accounts can login with PIN.
 60:         if ($user->role !== 'user') {
 61:             $this->failAndRateLimit('employee_code');
 62:         }
 63: 
 64:         if (! $user->is_active) {
 65:             $this->failAndRateLimit('employee_code');
 66:         }
 67: 
 68:         if (! $pinValid) {
 69:             $this->failAndRateLimit('pin');
 70:         }
 71: 
 72:         RateLimiter::clear($this->throttleKey());
 73:         RateLimiter::clear($this->accountThrottleKey());
 74: 
 75:         return $user;
 76:     }
 77: 
 78:     /**
 79:      * Ensure the login request is not rate limited.
 80:      *
 81:      * Two independent limits are enforced:
 82:      *   1. IP + employee_code — the existing per-endpoint guard
 83:      *   2. employee_code only — an account-level guard that survives
 84:      *      IP rotation, protecting against distributed brute-force
 85:      *      attacks against a single PIN
 86:      *
 87:      * @throws ValidationException
 88:      */
 89:     public function ensureIsNotRateLimited(): void
 90:     {
 91:         $maxAttempts = (int) config('rate_limits.login_attempts', 5);
 92: 
 93:         if (RateLimiter::tooManyAttempts($this->throttleKey(), $maxAttempts)) {
 94:             $this->throwLockout($this->throttleKey());
 95:         }
 96: 
 97:         $accountMax = (int) config('rate_limits.pin_account_attempts', 15);
 98: 
 99:         if (RateLimiter::tooManyAttempts($this->accountThrottleKey(), $accountMax)) {
100:             $this->throwLockout($this->accountThrottleKey());
101:         }
102:     }
103: 
104:     /**
105:      * @throws ValidationException
106:      */
107:     protected function throwLockout(string $key): never
108:     {
109:         event(new Lockout($this));
110: 
111:         $seconds = RateLimiter::availableIn($key);
112: 
113:         throw ValidationException::withMessages([
114:             'employee_code' => trans('auth.throttle', [
115:                 'seconds' => $seconds,
116:                 'minutes' => ceil($seconds / 60),
117:             ]),
118:         ]);
119:     }
120: 
121:     /**
122:      * Increase rate limit and throw a generic validation error.
123:      *
124:      * @throws ValidationException
125:      */
126:     protected function failAndRateLimit(string $field): never
127:     {
128:         $decay = (int) config('rate_limits.login_decay_seconds', 900);
129: 
130:         // Hər iki limiti eyni vaxtda vur — IP dəyişikliyi bypass etməsin.
131:         RateLimiter::hit($this->throttleKey(), $decay);
132:         RateLimiter::hit($this->accountThrottleKey(), $decay);
133: 
134:         throw ValidationException::withMessages([
135:             $field => __('auth.failed'),
136:         ]);
137:     }
138: 
139:     /**
140:      * Per-endpoint throttle key: employee_code + IP address.
141:      */
142:     public function throttleKey(): string
143:     {
144:         $code = Str::transliterate(Str::lower((string) $this->input('employee_code')));
145: 
146:         return $code.'|'.$this->ip();
147:     }
148: 
149:     /**
150:      * Account-level throttle key: employee_code only, IP-independent.
151:      *
152:      * This exists specifically to close the IP-rotation bypass
153:      * against a single employee account.
154:      */
155:     public function accountThrottleKey(): string
156:     {
157:         $code = Str::transliterate(Str::lower((string) $this->input('employee_code')));
158: 
159:         return 'pin_account:'.$code;
160:     }
161: }
</file>

<file path="app/Http/Requests/Concerns/ValidatesComplaint.php">
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: namespace App\Http\Requests\Concerns;
  4: 
  5: use App\Enums\ComplaintType;
  6: use App\Enums\Location;
  7: use App\Services\GarageContext;
  8: use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;
  9: 
 10: /**
 11:  * Shared validation rules for creating and updating complaints.
 12:  *
 13:  * WHY THIS TRAIT EXISTS
 14:  * ---------------------
 15:  * ComplaintStoreRequest and ComplaintUpdateRequest used to declare
 16:  * the exact same rules() and withValidator() bodies — 100+ lines of
 17:  * duplicated logic. Any change to a rule (e.g. adding a new field,
 18:  * tightening a max length) had to be made in two places, and a
 19:  * missed update would silently let invalid data through one path.
 20:  *
 21:  * The trait centralizes the rules. The two Request classes now only
 22:  * differ in their class name and — when the authorization logic
 23:  * eventually diverges — their authorize() method.
 24:  *
 25:  * RULE DESIGN NOTES
 26:  * -----------------
 27:  * - `bus_id`, `driver_id`, `service_vehicle_id`, `employee_id` and
 28:  *   `details.*.employee_id` are all scoped to the CURRENT garage via
 29:  *   Rule::exists(...)->where('garage_id', ...). This makes it
 30:  *   impossible to reference a row from another tenant, even if the
 31:  *   caller tampers with the form payload.
 32:  *
 33:  * - `details.*.used_quantity` allows min:0. Zero means "inspected /
 34:  *   repaired, nothing consumed" — see migration
 35:  *   2026_09_17_174409 and ComplaintStockService::deductStock().
 36:  *
 37:  * - `service_km` is required ONLY when the complaint type is
 38:  *   `maintenance`. A maintenance complaint without an interval value
 39:  *   is meaningless.
 40:  */
 41: trait ValidatesComplaint
 42: {
 43:     /**
 44:      * The complete rule set for a complaint store / update payload.
 45:      *
 46:      * @return array<string, mixed>
 47:      */
 48:     protected function complaintRules(): array
 49:     {
 50:         $garageId = GarageContext::getGarageId();
 51: 
 52:         $busRule = Rule::exists('buses', 'id')
 53:             ->where('garage_id', $garageId);
 54: 
 55:         $employeeRule = Rule::exists('employees', 'id')
 56:             ->where('garage_id', $garageId);
 57: 
 58:         $driverRule = Rule::exists('drivers', 'id')->where(fn ($query) => $query
 59:             ->where('garage_id', $garageId)
 60:             ->where('is_active', true)
 61:             ->whereNull('deleted_at'));
 62: 
 63:         $serviceVehicleRule = Rule::exists('service_vehicles', 'id')->where(fn ($query) => $query
 64:             ->where('garage_id', $garageId)
 65:             ->where('is_active', true)
 66:             ->whereNull('deleted_at'));
 67: 
 68:         return [
 69:             'bus_id' => ['required', $busRule],
 70:             'yer' => ['required', Rule::in(Location::values())],
 71:             'driver_name' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
 72:             'driver_id' => ['nullable', 'required_if:yer,road', $driverRule],
 73: 
 74:             // Required for road complaints. The stock service rejects
 75:             // the write if the selected vehicle does not have enough
 76:             // stock — there is no fallback to the warehouse.
 77:             'service_vehicle_id' => ['nullable', 'required_if:yer,road', $serviceVehicleRule],
 78: 
 79:             'complaint_type' => ['nullable', Rule::in(ComplaintType::values())],
 80: 
 81:             'complaints' => 'required|array|min:1',
 82:             'complaints.*' => [
 83:                 'required',
 84:                 'string',
 85:                 Rule::when(
 86:                     fn () => in_array($this->input('complaint_type'), [
 87:                         ComplaintType::Accident->value,
 88:                         ComplaintType::Breakdown->value,
 89:                     ], true),
 90:                     Rule::exists('complaint_types', 'name')->where('garage_id', $garageId),
 91:                 ),
 92:             ],
 93: 
 94:             'km' => 'nullable|integer|min:0',
 95:             'status' => 'required|in:pending,in_progress',
 96: 
 97:             // ── Date & time fields ──
 98:             'reported_date' => ['required_if:yer,road', 'nullable', 'date'],
 99:             'reported_time' => ['required_if:yer,road', 'nullable', 'date_format:H:i'],
100:             'start_date' => ['nullable', 'date'],
101:             'start_time' => ['nullable', 'date_format:H:i'],
102:             'end_date' => ['nullable', 'date'],
103:             'end_time' => ['nullable', 'date_format:H:i'],
104: 
105:             // ── Parts / details ──
106:             'details' => 'nullable|array',
107:             'details.*.code' => 'nullable|string|distinct:strict',
108:             // 0 is allowed and means "inspected / repaired, nothing
109:             // consumed". See the trait docblock for the rationale.
110:             'details.*.used_quantity' => 'nullable|integer|min:0',
111:             'details.*.employee_id' => ['required_with:details.*.code', $employeeRule],
112:             'details.*.notes' => 'required_with:details.*.code|string|max:2000',
113:             'employee_id' => ['nullable', $employeeRule],
114: 
115:             // ── Service (maintenance) ──
116:             'service_km' => [
117:                 'nullable',
118:                 'integer',
119:                 'min:0',
120:                 Rule::requiredIf(
121:                     fn () => $this->input('complaint_type') === ComplaintType::Maintenance->value
122:                 ),
123:             ],
124:         ];
125:     }
126: 
127:     /**
128:      * Cross-field validation that cannot be expressed with simple
129:      * rule strings.
130:      *
131:      * TWO GUARDS
132:      * ----------
133:      * 1. Duplicate part codes.
134:      *    ComplaintService::syncDetails() keys details by their `code`
135:      *    value. Two rows sharing the same code would silently
136:      *    collapse into one — the second overwrites the first. We
137:      *    reject the payload early with a clear message.
138:      *
139:      * 2. Required fields on part rows.
140:      *    `details.*.employee_id` and `details.*.notes` are declared
141:      *    with `required_with:details.*.code`, but Laravel's
142:      *    required_with checks for the PRESENCE of the sibling key,
143:      *    not its truthiness. An empty-string code slips past the
144:      *    rule. The explicit loop below closes that gap.
145:      */
146:     protected function validateComplaintDetails($validator): void
147:     {
148:         $validator->after(function ($validator) {
149:             // ── Duplicate part-code guard ──
150:             $codes = collect($this->input('details', []))
151:                 ->pluck('code')
152:                 ->filter(fn ($c) => filled($c));
153: 
154:             $duplicates = $codes->duplicates()->unique()->values();
155: 
156:             if ($duplicates->isNotEmpty()) {
157:                 $validator->errors()->add(
158:                     'details',
159:                     __('messages.flash.duplicate_part_codes', [
160:                         'codes' => $duplicates->implode(', '),
161:                     ])
162:                 );
163:             }
164: 
165:             // ── Per-row required fields ──
166:             foreach ($this->input('details', []) as $index => $detail) {
167:                 if (blank($detail['code'] ?? null)) {
168:                     continue;
169:                 }
170: 
171:                 if (blank($detail['employee_id'] ?? null)) {
172:                     $validator->errors()->add(
173:                         "details.$index.employee_id",
174:                         __('validation.required', [
175:                             'attribute' => __('validation.attributes.employee_id'),
176:                         ])
177:                     );
178:                 }
179: 
180:                 if (blank($detail['notes'] ?? null)) {
181:                     $validator->errors()->add(
182:                         "details.$index.notes",
183:                         __('validation.required', [
184:                             'attribute' => __('validation.attributes.notes'),
185:                         ])
186:                     );
187:                 }
188:             }
189:         });
190:     }
191: }
</file>

<file path="app/Http/Requests/DriverUpdateRequest.php">

 3: namespace App\Http\Requests;
 4: 
 5: use App\Services\GarageContext;
 6: use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;
 7: use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;
 8: 
 9: class DriverUpdateRequest extends FormRequest
10: {
11:     public function authorize(): bool
12:     {
13:         return true;
14:     }
15: 
16:     protected function prepareForValidation(): void
17:     {
18:         $this->merge([
19:             'code' => mb_strtoupper(trim((string) $this->input('code'))),
20:             'first_name' => trim((string) $this->input('first_name')),
21:             'last_name' => $this->filled('last_name') ? trim((string) $this->input('last_name')) : null,
22:         ]);
23:     }
24: 
25:     public function rules(): array
26:     {
27:         $driverId = $this->route('driver');
28:         $garageId = GarageContext::getGarageId();
29: 
30:         return [
31:             'code' => [
32:                 'required', 'string', 'max:100',
33:                 Rule::unique('drivers', 'code')->ignore($driverId)->where(fn ($query) => $query
34:                     ->where('garage_id', $garageId)
35:                     ->whereNull('deleted_at')),
36:             ],
37:             'first_name' => 'required|string|max:255',
38:             'last_name' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
39:             'phone' => 'nullable|string|max:50',
40:             'position' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
41:             'is_active' => 'required|boolean',
42:             'notes' => 'nullable|string',
43:         ];
44:     }
45: }

 3: namespace App\Http\Requests;

 9: 
10: class OilChangeStoreRequest extends FormRequest
11: {

13:     {
14:         return true;
15:     }
16: 
17:     public function rules(): array
18:     {
19:         $garageId = GarageContext::getGarageId();
20: 
21:         return [
22:             'bus_id' => [
23:                 'required',
24:                 Rule::exists('buses', 'id')->where('garage_id', $garageId),

32:             ],

34:             'actual_km' => 'required|integer|min:0',
35:             'changed_at' => 'nullable|date',
36:             'notes' => 'nullable|string|max:2000',
37:         ];
38:     }
39: 
40:     protected function prepareForValidation(): void
41:     {
42:         if ($this->filled('oil_brand')) {
43:             $this->merge([
44:                 'oil_brand' => mb_strtoupper(trim((string) $this->input('oil_brand'))),
45:             ]);
46:         }
47:     }
48: }

 3: namespace App\Http\Requests\SuperAdmin;
 4: 
 5: use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;
 6: 
 7: class CompanyStoreRequest extends SuperAdminRequest
 8: {
 9:     public function rules(): array
10:     {
11:         return [
12:             // ─── Company fields ───
13:             'name' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
14:             'slug' => [
15:                 'nullable',
16:                 'string',
17:                 'max:255',
18:                 'regex:/^[a-z0-9-]+$/',
19:                 // Only enforce uniqueness against NON-deleted rows, matching
20:                 // the partial unique index companies_slug_active_unique.
21:                 // Otherwise a soft-deleted company would permanently reserve
22:                 // its slug.
23:                 Rule::unique('companies', 'slug')->whereNull('deleted_at'),
24:             ],
25:             'email' => ['nullable', 'email', 'max:255'],
26:             'phone' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:50'],
27:             'address' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:1000'],
28:             'is_active' => ['nullable', 'boolean'],
29: 
30:             // ─── First Director (required — see SuperAdmin spec) ───
31:             'director_name' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
32:             'director_email' => [
33:                 'required',
34:                 'email',
35:                 'max:255',
36:                 // See UserStoreRequest for the rationale — the partial
37:                 // unique index users_email_active_unique allows reuse
38:                 // after soft-delete.
39:                 Rule::unique('users', 'email')->whereNull('deleted_at'),
40:             ],
41:             'director_password' => ['required', 'string', 'min:8', 'confirmed'],
42:             'director_pin' => [
43:                 'required',
44:                 'string',
45:                 'digits_between:4,6',
46:                 'confirmed',
47:             ],
48:         ];
49:     }
50: 
51:     public function messages(): array
52:     {
53:         return [
54:             'director_name.required' => __('messages.super_admin.companies.director_name_required'),
55:             'director_email.required' => __('messages.super_admin.companies.director_email_required'),
56:             'director_email.unique' => __('messages.super_admin.companies.director_email_taken'),
57:             'director_password.required' => __('messages.super_admin.companies.director_password_required'),
58:             'director_pin.required' => __('messages.super_admin.companies.director_pin_required'),
59:             'director_pin.digits_between' => __('messages.super_admin.companies.director_pin_digits'),
60:             'director_pin.confirmed' => __('messages.super_admin.companies.director_pin_mismatch'),
61:         ];
62:     }
63: 
64:     protected function prepareForValidation(): void
65:     {
66:         // Normalize whitespace on director fields
67:         $this->merge([
68:             'director_name' => trim((string) $this->input('director_name')),
69:             'director_email' => mb_strtolower(trim((string) $this->input('director_email'))),
70:         ]);
71:     }
72: }

<file path="app/Http/Requests/SuperAdmin/SuperAdminRequest.php">
 1: <?php
 2: 
 3: namespace App\Http\Requests\SuperAdmin;
 4: 
 5: use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;
 6: 
 7: /**
 8:  * Base class for every SuperAdmin-only FormRequest.
 9:  *
10:  * Centralizes the authorization rule — only the platform SuperAdmin
11:  * may submit these forms. The `/super-admin/*` routes are already
12:  * protected by the `super.admin` middleware; this check is the
13:  * second line of defense so a controller refactor cannot accidentally
14:  * expose an endpoint.
15:  *
16:  * Subclasses only need to declare rules() (and optionally messages()
17:  * and prepareForValidation()).
18:  */
19: abstract class SuperAdminRequest extends FormRequest
20: {
21:     public function authorize(): bool
22:     {
23:         return $this->user()?->isSuperAdmin() ?? false;
24:     }
25: }
</file>

<file path="app/Http/Requests/WarehouseTransferReceiveRequest.php">
 1: <?php
 2: 
 3: namespace App\Http\Requests;
 4: 
 5: use App\Models\WarehouseTransfer;
 6: use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;
 7: 
 8: class WarehouseTransferReceiveRequest extends FormRequest
 9: {
10:     public function authorize(): bool
11:     {
12:         return true;
13:     }
14: 
15:     public function rules(): array
16:     {
17:         return [
18:             'received' => 'required|array|min:1',
19:             'received.*' => 'required|integer|min:0',
20:         ];
21:     }
22: 
23:     /**
24:      * The base rules only validate each received value in isolation.
25:      * We must also enforce, per transfer item, that the received
26:      * quantity does NOT exceed the declared quantity.
27:      *
28:      * Allowing received > declared would create stock out of thin
29:      * air: the source garage only ever sent `declared` units, and the
30:      * dispatch step already deducted exactly that many from the source
31:      * warehouse. If the destination credited `received` (> declared)
32:      * to its own warehouse, the extra units would exist in two places
33:      * at once.
34:      *
35:      * Surplus handling (if it is ever needed) belongs to a dedicated
36:      * adjustment workflow, not to the receive form.
37:      */
38:     public function withValidator($validator): void
39:     {
40:         $validator->after(function ($validator) {
41:             $transfer = $this->route('transfer');
42: 
43:             if (! $transfer instanceof WarehouseTransfer) {
44:                 return;
45:             }
46: 
47:             // Map: item_id => declared_quantity
48:             $declared = $transfer->items()
49:                 ->pluck('declared_quantity', 'id');
50: 
51:             $received = (array) $this->input('received', []);
52: 
53:             foreach ($received as $itemId => $qty) {
54:                 $itemId = (int) $itemId;
55:                 $qty = (int) $qty;
56: 
57:                 if (! $declared->has($itemId)) {
58:                     // Unknown item id — service layer rejects this
59:                     // separately with a generic message.
60:                     continue;
61:                 }
62: 
63:                 $declaredQty = (int) $declared->get($itemId);
64: 
65:                 if ($qty > $declaredQty) {
66:                     $validator->errors()->add(
67:                         "received.{$itemId}",
68:                         __('messages.transfers.received_exceeds_declared', [
69:                             'declared' => $declaredQty,
70:                             'received' => $qty,
71:                         ])
72:                     );
73:                 }
74:             }
75:         });
76:     }
77: }
