<file path="app/Services/Reports/DailyKmReportService.php">
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: namespace App\Services\Reports;
  4: 
  5: use App\Models\AuditLog;
  6: use App\Models\Bus;
  7: use App\Models\DailyKmRecord;
  8: use App\Models\User;
  9: use Illuminate\Support\Collection;
 10: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
 11: 
 12: class DailyKmReportService
 13: {
 14:     /**
 15:      * Buses with no KM record for TODAY.
 16:      *
 17:      * The brand filter narrows the list to a single manufacturer.
 18:      */
 19:     public function missing(ReportPeriod $period, ReportScope $scope): Collection
 20:     {
 21:         // Use the period's end date, not now(), so the date shown in
 22:         // the view (`$period->to`) always matches what is actually
 23:         // queried. For daily/weekly/monthly presets these are equal;
 24:         // for a custom range they previously diverged.
 25:         $targetDate = $period->to->toDateString();
 26: 
 27:         return Bus::withoutGlobalScope('garage')
 28:             ->whereIn('buses.garage_id', $scope->garageIds)
 29:             ->where('buses.is_active', true)
 30:             ->whereNull('buses.deleted_at')
 31:             ->when($scope->brandId, fn ($q) => $q->where('buses.brand_id', $scope->brandId))
 32:             ->whereDoesntHave('dailyKmRecords', function ($q) use ($targetDate) {
 33:                 $q->whereDate('date', $targetDate);
 34:             })
 35:             ->orderBy('buses.dqn')
 36:             ->get(['buses.id', 'buses.dqn', 'buses.route_number', 'buses.bus_project', 'buses.km', 'buses.brand_id']);
 37:     }
 38: 
 39:     /**
 40:      * Top buses by total distance driven within the period.
 41:      */
 42:     public function topBuses(ReportPeriod $period, ReportScope $scope): Collection
 43:     {
 44:         return DailyKmRecord::withoutGlobalScope('garage')
 45:             ->whereIn('daily_km_records.garage_id', $scope->garageIds)
 46:             ->whereBetween('daily_km_records.date', [$period->from->toDateString(), $period->to->toDateString()])
 47:             ->whereNull('daily_km_records.deleted_at')
 48:             ->when($scope->userId, fn ($q) => $q->where('daily_km_records.created_by', $scope->userId))
 49:             ->join('buses', 'buses.id', '=', 'daily_km_records.bus_id')
 50:             ->when($scope->brandId, fn ($q) => $q->where('buses.brand_id', $scope->brandId))
 51:             ->select(
 52:                 'buses.id as bus_id',
 53:                 'buses.dqn',
 54:                 'buses.route_number',
 55:                 DB::raw('MIN(daily_km_records.km) as start_km'),
 56:                 DB::raw('MAX(daily_km_records.km) as end_km'),
 57:                 DB::raw('COUNT(*) as entries_count')
 58:             )
 59:             ->groupBy('buses.id', 'buses.dqn', 'buses.route_number')
 60:             ->get()
 61:             ->map(function ($row) {
 62:                 $row->distance = max(0, $row->end_km - $row->start_km);
 63: 
 64:                 return $row;
 65:             })
 66:             ->sortByDesc('distance')
 67:             ->take(20)
 68:             ->values();
 69:     }
 70: 
 71:     /**
 72:      * Per-user action counts based on the audit log.
 73:      *
 74:      * The brand filter is intentionally NOT applied — see the
 75:      * ComplaintReportService for the rationale.
 76:      */
 77:     public function workerActivity(ReportPeriod $period, ReportScope $scope): Collection
 78:     {
 79:         $rows = AuditLog::query()
 80:             ->where('auditable_type', DailyKmRecord::class)
 81:             ->whereBetween('audit_logs.created_at', [$period->from, $period->to])
 82:             ->whereIn('audit_logs.garage_id', $scope->garageIds)
 83:             ->when($scope->userId, fn ($q) => $q->where('audit_logs.user_id', $scope->userId))
 84:             ->select(
 85:                 'user_id',
 86:                 DB::raw('COUNT(*) as total_actions'),
 87:                 DB::raw("SUM(CASE WHEN event = 'created' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as created_count"),
 88:                 DB::raw("SUM(CASE WHEN event = 'updated' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as updated_count"),
 89:                 DB::raw("SUM(CASE WHEN event IN ('deleted','force_deleted') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as deleted_count")
 90:             )
 91:             ->groupBy('user_id')
 92:             ->orderByDesc('total_actions')
 93:             ->get();
 94: 
 95:         $users = User::whereIn('id', $rows->pluck('user_id')->filter()->all())
 96:             ->get()
 97:             ->keyBy('id');
 98: 
 99:         return $rows->map(fn ($row) => (object) [
100:             'user' => $users->get($row->user_id),
101:             'total_actions' => (int) $row->total_actions,
102:             'created_count' => (int) $row->created_count,
103:             'updated_count' => (int) $row->updated_count,
104:             'deleted_count' => (int) $row->deleted_count,
105:         ]);
106:     }
107: }

<file path="app/Services/Reports/DailyStatusReportService.php">
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: namespace App\Services\Reports;
  4: 
  5: use App\Models\AuditLog;
  6: use App\Models\BusDailyStatus;
  7: use App\Models\User;
  8: use Illuminate\Support\Collection;
  9: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
 10: 
 11: class DailyStatusReportService
 12: {
 13:     /**
 14:      * Distribution of statuses in the period.
 15:      */
 16:     public function distribution(ReportPeriod $period, ReportScope $scope): array
 17:     {
 18:         $base = BusDailyStatus::withoutGlobalScope('garage')
 19:             ->whereIn('bus_daily_statuses.garage_id', $scope->garageIds)
 20:             ->whereBetween('bus_daily_statuses.date', [$period->from->toDateString(), $period->to->toDateString()])
 21:             ->whereNull('bus_daily_statuses.deleted_at')
 22:             ->when($scope->userId, fn ($q) => $q->where('bus_daily_statuses.created_by', $scope->userId))
 23:             ->when($scope->brandId, fn ($q) => $q->whereHas(
 24:                 'bus',
 25:                 fn ($bq) => $bq->where('brand_id', $scope->brandId)
 26:             ));
 27: 
 28:         $rows = (clone $base)
 29:             ->select('status', DB::raw('COUNT(*) as total'))
 30:             ->groupBy('status')
 31:             ->orderByDesc('total')
 32:             ->get();
 33: 
 34:         $total = $rows->sum('total');
 35: 
 36:         return [
 37:             'rows' => $rows,
 38:             'total' => $total,
 39:         ];
 40:     }
 41: 
 42:     /**
 43:      * Status changes timeline — the audit log for BusDailyStatus in the period.
 44:      *
 45:      * Brand filter is applied via a subquery on the statuses' parent
 46:      * buses: only audit entries whose subject belongs to a bus of the
 47:      * selected brand are kept.
 48:      */
 49:     public function changes(ReportPeriod $period, ReportScope $scope): Collection
 50:     {
 51:         return AuditLog::query()
 52:             ->where('auditable_type', BusDailyStatus::class)
 53:             ->whereBetween('audit_logs.created_at', [$period->from, $period->to])
 54:             ->whereIn('audit_logs.garage_id', $scope->garageIds)
 55:             ->when($scope->userId, fn ($q) => $q->where('audit_logs.user_id', $scope->userId))
 56:             ->when($scope->brandId, function ($q) use ($scope) {
 57:                 $q->whereIn('auditable_id', function ($sub) use ($scope) {
 58:                     $sub->select('id')
 59:                         ->from('bus_daily_statuses')

 61:                             $sub2->select('id')
 62:                                 ->from('buses')
 63:                                 ->where('brand_id', $scope->brandId);
 64:                         });
 65:                 });
 66:             })
 67:             ->with('user')
 68:             ->orderByDesc('audit_logs.id')
 69:             ->limit(200)
 70:             ->get();
 71:     }
 72: 
 73:     /**

 75:      *
 76:      * Brand filter intentionally NOT applied — see ComplaintReportService.
 77:      */
 78:     public function workerActivity(ReportPeriod $period, ReportScope $scope): Collection
 79:     {
 80:         $rows = AuditLog::query()

 83:             ->whereIn('audit_logs.garage_id', $scope->garageIds)
 84:             ->when($scope->userId, fn ($q) => $q->where('audit_logs.user_id', $scope->userId))
 85:             ->select(
 86:                 'user_id',
 87:                 DB::raw('COUNT(*) as total_actions'),
 88:                 DB::raw("SUM(CASE WHEN event = 'created' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as created_count"),
 89:                 DB::raw("SUM(CASE WHEN event = 'updated' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as updated_count"),
 90:                 DB::raw("SUM(CASE WHEN event IN ('deleted','force_deleted') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as deleted_count")
 91:             )
 92:             ->groupBy('user_id')
 93:             ->orderByDesc('total_actions')
 94:             ->get();

 97:             ->get()

 99:

101:             'user' => $users->get($row->user_id),
102:             'total_actions' => (int) $row->total_actions,

<file path="app/Services/Reports/FleetHealthReportService.php">
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: namespace App\Services\Reports;
  4: 
  5: use App\Models\Complaint;
  6: use Illuminate\Support\Collection;
  7: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
  8: 
  9: /**
 10:  * Fleet health aggregations — reports #20–#25.
 11:  *
 12:  * Covers:
 13:  *   20. Cost per KM              — which bus is most expensive per km
 14:  *   21. Downtime Analysis        — which bus was out of service longest
 15:  *   22. Recurring Issues         — repeating problem descriptions
 16:  *   23. Recurring Complaints     — same issue on the same bus 2+ times
 17:  *   24. Accidents Report         — accident cards in the period
 18:  *   25. Bus Utilization          — % of days each bus was in service
 19:  */
 20: class FleetHealthReportService
 21: {
 22:     // ==================================================================
 23:     // #20 — COST PER KM
 24:     // ==================================================================
 25: 
 26:     /**
 27:      * Cost per kilometer for each active bus.
 28:      *
 29:      * Cost = sum of (used_quantity × price_at_use) across all details.
 30:      * Distance = MAX(km) - MIN(km) from daily_km_records in the period.
 31:      *
 32:      * @return Collection<int, object>
 33:      */
 34:     public function costPerKm(ReportPeriod $period, ReportScope $scope): Collection
 35:     {
 36:         $rows = DB::table('buses as b')
 37:             ->leftJoin('complaints as c', function ($join) use ($period) {
 38:                 $join->on('c.bus_id', '=', 'b.id')
 39:                     ->whereNull('c.deleted_at')
 40:                     ->whereBetween('c.created_at', [$period->from, $period->to]);
 41:             })
 42:             ->leftJoin('complaint_details as cd', function ($join) {
 43:                 $join->on('cd.complaint_id', '=', 'c.id')
 44:                     ->whereNull('cd.deleted_at')
 45:                     ->whereIn('cd.source_type', ['warehouse', 'service_vehicle']);
 46:             })
 47:             ->leftJoin('daily_km_records as dkr', function ($join) use ($period) {
 48:                 $join->on('dkr.bus_id', '=', 'b.id')
 49:                     ->whereNull('dkr.deleted_at')
 50:                     ->whereBetween('dkr.date', [
 51:                         $period->from->toDateString(),
 52:                         $period->to->toDateString(),
 53:                     ]);
 54:             })
 55:             ->whereIn('b.garage_id', $scope->garageIds)
 56:             ->where('b.is_active', true)
 57:             ->whereNull('b.deleted_at')
 58:             ->when($scope->brandId, fn ($q) => $q->where('b.brand_id', $scope->brandId))
 59:             ->select(
 60:                 'b.id as bus_id',
 61:                 'b.dqn',
 62:                 'b.route_number',
 63:                 DB::raw('COALESCE(SUM(cd.used_quantity * COALESCE(cd.price_at_use, 0)), 0) as total_cost'),
 64:                 DB::raw('COALESCE(MAX(dkr.km) - MIN(dkr.km), 0) as distance'),
 65:                 DB::raw('COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) as cards_count'),
 66:             )
 67:             ->groupBy('b.id', 'b.dqn', 'b.route_number')
 68:             ->get();
 69: 
 70:         return $rows
 71:             ->map(function ($r) {
 72:                 $r->total_cost = (float) $r->total_cost;
 73:                 $r->distance = (int) $r->distance;
 74:                 $r->cost_per_km = $r->distance > 0
 75:                     ? round($r->total_cost / $r->distance, 4)
 76:                     : null;
 77: 
 78:                 return $r;
 79:             })
 80:             ->filter(fn ($r) => $r->cost_per_km !== null)
 81:             ->sortByDesc('cost_per_km')
 82:             ->values();
 83:     }
 84: 
 85:     // ==================================================================
 86:     // #21 — DOWNTIME ANALYSIS
 87:     // ==================================================================
 88: 
 89:     /**
 90:      * Aggregate downtime per bus: how many hours each bus spent
 91:      * outside of service within the period.
 92:      *
 93:      * Uses `closed_at - created_at` for closed complaints. Open
 94:      * complaints are excluded from the total (their downtime is
 95:      * still ongoing — they belong on the dashboard, not here).
 96:      *
 97:      * @return Collection<int, object>
 98:      */
 99:     public function downtime(ReportPeriod $period, ReportScope $scope): Collection
100:     {
101:         return DB::table('complaints as c')
102:             ->join('buses as b', 'b.id', '=', 'c.bus_id')
103:             ->whereIn('c.garage_id', $scope->garageIds)
104:             ->whereNull('c.deleted_at')
105:             ->whereBetween('c.created_at', [$period->from, $period->to])
106:             ->whereNotNull('c.closed_at')
107:             ->when($scope->brandId, fn ($q) => $q->where('b.brand_id', $scope->brandId))
108:             ->select(
109:                 'b.id as bus_id',
110:                 'b.dqn',
111:                 'b.route_number',
112:                 DB::raw('COUNT(*) as complaint_count'),
113:                 DB::raw('SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (c.closed_at - c.created_at)) / 3600) as total_hours'),
114:                 DB::raw('AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (c.closed_at - c.created_at)) / 3600) as avg_hours'),
115:                 DB::raw('MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (c.closed_at - c.created_at)) / 3600) as max_hours'),
116:             )
117:             ->groupBy('b.id', 'b.dqn', 'b.route_number')
118:             ->orderByDesc('total_hours')
119:             ->get();
120:     }
121: 
122:     // ==================================================================
123:     // #22 — RECURRING ISSUES
124:     // ==================================================================
125: 
126:     /**
127:      * Complaint descriptions that appear 2+ times within the selected
128:      * period, broken down by bus.
129:      *
130:      * ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
131:      * NOTE: this method deliberately does NOT use
132:      * ComplaintItem::scopeRecurring().
133:      *
134:      * The scope has two limitations that break the report for
135:      * Directors:
136:      *
137:      *   1. It reads GarageContext::resolveGarageId() — a single
138:      *      garage id. Directors have no garage context, so the scope
139:      *      returns `WHERE 1 = 0` and the report renders empty.
140:      *
141:      *   2. It ignores $period and $scope->brandId, so changing the
142:      *      date range or the brand filter has no effect.
143:      *
144:      * The query below uses $scope->garageIds (already resolved to the
145:      * correct set of garages by ReportScope::for()), respects the
146:      * period and the optional brand filter, and returns the same
147:      * column shape the blade expects (description, total,
148:      * last_occurrence).
149:      * ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
150:      *
151:      * @return Collection<int, object>
152:      */
153:     public function recurringIssues(ReportPeriod $period, ReportScope $scope): Collection
154:     {
155:         return DB::table('complaint_items as ci')
156:             ->join('complaints as c', 'c.id', '=', 'ci.complaint_id')
157:             ->join('buses as b', 'b.id', '=', 'c.bus_id')
158:             ->whereIn('c.garage_id', $scope->garageIds)
159:             ->whereNull('c.deleted_at')
160:             // NOTE: complaint_items has no soft-delete column. Its lifecycle
161:             // is tied to the parent complaint via ON DELETE CASCADE.
162:             ->whereBetween('c.created_at', [$period->from, $period->to])
163:             ->when($scope->brandId, fn ($q) => $q->where('b.brand_id', $scope->brandId))
164:             ->where(function ($q) {
165:                 $q->whereIn('c.status', [
166:                     \App\Enums\ComplaintStatus::Pending->value,
167:                     \App\Enums\ComplaintStatus::InProgress->value,
168:                 ]);
169:             })
170:             ->select(
171:                 'ci.description',
172:                 'b.id as bus_id',
173:                 'b.dqn',
174:                 DB::raw('COUNT(*) as total'),
175:                 DB::raw('MAX(c.created_at) as last_occurrence')
176:             )
177:             ->groupBy('ci.description', 'b.id', 'b.dqn')
178:             ->havingRaw('COUNT(*) >= 2')
179:             ->orderByDesc('total')
180:             ->limit(200)
181:             ->get();
182:     }
183: 
184:     // ==================================================================
185:     // #23 — RECURRING COMPLAINTS ON SAME BUS
186:     // ==================================================================
187: 
188:     /**
189:      * Same complaint description appearing 2+ times on the same bus
190:      * within the period.
191:      *
192:      * @return Collection<int, object>
193:      */
194:     public function recurringComplaintsOnSameBus(ReportPeriod $period, ReportScope $scope): Collection
195:     {
196:         return DB::table('complaint_items as ci')
197:             ->join('complaints as c', 'c.id', '=', 'ci.complaint_id')
198:             ->join('buses as b', 'b.id', '=', 'c.bus_id')
199:             ->whereIn('c.garage_id', $scope->garageIds)
200:             ->whereNull('c.deleted_at')
201:             ->whereBetween('c.created_at', [$period->from, $period->to])
202:             ->when($scope->brandId, fn ($q) => $q->where('b.brand_id', $scope->brandId))
203:             ->select(
204:                 'ci.description',
205:                 'b.id as bus_id',
206:                 'b.dqn',
207:                 'b.route_number',
208:                 DB::raw('COUNT(*) as occurrences'),
209:                 DB::raw('MAX(c.created_at) as last_occurrence'),
210:                 DB::raw('MIN(c.created_at) as first_occurrence'),
211:             )
212:             ->groupBy('ci.description', 'b.id', 'b.dqn', 'b.route_number')
213:             ->havingRaw('COUNT(*) >= 2')
214:             ->orderByDesc('occurrences')
215:             ->limit(200)
216:             ->get();
217:     }
218: 
219:     // ==================================================================
220:     // #24 — ACCIDENTS REPORT
221:     // ==================================================================
222: 
223:     /**
224:      * All accident cards in the period.
225:      *
226:      * @return Collection<int, Complaint>
227:      */
228:     public function accidents(ReportPeriod $period, ReportScope $scope): Collection
229:     {
230:         return Complaint::withoutGlobalScope('garage')
231:             ->whereIn('garage_id', $scope->garageIds)
232:             ->where('complaint_type', 'accident')
233:             ->whereBetween('created_at', [$period->from, $period->to])
234:             ->when($scope->brandId, fn ($q) => $q->whereHas(
235:                 'bus',
236:                 fn ($bq) => $bq->where('brand_id', $scope->brandId)
237:             ))
238:             ->with([
239:                 'bus:id,dqn,route_number,bus_project',
240:                 'driver:id,code,first_name,last_name',
241:                 'serviceVehicle:id,name,plate_number',
242:             ])
243:             ->orderByDesc('created_at')
244:             ->limit(500)
245:             ->get();
246:     }
247: 
248:     // ==================================================================
249:     // #25 — BUS UTILIZATION
250:     // ==================================================================
251: 
252:     /**
253:      * Percent of days each bus was in service during the period.
254:      *
255:      * "In service" = has at least one daily_km_record (i.e. the bus
256:      * actually drove). Days without a KM record are counted as
257:      * out-of-service.
258:      *
259:      * @return Collection<int, object>
260:      */
261:     public function utilization(ReportPeriod $period, ReportScope $scope): Collection
262:     {
263:         $totalDays = $period->days();
264: 
265:         $rows = DB::table('buses as b')
266:             ->leftJoin('daily_km_records as dkr', function ($join) use ($period) {
267:                 $join->on('dkr.bus_id', '=', 'b.id')
268:                     ->whereNull('dkr.deleted_at')
269:                     ->whereBetween('dkr.date', [
270:                         $period->from->toDateString(),
271:                         $period->to->toDateString(),
272:                     ]);
273:             })
274:             ->leftJoin('bus_daily_statuses as bds', function ($join) use ($period) {
275:                 $join->on('bds.bus_id', '=', 'b.id')
276:                     ->whereNull('bds.deleted_at')
277:                     ->whereBetween('bds.date', [
278:                         $period->from->toDateString(),
279:                         $period->to->toDateString(),
280:                     ]);
281:             })
282:             ->whereIn('b.garage_id', $scope->garageIds)
283:             ->where('b.is_active', true)
284:             ->whereNull('b.deleted_at')
285:             ->when($scope->brandId, fn ($q) => $q->where('b.brand_id', $scope->brandId))
286:             ->select(
287:                 'b.id as bus_id',
288:                 'b.dqn',
289:                 'b.route_number',
290:                 DB::raw('COUNT(DISTINCT dkr.date) as days_in_service'),
291:                 DB::raw('COUNT(DISTINCT bds.date) as days_with_status'),
292:                 DB::raw('COALESCE(MAX(dkr.km) - MIN(dkr.km), 0) as total_distance'),
293:             )
294:             ->groupBy('b.id', 'b.dqn', 'b.route_number')
295:             ->get();
296: 
297:         return $rows
298:             ->map(function ($r) use ($totalDays) {
299:                 $r->days_in_service = (int) $r->days_in_service;
300:                 $r->days_with_status = (int) $r->days_with_status;
301:                 $r->total_distance = (int) $r->total_distance;
302:                 $r->total_days_in_period = $totalDays;
303:                 $r->utilization_percent = $totalDays > 0
304:                     ? round(($r->days_in_service / $totalDays) * 100, 1)
305:                     : 0.0;
306: 
307:                 return $r;
308:             })
309:             ->sortByDesc('utilization_percent')
310:             ->values();
311:     }
312: }

 85:     public function perBus(ReportPeriod $period, ReportScope $scope): Collection
 86:     {
 87:         $complaintIds = $this->complaintIds($period, $scope);
 88: 
 89:         if (empty($complaintIds)) {
 90:             return collect();
 91:         }
 92: 
 93:         $complaintStats = DB::table('complaints')
 94:             ->whereIn('id', $complaintIds)
 95:             ->select(
 96:                 'bus_id',
 97:                 DB::raw('COUNT(*) as cards_opened'),
 98:                 DB::raw("SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as cards_closed"),
 99:                 DB::raw("SUM(CASE WHEN complaint_type = 'maintenance' AND service_km IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as motor_oil_count")
100:             )
101:             ->groupBy('bus_id')
102:             ->get()
103:             ->keyBy('bus_id');
104: 
105:         $partStats = DB::table('complaint_details')
106:             ->whereIn('complaint_id', $complaintIds)
107:             ->whereNull('deleted_at')
108:             ->where('used_quantity', '>', 0)
109:             ->select(
110:                 'complaint_id',
111:                 DB::raw('SUM(used_quantity) as total_qty'),
112:                 DB::raw('SUM(used_quantity * COALESCE(price_at_use, 0)) as total_cost')
113:             )
114:             ->groupBy('complaint_id')
115:             ->get();
116: 
117:         // Roll up per bus via complaint → bus_id
118:         $complaintToBus = DB::table('complaints')
119:             ->whereIn('id', $complaintIds)
120:             ->pluck('bus_id', 'id');
121: 
122:         $partStatsPerBus = [];
123:         foreach ($partStats as $p) {
124:             $busId = $complaintToBus[$p->complaint_id] ?? null;
125:             if (! $busId) {
126:                 continue;
127:             }
128:             if (! isset($partStatsPerBus[$busId])) {
129:                 $partStatsPerBus[$busId] = ['total_qty' => 0, 'total_cost' => 0];
130:             }
131:             $partStatsPerBus[$busId]['total_qty'] += (int) $p->total_qty;
132:             $partStatsPerBus[$busId]['total_cost'] += (float) $p->total_cost;
133:         }
134: 
135:         $busIds = $complaintStats->keys()->all();
136:         $buses = DB::table('buses')
137:             ->whereIn('id', $busIds)
138:             ->whereNull('deleted_at')
139:             ->get(['id', 'dqn', 'route_number', 'bus_project', 'brand_id', 'garage_id'])
140:             ->keyBy('id');
141: 
142:         return collect($busIds)
143:             ->map(function ($busId) use ($complaintStats, $partStatsPerBus, $buses) {
144:                 $bus = $buses->get($busId);
145:                 if (! $bus) {
146:                     return null;
147:                 }
148:                 $c = $complaintStats->get($busId);
149:                 $p = $partStatsPerBus[$busId] ?? ['total_qty' => 0, 'total_cost' => 0];
150: 
151:                 return (object) [
152:                     'bus' => $bus,
153:                     'cards_opened' => (int) ($c->cards_opened ?? 0),
154:                     'cards_closed' => (int) ($c->cards_closed ?? 0),
155:                     'motor_oil_count' => (int) ($c->motor_oil_count ?? 0),
156:                     'total_qty' => $p['total_qty'],
157:                     'total_cost' => $p['total_cost'],
158:                 ];
159:             })
160:             ->filter()
161:             ->sortByDesc('cards_opened')
162:             ->values();
163:     }

234:                 'total_qty' => (int) $lines->sum('used_quantity'),

240:     public function mostRepaired(ReportPeriod $period, ReportScope $scope): Collection
241:     {
242:         $complaintIds = $this->complaintIds($period, $scope);
243: 
244:         if (empty($complaintIds)) {
245:             return collect();
246:         }
247: 
248:         $rows = DB::table('complaints')
249:             ->whereIn('id', $complaintIds)
250:             ->select(
251:                 'bus_id',
252:                 DB::raw('COUNT(*) as cards_count'),
253:                 DB::raw("SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as completed_count"),
254:                 DB::raw('SUM(CASE WHEN closed_at IS NOT NULL THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (closed_at - created_at)) / 3600 ELSE 0 END) as total_hours')
255:             )
256:             ->groupBy('bus_id')
257:             ->orderByDesc('cards_count')
258:             ->limit(50)
259:             ->get();
260: 
261:         $busIds = $rows->pluck('bus_id')->all();
262: 
263:         $buses = DB::table('buses')
264:             ->whereIn('id', $busIds)
265:             ->get(['id', 'dqn', 'route_number', 'bus_project'])
266:             ->keyBy('id');
267: 
268:         $costByBus = DB::table('complaint_details')
269:             ->whereIn('complaint_id', $complaintIds)
270:             ->whereNull('deleted_at')
271:             ->where('used_quantity', '>', 0)
272:             ->select(
273:                 'complaint_id',
274:                 DB::raw('SUM(used_quantity * COALESCE(price_at_use, 0)) as total_cost')
275:             )
276:             ->groupBy('complaint_id')
277:             ->get();
278: 
279:         $complaintToBus = DB::table('complaints')
280:             ->whereIn('id', $complaintIds)
281:             ->pluck('bus_id', 'id');
282: 
283:         $costRollup = [];
284:         foreach ($costByBus as $row) {
285:             $busId = $complaintToBus[$row->complaint_id] ?? null;
286:             if (! $busId) {
287:                 continue;
288:             }
289:             $costRollup[$busId] = ($costRollup[$busId] ?? 0) + (float) $row->total_cost;
290:         }
291: 
292:         return $rows->map(function ($row) use ($buses, $costRollup) {
293:             return (object) [
294:                 'bus' => $buses->get($row->bus_id),
295:                 'cards_count' => (int) $row->cards_count,
296:                 'completed_count' => (int) $row->completed_count,
297:                 'total_hours' => round((float) $row->total_hours, 1),
298:                 'total_cost' => (float) ($costRollup[$row->bus_id] ?? 0),
299:             ];
300:         });
301:     }

327:         $row = DB::table('complaint_details')
328:             ->whereIn('complaint_id', $complaintIds)
329:             ->whereNull('deleted_at')
330:             ->where('used_quantity', '>', 0)
331:             ->select(
332:                 DB::raw('COUNT(*) as line_count'),
333:                 DB::raw('COUNT(DISTINCT code) as distinct_parts'),
334:                 DB::raw('SUM(used_quantity) as total_quantity'),
335:                 DB::raw('SUM(used_quantity * COALESCE(price_at_use, 0)) as total_cost')
336:             )
337:             ->first();
338: 
339:         return $row ?: (object) [
340:             'line_count' => 0,
341:             'distinct_parts' => 0,
342:             'total_quantity' => 0,
343:             'total_cost' => 0,
344:         ];

<file path="app/Services/Reports/OilChangeReportService.php">
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: namespace App\Services\Reports;
  4: 
  5: use App\Enums\OilType;
  6: use App\Models\Bus;
  7: use App\Models\BusOilChange;
  8: use App\Services\OilChange\OilChangeStatusService;
  9: use Illuminate\Support\Collection;
 10: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
 11: 
 12: /**
 13:  * Aggregations for the oil-change report domain.
 14:  *
 15:  * Covers reports #11–#15 from the report specification:
 16:  *   11. Oil Change History          — full log per bus, filterable
 17:  *   12. Upcoming (next 30 days)     — buses approaching their due km
 18:  *   13. Monthly/Quarterly Count     — aggregate counts by oil type
 19:  *   14. Schedule Adherence          — early / on-time / late breakdown
 20:  *   15. Motor Oil Catalog Usage     — which oil brands/codes are used most
 21:  */
 22: class OilChangeReportService
 23: {
 24:     public function __construct(
 25:         protected OilChangeStatusService $statusService,
 26:     ) {}
 27: 
 28:     // ==================================================================
 29:     // #11 — OIL CHANGE HISTORY
 30:     // ==================================================================
 31: 
 32:     /**
 33:      * Full oil change history for the period.
 34:      *
 35:      * @return Collection<int, BusOilChange>
 36:      */
 37:     public function history(ReportPeriod $period, ReportScope $scope, ?OilType $type = null): Collection
 38:     {
 39:         return BusOilChange::withoutGlobalScope('garage')
 40:             ->whereIn('garage_id', $scope->garageIds)
 41:             ->whereNull('deleted_at')
 42:             ->whereBetween('created_at', [$period->from, $period->to])
 43:             ->when($scope->brandId, fn ($q) => $q->whereHas(
 44:                 'bus',
 45:                 fn ($bq) => $bq->where('brand_id', $scope->brandId)
 46:             ))
 47:             ->when($type, fn ($q) => $q->where('oil_type', $type->value))
 48:             ->with('bus:id,dqn,route_number,brand_id')
 49:             ->orderByDesc('actual_km')
 50:             ->orderByDesc('id')
 51:             ->limit(1000)
 52:             ->get();
 53:     }
 54: 
 55:     // ==================================================================
 56:     // #12 — UPCOMING (NEXT 30 DAYS)
 57:     // ==================================================================
 58: 
 59:     /**
 60:      * Buses whose next oil change is due within the next 30 days.
 61:      *
 62:      * We estimate "days remaining" using the fleet's average daily km
 63:      * over the period. If a bus has no recent KM records, we skip it.
 64:      *
 65:      * @return Collection<int, array{bus: Bus, type: OilType, status: object, days_remaining: int}>
 66:      */
 67:     public function upcoming(ReportPeriod $period, ReportScope $scope): Collection
 68:     {
 69:         $avgDailyKm = $this->averageDailyKm($scope);
 70: 
 71:         $buses = Bus::withoutGlobalScope('garage')
 72:             ->whereIn('garage_id', $scope->garageIds)
 73:             ->where('is_active', true)
 74:             ->whereNull('deleted_at')
 75:             ->when($scope->brandId, fn ($q) => $q->where('brand_id', $scope->brandId))
 76:             ->with([
 77:                 'latestKmRecord',
 78:                 'latestMotorOilChange',
 79:                 'latestGearboxOilChange',
 80:                 'latestAxleOilChange',
 81:             ])
 82:             ->get();
 83: 
 84:         $rows = collect();
 85: 
 86:         foreach ($buses as $bus) {
 87:             foreach (OilType::cases() as $type) {
 88:                 $status = $this->statusService->forBus($bus, $type);
 89: 
 90:                 if ($status->remainingKm === null || $status->remainingKm < 0) {
 91:                     continue; // overdue or no history — handled elsewhere
 92:                 }
 93: 
 94:                 if ($avgDailyKm <= 0) {
 95:                     continue;
 96:                 }
 97: 
 98:                 $daysRemaining = (int) ceil($status->remainingKm / $avgDailyKm);
 99: 
100:                 if ($daysRemaining > 30) {
101:                     continue;
102:                 }
103: 
104:                 $rows->push([
105:                     'bus' => $bus,
106:                     'type' => $type,
107:                     'status' => $status,
108:                     'days_remaining' => $daysRemaining,
109:                 ]);
110:             }
111:         }
112: 
113:         return $rows->sortBy('days_remaining')->values();
114:     }
115: 
116:     /**
117:      * Fleet-wide average km/day for the current scope.
118:      */
119:     private function averageDailyKm(ReportScope $scope): float
120:     {
121:         $row = DB::table('daily_km_records')
122:             ->whereIn('garage_id', $scope->garageIds)
123:             ->whereNull('deleted_at')
124:             ->where('date', '>=', now()->subDays(30)->toDateString())
125:             ->selectRaw('SUM(km) as total_km, COUNT(DISTINCT date) as days')
126:             ->first();
127: 
128:         if (! $row || (int) $row->days === 0) {
129:             return 0.0;
130:         }
131: 
132:         // SUM(km) here is the total ODOMETER value, not the delta.
133:         // For an accurate estimate we need the diff between the
134:         // highest and lowest km per bus, then divide by days.
135:         return $this->fleetDailyDistance($scope);
136:     }
137: 
138:     /**
139:      * Compute the fleet's true daily distance by subtracting the
140:      * odometer delta per bus over the last 30 days.
141:      */
142:     private function fleetDailyDistance(ReportScope $scope): float
143:     {
144:         $rows = DB::table('daily_km_records')
145:             ->whereIn('garage_id', $scope->garageIds)
146:             ->whereNull('deleted_at')
147:             ->where('date', '>=', now()->subDays(30)->toDateString())
148:             ->select('bus_id')
149:             ->selectRaw('MAX(km) - MIN(km) as distance')
150:             ->selectRaw('COUNT(DISTINCT date) as days')
151:             ->groupBy('bus_id')
152:             ->get();
153: 
154:         $totalDistance = 0;
155:         $totalDays = 0;
156: 
157:         foreach ($rows as $row) {
158:             $totalDistance += max(0, (int) $row->distance);
159:             $totalDays += (int) $row->days;
160:         }
161: 
162:         return $totalDays > 0 ? $totalDistance / $totalDays : 0.0;
163:     }
164: 
165:     // ==================================================================
166:     // #13 — MONTHLY / QUARTERLY COUNT
167:     // ==================================================================
168: 
169:     /**
170:      * Count of oil changes grouped by oil type and time bucket.
171:      *
172:      * @param  string  $bucket  'month' | 'quarter'
173:      * @return Collection<int, object>
174:      */
175:     public function countsByPeriod(
176:         ReportPeriod $period,
177:         ReportScope $scope,
178:         string $bucket = 'month'
179:     ): Collection {
180:         // Whitelist guard — $trunc is interpolated into a raw SQL string.
181:         // Do NOT remove this check without also parameterizing the call.
182:         $trunc = in_array($bucket, ['month', 'quarter'], true) ? $bucket : 'month';
183: 
184:         return BusOilChange::withoutGlobalScope('garage')
185:             ->whereIn('garage_id', $scope->garageIds)
186:             ->whereNull('deleted_at')
187:             ->whereBetween('created_at', [$period->from, $period->to])
188:             ->when($scope->brandId, fn ($q) => $q->whereHas(
189:                 'bus',
190:                 fn ($bq) => $bq->where('brand_id', $scope->brandId)
191:             ))
192:             ->select('oil_type')
193:             ->selectRaw("DATE_TRUNC('{$trunc}', created_at) as period_start")
194:             ->selectRaw('COUNT(*) as total')
195:             ->groupBy('oil_type', 'period_start')
196:             ->orderByDesc('period_start')
197:             ->orderBy('oil_type')
198:             ->get();
199:     }
200: 
201:     // ==================================================================
202:     // #14 — SCHEDULE ADHERENCE
203:     // ==================================================================
204: 
205:     /**
206:      * Adherence to scheduled km intervals.
207:      *
208:      * For each oil change in the period, classify:
209:      *   - early:    actual_km < scheduled_km
210:      *   - on_time:  actual_km == scheduled_km
211:      *   - late:     actual_km > scheduled_km
212:      *
213:      * Only rows with a non-null scheduled_km are counted — imported
214:      * gearbox/axle rows often have no schedule.
215:      *
216:      * @return array{early: int, on_time: int, late: int, total: int, on_time_rate: float}
217:      */
218:     public function scheduleAdherence(ReportPeriod $period, ReportScope $scope): array
219:     {
220:         $row = BusOilChange::withoutGlobalScope('garage')
221:             ->whereIn('garage_id', $scope->garageIds)
222:             ->whereNull('deleted_at')
223:             ->whereBetween('created_at', [$period->from, $period->to])
224:             ->whereNotNull('scheduled_km')
225:             ->when($scope->brandId, fn ($q) => $q->whereHas(
226:                 'bus',
227:                 fn ($bq) => $bq->where('brand_id', $scope->brandId)
228:             ))
229:             ->selectRaw('
230:                 SUM(CASE WHEN actual_km <  scheduled_km THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as early,
231:                 SUM(CASE WHEN actual_km =  scheduled_km THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as on_time,
232:                 SUM(CASE WHEN actual_km >  scheduled_km THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as late,
233:                 COUNT(*) as total
234:             ')
235:             ->first();
236: 
237:         $early = (int) ($row->early ?? 0);
238:         $onTime = (int) ($row->on_time ?? 0);
239:         $late = (int) ($row->late ?? 0);
240:         $total = (int) ($row->total ?? 0);
241: 
242:         return [
243:             'early' => $early,
244:             'on_time' => $onTime,
245:             'late' => $late,
246:             'total' => $total,
247:             'on_time_rate' => $total > 0 ? round((($onTime + $early) / $total) * 100, 1) : 0.0,
248:         ];
249:     }
250: 
251:     // ==================================================================
252:     // #15 — MOTOR OIL CATALOG USAGE
253:     // ==================================================================
254: 
255:     /**
256:      * Which motor-oil catalog entries (part_code / km / brand) were
257:      * actually used in the period.
258:      *
259:      * We join complaint_details (source of truth for what was
260:      * consumed) with motor_oil_details (the catalog) by part_code.
261:      *
262:      * @return Collection<int, object>
263:      */
264:     public function catalogUsage(ReportPeriod $period, ReportScope $scope): Collection
265:     {
266:         return DB::table('complaint_details as cd')
267:             ->join('complaints as c', 'c.id', '=', 'cd.complaint_id')
268:             ->leftJoin('motor_oil_details as mod', function ($join) {
269:                 $join->on('mod.part_code', '=', 'cd.code')
270:                     ->on('mod.garage_id', '=', 'cd.garage_id');
271:             })
272:             ->whereIn('cd.garage_id', $scope->garageIds)
273:             ->whereNull('cd.deleted_at')
274:             ->whereNull('c.deleted_at')
275:             ->whereBetween('c.created_at', [$period->from, $period->to])
276:             ->when($scope->brandId, fn ($q) => $q->whereIn('c.bus_id', function ($sub) use ($scope) {
277:                 $sub->select('id')->from('buses')->where('brand_id', $scope->brandId);
278:             }))
279:             ->select(
280:                 'cd.code',
281:                 DB::raw('MAX(cd.name) as part_name'),
282:                 DB::raw('MAX(mod.km) as catalog_km'),
283:                 DB::raw('MAX(mod.part_name) as catalog_name'),
284:                 DB::raw('SUM(cd.used_quantity) as total_used'),
285:                 DB::raw('COUNT(DISTINCT cd.complaint_id) as times_used'),
286:                 DB::raw('SUM(cd.used_quantity * COALESCE(cd.price_at_use, 0)) as total_cost'),
287:             )
288:             ->groupBy('cd.code')
289:             ->orderByDesc('total_used')
290:             ->get();
291:     }
292: 
293:     // ==================================================================
294:     // #27 — DEAD STOCK (warehouse items never consumed)
295:     // ==================================================================
296: 
297:     /**
298:      * Warehouse items that have NEVER been consumed in any complaint.
299:      *
300:      * This is a "current state" report — no period filter, because
301:      * "never used" means all-time zero usage.
302:      *
303:      * @return Collection<int, object>
304:      */
305:     public function deadStock(ReportScope $scope): Collection
306:     {
307:         return DB::table('warehouses as w')
308:             ->whereIn('w.garage_id', $scope->garageIds)
309:             ->whereNull('w.deleted_at')
310:             ->where('w.is_quarantine', false)
311:             ->where('w.quantity', '>', 0)
312:             ->whereNotExists(function ($sub) {
313:                 $sub->select(DB::raw(1))
314:                     ->from('complaint_details as cd')
315:                     ->whereNull('cd.deleted_at')
316:                     ->whereColumn('cd.code', 'w.code')
317:                     ->whereColumn('cd.garage_id', 'w.garage_id');
318:             })
319:             ->select(
320:                 'w.id',
321:                 'w.code',
322:                 'w.name',
323:                 'w.quantity',
324:                 'w.minimum_quantity',
325:                 'w.unit',
326:                 'w.price',
327:                 'w.category',
328:                 'w.created_at',
329:                 DB::raw('(w.quantity * COALESCE(w.price, 0)) as tied_capital'),
330:             )
331:             ->orderByDesc('tied_capital')
332:             ->get();
333:     }
334: }

 97:      *

101:     {

103:             ->join('complaints as c', 'c.id', '=', 'cd.complaint_id')

109:             ->when($scope->brandId, fn ($q) => $q->where('b.brand_id', $scope->brandId))

134:     public function perComplaint(ReportPeriod $period, ReportScope $scope): array

141:             })
142:             ->whereIn('c.garage_id', $scope->garageIds)
143:             ->whereNull('c.deleted_at')
144:             ->whereBetween('c.created_at', [$period->from, $period->to])
145:             ->when($scope->brandId, fn ($q) => $q->whereIn('c.bus_id', function ($sub) use ($scope) {
146:                 $sub->select('id')->from('buses')->where('brand_id', $scope->brandId);
147:             }))
148:             ->selectRaw('COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) as total_complaints')
149:             ->selectRaw('COUNT(cd.id) as total_parts')
150:             ->first();
151:

153:         $totalParts = (int) ($row->total_parts ?? 0);
154: 
155:         return [
156:             'total_complaints' => $totalComplaints,
157:             'total_parts' => $totalParts,
158:             'avg_parts_per_complaint' => $totalComplaints > 0
159:                 ? round($totalParts / $totalComplaints, 2)
160:                 : 0.0,
161:         ];

<file path="app/Services/Reports/ReportPeriod.php">
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: namespace App\Services\Reports;
  4: 
  5: use Carbon\Carbon;
  6: use Illuminate\Http\Request;
  7: 
  8: /**
  9:  * Immutable value object describing the date range of a report.
 10:  *
 11:  * Supported presets: daily, weekly, monthly, custom.
 12:  * Custom requires `from` and `to` query parameters (Y-m-d).
 13:  */
 14: class ReportPeriod
 15: {
 16:     public const PRESETS = ['daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'custom'];
 17: 
 18:     public function __construct(
 19:         public readonly Carbon $from,
 20:         public readonly Carbon $to,
 21:         public readonly string $preset,
 22:     ) {}
 23: 
 24:     /**
 25:      * Build a period from request query parameters.
 26:      */
 27:     public static function fromRequest(Request $request): self
 28:     {
 29:         $preset = (string) $request->input('period', 'monthly');
 30: 
 31:         if (! in_array($preset, self::PRESETS, true)) {
 32:             $preset = 'monthly';
 33:         }
 34: 
 35:         return match ($preset) {
 36:             'daily' => new self(now()->startOfDay(), now()->endOfDay(), 'daily'),
 37:             'weekly' => new self(now()->startOfWeek(), now()->endOfWeek(), 'weekly'),
 38:             'custom' => self::fromCustom($request),
 39:             default => new self(now()->startOfMonth(), now()->endOfMonth(), 'monthly'),
 40:         };
 41:     }
 42: 
 43:     /**
 44:      * Build from explicit from/to parameters (falls back to monthly if invalid).
 45:      */
 46:     private static function fromCustom(Request $request): self
 47:     {
 48:         try {
 49:             $from = Carbon::parse($request->input('from'))->startOfDay();
 50:             $to = Carbon::parse($request->input('to'))->endOfDay();
 51: 
 52:             // Swap if reversed
 53:             if ($from->greaterThan($to)) {
 54:                 [$from, $to] = [$to, $from];
 55:             }
 56: 
 57:             return new self($from, $to, 'custom');
 58:         } catch (\Throwable $e) {
 59:             return new self(now()->startOfMonth(), now()->endOfMonth(), 'monthly');
 60:         }
 61:     }
 62: 
 63:     /**
 64:      * Human-readable label, e.g. "01.09.2026 — 30.09.2026".
 65:      */
 66:     public function label(): string
 67:     {
 68:         return $this->from->format('d.m.Y').' — '.$this->to->format('d.m.Y');
 69:     }
 70: 
 71:     /**
 72:      * Number of days in the period (inclusive).
 73:      */
 74:     public function days(): int
 75:     {
 76:         return $this->from->diffInDays($this->to) + 1;
 77:     }
 78: 
 79:     /**
 80:      * Check if a given date falls inside this period.
 81:      */
 82:     public function contains(Carbon|string $date): bool
 83:     {
 84:         $d = $date instanceof Carbon ? $date : Carbon::parse($date);
 85: 
 86:         return $d->betweenIncluded($this->from, $this->to);
 87:     }
 88: 
 89:     /**
 90:      * Serialize back into query string parameters for the URL.
 91:      */
 92:     public function toQueryString(): array
 93:     {
 94:         $query = ['period' => $this->preset];
 95: 
 96:         if ($this->preset === 'custom') {
 97:             $query['from'] = $this->from->format('Y-m-d');
 98:             $query['to'] = $this->to->format('Y-m-d');
 99:         }
100: 
101:         return $query;
102:     }
103: }

<file path="app/Services/Reports/ReportScope.php">
 1: <?php
 2: 
 3: namespace App\Services\Reports;
 4: 
 5: use App\Models\Garage;
 6: use App\Models\User;
 7: use App\Services\GarageContext;
 8: 
 9: /**
10:  * Describes the visibility scope of a report for the current user.
11:  *
12:  *   Container scope  — which garages are visible.
13:  *     • Super Admin    → all garages on the platform
14:  *     • Director       → own company's garages only
15:  *     • Garage users   → current garage only
16:  *
17:  *   Data scope       — who inside the container can be seen.
18:  *     • Admin/Manager  → every record in the container
19:  *     • Worker         → only their own records
20:  *
21:  *   Read-only        — Super Admin + Director see aggregates only.
22:  *
23:  *   Brand filter     — optional manufacturer filter. When set, only
24:  *                      records belonging to buses of that brand are
25:  *                      counted. Supported domains: complaint,
26:  *                      daily_km, daily_status.
27:  */
28: class ReportScope
29: {
30:     /**
31:      * @param  array<int>  $garageIds
32:      */
33:     public function __construct(
34:         public readonly array $garageIds,
35:         public readonly ?int $userId,
36:         public readonly bool $readOnly,
37:         public readonly bool $aggregateOnly = false,
38:         public readonly ?int $brandId = null,
39:     ) {}
40: 
41:     public static function for(User $user, string $domain, ?int $brandId = null): self
42:     {
43:         // Super Admin: full platform, read-only aggregates
44:         if ($user->isSuperAdmin()) {
45:             return new self(
46:                 garageIds: Garage::pluck('id')->all(),
47:                 userId: null,
48:                 readOnly: true,
49:                 aggregateOnly: true,
50:                 brandId: $brandId,
51:             );
52:         }
53: 
54:         // Director: own company only, read-only
55:         if ($user->isDirector()) {
56:             $company = $user->activeDirectorCompany();
57: 
58:             return new self(
59:                 garageIds: $company ? $company->garages()->pluck('id')->all() : [],
60:                 userId: null,
61:                 readOnly: true,
62:                 aggregateOnly: true,
63:                 brandId: $brandId,
64:             );
65:         }
66: 
67:         // Garage users: current garage
68:         $garageId = GarageContext::resolveGarageId();
69:         $garageIds = $garageId ? [(int) $garageId] : [];
70: 
71:         // Worker within the domain → only own records
72:         $isWorker = $user->hasGarageRole($domain.'_worker');
73:         $userId = $isWorker ? $user->id : null;
74: 
75:         return new self(
76:             garageIds: $garageIds,
77:             userId: $userId,
78:             readOnly: false,
79:             aggregateOnly: false,
80:             brandId: $brandId,
81:         );
82:     }
83: 
84:     public function hasAccess(): bool
85:     {
86:         return ! empty($this->garageIds);
87:     }
88: }

<file path="app/Services/Reports/TransferReportService.php">
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: namespace App\Services\Reports;
  4: 
  5: use App\Enums\TransferStatus;
  6: use App\Models\AuditLog;
  7: use App\Models\User;
  8: use App\Models\WarehouseTransfer;
  9: use App\Models\WarehouseTransferItem;
 10: use Illuminate\Support\Collection;
 11: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
 12: 
 13: /**
 14:  * Aggregations for the warehouse transfer report domain.
 15:  *
 16:  * All queries are scoped to the current report scope's garageIds
 17:  * (a list of garages — for a Garage Admin it holds one id; for a
 18:  * Director every garage of their company; for a SuperAdmin every
 19:  * garage on the platform).
 20:  *
 21:  * A transfer is "visible" to a garage if that garage is either the
 22:  * source OR the destination. That is why the queries below use a
 23:  * whereIn on both columns.
 24:  */
 25: class TransferReportService
 26: {
 27:     /**
 28:      * Headline counters for the period.
 29:      */
 30:     public function summary(ReportPeriod $period, ReportScope $scope): array
 31:     {
 32:         $base = $this->baseQuery($period, $scope);
 33: 
 34:         $byStatus = (clone $base)
 35:             ->select('status', DB::raw('COUNT(*) as total'))
 36:             ->groupBy('status')
 37:             ->pluck('total', 'status')
 38:             ->all();
 39: 
 40:         $byType = (clone $base)
 41:             ->select('type', DB::raw('COUNT(*) as total'))
 42:             ->groupBy('type')
 43:             ->pluck('total', 'type')
 44:             ->all();
 45: 
 46:         $outbound = (clone $base)->whereIn('from_garage_id', $scope->garageIds)->count();
 47:         $inbound = (clone $base)->whereIn('to_garage_id', $scope->garageIds)->count();
 48: 
 49:         $totalItemsMoved = (int) WarehouseTransferItem::query()
 50:             ->whereIn('transfer_id', (clone $base)->pluck('id'))
 51:             ->sum('declared_quantity');
 52: 
 53:         $disputedCount = $byStatus[TransferStatus::Disputed->value] ?? 0;
 54:         $receivedCount = $byStatus[TransferStatus::Received->value] ?? 0;
 55:         $rejectedCount = $byStatus[TransferStatus::Rejected->value] ?? 0;
 56: 
 57:         $total = array_sum($byStatus);
 58:         $disputeRate = $total > 0 ? round(($disputedCount / $total) * 100, 1) : 0.0;
 59: 
 60:         return [
 61:             'total' => $total,
 62:             'outbound' => $outbound,
 63:             'inbound' => $inbound,
 64:             'items_moved' => $totalItemsMoved,
 65:             'disputed' => $disputedCount,
 66:             'received' => $receivedCount,
 67:             'rejected' => $rejectedCount,
 68:             'dispute_rate' => $disputeRate,
 69:             'by_status' => $byStatus,
 70:             'by_type' => $byType,
 71:         ];
 72:     }
 73: 
 74:     /**
 75:      * Transfers grouped by (from_garage, to_garage) pair.
 76:      */
 77:     public function byRoute(ReportPeriod $period, ReportScope $scope): Collection
 78:     {
 79:         return $this->baseQuery($period, $scope)
 80:             ->join('garages as from_g', 'from_g.id', '=', 'warehouse_transfers.from_garage_id')
 81:             ->leftJoin('garages as to_g', 'to_g.id', '=', 'warehouse_transfers.to_garage_id')
 82:             ->select(
 83:                 'warehouse_transfers.from_garage_id',
 84:                 'warehouse_transfers.to_garage_id',
 85:                 'from_g.name as from_garage_name',
 86:                 'from_g.code as from_garage_code',
 87:                 'to_g.name as to_garage_name',
 88:                 'to_g.code as to_garage_code',
 89:                 DB::raw('COUNT(*) as total_transfers'),
 90:                 DB::raw('SUM(CASE WHEN warehouse_transfers.status = \'disputed\' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as disputed_count'),
 91:                 DB::raw('SUM(CASE WHEN warehouse_transfers.status = \'received\' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as received_count')
 92:             )
 93:             ->groupBy(
 94:                 'warehouse_transfers.from_garage_id',
 95:                 'warehouse_transfers.to_garage_id',
 96:                 'from_g.name',
 97:                 'from_g.code',
 98:                 'to_g.name',
 99:                 'to_g.code',
100:             )
101:             ->orderByDesc('total_transfers')
102:             ->get();
103:     }
104: 
105:     /**
106:      * Items moved most often across all transfers in the period.
107:      */
108:     public function topItems(ReportPeriod $period, ReportScope $scope): Collection
109:     {
110:         $transferIds = $this->baseQuery($period, $scope)->pluck('id');
111: 
112:         if ($transferIds->isEmpty()) {
113:             return collect();
114:         }
115: 
116:         return WarehouseTransferItem::query()
117:             ->whereIn('warehouse_transfer_items.transfer_id', $transferIds)
118:             ->join('warehouses', 'warehouses.id', '=', 'warehouse_transfer_items.warehouse_id')
119:             ->select(
120:                 'warehouses.code',
121:                 DB::raw('MAX(warehouses.name) as name'),
122:                 DB::raw('MAX(warehouses.unit) as unit'),
123:                 DB::raw('COUNT(*) as times_transferred'),
124:                 DB::raw('SUM(warehouse_transfer_items.declared_quantity) as total_declared'),
125:                 DB::raw('SUM(COALESCE(warehouse_transfer_items.received_quantity, 0)) as total_received'),
126:             )
127:             ->groupBy('warehouses.code')
128:             ->orderByDesc('times_transferred')
129:             ->limit(50)
130:             ->get();
131:     }
132: 
133:     /**
134:      * Per-user activity, based on the audit log entries written for
135:      * WarehouseTransfer.
136:      */
137:     public function workerActivity(ReportPeriod $period, ReportScope $scope): Collection
138:     {
139:         $rows = AuditLog::query()
140:             ->where('auditable_type', WarehouseTransfer::class)
141:             ->whereBetween('audit_logs.created_at', [$period->from, $period->to])
142:             ->whereIn('audit_logs.garage_id', $scope->garageIds)
143:             ->select(
144:                 'user_id',
145:                 DB::raw('COUNT(*) as total_actions'),
146:                 DB::raw("SUM(CASE WHEN event = 'created' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as created_count"),
147:                 DB::raw("SUM(CASE WHEN event = 'updated' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as updated_count"),
148:                 DB::raw("SUM(CASE WHEN event IN ('deleted','force_deleted') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as deleted_count")
149:             )
150:             ->groupBy('user_id')
151:             ->orderByDesc('total_actions')
152:             ->get();
153: 
154:         $users = User::whereIn('id', $rows->pluck('user_id')->filter()->all())
155:             ->get()
156:             ->keyBy('id');
157: 
158:         return $rows->map(fn ($row) => (object) [
159:             'user' => $users->get($row->user_id),
160:             'total_actions' => (int) $row->total_actions,
161:             'created_count' => (int) $row->created_count,
162:             'updated_count' => (int) $row->updated_count,
163:             'deleted_count' => (int) $row->deleted_count,
164:         ]);
165:     }
166: 
167:     /**
168:      * Disputed transfers with the discrepancy amounts.
169:      */
170:     public function disputed(ReportPeriod $period, ReportScope $scope): Collection
171:     {
172:         return $this->baseQuery($period, $scope)
173:             ->where('status', TransferStatus::Disputed->value)
174:             ->with(['fromGarage', 'toGarage', 'toServiceVehicle', 'items'])
175:             ->orderByDesc('received_at')
176:             ->limit(200)
177:             ->get();
178:     }
179: 
180:     /**
181:      * Flat, line-level transfer report:
182:      *   from → to, item code, item name, declared qty, received qty.
183:      *
184:      * One row per warehouse_transfer_items line, so the reader sees the
185:      * EXACT granularity of the shipment — not an aggregated total.
186:      */
187:     public function detailed(ReportPeriod $period, ReportScope $scope): Collection
188:     {
189:         $transferIds = $this->baseQuery($period, $scope)->pluck('id');
190: 
191:         if ($transferIds->isEmpty()) {
192:             return collect();
193:         }
194: 
195:         return WarehouseTransferItem::query()
196:             ->whereIn('warehouse_transfer_items.transfer_id', $transferIds)
197:             ->join('warehouse_transfers', 'warehouse_transfers.id', '=', 'warehouse_transfer_items.transfer_id')
198:             ->join('warehouses', 'warehouses.id', '=', 'warehouse_transfer_items.warehouse_id')
199:             ->leftJoin('garages as from_g', 'from_g.id', '=', 'warehouse_transfers.from_garage_id')
200:             ->leftJoin('garages as to_g', 'to_g.id', '=', 'warehouse_transfers.to_garage_id')
201:             ->leftJoin('service_vehicles', 'service_vehicles.id', '=', 'warehouse_transfers.to_service_vehicle_id')
202:             ->select(
203:                 'warehouse_transfers.id as transfer_id',
204:                 'warehouse_transfers.type',
205:                 'warehouse_transfers.status',
206:                 'warehouse_transfers.created_at',
207:                 'warehouse_transfers.to_garage_id',
208:                 'warehouse_transfers.to_service_vehicle_id',
209:                 'from_g.name as from_garage_name',
210:                 'from_g.code as from_garage_code',
211:                 'to_g.name as to_garage_name',
212:                 'to_g.code as to_garage_code',
213:                 'service_vehicles.name as to_vehicle_name',
214:                 'warehouses.code',
215:                 'warehouses.name as part_name',
216:                 'warehouses.unit',
217:                 'warehouse_transfer_items.declared_quantity',
218:                 'warehouse_transfer_items.received_quantity',
219:             )
220:             ->orderByDesc('warehouse_transfers.created_at')
221:             ->orderBy('warehouse_transfers.id')
222:             ->limit(1000)
223:             ->get();
224:     }
225:     // ==================== PRIVATE ====================
226: 
227:     /**
228:      * Base query: transfers whose created_at falls in the period and
229:      * whose source OR destination is one of the visible garages.
230:      *
231:      * IMPORTANT — every column is fully qualified with the table name
232:      * (`warehouse_transfers.created_at`, etc.) because callers like
233:      * `byRoute()` JOIN the `garages` table twice. Both `garages` and
234:      * `warehouse_transfers` have a `created_at` column, so an
235:      * unqualified reference triggers PostgreSQL error 42702
236:      * ("ambiguous column reference").
237:      */
238:     private function baseQuery(ReportPeriod $period, ReportScope $scope)
239:     {
240:         return WarehouseTransfer::query()
241:             ->whereBetween('warehouse_transfers.created_at', [$period->from, $period->to])
242:             ->where(function ($q) use ($scope) {
243:                 $q->whereIn('warehouse_transfers.from_garage_id', $scope->garageIds)
244:                     ->orWhereIn('warehouse_transfers.to_garage_id', $scope->garageIds);
245:             });
246:     }
247: }

<file path="app/Services/Reports/WarehouseAnalyticsReportService.php">
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: namespace App\Services\Reports;
  4: 
  5: use Illuminate\Support\Collection;
  6: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
  7: 
  8: /**
  9:  * Warehouse analytics aggregations — reports #26, #28, #29, #30, #31.
 10:  *
 11:  * Complements the operational WarehouseReportService (receipt, usage,
 12:  * worker activity, low stock, movement) with analytical views that
 13:  * answer inventory-management questions:
 14:  *
 15:  *   26. Slow-moving Stock          — items idle for N days
 16:  *   28. Inventory Valuation        — total value, category breakdown
 17:  *   29. Reorder Suggestions        — what to reorder and how much
 18:  *   30. Supplier Performance       — supplier usage statistics
 19:  *   31. Part Movement History      — per-part per-bus chronological log
 20:  */
 21: class WarehouseAnalyticsReportService
 22: {
 23:     // ==================================================================
 24:     // #26 — SLOW-MOVING STOCK
 25:     // ==================================================================
 26: 
 27:     /**
 28:      * Warehouse items that have not been consumed in the last N days.
 29:      *
 30:      * "Consumed" = a complaint_details row with used_quantity > 0.
 31:      * Items that have never been consumed at all are excluded — those
 32:      * belong to the "Dead Stock" report (#27).
 33:      *
 34:      * @return Collection<int, object>
 35:      */
 36:     public function slowMoving(ReportScope $scope, int $days = 90): Collection
 37:     {
 38:         $cutoff = now()->subDays($days);
 39: 
 40:         return DB::table('warehouses as w')
 41:             ->whereIn('w.garage_id', $scope->garageIds)
 42:             ->whereNull('w.deleted_at')
 43:             ->where('w.is_quarantine', false)
 44:             ->where('w.quantity', '>', 0)
 45:             ->whereExists(function ($sub) {
 46:                 // Item must have been used at least once historically —
 47:                 // otherwise it belongs to dead-stock, not slow-moving.
 48:                 $sub->select(DB::raw(1))
 49:                     ->from('complaint_details as cd')
 50:                     ->whereNull('cd.deleted_at')
 51:                     ->whereColumn('cd.code', 'w.code')
 52:                     ->whereColumn('cd.garage_id', 'w.garage_id');
 53:             })
 54:             ->whereNotExists(function ($sub) use ($cutoff) {
 55:                 // ...but NOT in the last N days.
 56:                 $sub->select(DB::raw(1))
 57:                     ->from('complaint_details as cd')
 58:                     ->whereNull('cd.deleted_at')
 59:                     ->whereColumn('cd.code', 'w.code')
 60:                     ->whereColumn('cd.garage_id', 'w.garage_id')
 61:                     ->where('cd.created_at', '>=', $cutoff);
 62:             })
 63:             ->select(
 64:                 'w.id',
 65:                 'w.code',
 66:                 'w.name',
 67:                 'w.quantity',
 68:                 'w.unit',
 69:                 'w.price',
 70:                 'w.category',
 71:                 DB::raw('(w.quantity * COALESCE(w.price, 0)) as tied_capital'),
 72:                 DB::raw('(
 73:                     SELECT MAX(cd2.created_at)
 74:                     FROM complaint_details cd2
 75:                     WHERE cd2.code = w.code
 76:                       AND cd2.garage_id = w.garage_id
 77:                       AND cd2.deleted_at IS NULL
 78:                 ) as last_used_at'),
 79:             )
 80:             ->orderByDesc('tied_capital')
 81:             ->get()
 82:             ->map(function ($row) {
 83:                 $row->tied_capital = (float) $row->tied_capital;
 84:                 $row->days_since_use = $row->last_used_at
 85:                     ? (int) \Carbon\Carbon::parse($row->last_used_at)->diffInDays(now())
 86:                     : null;
 87: 
 88:                 return $row;
 89:             });
 90:     }
 91: 
 92:     // ==================================================================
 93:     // #28 — INVENTORY VALUATION
 94:     // ==================================================================
 95: 
 96:     /**
 97:      * Total inventory value, aggregated by category.
 98:      *
 99:      * @return array{
100:      *     total_value: float,
101:      *     total_items: int,
102:      *     total_quantity: int,
103:      *     by_category: Collection<int, object>
104:      * }
105:      */
106:     public function valuation(ReportScope $scope): array
107:     {
108:         $rows = DB::table('warehouses')
109:             ->whereIn('garage_id', $scope->garageIds)
110:             ->whereNull('deleted_at')
111:             ->where('is_quarantine', false)
112:             ->select(
113:                 DB::raw("COALESCE(NULLIF(category, ''), 'uncategorized') as category_key"),
114:                 DB::raw('COUNT(*) as item_count'),
115:                 DB::raw('SUM(quantity) as total_quantity'),
116:                 DB::raw('SUM(quantity * COALESCE(price, 0)) as total_value'),
117:             )
118:             ->groupBy('category_key')
119:             ->orderByDesc('total_value')
120:             ->get();
121: 
122:         $totalValue = (float) $rows->sum('total_value');
123:         $totalItems = (int) $rows->sum('item_count');
124:         $totalQuantity = (int) $rows->sum('total_quantity');
125: 
126:         return [
127:             'total_value' => $totalValue,
128:             'total_items' => $totalItems,
129:             'total_quantity' => $totalQuantity,
130:             'by_category' => $rows,
131:         ];
132:     }
133: 
134:     // ==================================================================
135:     // #29 — REORDER SUGGESTIONS
136:     // ==================================================================
137: 
138:     /**
139:      * Items at or below minimum quantity, with a suggested order size.
140:      *
141:      * Suggestion logic:
142:      *   target = max(minimum_quantity * 2, last_30_days_usage * 2)
143:      *   suggest = max(0, target - current_quantity)
144:      *
145:      * If the item has not been used in the last 30 days, the suggestion
146:      * is simply minimum_quantity * 2 - current_quantity.
147:      *
148:      * @return Collection<int, object>
149:      */
150:     public function reorderSuggestions(ReportScope $scope): Collection
151:     {
152:         $thirtyDaysAgo = now()->subDays(30);
153: 
154:         return DB::table('warehouses as w')
155:             ->whereIn('w.garage_id', $scope->garageIds)
156:             ->whereNull('w.deleted_at')
157:             ->where('w.is_quarantine', false)
158:             ->whereColumn('w.quantity', '<=', 'w.minimum_quantity')
159:             ->select(
160:                 'w.id',
161:                 'w.code',
162:                 'w.name',
163:                 'w.quantity',
164:                 'w.minimum_quantity',
165:                 'w.unit',
166:                 'w.price',
167:                 'w.supplier',
168:             )
169:             ->selectRaw(
170:                 '(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cd.used_quantity), 0)
171:                     FROM complaint_details cd
172:                     WHERE cd.code = w.code
173:                       AND cd.garage_id = w.garage_id
174:                       AND cd.deleted_at IS NULL
175:                       AND cd.created_at >= ?) as usage_last_30d',
176:                 [$thirtyDaysAgo]
177:             )
178:             ->orderByRaw('(w.minimum_quantity - w.quantity) DESC')
179:             ->get()
180:             ->map(function ($row) {
181:                 $row->usage_last_30d = (int) $row->usage_last_30d;
182:                 $row->deficit = max(0, (int) $row->minimum_quantity - (int) $row->quantity);
183: 
184:                 $target = max(
185:                     (int) $row->minimum_quantity * 2,
186:                     (int) $row->usage_last_30d * 2
187:                 );
188: 
189:                 $row->suggested_order = max(0, $target - (int) $row->quantity);
190:                 $row->estimated_cost = (float) $row->suggested_order * (float) ($row->price ?? 0);
191: 
192:                 return $row;
193:             });
194:     }
195: 
196:     // ==================================================================
197:     // #30 — SUPPLIER PERFORMANCE
198:     // ==================================================================
199: 
200:     /**
201:      * Usage statistics per supplier.
202:      *
203:      * "Usage" = sum of used_quantity across complaint_details where the
204:      * part's warehouse row has this supplier. Provides a signal for
205:      * supplier-quality reviews: high usage of parts from a supplier
206:      * might indicate quality issues.
207:      *
208:      * @return Collection<int, object>
209:      */
210:     public function supplierPerformance(ReportPeriod $period, ReportScope $scope): Collection
211:     {
212:         return DB::table('complaint_details as cd')
213:             ->join('warehouses as w', function ($join) {
214:                 $join->on('w.code', '=', 'cd.code')
215:                     ->on('w.garage_id', '=', 'cd.garage_id')
216:                     ->whereNull('w.deleted_at');
217:             })
218:             ->join('complaints as c', 'c.id', '=', 'cd.complaint_id')
219:             ->whereIn('cd.garage_id', $scope->garageIds)
220:             ->whereNull('cd.deleted_at')
221:             ->whereNull('c.deleted_at')
222:             ->whereBetween('c.created_at', [$period->from, $period->to])
223:             ->whereNotNull('w.supplier')
224:             ->where('w.supplier', '!=', '')
225:             ->where('cd.used_quantity', '>', 0)
226:             ->select(
227:                 'w.supplier',
228:                 DB::raw('COUNT(DISTINCT w.code) as distinct_parts'),
229:                 DB::raw('COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) as cards_count'),
230:                 DB::raw('SUM(cd.used_quantity) as total_used'),
231:                 DB::raw('SUM(cd.used_quantity * COALESCE(cd.price_at_use, 0)) as total_cost'),
232:             )
233:             ->groupBy('w.supplier')
234:             ->orderByDesc('total_used')
235:             ->get();
236:     }
237: 
238:     // ==================================================================
239:     // #31 — PART MOVEMENT HISTORY
240:     // ==================================================================
241: 
242:     /**
243:      * Chronological log: every part consumption with its bus, card,
244:      * date, quantity, price, and source. Supports filtering by part
245:      * code and bus DQN.
246:      *
247:      * @return Collection<int, object>
248:      */
249:     public function partMovementHistory(
250:         ReportPeriod $period,
251:         ReportScope $scope,
252:         ?string $code = null,
253:         ?string $dqn = null
254:     ): Collection {
255:         return DB::table('complaint_details as cd')
256:             ->join('complaints as c', 'c.id', '=', 'cd.complaint_id')
257:             ->join('buses as b', 'b.id', '=', 'c.bus_id')
258:             ->whereIn('cd.garage_id', $scope->garageIds)
259:             ->whereNull('cd.deleted_at')
260:             ->whereNull('c.deleted_at')
261:             ->whereBetween('c.created_at', [$period->from, $period->to])
262:             ->where('cd.used_quantity', '>', 0)
263:             ->whereIn('cd.source_type', ['warehouse', 'service_vehicle'])
264:             ->when($code, fn ($q) => $q->where('cd.code', 'ILIKE', "%{$code}%"))
265:             ->when($dqn, fn ($q) => $q->where('b.dqn', 'ILIKE', "%{$dqn}%"))
266:             ->when($scope->brandId, fn ($q) => $q->where('b.brand_id', $scope->brandId))
267:             ->select(
268:                 'cd.id as detail_id',
269:                 'cd.code',
270:                 'cd.name as part_name',
271:                 'cd.used_quantity',
272:                 'cd.price_at_use',
273:                 'cd.source_type',
274:                 'c.id as complaint_id',
275:                 'c.created_at',
276:                 'b.id as bus_id',
277:                 'b.dqn',
278:                 'b.route_number',
279:             )
280:             ->orderByDesc('c.created_at')
281:             ->orderByDesc('cd.id')
282:             ->limit(1000)
283:             ->get()
284:             ->map(function ($row) {
285:                 $row->line_cost = (float) $row->used_quantity * (float) ($row->price_at_use ?? 0);
286: 
287:                 return $row;
288:             });
289:     }
290: }
