 23: /**
 24:  * Development-only demo data.
 25:  *
 26:  * Creates TWO companies with different purposes:
 27:  *
 28:  *   1. "Demo Company"  → FULLY SEEDED
 29:  *      Every garage has the full catalog: buses, warehouse items,
 30:  *      motor-oil details, service templates, employees, drivers,
 31:  *      30 days of KM records and daily statuses, and complaints.
 32:  *      This is the sandbox you can freely destroy and re-create by
 33:  *      running `php artisan migrate:fresh --seed`.
 34:  *
 35:  *   2. "LEGACY MOTOR and SERVICE"  → STRUCTURE ONLY
 36:  *      The company, its garages, directors, garage admins and
 37:  *      default complaint types are created, but NO domain data.
 38:  *      This is your personal workspace: load your real buses,
 39:  *      warehouse, motor oil, etc. through the UI. Running the
 40:  *      seeder again will NOT touch anything you added here.
 41:  *
 42:  * The split means: seed everything → LEGACY is ready for your
 43:  * real data, Demo Company is ready for tests.
 44:  *
 45:  * ⚠️  Blocked in production. Real tenants are created through
 46:  *     the SuperAdmin UI in production.
 47:  */
 48: class DemoDataSeeder extends Seeder
 49: {
 50:     /**
 51:      * Default complaint types seeded for every garage — including
 52:      * the LEGACY garages, because a new complaint form should work
 53:      * out of the box.
 54:      */
 55:     private const COMPLAINT_TYPES = [
 56:         'Engine noise',
 57:         'Tire puncture',
 58:         'Brake problem',
 59:         'Lighting failure',
 60:         'Transmission problem',
 61:         'Suspension problem',
 62:         'Electrical problem',
 63:         'Air conditioning failure',
 64:         'Oil leak',
 65:         'Other',
 66:     ];
 67: 
 68:     /**
 69:      * Motor-oil service intervals (km) for the DEMO company.
 70:      */
 71:     private const SERVICE_INTERVALS = [15000, 30000, 60000, 90000, 120000];
 72: 
 73:     /**
 74:      * Employee positions (matches config('settings.employee_positions')).
 75:      */
 76:     private const EMPLOYEE_POSITIONS = ['master', 'mechanic', 'electrician', 'welder'];
 77: 
 78:     public function run(): void
 79:     {
 80:         // ⚠️ Blocked in production to prevent accidental seeding on live customer database.
 81:         if (app()->environment('production')) {
 82:             $this->command->error('DemoDataSeeder is blocked in production.');
 83: 
 84:             return;
 85:         }
 86: 
 87:         $this->command->info('🌱 Seeding demo data...');
 88: 
 89:         DB::transaction(function () {
 90:             // ─── Company 1: Demo Company (fully seeded) ───
 91:             $demo = $this->createCompany('Demo Company', 'demo-company');
 92:             $this->createDirector($demo, 'Demo Director', 'director@demo.test');
 93: 
 94:             $this->seedGarage($demo, 'Demo Central Garage', 'demo-central', withDomainData: true);
 95:             $this->seedGarage($demo, 'Demo North Garage', 'demo-north', withDomainData: true);
 96:             $this->seedGarage($demo, 'Demo South Garage', 'demo-south', withDomainData: true);
 97: 
 98:             // ─── Company 2: Sample Company (structure only) ───
 99:             $legacy = $this->createCompany('Sample Transport Co.', 'legacy-motor');
100:             $this->createDirector($legacy, 'Sample Director', 'director@sample.test');
101: 
102:             $this->seedGarage($legacy, 'Depot A', 'depot-a', withDomainData: false);
103:             $this->seedGarage($legacy, 'Depot B', 'depot-b', withDomainData: false);
104:             $this->seedGarage($legacy, 'Depot C', 'depot-c', withDomainData: false);
105:         });
106: 
107:         $this->command->info('✅ Demo data seeded successfully.');
108:         $this->command->newLine();
109:         $this->command->info('Login credentials (all passwords: password):');
110:         $this->command->info('  Super Admin       → admin@fleet.com');
111:         $this->command->info('  Demo Director     → director@demo.test');
112:         $this->command->info('  Sample Director   → director@sample.test');
113:         $this->command->info('  Garage admins     → {garage.code}.admin@demo.test');
114:         $this->command->warn('  Workers           → PIN 1234 (pin_is_default=true — will be forced to change)');
115:         $this->command->warn('⚠️  NEVER run this seeder on a publicly accessible server.');
116:     }
117: 
118:     // ==================================================================
119:     // COMPANY & DIRECTOR
120:     // ==================================================================
121: 
122:     private function createCompany(string $name, string $slug): Company
123:     {
124:         return Company::updateOrCreate(
125:             ['slug' => $slug],
126:             [
127:                 'name' => $name,
128:                 'email' => "info@{$slug}.test",
129:                 'phone' => '+994 12 '.random_int(100, 999).' '.random_int(10, 99).' '.random_int(10, 99),
130:                 'address' => 'Bakı, Azərbaycan',
131:                 'is_active' => true,
132:             ]
133:         );
134:     }
135: 
136:     private function createDirector(Company $company, string $name, string $email): User
137:     {
138:         $director = User::updateOrCreate(
139:             ['email' => $email],
140:             [
141:                 'name' => $name,
142:                 'password' => Hash::make('password'),
143:                 'employee_code' => 'DIR-'.strtoupper(substr(md5($email), 0, 6)),
144:                 'pin' => Hash::make('1234'),
145:                 'pin_is_default' => true,
146:                 'is_active' => true,
147:                 'email_verified_at' => now(), // ← YENİ
148:             ]
149:         );
150: 
151:         if ($director->role !== 'user') {
152:             $director->demoteToRegularUser()->save();
153:         }
154: 
155:         $company->users()->syncWithoutDetaching([
156:             $director->id => ['role' => 'director', 'is_active' => true],
157:         ]);
158: 
159:         // Ensure only one active director per company
160:         $company->users()
161:             ->wherePivot('role', 'director')
162:             ->wherePivot('is_active', true)
163:             ->where('users.id', '!=', $director->id)
164:             ->get()
165:             ->each(function (User $other) use ($company) {
166:                 $company->users()->updateExistingPivot($other->id, ['is_active' => false]);
167:             });
168: 
169:         return $director;
170:     }
171: 
172:     // ==================================================================
173:     // GARAGE — the single entry point for seeding a garage
174:     // ==================================================================
175: 
176:     /**
177:      * Create (or update) a garage and optionally seed its domain data.
178:      *
179:      * When $withDomainData is false, only the structure is created:
180:      *   - the garage itself
181:      *   - its admin user (so someone can log in)
182:      *   - the default complaint-type catalog (so the new-complaint
183:      *     form works out of the box)
184:      *
185:      * No buses, no warehouse, no motor oil, no employees, no drivers,
186:      * no KM records, no statuses, no complaints.
187:      *
188:      * That way, running the seeder again never overwrites the real
189:      * data the operator has loaded into the LEGACY garages.
190:      */
191:     private function seedGarage(
192:         Company $company,
193:         string $name,
194:         string $code,
195:         bool $withDomainData
196:     ): Garage {
197:         $garage = Garage::updateOrCreate(
198:             ['code' => $code],
199:             [
200:                 'company_id' => $company->id,
201:                 'name' => $name,
202:                 'address' => 'Bakı, Azərbaycan',
203:                 'phone' => '+994 12 '.random_int(100, 999).' '.random_int(10, 99).' '.random_int(10, 99),
204:                 'is_active' => true,
205:             ]
206:         );
207: 
208:         // Set the context once so every nested seeder writes to the
209:         // right tenant. HasGarageScope and Auditable both rely on it.
210:         GarageContext::set($garage->id, $company->id);
211: 
212:         $this->command->line("  → Seeding garage: {$garage->name} ({$garage->code})".
213:             ($withDomainData ? '' : '  [structure only]'));
214: 
215:         // Structure — always seeded.
216:         $this->createGarageAdmin($garage);
217:         $this->createComplaintTypes($garage);
218: 
219:         // Domain data — only for the demo company.
220:         if ($withDomainData) {
221:             $this->createGarageUsers($garage);
222:             $this->createMotorOilCatalog($garage);
223:             $this->createWarehouseItems($garage);
224:             $this->createBuses($garage);
225:             $this->createEmployees($garage);
226:             $this->createDrivers($garage);
227:             $this->createDailyKmRecords($garage);
228:             $this->createDailyStatuses($garage);
229:             $this->createComplaints($garage);
230:         }
231: 
232:         GarageContext::clear();
233: 
234:         return $garage;
235:     }
236: 
237:     // ==================================================================
238:     // PER-GARAGE SEEDERS — STRUCTURE
239:     // ==================================================================
240: 
241:     private function createGarageAdmin(Garage $garage): void
242:     {
243:         $adminEmail = "{$garage->code}.admin@demo.test";
244: 
245:         $admin = User::updateOrCreate(
246:             ['email' => $adminEmail],
247:             [
248:                 'name' => "{$garage->name} Admin",
249:                 'password' => Hash::make('password'),
250:                 'employee_code' => 'ADM-'.strtoupper(substr(md5($adminEmail), 0, 6)),
251:                 'pin' => Hash::make('1234'),
252:                 'pin_is_default' => true,
253:                 'is_active' => true,
254:                 'email_verified_at' => now(), // ← YENİ
255:             ]
256:         );
257: 
258:         if ($admin->role !== 'user') {
259:             $admin->demoteToRegularUser()->save();
260:         }
261: 
262:         // Ensure no other active admin exists in this garage
263:         // (partial unique index garage_user_single_admin).
264:         $garage->users()
265:             ->wherePivot('role', 'admin')
266:             ->wherePivot('is_active', true)
267:             ->where('users.id', '!=', $admin->id)
268:             ->get()
269:             ->each(function (User $other) use ($garage) {
270:                 $garage->users()->updateExistingPivot($other->id, ['is_active' => false]);
271:             });
272: 
273:         $garage->users()->syncWithoutDetaching([
274:             $admin->id => ['role' => 'admin', 'is_active' => true],
275:         ]);
276:         $garage->users()->updateExistingPivot($admin->id, [
277:             'role' => 'admin',
278:             'is_active' => true,
279:         ]);
280:     }
281: 
282:     private function createComplaintTypes(Garage $garage): void
283:     {
284:         foreach (self::COMPLAINT_TYPES as $name) {
285:             ComplaintType::withoutGlobalScopes()->updateOrCreate(
286:                 ['name' => $name, 'garage_id' => $garage->id],
287:                 ['company_id' => $garage->company_id]
288:             );
289:         }
290:     }

296:     private function createGarageUsers(Garage $garage): void
297:     {
298:         // Managers + Workers: 4 domains × 2 tiers = 8 accounts
299:         $roleMatrix = [
300:             'complaint_manager', 'complaint_worker',
301:             'warehouse_manager', 'warehouse_worker',
302:             'daily_km_manager', 'daily_km_worker',
303:             'daily_status_manager', 'daily_status_worker',
304:         ];
305: 
306:         foreach ($roleMatrix as $role) {
307:             $slug = str_replace('_', '.', $role);
308:             $email = "{$garage->code}.{$slug}@demo.test";
309: 
310:             $user = User::updateOrCreate(
311:                 ['email' => $email],
312:                 [
313:                     'name' => "{$garage->name} ".ucwords(str_replace('_', ' ', $role)),
314:                     'password' => Hash::make('password'),
315:                     'employee_code' => strtoupper(substr($role, 0, 3)).'-'.
316:                         strtoupper(substr(md5($email), 0, 6)),
317:                     'pin' => Hash::make('1234'),
318:                     'pin_is_default' => false,
319:                     'is_active' => true,
320:                     'email_verified_at' => now(), // ← YENİ
321:                 ]
322:             );
323: 
324:             if ($user->role !== 'user') {
325:                 $user->demoteToRegularUser()->save();
326:             }
327: 
328:             $garage->users()->syncWithoutDetaching([
329:                 $user->id => ['role' => $role, 'is_active' => true],
330:             ]);
331:         }
332:     }

334:     private function createMotorOilCatalog(Garage $garage): void
335:     {
336:         foreach (self::SERVICE_INTERVALS as $km) {
337:             $parts = [
338:                 ['code' => "OIL-FLT-{$km}", 'name' => "Oil filter ({$km} km)", 'qty' => 1, 'unit' => 'piece'],
339:                 ['code' => "OIL-15W40-{$km}", 'name' => "Engine oil 15W40 ({$km} km)", 'qty' => 18, 'unit' => 'liter'],
340:                 ['code' => "OIL-GSK-{$km}", 'name' => "Gasket ({$km} km)", 'qty' => 1, 'unit' => 'piece'],
341:             ];
342: 
343:             foreach ($parts as $part) {
344:                 MotorOilDetail::updateOrCreate(
345:                     [
346:                         'garage_id' => $garage->id,
347:                         'part_code' => $part['code'],
348:                         'km' => $km,
349:                     ],
350:                     [
351:                         'company_id' => $garage->company_id,
352:                         'part_name' => $part['name'],
353:                         'unit' => $part['unit'],
354:                         'quantity' => $part['qty'],
355:                         'count' => 1,
356:                     ]
357:                 );
358:             }
359: 
360:             ServiceTemplate::updateOrCreate(
361:                 [
362:                     'garage_id' => $garage->id,
363:                     'default_km_interval' => $km,
364:                 ],
365:                 [
366:                     'company_id' => $garage->company_id,
367:                     'name' => "Motor Oil Change ({$km} km)",
368:                     'details' => collect($parts)->map(fn ($p) => [
369:                         'code' => $p['code'],
370:                         'name' => $p['name'],
371:                         'quantity' => $p['qty'],
372:                         'unit' => $p['unit'],
373:                     ])->toArray(),
374:                 ]
375:             );
376:         }
377:     }

409:     private function createBuses(Garage $garage): void
410:     {
411:         $projects = ['BakuBus', 'Azerbaijan Automobile'];
412:         $routes = ['101', '105', '120', '154', '175'];
413: 
414:         for ($i = 1; $i <= 5; $i++) {
415:             $dqn = sprintf('%s-%03d', strtoupper($garage->code), $i);
416: 
417:             Bus::withoutGlobalScopes()->updateOrCreate(
418:                 ['dqn' => $dqn, 'garage_id' => $garage->id],
419:                 [
420:                     'company_id' => $garage->company_id,
421:                     'bus_project' => $projects[$i % count($projects)],
422:                     'vin' => strtoupper('VIN'.$garage->id.str_pad((string) $i, 11, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT)),
423:                     'uzunluq' => 12.5,
424:                     'route_number' => $routes[$i % count($routes)],
425:                     'engine_number' => 'ENG-'.str_pad((string) $i, 6, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT),
426:                     'km' => 100000 + ($i * 15000),
427:                     'is_active' => true,
428:                 ]
429:             );
430:         }
431:     }

484:     private function createDailyKmRecords(Garage $garage): void
485:     {
486:         $buses = Bus::withoutGlobalScopes()
487:             ->where('garage_id', $garage->id)
488:             ->where('is_active', true)
489:             ->get();
490: 
491:         if ($buses->isEmpty()) {
492:             return;
493:         }
494: 
495:         for ($day = 30; $day >= 0; $day--) {
496:             $date = now()->subDays($day);
497: 
498:             if ($date->isSunday()) {
499:                 continue;
500:             }
501: 
502:             foreach ($buses as $bus) {
503:                 if (random_int(1, 100) <= 10) {
504:                     continue;
505:                 }
506: 
507:                 $kmBase = 100000 + ($bus->id * 15000);
508:                 $km = $kmBase + ((30 - $day) * random_int(150, 350));
509: 
510:                 DailyKmRecord::withoutGlobalScopes()->updateOrCreate(
511:                     [
512:                         'bus_id' => $bus->id,
513:                         'date' => $date->toDateString(),
514:                     ],
515:                     [
516:                         'garage_id' => $garage->id,
517:                         'company_id' => $garage->company_id,
518:                         'km' => $km,
519:                         'notes' => null,
520:                     ]
521:                 );
522:             }
523:         }
524:     }
525: 
526:     private function createDailyStatuses(Garage $garage): void
527:     {
528:         $buses = Bus::withoutGlobalScopes()
529:             ->where('garage_id', $garage->id)
530:             ->where('is_active', true)
531:             ->get();
532: 
533:         if ($buses->isEmpty()) {
534:             return;
535:         }
536: 
537:         $statuses = [
538:             'READY FOR ROUTE',
539:             'READY FOR ROUTE',
540:             'READY FOR ROUTE',
541:             'IN MAINTENANCE',
542:             'OUT OF SERVICE',
543:         ];
544: 
545:         for ($day = 30; $day >= 0; $day--) {
546:             $date = now()->subDays($day);
547: 
548:             foreach ($buses as $bus) {
549:                 if (random_int(1, 100) > 40) {
550:                     continue;
551:                 }
552: 
553:                 BusDailyStatus::withoutGlobalScopes()->updateOrCreate(
554:                     [
555:                         'bus_id' => $bus->id,
556:                         'date' => $date->toDateString(),
557:                     ],
558:                     [
559:                         'garage_id' => $garage->id,
560:                         'company_id' => $garage->company_id,
561:                         'status' => $statuses[array_rand($statuses)],
562:                         'notes' => null,
563:                     ]
564:                 );
565:             }
566:         }
567:     }
568: 
569:     private function createComplaints(Garage $garage): void
570:     {
571:         $buses = Bus::withoutGlobalScopes()
572:             ->where('garage_id', $garage->id)
573:             ->get();
574: 
575:         if ($buses->isEmpty()) {
576:             return;
577:         }
578: 
579:         $types = ['breakdown', 'accident', 'maintenance'];
580:         $statuses = ['pending', 'in_progress', 'completed'];
581:         $descriptions = [
582:             'Engine noise at high RPM',
583:             'Tire puncture on rear left',
584:             'Brake pedal feels soft',
585:             'Left headlight not working',
586:             'Gearbox slipping on 3rd gear',
587:             'Air conditioner not cooling',
588:             'Oil leak under engine',
589:             'Suspension noise on bumps',
590:         ];
591: 
592:         $worker = User::whereHas('garages', function ($q) use ($garage) {
593:             $q->where('garage_id', $garage->id)->where('role', 'complaint_worker');
594:         })->first();
595: 
596:         for ($i = 1; $i <= 10; $i++) {
597:             $createdAt = now()->subDays(random_int(0, 25))->subHours(random_int(0, 23));
598:             $status = $statuses[array_rand($statuses)];
599:             $closedAt = $status === 'completed' ? $createdAt->copy()->addHours(random_int(2, 72)) : null;
600: 
601:             $complaint = Complaint::withoutGlobalScopes()->create([
602:                 'bus_id' => $buses->random()->id,
603:                 'garage_id' => $garage->id,
604:                 'company_id' => $garage->company_id,
605:                 'created_by' => $worker?->id,
606:                 'yer' => random_int(0, 1) ? 'garage' : 'road',
607:                 'status' => $status,
608:                 'complaint_type' => $types[array_rand($types)],
609:                 'km' => random_int(100000, 250000),
610:                 'start_date' => $createdAt->toDateString(),
611:                 'start_time' => $createdAt->format('H:i'),
612:                 'closed_at' => $closedAt,
613:                 'end_date' => $closedAt?->toDateString(),
614:                 'end_time' => $closedAt?->format('H:i'),
615:                 'work_done_by' => $status === 'completed' ? 'Standard repair completed.' : null,
616:             ]);
617: 
618:             DB::table('complaints')
619:                 ->where('id', $complaint->id)
620:                 ->update(['created_at' => $createdAt]);
621: 
622:             for ($j = 0; $j < random_int(1, 2); $j++) {
623:                 $complaint->items()->create([
624:                     'description' => $descriptions[array_rand($descriptions)],
625:                     'type' => $complaint->complaint_type?->value,
626:                     'garage_id' => $garage->id,
627:                     'company_id' => $garage->company_id,
628:                 ]);
629:             }
630:         }
631:     }
632: }

<file path="database/seeders/UserSeeder.php">
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: namespace Database\Seeders;
  4: 
  5: use App\Models\User;
  6: use Illuminate\Database\Seeder;
  7: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
  8: use Illuminate\Support\Str;
  9: 
 10: /**
 11:  * Seeds the platform-level SuperAdmin account.
 12:  *
 13:  * Every other account type is created through its dedicated flow:
 14:  *
 15:  *   ┌─────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
 16:  *   │ Account type        │ Created by                                   │
 17:  *   ├─────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────┤
 18:  *   │ SuperAdmin          │ THIS seeder (idempotent, platform-level)     │
 19:  *   │ Company Director    │ CompanyController::store                     │
 20:  *   │                     │   → CompanyOnboardingService                 │
 21:  *   │ Garage Admin        │ GarageController::store                      │
 22:  *   │                     │   → GarageOnboardingService                  │
 23:  *   │ Workers / Managers  │ UserManagementController (garage Admin)      │
 24:  *   └─────────────────────┴──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
 25:  *
 26:  * The SuperAdmin is intentionally NOT attached to any garage — it is
 27:  * a platform-scoped role, not a tenant-scoped one. The old
 28:  * `seedGarageAdmin()` method (which created `garage.admin@example.com`)
 29:  * was removed in favor of the onboarding flows above.
 30:  */
 31: class UserSeeder extends Seeder
 32: {
 33:     public function run(): void
 34:     {
 35:         $this->seedSuperAdmin();
 36:     }
 37: 
 38:     // ============================================================
 39:     // 1. SUPER ADMIN
 40:     // ============================================================
 41:     private function seedSuperAdmin(): void
 42:     {
 43:         $existing = User::withoutGlobalScopes()
 44:             ->where('email', 'admin@fleet.com')
 45:             ->first();
 46: 
 47:         // Idempotent: never overwrite an existing SuperAdmin's password.
 48:         // Re-running `php artisan db:seed` must NOT reset credentials.
 49:         if ($existing) {
 50:             if (! $existing->isSuperAdmin()) {
 51:                 $existing->promoteToSuperAdmin()->save();
 52:                 $this->command->info('Existing user admin@fleet.com promoted to Super Admin.');
 53:             } else {
 54:                 $this->command->line('Super Admin already exists — password left untouched.');
 55:             }
 56: 
 57:             return;
 58:         }
 59: 
 60:         $password = $this->resolveSuperAdminPassword();
 61:         $generated = $password === null; // null signals "random was generated"
 62: 
 63:         if ($generated) {
 64:             $password = Str::password(24, symbols: true);
 65:         }
 66: 
 67:         $superAdmin = User::create([
 68:             'name' => 'Super Admin',
 69:             'email' => 'admin@fleet.com',
 70:             'password' => Hash::make($password),
 71:             'is_active' => true,
 72:             // Admin-created users are considered pre-verified. Self-registration
 73:             // is disabled, so there is no verification email to send. Without
 74:             // this flag the user would be locked out by the `verified`
 75:             // middleware immediately after `migrate:fresh --seed`.
 76:             'email_verified_at' => now(),
 77:         ]);
 78: 
 79:         $superAdmin->promoteToSuperAdmin()->save();
 80: 
 81:         $this->reportSuperAdminCredentials($password, $generated);
 82:     }
 83: 
 84:     /**
 85:      * Decide which password to use for a brand-new Super Admin.
 86:      *
 87:      * Priority:
 88:      *   1. SUPER_ADMIN_PASSWORD env var (explicit operator intent)
 89:      *   2. Local/testing without env var → 'password' for developer convenience
 90:      *   3. Every other environment without env var → generate a strong
 91:      *      random password
 92:      *
 93:      * @return string|null The chosen password, or null to signal
 94:      *                     "caller must generate a random one".
 95:      */
 96:     private function resolveSuperAdminPassword(): ?string
 97:     {
 98:         if ($env = env('SUPER_ADMIN_PASSWORD')) {
 99:             return (string) $env;
100:         }
101: 
102:         if (app()->environment(['local', 'testing'])) {
103:             return 'password';
104:         }
105: 
106:         return null; // signal random generation
107:     }
108: 
109:     /**
110:      * Print a loud, one-time warning so the operator can copy the
111:      * credentials before they scroll off the terminal.
112:      */
113:     private function reportSuperAdminCredentials(string $password, bool $generated): void
114:     {
115:         if (! $generated) {
116:             $this->command->info('Super Admin created with the password from SUPER_ADMIN_PASSWORD.');
117: 
118:             return;
119:         }
120: 
121:         $this->command->newLine();
122:         $this->command->info('══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════');
123:         $this->command->info(' SUPER ADMIN CREDENTIALS (shown ONLY once)');
124:         $this->command->info('══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════');
125:         $this->command->line('  Email:    admin@fleet.com');
126:         $this->command->line('  Password: '.$password);
127:         $this->command->info('══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════');
128: 
129:         $this->command->warn('  ⚠️  This password was RANDOMLY generated.');
130:         $this->command->warn('  ⚠️  Save it NOW — it will NEVER be shown again.');
131:         $this->command->warn('  ⚠️  If lost, run: php artisan tinker');
132:         $this->command->warn('      User::where("email","admin@fleet.com")');
133:         $this->command->warn('          ->update(["password" => Hash::make("new")]);');
134: 
135:         $this->command->newLine();
136:     }
137: }
</file>

<file path="docker/backup/backup-run.sh">
 1: #!/bin/sh
 2: # =============================================================================
 3: # Single-shot backup script — invoked by crond once per day.
 4: #
 5: # Flow:
 6: #   1. pg_dump the database to a timestamped .sql file.
 7: #   2. Compress with gzip -9.
 8: #   3. Write a freshness marker (/backups/.last-success) that the app's
 9: #      /health endpoint reads to detect a stale backup.
10: #   4. Delete backups older than BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS.
11: #
12: # On failure: remove the partial dump, log it, and exit non-zero so
13: # crond records the failure.
14: # =============================================================================
15: set -eu
16: 
17: TS="$(date +%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M-%S)"
18: OUT="/backups/fleet_${TS}.sql.gz"
19: TMP="/backups/.fleet_${TS}.sql.partial"
20: MARKER="/backups/.last-success"
21: RETENTION_DAYS="${BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS:-14}"
22: 
23: log() { echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] $*"; }
24: 
25: log "Starting backup -> ${OUT}"
26: 
27: # Dump directly to a partial file so a crash halfway through never leaves
28: # a truncated .sql.gz that a restore script would happily try to load.
29: if ! PGPASSWORD="${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}" pg_dump \
30:         -h postgres \
31:         -U "${POSTGRES_USER}" \
32:         -d "${POSTGRES_DB}" \
33:         --no-owner \
34:         --no-privileges \
35:         --clean \
36:         --if-exists \
37:         > "${TMP}"; then
38:     log "ERROR: pg_dump failed"
39:     rm -f "${TMP}"
40:     exit 1
41: fi
42: 
43: # Compress and remove the raw partial in one atomic-ish step.
44: if ! gzip -9 < "${TMP}" > "${OUT}"; then
45:     log "ERROR: gzip failed"
46:     rm -f "${TMP}" "${OUT}"
47:     exit 1
48: fi
49: 
50: rm -f "${TMP}"
51: 
52: SIZE="$(du -h "${OUT}" | cut -f1)"
53: log "Backup OK — ${OUT} (${SIZE})"
54: 
55: # Freshness marker — the health endpoint reads mtime of this file.
56: touch "${MARKER}"
57: 
58: # Retention sweep. Uses -mtime which is measured in 24-hour units by
59: # POSIX, so a value of 14 means "strictly more than 14*24 hours old".
60: DELETED=$(find /backups -maxdepth 1 -name 'fleet_*.sql.gz' -mtime +"${RETENTION_DAYS}" -print -delete | wc -l)
61: log "Retention cleanup done — removed ${DELETED} file(s) older than ${RETENTION_DAYS} days"
62: 
63: exit 0
</file>

<file path="docker/backup/entrypoint.sh">
 1: #!/bin/sh
 2: # =============================================================================
 3: # Backup sidecar entrypoint.
 4: #
 5: # Installs a single crontab entry and runs crond in the foreground. This is
 6: # the standard Alpine pattern — no supervisor, no systemd, one process that
 7: # stays in the foreground so Docker's restart policy can manage the container.
 8: #
 9: # Environment (from .env.production.db):
10: #   POSTGRES_USER, POSTGRES_PASSWORD, POSTGRES_DB
11: #
12: # Optional:
13: #   BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS  — how many days of backups to keep (default 14)
14: #   BACKUP_HOUR            — hour of the day to run (default 02)
15: # =============================================================================
16: set -e
17: 
18: BACKUP_HOUR="${BACKUP_HOUR:-02}"
19: BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS="${BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS:-14}"
20: 
21: # Persist these to /etc/environment so crond's child shell inherits them.
22: # Cron does NOT source any shell profile, so anything the backup script
23: # reads must live here.
24: cat > /etc/environment <<EOF
25: POSTGRES_USER=${POSTGRES_USER}
26: POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
27: POSTGRES_DB=${POSTGRES_DB}
28: BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS=${BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS}
29: EOF
30: 
31: # Install the crontab. 02:00 by default, but operators can override the
32: # hour via BACKUP_HOUR without touching the repo.
33: cat > /etc/crontabs/root <<EOF
34: 0 ${BACKUP_HOUR} * * * /usr/local/bin/backup-run.sh >> /var/log/backup.log 2>&1
35: EOF
36: 
37: echo "[$(date)] Backup sidecar starting — cron hour=${BACKUP_HOUR}, retention=${BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS}d"
38: 
39: # crond needs a writable log directory. -l 2 = log level info.
40: touch /var/log/backup.log
41: exec crond -f -l 2
</file>

<file path="docker/nginx/fleet.conf.example">
  1: # =============================================================================
  2: # Recommended production Nginx configuration for Fleet Maintenance.
  3: #
  4: # Copy to /etc/nginx/sites-available/fleet and adjust:
  5: #   - server_name     (currently fleet.yourdomain.com)
  6: #   - TLS cert paths  (currently Let's Encrypt defaults)
  7: #   - upstream host   (default: 127.0.0.1:8080, matching the docker
  8: #                      compose "127.0.0.1:8080:80" port binding)
  9: #
 10: # This file is NOT consumed by Docker — it is a template for the
 11: # operator to review and adapt. Renaming it to .conf (without .example)
 12: # has no effect on the application or the compose stack.
 13: # =============================================================================
 14: 
 15: upstream fleet_backend {
 16:     server 127.0.0.1:8080;
 17:     keepalive 32;
 18: }
 19: 
 20: # ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 21: # HTTP → HTTPS redirect + ACME challenge passthrough
 22: # ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 23: server {
 24:     listen 80;
 25:     listen [::]:80;
 26:     server_name fleet.yourdomain.com;
 27: 
 28:     # Let's Encrypt HTTP-01 challenge — must be reachable over plain
 29:     # HTTP, before the redirect.
 30:     location /.well-known/acme-challenge/ {
 31:         root /var/www/certbot;
 32:     }
 33: 
 34:     location / {
 35:         return 301 https://$host$request_uri;
 36:     }
 37: }
 38: 
 39: # ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 40: # HTTPS server
 41: # ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 42: server {
 43:     listen 443 ssl;
 44:     listen [::]:443 ssl;
 45:     http2 on;
 46:     server_name fleet.yourdomain.com;
 47: 
 48:     ssl_certificate     /etc/letsencrypt/live/fleet.yourdomain.com/fullchain.pem;
 49:     ssl_certificate_key /etc/letsencrypt/live/fleet.yourdomain.com/privkey.pem;
 50:     ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;
 51:     ssl_ciphers HIGH:!aNULL:!MD5;
 52:     ssl_prefer_server_ciphers on;
 53: 
 54:     # Security headers. HSTS is intentionally long (1 year) — remove
 55:     # the preload directive until you are confident the domain will
 56:     # stay HTTPS-only forever.
 57:     add_header Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains" always;
 58:     add_header X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff" always;
 59:     add_header X-Frame-Options "SAMEORIGIN" always;
 60:     add_header Referrer-Policy "strict-origin-when-cross-origin" always;
 61: 
 62:     # Import files are limited to 10 MB in the app; leave headroom.
 63:     client_max_body_size 20M;
 64: 
 65:     # ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 66:     # /health — monitoring endpoint
 67:     #
 68:     # Deliberately public in the application (no auth middleware), so
 69:     # external uptime checkers can reach it without credentials.
 70:     #
 71:     # That openness exposes a small amount of operational info to
 72:     # anonymous visitors:
 73:     #   - database / cache / storage status
 74:     #   - queue driver name
 75:     #   - free disk space percentage
 76:     #   - age of the last successful backup
 77:     #
 78:     # None of that is sensitive on its own, but aggregated over time
 79:     # it reveals your deployment cadence and infrastructure shape.
 80:     # Restrict it to your monitoring network.
 81:     # ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 82:     location = /health {
 83:         allow 127.0.0.1;       # loopback (local check)
 84:         allow 10.0.0.0/8;      # private network — adjust to your VPC
 85:         allow 172.16.0.0/12;   # docker bridge networks
 86:         allow 192.168.0.0/16;  # LAN
 87:         deny all;
 88: 
 89:         # If your monitoring tool runs from a dynamic IP (UptimeRobot
 90:         # free tier, Cloudflare Health Checks), you cannot whitelist
 91:         # it. Two options:
 92:         #
 93:         #   1. Replace the allow/deny block with a shared-secret check:
 94:         #        if ($arg_token != "CHANGE_ME_TO_A_LONG_RANDOM_STRING") {
 95:         #            return 403;
 96:         #        }
 97:         #      and point the monitor at /health?token=...
 98:         #
 99:         #   2. Add a second endpoint /health/public in Laravel that
100:         #      returns a bare 200 without any service details, and let
101:         #      the monitor hit that instead.
102: 
103:         proxy_pass http://fleet_backend;
104:         proxy_set_header Host              $host;
105:         proxy_set_header X-Real-IP         $remote_addr;
106:         proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For   $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
107:         proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
108:     }
109: 
110:     # ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
111:     # Everything else
112:     # ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
113:     location / {
114:         proxy_pass http://fleet_backend;
115:         proxy_set_header Host              $host;
116:         proxy_set_header X-Real-IP         $remote_addr;
117:         proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For   $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
118:         proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
119:         proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Host  $host;
120: 
121:         # WebSocket support (kept for future live-update features;
122:         # harmless if unused).
123:         proxy_http_version 1.1;
124:         proxy_set_header Upgrade    $http_upgrade;
125:         proxy_set_header Connection "upgrade";
126: 
127:         proxy_read_timeout    300;
128:         proxy_connect_timeout  60;
129:     }
130: }
</file>

<file path="Dockerfile">
  1: # syntax=docker/dockerfile:1.7
  2: 
  3: # ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  4: # PHP runtime (Apache)
  5: #
  6: # QEYD: Bu layihə JS build tələb etmir — Bootstrap, FontAwesome və
  7: # Bootstrap Icons artıq `public/vendor/` altında saxlanılır, Alpine.js
  8: # isə yalnız `resources/js/app.js`-də import olunur və istifadə
  9: # edilmir. Ona görə Node stage-i Dockerfile-dən çıxarıldı.
 10: # ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 11: FROM php:8.4-apache AS app
 12: 
 13: # ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 14: # System dependencies + PHP extensions
 15: # ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 16: RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
 17:         git \
 18:         unzip \
 19:         curl \
 20:         libpq-dev \
 21:         libzip-dev \
 22:         libpng-dev \
 23:         libjpeg62-turbo-dev \
 24:         libfreetype6-dev \
 25:         libicu-dev \
 26:     && docker-php-ext-configure gd --with-freetype --with-jpeg \
 27:     && docker-php-ext-install -j"$(nproc)" \
 28:         pdo_pgsql \
 29:         pgsql \
 30:         zip \
 31:         gd \
 32:         intl \
 33:         opcache \
 34:     && a2enmod rewrite headers \
 35:     && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
 36: 
 37: # ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 38: # OPcache — production-ready defaults
 39: # ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 40: RUN { \
 41:         echo 'opcache.enable=1'; \
 42:         echo 'opcache.enable_cli=0'; \
 43:         echo 'opcache.validate_timestamps=0'; \
 44:         echo 'opcache.memory_consumption=256'; \
 45:         echo 'opcache.interned_strings_buffer=16'; \
 46:         echo 'opcache.max_accelerated_files=20000'; \
 47:     } > /usr/local/etc/php/conf.d/opcache.ini
 48: 
 49: # ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 50: # max_input_vars — enforced at the INI layer (PHP_INI_PERDIR)
 51: #
 52: # This directive cannot be changed with ini_set() at runtime. The
 53: # image ships with the value raised so large complaint forms and
 54: # bulk imports do not hit PHP's default 1000-input cap. FPM/CGI
 55: # deployments can also ship a public/.user.ini with the same value.
 56: # ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 57: RUN printf 'max_input_vars = 3000\n' > /usr/local/etc/php/conf.d/max_input_vars.ini
 58: # ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 59: # Composer binary
 60: # ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 61: COPY --from=composer:2 /usr/bin/composer /usr/bin/composer
 62: 
 63: WORKDIR /var/www/html
 64: 
 65: # ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 66: # PHP dependencies — cached layer
 67: # ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 68: COPY composer.json composer.lock ./
 69: 
 70: RUN composer install \
 71:         --no-dev \
 72:         --no-interaction \
 73:         --no-scripts \
 74:         --prefer-dist \
 75:         --optimize-autoloader \
 76:         --no-progress
 77: 
 78: # ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 79: # Application source (excluding what .dockerignore filters out)
 80: # ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 81: COPY . .
 82: 
 83: # ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 84: # Regenerate the Composer autoloader against the full source tree
 85: #
 86: # `bootstrap/cache/packages.php` is machine-local state. In particular, a
 87: # development cache can contain providers from require-dev (Pail, Breeze,
 88: # Collision, etc.) that do not exist in this production image because Composer
 89: # is installed with --no-dev. Always discard it and regenerate discovery from
 90: # the image's actual vendor directory.
 91: # ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 92: RUN rm -f bootstrap/cache/*.php \
 93:     && composer dump-autoload --optimize --no-dev
 94: 
 95: # ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 96: # Apache — point DocumentRoot at /public
 97: # ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 98: RUN sed -ri -e 's!/var/www/html!/var/www/html/public!g' \
 99:         /etc/apache2/sites-available/000-default.conf \
100:         /etc/apache2/apache2.conf
101: 
102: RUN printf '<Directory /var/www/html/public>\n\
103:     AllowOverride All\n\
104:     Require all granted\n\
105: </Directory>\n' > /etc/apache2/conf-available/laravel.conf \
106:     && a2enconf laravel
107: 
108: # ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
109: # Permissions + storage symlink
110: # ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
111: RUN chown -R www-data:www-data storage bootstrap/cache \
112:     && php artisan storage:link || true
113: 
114: # ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
115: # Healthcheck — Laravel's /up endpoint
116: # ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
117: HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=5s --start-period=30s --retries=3 \
118:     CMD curl -fsS http://localhost/up || exit 1
119: 
120: EXPOSE 80
121: 
122: CMD ["apache2-foreground"]
</file>

<file path="public/.htaccess">
 1: <IfModule mod_rewrite.c>
 2:     <IfModule mod_negotiation.c>
 3:         Options -MultiViews -Indexes
 4:     </IfModule>
 5: 
 6:     RewriteEngine On
 7: 
 8:     # Handle Authorization Header
 9:     RewriteCond %{HTTP:Authorization} .
10:     RewriteRule .* - [E=HTTP_AUTHORIZATION:%{HTTP:Authorization}]
11: 
12:     # Handle X-XSRF-Token Header
13:     RewriteCond %{HTTP:x-xsrf-token} .
14:     RewriteRule .* - [E=HTTP_X_XSRF_TOKEN:%{HTTP:X-XSRF-Token}]
15: 
16:     # Redirect Trailing Slashes If Not A Folder...
17:     RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-d
18:     RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} (.+)/$
19:     RewriteRule ^ %1 [L,R=301]
20: 
21:     # Send Requests To Front Controller...
22:     RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-d
23:     RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-f
24:     RewriteRule ^ index.php [L]
25: </IfModule>
</file>

<file path="public/.user.ini">
 1: ; ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 2: ; PHP runtime overrides for the public web root.
 3: ;
 4: ; Read by PHP-FPM and the CGI/FastCGI SAPI only. It is NOT read by
 5: ; mod_php (the php:*-apache Docker image uses mod_php — see the
 6: ; Dockerfile for that case) or by the CLI server (`php artisan serve`).
 7: ;
 8: ; ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 9: 
10: ; Large complaint forms, bulk imports and long nested arrays used to
11: ; hit PHP's default 1000-input cap and get silently truncated. Raised
12: ; to 3000 so a complaint with ~150 parts, or a bulk-import payload,
13: ; can be submitted without losing fields.
14: max_input_vars = 3000
15: 
16: ; Match the OPcache directive from the Dockerfile so opcache does not
17: ; re-validate timestamps on every request in production.
18: ; (FPM-only; harmless in dev.)
19: ; opcache.validate_timestamps = 0
</file>

<file path="README.md">
  1: # Fleet Control
  2: 
  3: Fleet Control avtobus parkının texniki istismarını idarə etmək üçün hazırlanmış Laravel tətbiqidir. Sistem bir neçə şirkət və qarajla işləyir; məlumat, istifadəçi rolu və əməliyyatlar cari qaraj üzrə ayrılır.
  4: 
  5: ## İlkin giriş
  6: 
  7: Seeder Super Admin hesabı yaradır:
  8: 
  9: - **Email:** `admin@fleet.com`
 10: - **Parol:**
 11:   - **Production:** ya `SUPER_ADMIN_PASSWORD` env dəyişəni ilə təyin edin,
 12:     ya da seeder tərəfindən təsadüfi generasiya olunan güclü parolu
 13:     konsoldan bir dəfəlik kopyalayın (parol YALNIZ bir dəfə göstərilir!).
 14:   - **Local/dev:** `password`
 15: 
 16: ⚠️ **Diqqət:** Əgər production-da parol konsoldan kopyalanmasa, onu
 17: `php artisan tinker` vasitəsilə yenidən təyin etməli olacaqsınız:
 18: 
 19: \`\`\`
 20: User::where('email','admin@fleet.com')
 21:     ->update(['password' => Hash::make('yeni-guclu-parol')]);
 22: \`\`\`
 23: 
 24: İlk girişdən sonra **Profil → Şifrəni dəyiş** bölməsindən parolu dəyişin.
 25: 
 26: ## Əsas imkanlar
 27: 
 28: - Avtobusların, xətt nömrələrinin, DQN/VIN və son yürüşün idarə edilməsi
 29: - Günlük KM və günlük status qeydləri
 30: - Nasazlıq, qəza və texniki xidmət kartlarının açılması
 31: - Texniki xidmətdə növbəti yağdəyişmə intervalına görə detalların avtomatik gətirilməsi
 32: - Kartda istifadə olunan detalın, miqdarın və işi görən işçinin qeyd edilməsi
 33: - Stok qalığının izlənməsi və mənfi stokun qarşısının alınması
 34: - Şikayət kartının PDF akt kimi açılması/çap edilməsi
 35: - Excel-dən avtobus, anbar, işçi, sürücü, günlük KM, günlük status və digər məlumatların idxalı
 36: - Sürücülərin Excel-ə ixracı
 37: - Şirkət → qaraj → məlumat quruluşu
 38: - Rol əsaslı menyu və icazələr
 39: - Açıq və tünd rejim
 40: 
 41: ## Sistem quruluşu
 42: 
 43: ```text
 44: Şirkət
 45: └── Qaraj
 46:     ├── Avtobuslar
 47:     ├── Kartlar / Şikayətlər
 48:     ├── Anbar
 49:     ├── Günlük KM
 50:     ├── Günlük statuslar
 51:     ├── Sürücülər
 52:     └── İşçilər
 53: ```
 54: 
 55: İstifadəçi yalnız ona təyin edilmiş qarajdakı məlumatları görür.
 56: 
 57: ## Rollar və icazələr
 58: 
 59: | Rol | İcazə |
 60: | --- | --- |
 61: | `admin` | Təyin olunduğu qarajda bütün əməliyyatlar və istifadəçi idarəetməsi |
 62: | `complaint` | Kart/şikayət yaratmaq, redaktə etmək və idarə etmək |
 63: | `warehouse` | Anbar məhsullarını və stokunu idarə etmək |
 64: | `daily_km` | Günlük KM qeydlərini idarə etmək |
 65: | `daily_status` | Günlük status qeydlərini idarə etmək |
 66: | `directorate` | Müvafiq bölmələrə yalnız baxış; yaratma, redaktə və silmə yoxdur |
 67: 
 68: Admin yeni hesabları **İstifadəçilər** bölməsindən yaradır, cari qaraja bağlayır, rol verir, hesabı aktiv/passiv edir və şifrəni yeniləyə bilir.

 86: 
 87: `.env` faylında PostgreSQL bağlantısını öz mühitinizə uyğun yazın:
 88:

 91: DB_HOST=127.0.0.1
 92: DB_PORT=5432
 93: DB_DATABASE=fleet_maintenance_v2

 95: DB_PASSWORD=your_password

102: php artisan serve

120: ## Excel idxalı
121: 
122: Hər idxal səhifəsində qəbul olunan sütunlar göstərilir. Fayllar `.xlsx`, `.xls` və ya `.csv` formatında, maksimum 10 MB ola bilər.
123: 
124: Avtobus idxalında `DQN` məcburidir. Eyni DQN cari qarajda yenilənir; başqa qaraja aid DQN isə idxal edilmir.
125: 
126: ## Texniki xidmət kartı
127: 
128: 1. Kart açarkən avtobus və texniki xidmət tipi seçilir.
129: 2. Sistem avtobusun son KM göstəricisini götürür.
130: 3. Motor yağı cədvəlindən son KM-dən böyük olan ilk interval seçilir.
131: 4. Həmin intervalın detallar siyahısı avtomatik əlavə edilir.
132: 5. Dəyişməyəcək detal varsa, kartdakı **Detalı sil** düyməsi ilə çıxarılır. Silinən detal anbardan düşmür.
133: 
134: ## Error Monitoring (Sentry)
135: 
136: Tətbiq **Sentry** ilə inteqrasiya olunub — production-da baş verən
137: unhandled exception-ları və yavaş request-ləri avtomatik olaraq
138: Sentry dashboard-ına göndərir.
139: 
140: ### Aktivləşdirmə
141: 
142: Sentry **default olaraq söndürülmüşdür** — `SENTRY_LARAVEL_DSN` boş
143: olduqda SDK heç bir şəbəkə sorğusu etmir və sıfır overhead yaradır.
144: Bu, paketi bütün mühitlərdə təhlükəsiz edir.
145: 
146: Production-da aktivləşdirmək üçün:
147: 
148: 1. [sentry.io](https://sentry.io) -da **Laravel** layihəsi yaradın
149: 2. **Project Settings → Client Keys (DSN)** bölməsindən DSN-i kopyalayın
150: 3. `.env.production`-a əlavə edin:
151: 
152: ```dotenv
153: SENTRY_LARAVEL_DSN=https://abc123@o12345.ingest.sentry.io/67890
154: SENTRY_ENVIRONMENT=production
155: ```
156: 
157: 4. Container-ləri yenidən başladın:
158: 
159: ```bash
160: docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml restart app scheduler
161: ```
162: 
163: ### Nə göndərilir, nə göndərilmir
164: 
165: **Göndərilir:**
166: - Unhandled exception-lar (real bug-lar, crash-lər)
167: - Infrastructure xətaları (DB connection qırıldı, disk doldu)
168: - Performance trace-lər (`SENTRY_TRACES_SAMPLE_RATE` ilə idarə olunur)
169: 
170: **Göndərilmir** (`config/sentry.php` → `before_send` filtri):
171: - `ValidationException` — istifadəçi səhvi, bug deyil
172: - `AuthenticationException` — giriş cəhdi, normal
173: - `AuthorizationException` — icazə rədd edildi, normal
174: - `ModelNotFoundException`, `NotFoundHttpException` — 404-lər
175: - `GarageAccessDeniedException`, `StockInsufficientException`,
176:   `MissingGarageContextException` — tətbiq tərəfindən normal idarə olunan
177:   biznes xətaları
178: 
179: Bu filtr sayəsində Sentry dashboard-ı **yalnız real problemləri** göstərir,
180: səs-küy yoxdur.
181: 
182: ### Sample rate tənzimləməsi
183: 
184: | Dəyişən | Default | Nə üçün |
185: |---------|---------|---------|
186: | `SENTRY_SAMPLE_RATE` | `1.0` | Xəta event-lərinin faizi. Xətalar nadir olduğu üçün 100% düzgündür. |
187: | `SENTRY_TRACES_SAMPLE_RATE` | `0.1` | Performance trace-lərin faizi. 10% yavaş endpoint-ləri tutmaq üçün kifayətdir. |
188: | `SENTRY_SEND_DEFAULT_PII` | `false` | İstifadəçi email/IP göndərilsin? **Production-da `true` etməyin** — privacy policy tələb edir. |
189: 
190: ### Self-hosted alternativ
191: 
192: Sentry açıq mənbəlidir. Öz serverinizdə işlətmək üçün:
193: 
194: ```bash
195: git clone https://github.com/getsentry/self-hosted.git
196: cd self-hosted && ./install.sh
197: ```
198: 
199: Sonra DSN-i öz host-unuza yönəldin. Bu, data suverenliyi tələbləri
200: olan müştərilər üçün doğru seçimdir.
201: 
202: ## Database Backup
203: 
204: Production-da avtomatik DB backup **backup sidecar** konteyneri vasitəsilə işləyir
205: (`docker-compose.prod.yml`).
206: 
207: ### Necə işləyir
208: 
209: 1. Hər gecə saat **02:00**-da (konfiqurasiya olunur — `BACKUP_HOUR`) `pg_dump`
210:    işə düşür və PostgreSQL-i `./backups/` qovluğuna `.sql.gz` formatında yazır.
211: 2. Uğurlu dump-dan sonra `.last-success` marker faylı yenilənir.
212: 3. `BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS`-dən (default: 14 gün) köhnə fayllar avtomatik silinir.
213: 4. `/health` endpoint hər dəfə `.last-success`-in yaşını yoxlayır; backup
214:    25 saatdan köhnədirsə, `503 unhealthy` qaytarır.
215: 
216: ### Backup faylları hara düşür
217: 
218: Host-da: `./backups/fleet_YYYY-MM-DD_HH-MM-SS.sql.gz`
219: 
220: Bu qovluq **host bind mount**-dur (`docker-compose.prod.yml`-də
221: `./backups:/backups`), ona görə Docker-dan asılı olmayaraq hər hansı
222: rsync/scp aləti ilə oxuna bilər.
223: 
224: ### Off-site kopyalama (tövsiyə olunur)
225: 
226: Backup-ı yalnız serverdə saxlamaq **kifayət deyil** — server yansa və ya
227: hardware failure olsa, backup da itər. Hər gecə backup-ı başqa yerə
228: kopyalayın:
229: 
230: ```bash
231: # Nümunə: S3-ə (aws-cli quraşdırılmış olmalı)
232: aws s3 sync /path/to/fleet/backups s3://my-fleet-backups/ \
233:     --exclude '*' --include 'fleet_*.sql.gz'
234: ```
235: 
236: Bunu host-un `crontab`-ına backup-dan **1 saat sonra** (03:00) əlavə edin.
237: 
238: ### Bərpa (restore)
239: 
240: ```bash
241: # 1. Backup faylını seçin
242: ls -lh backups/
243: 
244: # 2. Database-i bərpa edin (DİQQƏT: mövcud data üzərinə yazır!)
245: gunzip -c backups/fleet_2026-09-24_02-00-01.sql.gz \
246:     | docker exec -i fleet-prod-postgres \
247:         psql -U fleet_prod -d fleet_maintenance_production
248: 
249: # 3. Uğurlu bərpadan sonra app-i yenidən başladın
250: docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml restart app scheduler
251: ```
252: 
253: ### Backup-ı yoxlamaq
254: 
255: ```bash
256: # Son backup-ın yaşını gör
257: ls -lh backups/ | tail -5
258: 
259: # Health endpoint-ə bax
260: curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8080/health | jq '.services.backup'
261: 
262: # Backup sidecar-ın loglarına bax
263: docker logs fleet-prod-backup --tail 50
264: ```
265: 
266: ### Manual backup almaq
267: 
268: ```bash
269: docker exec fleet-prod-backup /usr/local/bin/backup-run.sh
270: ```
271:

275: php artisan test
276: ```

288: ## Production Deploy Checklist
289: 
290: ### 0. İlk deploy və yeniləmə əmrləri
291: 
292: Serverdə repozitoriyanı klonladıqdan sonra `.env.production` və
293: `.env.production.db` fayllarını nümunələrdən yaradıb real sirlərlə doldurun.
294: Bu iki fayl Git-ə daxil edilmir.
295: 
296: ```bash
297: cp .env.production.example .env.production
298: cp .env.production.db.example .env.production.db
299: # Faylları redaktə edin: APP_KEY, APP_URL, DB/POSTGRES parolları, SMTP və TRUSTED_PROXIES
300: 
301: docker build -t fleet-v2-app:latest .
302: docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d
303: docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml ps
304: ```
305: 
306: `migrate` xidməti tətbiq və scheduler/queue proseslərindən əvvəl avtomatik
307: olaraq migration-ları işlədir və `UserSeeder` ilə platform Super Admin hesabını
308: yaradır. Seeder idempotentdir: mövcud adminin şifrəsini və ya məlumatlarını
309: dəyişmir. İlk production deploy-da `SUPER_ADMIN_PASSWORD` dəyərini əvvəlcədən
310: `.env.production`-da yazın; boş olduqda güclü təsadüfi şifrə yaradılır və yalnız
311: `docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml logs migrate` çıxışında bir dəfə
312: göstərilir. Xidmətin statusu `Exited (0)` olmalıdır; başqa statusda tətbiq
313: prosesləri qəsdən başlamaz.
314: 
315: Yeni versiya üçün eyni `docker build` və `docker compose ... up -d` əmrlərini
316: işlədin. Migration-lar idempotentdir və yalnız tətbiq edilməmiş dəyişiklikləri
317: yerinə yetirir. Queue worker ayrıca xidmətdir; database queue-dakı işləri
318: emal edir və hər saat özünü yenidən başladaraq yeni kodu götürür.
319: 
320: ### 1. Təhlükəsizlik
321: 
322: - `.env.production` faylı **yalnız serverdə** saxlanmalıdır — git-ə heç vaxt commit etmə.
323: - `APP_DEBUG=false` **mütləqdir** — stack trace-lər istifadəçiyə göstərilməməlidir.
324: - `APP_KEY` `php artisan key:generate --show` ilə yaradılmalı və `.env.production`-a yazılmalıdır.
325: - `SUPER_ADMIN_PASSWORD` env dəyişəni ilə təyin et, yoxsa ilk seed təsadüfi güclü parol generasiya edəcək (BİR DƏFƏ konsola çap olunacaq).
326: 
327: ### 2. Reverse Proxy (Nginx / Cloudflare / ALB)
328: 
329: Əksər production deployment-lər reverse proxy arxasında olur. `TRUSTED_PROXIES` düzgün təyin olunmasa:
330: 
331: - **Rate limiting** səhv işləyir (hamı proxy-nin IP-si ilə eyni bucket-a düşür)
332: - **Audit log-lar** yanlış IP-lər yazır
333: - **Session secure cookie** HTTPS sxemini təyin edə bilmir → redirect loop
334: 
335: `.env.production`-da ssenariyə uyğun dəyər qoy:
336: 
337: | Arxitektura | Dəyər |
338: |-------------|-------|
339: | Nginx eyni serverdə | `127.0.0.1` |
340: | Nginx ayrı Docker-də | `172.16.0.0/12,10.0.0.0/8` |
341: | Cloudflare | [rəsmi IP siyahısı](https://www.cloudflare.com/ips/) |
342: | AWS ALB | VPC CIDR (məs. `10.0.0.0/8`) |
343: 
344: ⚠️ **`TRUSTED_PROXIES=*` HEÇ VAXT istifadə etmə** — bu, IP spoofing-ə imkan verir.
345: 
346: ### 3. HTTPS və Cookie Təhlükəsizliyi
347: 
348: `.env.production`-da:
349: 
350: ```dotenv
351: SESSION_SECURE_COOKIE=true
352: SESSION_HTTP_ONLY=true
353: SESSION_SAME_SITE=lax
354: 
355: ### 5. `/health` Endpoint Security
356: 
357: `/health` **auth tələb etmir** — çünki monitoring tool-lar (UptimeRobot,
358: Kubernetes liveness probes, internal checks) onu autentifikasiya olmadan
359: çağırmalıdır.
360: 
361: Bu, kiçik bir **information disclosure** riskidir: cavab ehtiva edir
362: 
363: ```json
364: {
365:   "services": {
366:     "queue":  { "driver": "database" },
367:     "disk":   { "free_percent": 62.4 },
368:     "backup": { "age_hours": 4.2 }
369:   }
370: }
371: ```
372: 
373: Aqreqat olaraq bu məlumat deployment ritmini və infrastruktur formasını
374: ifşa edir. **Production-da reverse proxy səviyyəsində məhdudlaşdırın.**
375: 
376: Hazır Nginx konfiqurasiyası: [`docker/nginx/fleet.conf.example`](docker/nginx/fleet.conf.example)
377: 
378: Əsas hissə:
379: 
380: ```nginx
381: location = /health {
382:     allow 127.0.0.1;       # loopback
383:     allow 10.0.0.0/8;      # private network
384:     allow 172.16.0.0/12;   # docker bridge
385:     allow 192.168.0.0/16;  # LAN
386:     deny all;
387:     proxy_pass http://fleet_backend;
388: }
389: ```
390: 
391: **Dinamik IP-dən monitorinq edirsinizsə** (UptimeRobot free tier kimi),
392: whitelist mümkün deyil. Əvəzinə shared-secret query string istifadə edin:
393: 
394: ```nginx
395: if ($arg_token != "CHANGE_ME_TO_A_LONG_RANDOM_STRING") {
396:     return 403;
397: }
398: ```
399: 
400: və monitor-u `/health?token=...` ünvanına yönəldin.
401: 
402: **Backup freshness probe-unu söndürmək** üçün (məsələn backup sidecar
403: işlətmirsizsə) `.env.production`-da:
404: 
405: ```dotenv
406: HEALTH_BACKUP_MAX_AGE_HOURS=0
407: ```
408: 
409: Bu, probe-u tamamilə `skipped` edir — `/health` yenə 200 qaytarır.
410: 
411: ## Təhlükəsizlik qeydləri
412: 
413: - `.env` faylını GitHub-a göndərməyin.
414: - Production mühitində `APP_DEBUG=false` istifadə edin.
415: - İlkin admin şifrəsini dərhal dəyişin.
416: - İstifadəçilərə yalnız ehtiyac duyduğu qaraj və rolu verin.
417: 
418: ### 4. PostgreSQL Credentials
419: 
420: Production-da PostgreSQL parolu **mütləq** güclü və unikal olmalıdır.
421: Zəif parol bütün tenant məlumatlarını riskə atır.
422: 
423: ```bash
424: # 1. Güclü parol yarat
425: openssl rand -base64 32
426: 
427: # 2. Kopyala və doldur
428: cp .env.production.db.example .env.production.db
429: nano .env.production.db
</file>

<file path="resources/views/auth/change-pin.blade.php">

176:             const dateExplicit = btn.dataset.dateExplicit === '1';

178:             if (total === 0) return;
179: 
180:             const message = @json(__('messages.common.bulk_delete_all_confirm'))
181:                 .replace(':count', total);
182:

186: 
187:             // Only pass the date if the user explicitly filtered by it.
188:             // Otherwise, the controller deletes across ALL dates.

191:                 if (date !== '') {
192:                     const i = document.createElement('input');
193:                     i.type = 'hidden'; i.name = 'date'; i.value = date;
194:                     filtersContainer.appendChild(i);
195:                 }
196:             }
197:

199:             const status = document.getElementById('status')?.value ?? '';
200: 
201:             if (dqn !== '') {
202:                 const i = document.createElement('input');
203:                 i.type = 'hidden'; i.name = 'dqn'; i.value = dqn;
204:                 filtersContainer.appendChild(i);
205:             }
206:             if (status !== '') {
207:                 const i = document.createElement('input');
208:                 i.type = 'hidden'; i.name = 'status'; i.value = status;
209:                 filtersContainer.appendChild(i);
210:             }
211: 
212:             form.action = "{{ route('bus-daily-statuses.bulk.delete-all') }}";
213:             form.submit();
214:         });
215:     })();
216: </script>

 79:     const bulkDeleteAllForm    = document.getElementById('bulkDeleteAllForm');
 80:     const bulkDeleteAllFilters = document.getElementById('bulkDeleteAllFilters');
 81:     const DELETE_ALL_LABEL     = @json(__('messages.common.bulk_delete_all'));
 82: 
 83:     const translations = {
 84:         bulk_deactivate: @json(__('messages.buses.bulk_deactivate')),
 85:         bulk_activate: @json(__('messages.buses.bulk_activate')),
 86:         bulk_delete: @json(__('messages.buses.bulk_delete')),
 87:         bulk_deactivate_confirm: @json(__('messages.buses.bulk_deactivate_confirm')),
 88:         bulk_activate_confirm: @json(__('messages.buses.bulk_activate_confirm')),
 89:         bulk_delete_confirm: @json(__('messages.buses.bulk_delete_confirm')),
 90:     };
 91: 
 92:     function updateBulkButtons() {
 93:         const count = selectedIds.size;
 94:         if (bulkDeactivateBtn) {
 95:             bulkDeactivateBtn.disabled = count === 0;
 96:             bulkDeactivateBtn.innerHTML = `<i class="bi bi-x-circle"></i> ${translations.bulk_deactivate} (${count})`;
 97:         }
 98:         if (bulkActivateBtn) {
 99:             bulkActivateBtn.disabled = count === 0;
100:             bulkActivateBtn.innerHTML = `<i class="bi bi-check-circle"></i> ${translations.bulk_activate} (${count})`;
101:         }
102:         if (bulkDeleteBtn) {
103:             bulkDeleteBtn.disabled = count === 0;
104:             bulkDeleteBtn.innerHTML = `<i class="bi bi-trash"></i> ${translations.bulk_delete} (${count})`;
105:         }
106:     }
107: 
108:     function syncBulkDeleteAllButton() {
109:         if (! bulkDeleteAllBtn) return;
110: 
111:         const counter = document.querySelector('#searchResults .total-count');
112:         const newTotal = counter?.dataset.count || '0';
113: 
114:         bulkDeleteAllBtn.dataset.total = newTotal;
115:         bulkDeleteAllBtn.disabled = newTotal === '0';
116:         bulkDeleteAllBtn.innerHTML =
117:             '<i class="bi bi-trash-fill"></i> '
118:             + DELETE_ALL_LABEL + ' (' + newTotal + ')';
119:     }
120: 
121:     document.addEventListener('change', function (e) {
122:         if (e.target.matches('.bus-checkbox')) {
123:             const id = parseInt(e.target.value, 10);
124:             if (e.target.checked) {
125:                 selectedIds.add(id);
126:             } else {
127:                 selectedIds.delete(id);
128:             }
129:             updateBulkButtons();
130:         }
131: 
132:         if (e.target.matches('#selectAll')) {
133:             const checkboxes = document.querySelectorAll('.bus-checkbox');
134:             checkboxes.forEach(cb => {
135:                 cb.checked = e.target.checked;
136:                 const id = parseInt(cb.value, 10);
137:                 if (e.target.checked) {
138:                     selectedIds.add(id);
139:                 } else {
140:                     selectedIds.delete(id);
141:                 }
142:             });
143:             updateBulkButtons();
144:         }
145:     });
146: 
147:     function submitBulk(action, method, confirmMessage) {
148:         if (selectedIds.size === 0) return;
149:         if (!confirm(confirmMessage.replace(':count', selectedIds.size))) return;
150: 
151:         bulkForm.action = action;
152:         bulkForm.method = 'POST';
153: 
154:         bulkForm.querySelectorAll('input[name="_method"]').forEach(el => el.remove());
155: 
156:         if (method !== 'POST') {
157:             const methodInput = document.createElement('input');
158:             methodInput.type = 'hidden';
159:             methodInput.name = '_method';
160:             methodInput.value = method;
161:             bulkForm.appendChild(methodInput);
162:         }
163: 
164:         selectedIdsInput.value = JSON.stringify([...selectedIds]);
165:         bulkForm.submit();
166:     }
167: 
168:     bulkDeactivateBtn?.addEventListener('click', () => {
169:         submitBulk(
170:             "{{ route('buses.bulk.deactivate') }}",
171:             'POST',
172:             translations.bulk_deactivate_confirm
173:         );
174:     });
175: 
176:     bulkActivateBtn?.addEventListener('click', () => {
177:         submitBulk(
178:             "{{ route('buses.bulk.activate') }}",
179:             'POST',
180:             translations.bulk_activate_confirm
181:         );
182:     });
183: 
184:     bulkDeleteBtn?.addEventListener('click', () => {
185:         submitBulk(
186:             "{{ route('buses.bulk.delete') }}",
187:             'DELETE',
188:             translations.bulk_delete_confirm
189:         );
190:     });
191: 
192:     // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
193:     // DELETE ALL MATCHING FILTER
194:     // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
195: 
196:     if (bulkDeleteAllBtn && bulkDeleteAllForm && bulkDeleteAllFilters) {
197:         bulkDeleteAllBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
198:             const total = parseInt(bulkDeleteAllBtn.dataset.total, 10) || 0;
199: 
200:             if (total === 0) return;
201: 
202:             const message = @json(__('messages.common.bulk_delete_all_confirm'))
203:                 .replace(':count', total);
204: 
205:             if (! confirm(message)) return;
206: 
207:             bulkDeleteAllFilters.innerHTML = '';
208:             Object.entries(collectFilters()).forEach(([key, value]) => {
209:                 const input = document.createElement('input');
210:                 input.type = 'hidden';
211:                 input.name = key;
212:                 input.value = value;
213:                 bulkDeleteAllFilters.appendChild(input);
214:             });
215: 
216:             bulkDeleteAllForm.action = "{{ route('buses.bulk.delete-all') }}";
217:             bulkDeleteAllForm.submit();
218:         });
219:     }
220: 
221:     let searchTimeout = null;
222: 
223:     function collectFilters() {
224:         const filters = {};
225:         document.querySelectorAll('#busTableFilter input[name], #busTableFilter select[name]').forEach(el => {
226:             const value = (el.value || '').trim();
227:             if (value !== '') {
228:                 filters[el.name] = value;
229:             }
230:         });
231:         return filters;
232:     }
233: 
234:     function performSearch() {
235:         const filters = collectFilters();
236:         const hasFilters = Object.keys(filters).length > 0;
237: 
238:         const params = new URLSearchParams(filters);
239:         const queryString = params.toString();
240: 
241:         const fetchUrl = "{{ route('buses.search') }}" + (queryString ? '?' + queryString : '');
242: 
243:         const browserUrl = (hasFilters
244:             ? "{{ route('buses.search') }}"
245:             : "{{ route('buses.index') }}"
246:         ) + (queryString ? '?' + queryString : '');
247: 
248:         fetch(fetchUrl, {
249:             headers: {
250:                 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest',
251:                 'Accept': 'text/html',
252:             },
253:             credentials: 'same-origin',
254:         })
255:         .then(response => {
256:             if (!response.ok) {
257:                 throw new Error('Search failed: HTTP ' + response.status);
258:             }
259:             return response.text();
260:         })
261:         .then(html => {
262:             document.getElementById('searchResults').innerHTML = html;
263: 
264:             history.replaceState(null, '', browserUrl);
265: 
266:             selectedIds.clear();
267:             updateBulkButtons();
268:             syncBulkDeleteAllButton();
269:         })
270:         .catch(error => {
271:             console.error('Bus search error:', error);
272:         });
273:     }
274: 
275:     function scheduleSearch() {
276:         clearTimeout(searchTimeout);
277:         searchTimeout = setTimeout(performSearch, 300);
278:     }
279: 
280:     document.addEventListener('input', function (e) {
281:         if (e.target.matches('#busTableFilter input[name]')) {
282:             scheduleSearch();
283:         }
284:     });
285: 
286:     document.addEventListener('change', function (e) {
287:         if (e.target.matches('#busTableFilter select[name]')) {
288:             clearTimeout(searchTimeout);
289:             performSearch();
290:         }
291:     });
292: 
293:     document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
294:         if (e.key === 'Enter' && e.target.matches('#busTableFilter input[name]')) {
295:             e.preventDefault();
296:             clearTimeout(searchTimeout);
297:             performSearch();
298:         }
299:     });
300: 
301:     updateBulkButtons();
302:     syncBulkDeleteAllButton();
303: })();
304: </script>
305: @endsection
</file>

168: </div>
169: @endsection
170: 
171: @section('scripts')
172: <script>
173: (function () {
174:     'use strict';
175: 
176:     const form            = document.getElementById('complaintFilterForm');
177:     const results         = document.getElementById('searchResults');
178:     const totalCount      = document.getElementById('totalCount');
179:     const searchStatus    = document.getElementById('searchStatus');
180:     const activeFilterBadge = document.getElementById('activeFilterBadge');
181:     const activeFilterCount = document.getElementById('activeFilterCount');
182:     const clearSearch     = document.getElementById('clearSearch');
183:     const bulkDeleteBtn   = document.getElementById('bulkDeleteBtn');
184:     const bulkDeleteForm  = document.getElementById('bulkDeleteForm');
185:     const bulkSelectedIds = document.getElementById('bulkSelectedIds');
186: 
187:     if (!form || !results) return;
188: 
189:     // ─── Selected IDs — kept in a Set so it survives pagination ───
190:     const selectedIds = new Set();
191: 
192:     let searchTimeout = null;
193:     let currentRequest = 0;
194: 
195:     const FILTER_KEYS = ['search', 'status', 'complaint_type', 'yer', 'date_from', 'date_to'];
196: 
197:     // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
198:     // SEARCH
199:     // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
200: 
201:     function collectFilters() {
202:         const params = new URLSearchParams();
203: 
204:         FILTER_KEYS.forEach(key => {
205:             const el = form.querySelector(`[name="${key}"]`);
206:             if (!el) return;
207: 
208:             const value = (el.value || '').trim();
209:             if (value !== '') {
210:                 params.set(key, value);
211:             }
212:         });
213: 
214:         return params;
215:     }
216: 
217:     function updateFilterBadge(params) {
218:         const count = params.toString() ? Array.from(params.keys()).length : 0;
219: 
220:         if (count > 0) {
221:             activeFilterCount.textContent = count;
222:             activeFilterBadge.style.display = 'inline-block';
223:         } else {
224:             activeFilterBadge.style.display = 'none';
225:         }
226:     }
227: 
228:     function performSearch() {
229:         const params = collectFilters();
230:         const queryString = params.toString();
231:         const requestId = ++currentRequest;
232: 
233:         searchStatus.style.display = 'inline-block';
234: 
235:         const fetchUrl = "{{ route('complaints.search') }}"
236:             + (queryString ? '?' + queryString : '');
237: 
238:         const browserUrl = "{{ route('complaints.index') }}"
239:             + (queryString ? '?' + queryString : '');
240: 
241:         fetch(fetchUrl, {
242:             headers: {
243:                 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest',
244:                 'Accept': 'text/html',
245:             },
246:             credentials: 'same-origin',
247:         })
248:         .then(response => {
249:             if (!response.ok) {
250:                 throw new Error('Search failed: HTTP ' + response.status);
251:             }
252:             return response.text();
253:         })
254:         .then(html => {
255:             if (requestId !== currentRequest) return;
256: 
257:             results.innerHTML = html;
258: 
259:             const counter = results.querySelector('.total-count');
260:             if (counter && totalCount) {
261:                 const newTotal = counter.dataset.count || '0';
262:                 totalCount.textContent = newTotal;
263: 
264:                 // Keep the "delete all" button in sync with the
265:                 // freshly-filtered total.
266:                 if (bulkDeleteAllBtn) {
267:                     bulkDeleteAllBtn.dataset.total = newTotal;
268:                     bulkDeleteAllBtn.disabled = newTotal === '0';
269:                     bulkDeleteAllBtn.innerHTML =
270:                         '<i class="bi bi-trash-fill"></i> '
271:                         + DELETE_ALL_LABEL + ' (' + newTotal + ')';
272:                 }
273:             }
274: 
275:             history.replaceState(null, '', browserUrl);
276: 
277:             updateFilterBadge(params);
278: 
279:             // Re-sync checkbox state after the table is re-rendered.
280:             syncCheckboxState();
281:         })
282:         .catch(error => {
283:             console.error('Complaint search error:', error);
284:         })
285:         .finally(() => {
286:             if (requestId === currentRequest) {
287:                 searchStatus.style.display = 'none';
288:             }
289:         });
290:     }
291: 
292:     function scheduleSearch(delay) {
293:         clearTimeout(searchTimeout);
294:         searchTimeout = setTimeout(performSearch, delay);
295:     }
296: 
297:     // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
298:     // BULK SELECTION
299:     // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
300: 
301:     function updateBulkButton() {
302:         if (!bulkDeleteBtn) return;
303: 
304:         const count = selectedIds.size;
305: 
306:         bulkDeleteBtn.disabled = count === 0;
307:         bulkDeleteBtn.innerHTML =
308:             '<i class="bi bi-trash"></i> '
309:             + @json(__('messages.complaints.bulk_delete'))
310:             + ' (' + count + ')';
311:     }
312: 
313:     /**
314:      * Restore the checked state on the freshly-rendered table.
315:      * Called after every AJAX search so that selections survive
316:      * pagination and filter changes.
317:      */
318:     function syncCheckboxState() {
319:         const checkboxes = results.querySelectorAll('.complaint-checkbox');
320: 
321:         checkboxes.forEach(cb => {
322:             const id = parseInt(cb.value, 10);
323:             cb.checked = selectedIds.has(id);
324:         });
325: 
326:         // Update the "select all" header checkbox.
327:         const selectAll = document.getElementById('selectAllComplaints');
328:         if (selectAll) {
329:             selectAll.checked = checkboxes.length > 0
330:                 && Array.from(checkboxes).every(cb => cb.checked);
331:         }
332: 
333:         updateBulkButton();
334:     }
335: 
336:     // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
337:     // BULK DELETE ALL MATCHING FILTER
338:     // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
339: 
340:     const bulkDeleteAllBtn     = document.getElementById('bulkDeleteAllBtn');
341:     const bulkDeleteAllForm    = document.getElementById('bulkDeleteAllForm');
342:     const bulkDeleteAllFilters = document.getElementById('bulkDeleteAllFilters');
343:     const DELETE_ALL_LABEL     = @json(__('messages.complaints.bulk_delete_all'));
344: 
345:     if (bulkDeleteAllBtn && bulkDeleteAllForm && bulkDeleteAllFilters) {
346:         bulkDeleteAllBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
347:             const total = parseInt(bulkDeleteAllBtn.dataset.total, 10) || 0;
348: 
349:             if (total === 0) return;
350: 
351:             const message = @json(__('messages.complaints.bulk_delete_all_confirm'))
352:                 .replace(':count', total);
353: 
354:             if (! confirm(message)) return;
355: 
356:             // Inject the current filter params into the hidden form.
357:             bulkDeleteAllFilters.innerHTML = '';
358:             collectFilters().forEach((value, key) => {
359:                 const input = document.createElement('input');
360:                 input.type = 'hidden';
361:                 input.name = key;
362:                 input.value = value;
363:                 bulkDeleteAllFilters.appendChild(input);
364:             });
365: 
366:             bulkDeleteAllForm.action = "{{ route('complaints.bulk.delete-all') }}";
367:             bulkDeleteAllForm.submit();
368:         });
369:     }
370: 
371:     // Delegated events — survive table re-renders.
372:     results.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
373:         if (e.target.matches('.complaint-checkbox')) {
374:             const id = parseInt(e.target.value, 10);
375: 
376:             if (e.target.checked) {
377:                 selectedIds.add(id);
378:             } else {
379:                 selectedIds.delete(id);
380:             }
381: 
382:             syncCheckboxState();
383:             return;
384:         }
385: 
386:         if (e.target.matches('#selectAllComplaints')) {
387:             const checkboxes = results.querySelectorAll('.complaint-checkbox');
388: 
389:             checkboxes.forEach(cb => {
390:                 const id = parseInt(cb.value, 10);
391: 
392:                 if (e.target.checked) {
393:                     selectedIds.add(id);
394:                 } else {
395:                     selectedIds.delete(id);
396:                 }
397:             });
398: 
399:             syncCheckboxState();
400:         }
401:     });
402: 
403:     // ─── Bulk delete submit ───
404:     if (bulkDeleteBtn && bulkDeleteForm && bulkSelectedIds) {
405:         bulkDeleteBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
406:             if (selectedIds.size === 0) return;
407: 
408:             const message = @json(__('messages.complaints.bulk_delete_confirm'))
409:                 .replace(':count', selectedIds.size);
410: 
411:             if (! confirm(message)) return;
412: 
413:             bulkSelectedIds.value = JSON.stringify(Array.from(selectedIds));
414: 
415:             // IMPORTANT: the form already contains _method=DELETE,
416:             // so no need to inject it here.
417:             bulkDeleteForm.action = "{{ route('complaints.bulk.delete') }}";
418:             bulkDeleteForm.submit();
419:         });
420:     }
