423:     // FILTER BINDINGS
424:     // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
425: 
426:     const textInput = form.querySelector('input[name="search"]');
427:     if (textInput) {
428:         textInput.addEventListener('input', () => scheduleSearch(300));
429:     }
430: 
431:     form.querySelectorAll('select[name], input[type="date"]').forEach(el => {
432:         el.addEventListener('change', () => scheduleSearch(0));
433:     });
434: 
435:     if (clearSearch) {
436:         clearSearch.addEventListener('click', () => {
437:             if (textInput) textInput.value = '';
438:             clearTimeout(searchTimeout);
439:             performSearch();
440:         });
441:     }
442: 
443:     form.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
444:         e.preventDefault();

446:         performSearch();
447:     });

454:     syncCheckboxState();
455: })();

 19:     function getBusByDqn(dqnValue) {
 20:         const input       = document.getElementById('dqn');
 21:         const routeInput  = document.getElementById('route_number');
 22:         const busIdInput  = document.getElementById('bus_id');
 23:         const kmInput     = document.getElementById('km');
 24:         const help        = document.getElementById('dqnHelp');
 25: 
 26:         const dqn = (dqnValue || '').trim().toUpperCase();
 27: 
 28:         routeInput.value = '';
 29:         busIdInput.value = '';
 30:         kmInput.value    = '';
 31:         help.textContent = '';
 32:         help.className   = 'form-text';
 33:         input.classList.remove('is-valid', 'is-invalid');
 34: 
 35:         if (! dqn) return;
 36: 
 37:         const requestId = ++busLookupRequest;
 38: 
 39:         fetch('/get-bus-by-dqn/' + encodeURIComponent(dqn), {
 40:             headers: {
 41:                 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest',
 42:                 'Accept': 'application/json',
 43:             },
 44:             credentials: 'same-origin',
 45:         })
 46:         .then(response => response.json())
 47:         .then(data => {
 48:             if (requestId !== busLookupRequest) return;
 49: 
 50:             if (data.found) {
 51:                 routeInput.value = data.route_number || '';
 52:                 busIdInput.value = data.bus_id || '';
 53:                 kmInput.value    = data.km || '';
 54:                 input.classList.add('is-valid');
 55:                 help.textContent = '';
 56:                 help.className   = 'form-text';
 57: 
 58:                 const typeInput = document.querySelector('input[name="complaint_type"]:checked');
 59:                 if (typeInput && typeInput.value === 'maintenance') {
 60:                     loadMotorOilIntervals();

 66:             }

160:     function getPartByCode(input) {
161:         const code      = input.value.trim();
162:         const item      = input.closest('.detail-item');
163:         const nameInput = item.querySelector('input[name*="[name]"]');
164:         const stockInput = item.querySelector('input[name*="[stock_quantity]"]');
165:         const helpEl    = item.querySelector('.part-help');

169:         input.classList.remove('is-valid', 'is-invalid');
170:

173:             helpEl.className   = 'form-text part-help';
174:         }
175: 
176:         if (! code) return;
177: 
178:         const yer = document.querySelector('input[name="yer"]:checked')?.value;
179:

181:         if (yer === 'road') {
182:             const vehicleId = document.getElementById('service_vehicle_id')?.value;
183:

185:                 input.classList.add('is-invalid');

198:                 headers: {
199:                     'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest',
200:                     'Accept': 'application/json',
201:                 },
202:                 credentials: 'same-origin',
203:             })
204:             .then(response => response.json())
205:             .then(data => {

256:     // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
257:     // COMPLAINT TYPE → LOCATION + DETAILS RESET
258:     //
259:     // When the user switches TO maintenance, we snapshot the current
260:     // contents of #detailsContainer. When they switch back to
261:     // accident/breakdown, we restore that snapshot — instead of
262:     // leaving the auto-loaded maintenance parts behind.
263:     //
264:     // Why snapshot instead of just clearing: on an edit page the
265:     // user may have existing breakdown details. If they click
266:     // maintenance by mistake and then switch back, we must not
267:     // lose their work.
268:     //
269:     // `resetLocation` — false on page load (so old('yer') survives),
270:     // true when the user changes a radio (so the location resets).
271:     // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
272:     let nonMaintenanceSnapshot = null;
273:     let isInitialRender = true;
274: 
275:     function handleComplaintTypeChange(resetLocation) {
276:         if (typeof resetLocation === 'undefined') {
277:             resetLocation = true;
278:         }
279: 
280:         const typeInput   = document.querySelector('input[name="complaint_type"]:checked');
281:         const roadRadio   = document.getElementById('yer_road');
282:         const garageRadio = document.getElementById('yer_garage');
283: 
284:         if (! roadRadio || ! garageRadio) return;
285: 
286:         // ─── Snapshot / restore of the details container ───
287:         // Skipped on the initial render, because on an edit page the
288:         // container already holds DB-loaded details and snapshotting
289:         // them would corrupt the restore behaviour.
290:         if (! isInitialRender && typeInput) {
291:             const container = document.getElementById('detailsContainer');
292: 
293:             if (container) {
294:                 if (typeInput.value === 'maintenance' && nonMaintenanceSnapshot === null) {
295:                     // Entering maintenance — remember the current state.
296:                     nonMaintenanceSnapshot = {
297:                         html: container.innerHTML,
298:                         detailCount: detailCount,
299:                     };
300:                 } else if (typeInput.value !== 'maintenance' && nonMaintenanceSnapshot !== null) {
301:                     // Leaving maintenance — restore the pre-maintenance state.
302:                     container.innerHTML = nonMaintenanceSnapshot.html;
303:                     detailCount = nonMaintenanceSnapshot.detailCount;
304:                     nonMaintenanceSnapshot = null;
305: 
306:                     // Re-run part lookups so the "stock" column reflects
307:                     // the correct source (warehouse vs service vehicle).
308:                     document.querySelectorAll('#detailsContainer input[name*="[code]"]')
309:                         .forEach(input => {
310:                             if (input.value.trim()) {
311:                                 getPartByCode(input);
312:                             }
313:                         });
314:                 }
315:             }
316:         }
317: 
318:         roadRadio.disabled   = false;
319:         garageRadio.disabled = false;
320: 
321:         if (resetLocation) {
322:             roadRadio.checked   = false;
323:             garageRadio.checked = false;
324:         }
325: 
326:         toggleFields();
327: 
328:         if (! typeInput) return;
329: 
330:         if (typeInput.value === 'maintenance') {
331:             roadRadio.disabled   = true;
332:             garageRadio.checked  = true;
333:             toggleFields();
334: 
335:             document.getElementById('complaintsDropdown').style.display = 'none';
336:             document.getElementById('serviceTypeBlock').style.display    = 'block';
337:             document.getElementById('complaintsLabel').innerHTML =
338:                 '📝 ' + @json(__('messages.complaints.service_type_label'));
339: 
340:             document.querySelectorAll('#complaintsDropdown select[name="complaints[]"]')
341:                 .forEach(el => { el.disabled = true; el.required = false; });
342: 
343:             document.querySelectorAll('#serviceTypeBlock select, #serviceTypeBlock input')
344:                 .forEach(el => { el.disabled = false; });
345: 
346:             if (document.getElementById('bus_id').value) {
347:                 loadMotorOilIntervals();
348:             }
349:         } else {
350:             document.getElementById('complaintsDropdown').style.display = 'block';
351:             document.getElementById('serviceTypeBlock').style.display    = 'none';
352:             document.getElementById('complaintsLabel').innerHTML =
353:                 '📝 ' + @json(__('messages.complaints.complaints_list'));
354: 
355:             document.querySelectorAll('#complaintsDropdown select[name="complaints[]"]')
356:                 .forEach(el => { el.disabled = false; el.required = true; });
357: 
358:             document.querySelectorAll('#serviceTypeBlock select, #serviceTypeBlock input')
359:                 .forEach(el => { el.disabled = true; });
360: 
361:             document.getElementById('service_km_select').innerHTML =
362:                 '<option value="">' + @json(__('messages.complaints.select_service')) + '</option>';
363: 
364:             document.getElementById('serviceComplaintLabel').value = '';
365:         }
366:     }

436:             },
437:             credentials: 'same-origin',
438:         })
439:         .then(response => response.json())
440:         .then(data => {
441:             renderServiceParts(data.parts || []);
442:         })
443:         .catch(err => {
444:             console.error('Parts load error:', err);
445:         });
446:     }

530:     // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
531:     function addComplaint() {
532:         const container = document.getElementById('complaintsContainer');
533:         if (! container) return;
534: 
535:         const source = container.querySelector('.complaint-item');
536:         if (! source) return;
537: 
538:         const item   = source.cloneNode(true);
539:         const select = item.querySelector('select');
540: 
541:         if (select) select.value = '';
542: 
543:         container.append(item);
544: 
545:         container.querySelectorAll('.complaint-number').forEach((el, idx) => {
546:             el.textContent = (idx + 1) + '.';
547:         });
548:     }
549: 
550:     function removeComplaint(button) {
551:         const container = document.getElementById('complaintsContainer');
552:         if (! container) return;
553: 
554:         if (container.querySelectorAll('.complaint-item').length > 1) {
555:             button.closest('.complaint-item').remove();
556: 
557:             container.querySelectorAll('.complaint-number').forEach((el, idx) => {
558:                 el.textContent = (idx + 1) + '.';
559:             });
560:         }
561:     }

563:     // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
564:     // DETAILS (add / remove)
565:     // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
566:     // Starting index coming from the server (max key in old input + 1)
567:     let detailCount = parseInt(
568:         document.getElementById('detailCountValue')?.value || '1',
569:         10
570:     ) || 1;
571: 
572:     function addDetail() {
573:         const container = document.getElementById('detailsContainer');
574:         if (! container) return;
575: 
576:         const source = container.querySelector('.detail-item');
577:         if (! source) return;
578: 
579:         const typeInput = document.querySelector('input[name="complaint_type"]:checked');
580:         if (typeInput && typeInput.value === 'maintenance') {
581:             return;
582:         }
583: 
584:         const item = source.cloneNode(true);
585: 
586:         item.querySelectorAll('input:not([type="hidden"])').forEach(i => { i.value = ''; });
587:         item.querySelectorAll('textarea').forEach(t => { t.value = ''; });
588:         item.querySelectorAll('input[type="hidden"]').forEach(i => { i.value = ''; });
589: 
590:         const qtyInput = item.querySelector('input[name*="[used_quantity]"]');
591:         if (qtyInput) qtyInput.value = '1';
592: 
593:         item.querySelectorAll('input, select, textarea').forEach(el => {
594:             if (el.name) {
595:                 el.name = el.name.replace(/\[\d+\]/, '[' + detailCount + ']');
596:             }
597:         });
598: 
599:         container.append(item);
600:         detailCount++;
601:     }
602: 
603:     function removeDetail(button) {
604:         const items = document.querySelectorAll('.detail-item');
605: 
606:         if (items.length > 1) {
607:             button.closest('.detail-item').remove();
608:         } else {
609:             const item = button.closest('.detail-item');
610: 
611:             item.querySelectorAll('input').forEach(i => {
612:                 if (i.name && i.name.includes('used_quantity')) {
613:                     i.value = '0';
614:                 }
615:             });
616:         }
617:     }
618: 
619:     // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
620:     // LOCATION → toggle driver / report / service vehicle
621:     // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
622:     function toggleFields() {
623:         const yer           = document.querySelector('input[name="yer"]:checked');
624:         const driverField   = document.getElementById('surucuField');
625:         const reportFields  = document.getElementById('bildirilmeFields');
626:         const vehicleField  = document.getElementById('serviceVehicleField');
627:         const vehicleSelect = document.getElementById('service_vehicle_id');
628: 
629:         if (! yer) {
630:             if (driverField)  driverField.style.display  = 'none';
631:             if (reportFields) reportFields.style.display = 'none';
632:             if (vehicleField) vehicleField.style.display = 'none';
633: 
634:             if (vehicleSelect) {
635:                 vehicleSelect.disabled = true;
636:                 vehicleSelect.required = false;
637:             }
638: 
639:             return;
640:         }
641: 
642:         if (yer.value === 'garage') {
643:             if (driverField)  driverField.style.display  = 'none';
644:             if (reportFields) reportFields.style.display = 'none';
645:             if (vehicleField) vehicleField.style.display = 'none';
646: 
647:             if (vehicleSelect) {
648:                 vehicleSelect.disabled = true;
649:                 vehicleSelect.required = false;
650:                 vehicleSelect.value    = '';
651:             }
652:         } else {
653:             if (driverField)  driverField.style.display  = 'block';
654:             if (reportFields) reportFields.style.display = 'block';
655:             if (vehicleField) vehicleField.style.display = 'block';
656: 
657:             if (vehicleSelect) {
658:                 vehicleSelect.disabled = false;
659:                 vehicleSelect.required = true;
660:             }
661:         }
662: 
663:         // ─── Re-lookup filled part codes when the source changes ───
664:         document.querySelectorAll('#detailsContainer input[name*="[code]"]').forEach(input => {
665:             if (input.value.trim()) {
666:                 getPartByCode(input);
667:             }
668:         });
669: 
670:         // ─── Update the stock label so the operator knows the source ───
671:         const label = yer.value === 'road'
672:             ? @json(__('messages.complaints.service_vehicle'))
673:             : @json(__('messages.warehouse.quantity'));
674: 
675:         document.querySelectorAll('.stock-source-label').forEach(el => {
676:             el.textContent = label;
677:         });
678:     }
679:

681:     // INIT

695:             if (input.value.trim()) {
696:                 getPartByCode(input);
697:             }
698:         });

161: @section('scripts')
162: <script>
163:     (function () {
164:         const btn = document.getElementById('bulkDeleteAllBtn');
165:         const form = document.getElementById('bulkDeleteAllForm');
166:         const filtersContainer = document.getElementById('bulkDeleteAllFilters');
167: 
168:         if (! btn || ! form || ! filtersContainer) return;
169: 
170:         btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
171:             const total = parseInt(btn.dataset.total, 10) || 0;
172:             const dateExplicit = btn.dataset.dateExplicit === '1';
173: 
174:             if (total === 0) return;
175: 
176:             const message = @json(__('messages.common.bulk_delete_all_confirm'))
177:                 .replace(':count', total);
178: 
179:             if (! confirm(message)) return;
180: 
181:             filtersContainer.innerHTML = '';
182: 
183:             // Only pass the date if the user explicitly filtered by it.
184:             // Otherwise, the controller deletes across ALL dates.
185:             if (dateExplicit) {
186:                 const date = document.getElementById('date')?.value ?? '';
187:                 if (date !== '') {
188:                     const i = document.createElement('input');
189:                     i.type = 'hidden'; i.name = 'date'; i.value = date;
190:                     filtersContainer.appendChild(i);
191:                 }
192:             }
193: 
194:             const dqn = document.getElementById('dqn')?.value ?? '';
195: 
196:             if (dqn !== '') {
197:                 const i = document.createElement('input');
198:                 i.type = 'hidden'; i.name = 'dqn'; i.value = dqn;
199:                 filtersContainer.appendChild(i);
200:             }
201: 
202:             form.action = "{{ route('daily-km-records.bulk.delete-all') }}";
203:             form.submit();
204:         });
205:     })();
206: </script>
207: @endsection
</file>

68:                     {{-- Hidden input ensures a value is sent even when the
69:                          checkbox is unchecked. An unchecked HTML checkbox
70:                          submits nothing, so without this the server fell
71:                          back to the DB default (is_active = true) and
72:                          unchecking the box had no effect. This matches
73:                          the pattern already used by bus-brands,
74:                          service-vehicles and users forms. --}}
75:                     <input type="hidden" name="is_active" value="0">
76:                     <input class="form-check-input" type="checkbox" id="is_active" name="is_active" value="1"
77:                            {{ old('is_active', '1') == '1' ? 'checked' : '' }}>
78:                     <label class="form-check-label" for="is_active">✅ {{ __('messages.common.active') }}</label>
79:                 </div>
80:             </div>
81: 
82:             <div class="d-flex gap-2">
83:                 <button type="submit" class="btn btn-success">
84:                     <i class="bi bi-save"></i> {{ __('messages.common.save') }}
85:                 </button>
86:                 <a href="{{ route('employees.index') }}" class="btn btn-secondary">
87:                     <i class="bi bi-arrow-left"></i> {{ __('messages.common.back') }}
88:                 </a>
89:             </div>
90:         </form>
91:     </div>
92: </div>

1165: <section class="os-section os-section--soft" id="faq">
1166:     <div class="container-os">
1167:         <div class="os-heading reveal">
1168:             <span class="eyebrow eyebrow--light">FAQ</span>
1169:             <h2>Tez-tez soruşulan suallar</h2>
1170:         </div>
1171:         <div class="faq-list reveal">
1172:             <details class="faq-item" open>
1173:                 <summary>Mövcud Excel məlumatlarımızı köçürə bilərikmi?</summary>
1174:                 <p>Bəli. Avtobus, anbar, işçi, sürücü, günlük KM və kart məlumatları Excel-dən idxal olunur. Standart sütunlar göstərilir, kifayət qədər Excel faylını atmaqdır.</p>
1175:             </details>
1176:             <details class="faq-item">
1177:                 <summary>Bir neçə qarajımız var, necə işləyir?</summary>
1178:                 <p>Fleet OS çoxqarajlıdır. Hər qaraj tam izolə edilmiş data ilə işləyir. Üst səviyyədə direktor bütün qarajları bir baxışda görür, amma heç nəyi dəyişdirə bilmir.</p>
1179:             </details>
1180:             <details class="faq-item">
1181:                 <summary>İşçilər PIN ilə necə daxil olur?</summary>
1182:                 <p>Hər işçiyə işçi kodu + 4 rəqəmli PIN verilir. İlk girişdə PIN dəyişmə məcburidir. Bu, sahədə işləyən işçilər üçün email/parol xatırlamaqdan qat-qat asandır.</p>
1183:             </details>
1184:             <details class="faq-item">
1185:                 <summary>PDF aktlar rəsmi sənəd kimi istifadə oluna bilərmi?</summary>
1186:                 <p>Bəli. Hər bağlanan kart üçün şirkət başlığı, qaraj məlumatı, avtobus, detallar, işi görən işçi və 3 imza yeri olan rəsmi akt PDF kimi generasiya olunur.</p>
1187:             </details>
1188:             <details class="faq-item">
1189:                 <summary>Data harada saxlanılır?</summary>
1190:                 <p>İki variant var: bulud (bizim serverlərimizdə) və ya self-hosted (sizin serverlərinizdə). Self-hosted variant Enterprise paketdə mövcuddur.</p>
1191:             </details>
1192:             <details class="faq-item">
1193:                 <summary>Hesabatları Excel-ə çıxarmaq mümkündürmü?</summary>
1194:                 <p>Bəli. 30+ hesabatın hamısı bir kliklə Excel-ə ixrac olunur. Cari filtrlər (dövr, marka, axtarış) ixraca da tətbiq olunur.</p>
1195:             </details>
1196:         </div>

1281:         entries.forEach(entry => {
1282:             if (entry.isIntersecting) {
1283:                 entry.target.classList.add('is-visible');
1284:                 observer.unobserve(entry.target);
1285:             }
1286:         });
1287:     }, { threshold: 0.1, rootMargin: '0px 0px -50px 0px' });
1288:

 78:                      * Resolve "may the current user see this domain?".
 79:                      *
 80:                      * A user can view any domain if they are a SuperAdmin or a
 81:                      * garage Admin. Otherwise they must hold at least one of the
 82:                      * domain's roles (e.g. warehouse_manager, warehouse_worker).
 83:                      *
 84:                      * Centralizing the rule here means that adding a new role to a
 85:                      * domain only requires updating RoleEnum::*Roles() — every
 86:                      * sidebar entry picks it up automatically.
 87:                      *
 88:                      * @param array<int, string> $roles
 89:                      */
 90:                     $canViewDomain = static function (array $roles) use ($isSuperAdmin, $isAdmin, $currentUser): bool {
 91:                         if ($isSuperAdmin || $isAdmin) {
 92:                             return true;
 93:                         }
 94: 
 95:                         return $currentUser?->hasGarageRole($roles) ?? false;
 96:                     };
 97: 
 98:                     // ---- Operations ----
 99:                     // Buses, Motor Oil and Oil Changes are admin-only domains — they
100:                     // have no manager/worker split, so they are checked directly.
101:                     $canViewBuses      = $isSuperAdmin || $isAdmin;
102:                     $canViewMotorOil   = $isSuperAdmin || $isAdmin;
103:                     $canViewOilChanges = $isSuperAdmin || $isAdmin;
104: 
105:                     $canViewComplaints  = $canViewDomain(RoleEnum::complaintRoles());
106:                     $canViewWarehouse   = $canViewDomain(RoleEnum::warehouseRoles());
107: 
108:                     // ---- Daily records ----
109:                     $canViewDailyStatus = $canViewDomain(RoleEnum::dailyStatusRoles());
110:                     $canViewDailyKm     = $canViewDomain(RoleEnum::dailyKmRoles());
111: 
112:                     // ---- Admin-only sections ----
113:                     $canManage = $isAdmin;
114: 
115:                     // ---- Reports ----
116:                     // Transfer and Maintenance reports reuse the roles of the
117:                     // domain they summarize: warehouse and complaint respectively.
118:                     $canViewWarehouseReports    = $canViewDomain(RoleEnum::warehouseRoles());
119:                     $canViewComplaintReports    = $canViewDomain(RoleEnum::complaintRoles());
120:                     $canViewDailyKmReports      = $canViewDomain(RoleEnum::dailyKmRoles());
121:                     $canViewDailyStatusReports  = $canViewDomain(RoleEnum::dailyStatusRoles());
122:                     $canViewTransferReports     = $canViewDomain(RoleEnum::warehouseRoles());
123:                     // ---- Manager-level-only report domains ----
124:                     // Parts Usage and Warehouse Analytics intentionally
125:                     // exclude worker roles: the routes are restricted to
126:                     // ADMIN + MANAGER level, so exposing the sidebar
127:                     // link to workers would only lead to a 403.
128:                     $canViewPartsUsage = $isSuperAdmin
129:                         || $isAdmin
130:                         || $currentUser?->hasGarageRole(RoleEnum::WAREHOUSE_MANAGER->value)
131:                         || $currentUser?->hasGarageRole(RoleEnum::COMPLAINT_MANAGER->value);
132: 
133:                     $canViewWarehouseAnalytics = $isSuperAdmin
134:                         || $isAdmin
135:                         || $currentUser?->hasGarageRole(RoleEnum::WAREHOUSE_MANAGER->value);
136: 
137:                     // Maintenance reports reuse the complaint domain
138:                     // (they summarize technical work). Both managers and
139:                     // workers of the complaint domain can see them.
140:                     $canViewMaintenanceReports = $canViewDomain(RoleEnum::complaintRoles());
141:                 @endphp

495:         const themeToggle = document.querySelector('[data-role="theme-toggle"]');
496:         const syncThemeToggle = () => {
497:             const isDark = document.documentElement.dataset.fleetTheme === 'dark';
498:             if (themeToggle) {
499:                 themeToggle.setAttribute('aria-label', isDark ? @json(__('messages.common.theme_light')) : @json(__('messages.common.theme_dark')));
500:                 themeToggle.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-' + (isDark ? 'sun' : 'moon') + '"></i>';
501:             }
502:         };
503:         syncThemeToggle();
504:         if (themeToggle) {
505:             themeToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
506:                 const nextTheme = document.documentElement.dataset.fleetTheme === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark';
507:                 if (nextTheme === 'dark') {
508:                     document.documentElement.dataset.fleetTheme = 'dark';
509:                 } else {
510:                     delete document.documentElement.dataset.fleetTheme;
511:                 }
512:                 localStorage.setItem('fleet-theme', nextTheme);
513:                 syncThemeToggle();
514:             });
515:         }
516:     </script>
517:     @yield('scripts')
518:     @stack('scripts')
519: </body>
520: </html>
</file>

 37:                         <option value="">{{ __('messages.motor_oil.filter_all_brands') }}</option>

 75: @section('scripts')
 76: <script>
 77:     let motorOilSearchTimeout = null;
 78: 
 79:     function liveSearch() {
 80:         clearTimeout(motorOilSearchTimeout);
 81:         motorOilSearchTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
 82:             performMotorOilSearch();
 83:         }, 300);
 84:     }
 85: 
 86:     function clearSearch() {
 87:         const input = document.getElementById('motorOilSearchInput');
 88:         if (input) {
 89:             input.value = '';
 90:         }
 91:         clearTimeout(motorOilSearchTimeout);
 92:         performMotorOilSearch();
 93:     }
 94: 
 95:     function collectMotorOilFilters() {
 96:         const filters = {};
 97:         const brand = document.getElementById('brandFilter')?.value || '';
 98:         const search = String(document.getElementById('motorOilSearchInput')?.value || '')
 99:             .replace(/[.,\s]/g, '');
100: 
101:         if (brand) filters.brand_id = brand;
102:         if (search) filters.search = search;
103: 
104:         return filters;
105:     }
106: 
107:     function performMotorOilSearch() {
108:         const filters = collectMotorOilFilters();
109:         const params = new URLSearchParams(filters);
110: 
111:         const url = '{{ route('motor-oil.search') }}'
112:             + (params.toString() ? '?' + params.toString() : '');
113: 
114:         fetch(url, {
115:             headers: {
116:                 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest',
117:                 'Accept': 'text/html',
118:             },
119:             credentials: 'same-origin',
120:         })
121:         .then(response => {
122:             if (!response.ok) {
123:                 throw new Error('Search failed: HTTP ' + response.status);
124:             }
125:             return response.text();
126:         })
127:         .then(html => {
128:             const container = document.getElementById('motorOilResults');
129:             if (!container) return;
130: 
131:             container.innerHTML = html;
132: 
133:             const counter = container.querySelector('.total-count');
134:             const totalEl = document.getElementById('totalCount');
135:             const newTotal = counter ? (counter.dataset.count || '0') : '0';
136: 
137:             if (totalEl) {
138:                 totalEl.textContent = newTotal;
139:             }
140: 
141:             syncBulkDeleteAllButton(newTotal);
142: 
143:             const browserUrl = '{{ route('motor-oil.index') }}'
144:                 + (params.toString() ? '?' + params.toString() : '');
145:             history.replaceState(null, '', browserUrl);
146:         })
147:         .catch(error => {
148:             console.error('Motor oil search error:', error);
149:         });
150:     }
151: 
152:     function syncBulkDeleteAllButton(total) {
153:         const btn = document.getElementById('bulkDeleteAllBtn');
154:         if (! btn) return;
155: 
156:         btn.dataset.total = total;
157:         btn.disabled = total === '0';
158:         btn.innerHTML =
159:             '<i class="bi bi-trash-fill"></i> '
160:             + @json(__('messages.common.bulk_delete_all'))
161:             + ' (' + total + ')';
162:     }
163: 
164:     // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
165:     // DELETE ALL MATCHING FILTER
166:     // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
167: 
168:     (function () {
169:         const btn       = document.getElementById('bulkDeleteAllBtn');
170:         const form      = document.getElementById('bulkDeleteAllForm');
171:         const container = document.getElementById('bulkDeleteAllFilters');
172: 
173:         if (! btn || ! form || ! container) return;
174: 
175:         btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
176:             const total = parseInt(btn.dataset.total, 10) || 0;
177: 
178:             if (total === 0) return;
179: 
180:             const message = @json(__('messages.common.bulk_delete_all_confirm'))
181:                 .replace(':count', total);
182: 
183:             if (! confirm(message)) return;
184: 
185:             container.innerHTML = '';
186:             Object.entries(collectMotorOilFilters()).forEach(([key, value]) => {
187:                 const input = document.createElement('input');
188:                 input.type = 'hidden';
189:                 input.name = key;
190:                 input.value = value;
191:                 container.appendChild(input);
192:             });
193: 
194:             form.action = "{{ route('motor-oil.bulk.delete-all') }}";
195:             form.submit();
196:         });
197:     })();
198: 
199:     // Brand filter triggers a fresh search.
200:     document.getElementById('brandFilter')?.addEventListener('change', () => {
201:         clearTimeout(motorOilSearchTimeout);
202:         performMotorOilSearch();
203:     });
204: 
205:     document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
206:         const counter = document.querySelector('#motorOilResults .total-count');
207:         const totalEl = document.getElementById('totalCount');
208:         if (counter && totalEl) {
209:             totalEl.textContent = counter.dataset.count || '0';
210:         }
211:     });
212: </script>
213: @endsection

117:                         <i class="fas fa-arrow-rotate-right fa-spin"></i>

127: {{-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── --}}
128: {{-- RESULTS (chips + tabs + table) — replaced by AJAX              --}}
129: {{-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── --}}
130: <div id="oilChangeResults">
131:     @include('oil-changes.partials.results', [
132:         'rows'         => $rows,
133:         'statusFilter' => $statusFilter,
134:         'activeType'   => $activeType,
135:         'typeCounts'   => $typeCounts,
136:         'urgentCount'  => $urgentCount,
137:         'filters'      => $filters,
138:     ])
139: </div>
140: @endsection
141: 
142: @section('scripts')
143: <script>
144: (function () {
145:     'use strict';
146: 
147:     const form             = document.getElementById('oilChangeSearchForm');
148:     const results          = document.getElementById('oilChangeResults');
149:     const statusIndicator  = document.getElementById('oilSearchStatus');
150:     const typeInput        = document.getElementById('oilTypeInput');
151:     const statusInput      = document.getElementById('oilStatusInput');
152:     const clearBtn         = document.getElementById('oilClearFilters');
153: 
154:     if (! form || ! results) return;
155: 
156:     let timer          = null;
157:     let currentRequest = 0;
158: 
159:     // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
160:     // SEARCH
161:     // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
162: 
163:     function buildQuery() {
164:         const params = new URLSearchParams(new FormData(form));
165:         // Drop empty values so the URL stays clean.
166:         for (const [key, value] of Array.from(params.entries())) {
167:             if (value === '' || value === null) {
168:                 params.delete(key);
169:             }
170:         }
171:         return params.toString();
172:     }
173: 
174:     function performSearch() {
175:         const qs = buildQuery();
176:         const requestId = ++currentRequest;
177: 
178:         statusIndicator.style.display = 'inline-block';
179: 
180:         const fetchUrl = "{{ route('oil-changes.search') }}" + (qs ? '?' + qs : '');
181: 
182:         fetch(fetchUrl, {
183:             headers: {
184:                 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest',
185:                 'Accept': 'text/html',
186:             },
187:             credentials: 'same-origin',
188:         })
189:         .then(response => {
190:             if (! response.ok) {
191:                 throw new Error('Search failed: HTTP ' + response.status);
192:             }
193:             return response.text();
194:         })
195:         .then(html => {
196:             if (requestId !== currentRequest) return;
197: 
198:             results.innerHTML = html;
199: 
200:             // Sync the URL bar with the current filter state.
201:             const browserUrl = "{{ route('oil-changes.index') }}" + (qs ? '?' + qs : '');
202:             history.replaceState(null, '', browserUrl);
203: 
204:             // Re-bind tab and chip click handlers after the DOM swap.
205:             attachTabHandlers();
206:             attachChipHandlers();
207:         })
208:         .catch(error => console.error('Oil change search error:', error))
209:         .finally(() => {
210:             if (requestId === currentRequest) {
211:                 statusIndicator.style.display = 'none';
212:             }
213:         });
214:     }
215: 
216:     function scheduleSearch(delay) {
217:         clearTimeout(timer);
218:         timer = setTimeout(performSearch, delay);
219:     }
220: 
221:     // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
222:     // FILTER BINDINGS
223:     // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
224: 
225:     form.addEventListener('input', function (e) {
226:         if (e.target.matches('input[name]')) {
227:             scheduleSearch(300);
228:         }
229:     });
230: 
231:     form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
232:         e.preventDefault();
233:         clearTimeout(timer);
234:         performSearch();
235:     });
236: 
237:     clearBtn?.addEventListener('click', function () {
238:         form.querySelectorAll('input[type="text"], input[type="number"]').forEach(el => {
239:             el.value = '';
240:         });
241:         clearTimeout(timer);
242:         performSearch();
243:     });
244: 
245:     // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
246:     // TAB / CHIP HANDLERS
247:     //
248:     // Both keep their href for middle-click / JS-disabled fallback,
249:     // but the click is intercepted and routed through performSearch()
250:     // so the whole page does not reload.
251:     // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
252: 
253:     function attachTabHandlers() {
254:         results.querySelectorAll('.oil-tab-link').forEach(link => {
255:             link.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
256:                 // Allow middle-click / ctrl+click to open in new tab.
257:                 if (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.button !== 0) return;
258: 
259:                 e.preventDefault();
260:                 typeInput.value = link.dataset.type;
261:                 performSearch();
262:             });
263:         });
264:     }
265: 
266:     function attachChipHandlers() {
267:         results.querySelectorAll('.oil-status-chip').forEach(chip => {
268:             chip.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
269:                 if (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.button !== 0) return;
270: 
271:                 e.preventDefault();
272:                 statusInput.value = chip.dataset.status;
273:                 performSearch();
274:             });
275:         });
276:     }
277: 
278:     // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
279:     // INIT
280:     // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
281: 
282:     attachTabHandlers();
283:     attachChipHandlers();
284: })();
285: </script>
286: @endsection
</file>

138:     const ITEM_BY_CODE = {};
139:     WAREHOUSE_ITEMS.forEach(function (item) {
140:         ITEM_BY_CODE[String(item.code).toUpperCase()] = item;
141:     });
142: 
143:     let itemCounter = 0;
144: 
145:     function addItemRow() {
146:         const container = document.getElementById('itemsContainer');
147:         if (!container) return;
148: 
149:         const idx = itemCounter++;
150: 
151:         const row = document.createElement('tr');
152:         row.innerHTML =
153:             '<td>' +
154:                 '<input type="text" class="form-control form-control-sm item-code" ' +
155:                        'name="items[' + idx + '][code]" ' +
156:                        'placeholder="{{ __('messages.warehouse.code_placeholder') }}" ' +
157:                        'oninput="onCodeInput(this)" ' +
158:                        'autocomplete="off" ' +
159:                        'style="text-transform: uppercase;" ' +
160:                        'required>' +
161:                 '<input type="hidden" name="items[' + idx + '][warehouse_id]" class="item-warehouse-id">' +
162:             '</td>' +
163:             '<td>' +
164:                 '<input type="text" class="form-control form-control-sm item-name" readonly tabindex="-1" style="background:#e9ecef;">' +
165:             '</td>' +
166:             '<td>' +
167:                 '<span class="text-muted item-available">—</span>' +
168:             '</td>' +
169:             '<td>' +
170:                 '<input type="number" class="form-control form-control-sm item-qty" ' +
171:                        'name="items[' + idx + '][declared_quantity]" ' +
172:                        'min="1" required>' +
173:             '</td>' +
174:             '<td class="text-end">' +
175:                 '<button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-danger" onclick="removeItemRow(this)">' +
176:                     '<i class="bi bi-trash"></i>' +
177:                 '</button>' +
178:             '</td>';
179: 
180:         container.appendChild(row);
181:     }
182: 
183:     function removeItemRow(btn) {
184:         const container = document.getElementById('itemsContainer');
185:         if (container.querySelectorAll('tr').length <= 1) return;
186:         btn.closest('tr').remove();
187:     }
188: 
189:     function onCodeInput(input) {
190:         const row = input.closest('tr');
191:         const code = String(input.value || '').trim().toUpperCase();
192:         const item = ITEM_BY_CODE[code];
193: 
194:         const nameEl     = row.querySelector('.item-name');
195:         const availableEl = row.querySelector('.item-available');
196:         const qtyEl      = row.querySelector('.item-qty');
197:         const idEl       = row.querySelector('.item-warehouse-id');
198: 
199:         input.classList.remove('is-valid', 'is-invalid');
200: 
201:         if (!code) {
202:             nameEl.value = '';
203:             availableEl.textContent = '—';
204:             idEl.value = '';
205:             return;
206:         }
207: 
208:         if (!item) {
209:             nameEl.value = '';
210:             availableEl.textContent = '—';
211:             idEl.value = '';
212:             input.classList.add('is-invalid');
213:             return;
214:         }
215: 
216:         // Match found — autofill name, available, and warehouse id.
217:         nameEl.value = item.name;
218:         availableEl.innerHTML = '<strong>' + item.quantity + '</strong> ' + (item.unit || '');
219:         idEl.value = item.id;
220:         input.classList.add('is-valid');
221: 
222:         if (!qtyEl.value) {
223:             qtyEl.value = 1;
224:         }
225:     }
226: 
227:     function onTypeChange() {
228:         const type = document.querySelector('input[name="type"]:checked')?.value;
229: 
230:         const garageField   = document.getElementById('to_garage_field');
231:         const vehicleField  = document.getElementById('to_service_vehicle_field');
232:         const garageSelect  = document.getElementById('to_garage_id');
233:         const vehicleSelect = document.getElementById('to_service_vehicle_id');
234: 
235:         garageField.style.display   = 'none';
236:         vehicleField.style.display  = 'none';
237:         garageSelect.disabled  = true;
238:         vehicleSelect.disabled = true;
239:         garageSelect.value     = '';
240:         vehicleSelect.value    = '';
241: 
242:         if (type === 'garage_to_garage') {
243:             garageField.style.display = 'block';
244:             garageSelect.disabled = false;
245:         } else if (type === 'to_service_vehicle') {
246:             vehicleField.style.display = 'block';
247:             vehicleSelect.disabled = false;
248:         }
249:     }
250: 
251:     document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
252:         onTypeChange();
253:         addItemRow();
254:     });
255: </script>
256: @endpush
</file>

 45: <div class="card mb-4">
 46:     <div class="card-body">
 47:         <div class="row g-3">
 48:             <div class="col-md-8">
 49:                 <div class="input-group">
 50:                     <span class="input-group-text"><i class="bi bi-search"></i></span>
 51:                     <input type="text" class="form-control" id="searchInput"
 52:                         placeholder="{{ __('messages.warehouse.search_placeholder') }}"
 53:                         value="{{ $search ?? '' }}"
 54:                         oninput="liveSearch(this.value)">
 55:                     <input type="hidden" id="viewInput" value="{{ $view ?? 'active' }}">
 56:                     <button class="btn btn-secondary" type="button"
 57:                             onclick="document.getElementById('searchInput').value=''; liveSearch('');">
 58:                         <i class="bi bi-x-circle"></i> {{ __('messages.common.clear') }}
 59:                     </button>
 60:                 </div>
 61:                 <small class="text-muted mt-2 d-block">{{ __('messages.warehouse.search_hint') }}</small>
 62:             </div>

 66:                 </small>
 67:             </div>
 68:         </div>
 69:     </div>

 73:     @include('warehouses.partials.table', ['warehouses' => $warehouses])
 74: </div>

 76: 
 77: @section('scripts')
 78: <script>
 79:     function liveSearch(query) {
 80:         const params = new URLSearchParams();
 81:         const search = (query ?? '').trim();
 82:         const view = document.getElementById('viewInput')?.value ?? 'active';
 83: 
 84:         if (search) params.set('search', search);
 85:         params.set('view', view);
 86: 
 87:         fetch('{{ url('/warehouses/search') }}?' + params.toString(), {
 88:             headers: {
 89:                 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest',
 90:                 'Accept': 'text/html',
 91:             },
 92:             credentials: 'same-origin',
 93:         })
 94:         .then(r => r.text())
 95:         .then(html => {
 96:             document.getElementById('searchResults').innerHTML = html;
 97:             const count = document.querySelector('#searchResults .total-count');
 98:             if (count) document.getElementById('totalCount').textContent = count.dataset.count || '0';
 99:         })
100:         .catch(e => console.error('Warehouse search error:', e));
101:     }
102: </script>
103: @endsection
</file>

<file path="routes/console.php">
 1: <?php
 2: 
 3: use Illuminate\Foundation\Inspiring;
 4: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Artisan;
 5: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Schedule;
 6: 
 7: Artisan::command('inspire', function () {
 8:     $this->comment(Inspiring::quote());
 9: })->purpose('Display an inspiring quote');
10: 
11: // 1. Archive audit logs older than 6 months — runs every night at 03:00.
12: Schedule::command('audit:archive --months=6')
13:     ->dailyAt('03:00')
14:     ->runInBackground()
15:     ->withoutOverlapping();
16: 
17: // 2. Prune expired Sanctum API tokens every night at 02:00.
18: //
19: // Sanctum tokens have a 30-day TTL (config/sanctum.php). Without this
20: // schedule, expired rows accumulate in personal_access_tokens forever,
21: // bloating the table and slowing down token lookups.
22: //
23: // The `--hours=24` flag keeps a 24-hour grace window after expiry, so
24: // a client that fires a request in-flight around the expiration moment
25: // gets a clean 401 instead of a "token row already deleted" error.
26: Schedule::command('sanctum:prune-expired --hours=24')
27:     ->dailyAt('02:00')
28:     ->runInBackground()
29:     ->withoutOverlapping();
30: 
31: // 3. Daily KM reminder — placeholder for a future notification job.
32: // Schedule::command('buses:check-daily-km')->dailyAt('23:00');
33: 
34: // 4. Prune stale cache tags every Sunday at 04:00 so the cache does
35: //    not grow unbounded over time.
36: Schedule::command('cache:prune-stale-tags')->weeklyOn(0, '04:00');
</file>

 55:         GarageContext::clear();
 56:         parent::tearDown();

 60:     {
 61:         return Complaint::create([
 62:             'bus_id' => $this->bus->id,
 63:             'garage_id' => $this->garage->id,
 64:             'company_id' => $this->company->id,

 66:             'status' => $status,
 67:             'complaint_type' => 'breakdown',
 68:         ]);

 72:     {
 73:         return [
 74:             'end_date' => now()->toDateString(),

 76:             'work_done' => 'Complaint resolved by test.',
 77:         ];
 78:     }
 79:

 81:     // 1. HAPPY PATH

 87: 
 88:         $result = $this->action->execute($complaint, $this->closeData());
 89: 
 90:         $this->assertSame(ComplaintStatus::Completed, $result->status);
 91:         $this->assertNotNull($result->closed_at);
 92:         $this->assertSame('Complaint resolved by test.', $result->work_done_by);
 93:     }
 94:

 96:     {

 98:

100: 
101:         $this->assertSame(ComplaintStatus::Completed, $result->status);
102:     }
103:

106:         $complaint = $this->makeComplaint('pending');
107: 
108:         $result = $this->action->execute($complaint, $this->closeData());
109: 
110:         // A fresh model instance, not the same reference
111:         $this->assertNotSame($complaint, $result);
112:         $this->assertTrue($result->exists);

194:

<file path="tests/Feature/Api/TokenExpirationTest.php">
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: namespace Tests\Feature\Api;
  4: 
  5: use App\Models\User;
  6: use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
  7: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
  8: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
  9: use Laravel\Sanctum\PersonalAccessToken;
 10: use Tests\TestCase;
 11: 
 12: class TokenExpirationTest extends TestCase
 13: {
 14:     use RefreshDatabase;
 15: 
 16:     public function test_sanctum_expiration_is_configured(): void
 17:     {
 18:         $expiration = config('sanctum.expiration');
 19: 
 20:         $this->assertNotNull($expiration, 'Sanctum expiration must not be null');
 21:         $this->assertIsInt($expiration);
 22:         $this->assertGreaterThan(0, $expiration);
 23:     }
 24: 
 25:     public function test_sanctum_expiration_defaults_to_30_days(): void
 26:     {
 27:         // 60 min * 24 hours * 30 days = 43200
 28:         $this->assertEquals(43200, config('sanctum.expiration'));
 29:     }
 30: 
 31:     public function test_login_still_works_with_expiration_configured(): void
 32:     {
 33:         $user = User::factory()->create([
 34:             'email' => 'api@test.com',
 35:             'password' => Hash::make('secret123'),
 36:             'role' => 'user',
 37:         ]);
 38: 
 39:         $response = $this->postJson('/api/login', [
 40:             'email' => 'api@test.com',
 41:             'password' => 'secret123',
 42:             'device_name' => 'phpunit',
 43:         ]);
 44: 
 45:         $response->assertOk()
 46:             ->assertJsonStructure(['access_token', 'token_type', 'user']);
 47: 
 48:         $this->assertNotEmpty($response->json('access_token'));
 49:     }
 50: 
 51:     public function test_fresh_token_is_accepted(): void
 52:     {
 53:         $user = User::factory()->create(['role' => 'user']);
 54:         $token = $user->createToken('fresh-test');
 55:         $plainText = $token->plainTextToken;
 56: 
 57:         $response = $this->withToken($plainText)->getJson('/api/user');
 58: 
 59:         // Fresh token is NOT rejected as expired.
 60:         // It gets 400 because X-Garage-Id header is missing.
 61:         // Getting 401 would mean the token was rejected.
 62:         $this->assertNotEquals(
 63:             401,
 64:             $response->status(),
 65:             'Fresh token must not be rejected as expired'
 66:         );
 67:     }
 68: 
 69:     public function test_token_expires_after_configured_duration(): void
 70:     {
 71:         $user = User::factory()->create(['role' => 'user']);
 72:         $token = $user->createToken('expiry-test');
 73:         $plainText = $token->plainTextToken;
 74: 
 75:         // `created_at` is not in PersonalAccessToken::$fillable, so `update()`
 76:         // silently ignores it. Use DB directly to bypass mass assignment.
 77:         DB::table('personal_access_tokens')
 78:             ->where('id', $token->accessToken->id)
 79:             ->update(['created_at' => now()->subDays(31)]);
 80: 
 81:         // Sanity check that the timestamp was actually changed
 82:         $fresh = PersonalAccessToken::find($token->accessToken->id);
 83:         $this->assertTrue(
 84:             $fresh->created_at->isBefore(now()->subDays(30)),
 85:             'Test setup failed: created_at was not updated in database'
 86:         );
 87: 
 88:         $response = $this->withToken($plainText)->getJson('/api/user');
 89: 
 90:         $response->assertStatus(401, 'Expired token must be rejected with 401');
 91:     }
 92: 
 93:     public function test_token_within_expiration_window_is_accepted(): void
 94:     {
 95:         $user = User::factory()->create(['role' => 'user']);
 96:         $token = $user->createToken('within-window');
 97:         $plainText = $token->plainTextToken;
 98: 
 99:         // Simulate token created 29 days ago (within 30-day limit)
100:         DB::table('personal_access_tokens')
101:             ->where('id', $token->accessToken->id)
102:             ->update(['created_at' => now()->subDays(29)]);
103: 
104:         $response = $this->withToken($plainText)->getJson('/api/user');
105: 
106:         // Still valid → 400 (missing header), not 401
107:         $this->assertNotEquals(
108:             401,
109:             $response->status(),
110:             'Token within expiration window must not be rejected'
111:         );
112:     }
113: 
114:     public function test_manually_expired_token_is_rejected(): void
115:     {
116:         // Sanctum allows setting expires_at explicitly — validate that path too.
117:         $user = User::factory()->create(['role' => 'user']);
118:         $token = $user->createToken('explicit-expiry');
119:         $token->accessToken->update(['expires_at' => now()->subDay()]);
120:         $plainText = $token->plainTextToken;
121: 
122:         $response = $this->withToken($plainText)->getJson('/api/user');
123: 
124:         $response->assertStatus(401);
125:     }
126: }

<file path="tests/Feature/Audit/AssignmentAuditTransactionTest.php">
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: namespace Tests\Feature\Audit;
  4: 
  5: use App\Models\AuditLog;
  6: use App\Models\Company;
  7: use App\Models\User;
  8: use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
  9: use Tests\TestCase;
 10: use Tests\Traits\MakesSuperAdminWithMfa;
 11: 
 12: class AssignmentAuditTransactionTest extends TestCase
 13: {
 14:     use MakesSuperAdminWithMfa;
 15:     use RefreshDatabase;
 16: 
 17:     public function test_audit_failure_rolls_back_director_assignment(): void
 18:     {
 19:         // Disable Laravel's HTTP exception handler so the RuntimeException
 20:         // thrown by the AuditLog listener propagates to the test instead
 21:         // of being converted into a 500 response.
 22:         $this->withoutExceptionHandling();
 23: 
 24:         $superAdmin = $this->makeSuperAdminWithMfa();
 25:         $company = Company::factory()->create();
 26: 
 27:         $oldDirector = User::factory()->create(['role' => 'user', 'name' => 'Old Director']);
 28:         $company->users()->attach($oldDirector->id, [
 29:             'role' => 'director',
 30:             'is_active' => true,
 31:         ]);
 32: 
 33:         $newDirector = User::factory()->create(['role' => 'user', 'name' => 'New Director']);
 34: 
 35:         // Force AuditLog::create to throw during the transaction.
 36:         AuditLog::creating(function () {
 37:             throw new \RuntimeException('Simulated audit failure');
 38:         });
 39: 
 40:         $caught = null;
 41: 
 42:         try {
 43:             $this->actingAs($superAdmin)
 44:                 ->withSession(['current_company_id' => $company->id])
 45:                 ->post(route('super-admin.companies.assign-director', $company), [
 46:                     'user_id' => $newDirector->id,
 47:                 ]);
 48:         } catch (\RuntimeException $e) {
 49:             $caught = $e;
 50:         }
 51: 
 52:         $this->assertNotNull(
 53:             $caught,
 54:             'Expected RuntimeException from the audit listener was not thrown'
 55:         );
 56:         $this->assertSame('Simulated audit failure', $caught->getMessage());
 57: 
 58:         // The old director must still be active — rollback worked.
 59:         $oldPivot = $company->users()->whereKey($oldDirector->id)->first();
 60:         $this->assertNotNull($oldPivot);
 61:         $this->assertTrue(
 62:             (bool) $oldPivot->pivot->is_active,
 63:             'Old director must still be active after audit failure'
 64:         );
 65: 
 66:         // No new director row should have been created.
 67:         $this->assertNull(
 68:             $company->users()->whereKey($newDirector->id)->first(),
 69:             'New director must not be attached after audit failure'
 70:         );
 71:     }
 72: 
 73:     public function test_audit_failure_rolls_back_director_removal(): void
 74:     {
 75:         // Same reasoning as above.
 76:         $this->withoutExceptionHandling();
 77: 
 78:         $superAdmin = $this->makeSuperAdminWithMfa();
 79:         $company = Company::factory()->create();
 80: 
 81:         $director = User::factory()->create(['role' => 'user']);
 82:         $company->users()->attach($director->id, [
 83:             'role' => 'director',
 84:             'is_active' => true,
 85:         ]);
 86: 
 87:         AuditLog::creating(function () {
 88:             throw new \RuntimeException('Simulated audit failure');
 89:         });
 90: 
 91:         $caught = null;
 92: 
 93:         try {
 94:             $this->actingAs($superAdmin)
 95:                 ->withSession(['current_company_id' => $company->id])
 96:                 ->delete(route('super-admin.companies.remove-director', [$company, $director]));
 97:         } catch (\RuntimeException $e) {
 98:             $caught = $e;
 99:         }
100: 
101:         $this->assertNotNull(
102:             $caught,
103:             'Expected RuntimeException from the audit listener was not thrown'
104:         );
105:         $this->assertSame('Simulated audit failure', $caught->getMessage());
106: 
107:         // The director must still be attached — rollback worked.
108:         $this->assertNotNull(
109:             $company->users()->whereKey($director->id)->first(),
110:             'Director must still be attached after audit failure'
111:         );
112:     }
113: }

 22:         parent::setUp();
 23: 
 24:         $company = Company::factory()->create();
 25:         $this->garage = Garage::factory()->create(['company_id' => $company->id]);
 26: 
 27:         GarageContext::set($this->garage->id, $company->id);
 28:     }
 29: 
 30:     protected function tearDown(): void
 31:     {
 32:         GarageContext::clear();
 33:         parent::tearDown();
 34:     }
 35: 
 36:     public function test_created_event_writes_single_audit_log(): void
 37:     {
 38:         $bus = Bus::factory()->create([
 39:             'garage_id' => $this->garage->id,
 40:             'company_id' => $this->garage->company_id,
 41:         ]);
 42: 
 43:         $logs = AuditLog::where('auditable_type', Bus::class)
 44:             ->where('auditable_id', $bus->id)
 45:             ->where('event', 'created')
 46:             ->get();
 47: 
 48:         $this->assertCount(1, $logs, 'created event must write exactly 1 log');
 49:     }
 50: 
 51:     public function test_updated_event_writes_single_audit_log(): void
 52:     {
 53:         $bus = Bus::factory()->create([
 54:             'garage_id' => $this->garage->id,
 55:             'company_id' => $this->garage->company_id,
 56:         ]);
 57: 
 58:         AuditLog::query()->delete(); // remove created log
 59: 
 60:         $bus->update(['route_number' => 'TEST-999']);
 61: 
 62:         $logs = AuditLog::where('auditable_type', Bus::class)
 63:             ->where('auditable_id', $bus->id)
 64:             ->where('event', 'updated')
 65:             ->get();
 66: 
 67:         $this->assertCount(1, $logs, 'updated event must write exactly 1 log (not 2)');
 68: 
 69:         $newValues = $logs->first()->new_values;
 70: 
 71:         $this->assertArrayHasKey('route_number', $newValues);
 72:         $this->assertEquals('TEST-999', $newValues['route_number']);
 73: 
 74:         // Timestamps must be filtered out
 75:         $this->assertArrayNotHasKey('updated_at', $newValues);
 76:         $this->assertArrayNotHasKey('created_at', $newValues);
 77:     }
 78: 
 79:     public function test_no_audit_log_when_nothing_changes(): void
 80:     {
 81:         $bus = Bus::factory()->create([
 82:             'garage_id' => $this->garage->id,
 83:             'company_id' => $this->garage->company_id,
 84:         ]);
 85: 
 86:         AuditLog::query()->delete();
 87: 
 88:         // Set the same value — nothing changes
 89:         $bus->update(['route_number' => $bus->route_number]);
 90: 
 91:         $logs = AuditLog::where('auditable_type', Bus::class)
 92:             ->where('auditable_id', $bus->id)
 93:             ->get();

 14: {

 24:

 34:         parent::tearDown();
 35:     }
 36: 
 37:     private function createBus(array $attributes = []): Bus
 38:     {
 39:         return Bus::factory()->create(array_merge([
 40:             'garage_id' => $this->garage->id,

 42:             'is_active' => true,

 46:     // ==================================================================

 49: 
 50:     public function test_int_and_string_int_are_considered_equal(): void
 51:     {
 52:         $bus = $this->createBus(['is_active' => true]);
 53: 
 54:         AuditLog::query()->delete();
 55: 
 56:         // Simulate bulk update with the SAME value using a different type.
 57:         // Old value in DB may come as bool true or int 1 depending on driver;
 58:         // new value here is PHP int 1.
 59:         Bus::auditBulkUpdate([$bus->id], ['is_active' => 1], 'bulk_test');
 60: 
 61:         $this->assertEquals(
 62:             0,

<file path="tests/Feature/Auth/PinAccountLockoutTest.php">
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: namespace Tests\Feature\Auth;
  4: 
  5: use App\Models\User;
  6: use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
  7: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
  8: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\RateLimiter;
  9: use Tests\TestCase;
 10: 
 11: class PinAccountLockoutTest extends TestCase
 12: {
 13:     use RefreshDatabase;
 14: 
 15:     protected function setUp(): void
 16:     {
 17:         parent::setUp();
 18: 
 19:         // Reset all relevant rate limiters between tests.
 20:         RateLimiter::clear('emp-lock|127.0.0.1');
 21:         RateLimiter::clear('emp-lock|10.0.0.1');
 22:         RateLimiter::clear('emp-lock|10.0.0.2');
 23:         RateLimiter::clear('pin_account:emp-lock');
 24:     }
 25: 
 26:     protected function tearDown(): void
 27:     {
 28:         RateLimiter::clear('emp-lock|127.0.0.1');
 29:         RateLimiter::clear('emp-lock|10.0.0.1');
 30:         RateLimiter::clear('emp-lock|10.0.0.2');
 31:         RateLimiter::clear('pin_account:emp-lock');
 32: 
 33:         parent::tearDown();
 34:     }
 35: 
 36:     // ==================================================================
 37:     // 1. HAPPY PATH
 38:     // ==================================================================
 39: 
 40:     public function test_pin_login_succeeds_with_valid_credentials(): void
 41:     {
 42:         $this->makeUser('EMP-LOCK', '1234');
 43: 
 44:         $response = $this->post('/login/pin', [
 45:             'employee_code' => 'EMP-LOCK',
 46:             'pin' => '1234',
 47:         ]);
 48: 
 49:         $response->assertRedirect();
 50:         $this->assertAuthenticated();
 51:     }
 52: 
 53:     // ==================================================================
 54:     // 2. IP-ROTATION BYPASS IS BLOCKED
 55:     // ==================================================================
 56: 
 57:     public function test_ip_rotation_does_not_bypass_account_lockout(): void
 58:     {
 59:         $this->makeUser('EMP-LOCK', '1234');
 60: 
 61:         // 15 wrong attempts from 15 different IPs.
 62:         // The per-IP limiter is configured for 5 attempts, but since
 63:         // each request comes from a different IP, that limiter never
 64:         // fires — only the account-level limiter does.
 65:         for ($i = 1; $i <= 15; $i++) {
 66:             $this->withServerVariables(['REMOTE_ADDR' => "10.0.0.{$i}"])
 67:                 ->post('/login/pin', [
 68:                     'employee_code' => 'EMP-LOCK',
 69:                     'pin' => '0000',
 70:                 ]);
 71:         }
 72: 
 73:         // 16th attempt with the CORRECT PIN from yet another IP
 74:         // must still be blocked.
 75:         $response = $this->withServerVariables(['REMOTE_ADDR' => '10.0.0.99'])
 76:             ->post('/login/pin', [
 77:                 'employee_code' => 'EMP-LOCK',
 78:                 'pin' => '1234',
 79:             ]);
 80: 
 81:         $response->assertSessionHasErrors('employee_code');
 82:         $this->assertGuest();
 83:     }
 84: 
 85:     // ==================================================================
 86:     // 3. IP-BASED LIMIT STILL WORKS
 87:     // ==================================================================
 88: 
 89:     public function test_per_ip_rate_limit_blocks_after_five_attempts(): void
 90:     {
 91:         $this->makeUser('EMP-LOCK', '1234');
 92: 
 93:         // 5 wrong attempts from the SAME IP exhaust the per-IP limiter.
 94:         for ($i = 0; $i < 5; $i++) {
 95:             $this->withServerVariables(['REMOTE_ADDR' => '10.0.0.1'])
 96:                 ->post('/login/pin', [
 97:                     'employee_code' => 'EMP-LOCK',
 98:                     'pin' => '0000',
 99:                 ]);
100:         }
101: 
102:         // 6th attempt, correct PIN, same IP — must be blocked.
103:         $response = $this->withServerVariables(['REMOTE_ADDR' => '10.0.0.1'])
104:             ->post('/login/pin', [
105:                 'employee_code' => 'EMP-LOCK',
106:                 'pin' => '1234',
107:             ]);
108: 
109:         $response->assertSessionHasErrors('employee_code');
110:         $this->assertGuest();
111:     }
112: 
113:     // ==================================================================
114:     // 4. SUCCESS CLEARS BOTH LIMITERS
115:     // ==================================================================
116: 
117:     public function test_successful_login_clears_all_limiters(): void
118:     {
119:         $this->makeUser('EMP-LOCK', '1234');
120: 
121:         // A few wrong attempts.
122:         for ($i = 0; $i < 3; $i++) {
123:             $this->withServerVariables(['REMOTE_ADDR' => '10.0.0.1'])
124:                 ->post('/login/pin', [
125:                     'employee_code' => 'EMP-LOCK',
126:                     'pin' => '0000',
127:                 ]);
128:         }
129: 
130:         // Successful login.
131:         $this->withServerVariables(['REMOTE_ADDR' => '10.0.0.1'])
132:             ->post('/login/pin', [
133:                 'employee_code' => 'EMP-LOCK',
134:                 'pin' => '1234',
135:             ]);
136: 
137:         // Log out so the limiter state is what matters.
138:         $this->post('/logout');
139: 
140:         // The next 4 attempts must not be pre-blocked by the previous
141:         // failures. Verify by making 4 more wrong attempts from the
142:         // same IP — the error should be "auth.failed" (rate limit not
143:         // yet hit), not the "Too many" throttle message.
144:         //
145:         // NOTE: a wrong PIN produces the error under the `pin` key,
146:         // not `employee_code` — see PinLoginRequest::failAndRateLimit().
147:         for ($i = 0; $i < 4; $i++) {
148:             $response = $this->withServerVariables(['REMOTE_ADDR' => '10.0.0.1'])
149:                 ->post('/login/pin', [
150:                     'employee_code' => 'EMP-LOCK',
151:                     'pin' => '0000',
152:                 ]);
153: 
154:             $response->assertSessionHasErrors('pin');
155: 
156:             $messages = session('errors')->getBag('default')->get('pin');
157:             $text = implode(' ', $messages);
158: 
159:             $this->assertStringNotContainsString(
160:                 'Too many',
161:                 $text,
162:                 'Limiter should have been cleared by the successful login'
163:             );
164:         }
165:     }
166: 
167:     // ==================================================================
168:     // HELPERS
169:     // ==================================================================
170: 
171:     private function makeUser(string $code, string $pin): User
172:     {
173:         return User::factory()->create([
174:             'role' => 'user',
175:             'employee_code' => $code,
176:             'pin' => Hash::make($pin),
177:             'pin_is_default' => false,
178:             'is_active' => true,
179:         ]);
180:     }
181: }

  1: <?php

  3: namespace Tests\Feature\Auth;
  4: 
  5: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\File;
  6: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;
  7: use Tests\TestCase;
  8: 
  9: /**
 10:  * Public registration is intentionally disabled in this application.
 11:  *
 12:  * Users are created exclusively by administrators through the
 13:  * SuperAdmin panel or the per-garage user management screen. The
 14:  * /register route does not exist, and no RegisteredUserController
 15:  * should ever be reintroduced without an explicit security review.
 16:  *
 17:  * This test file replaces the old RegistrationTest which was passing
 18:  * for the wrong reason: it asserted a 404 (route missing) but the
 19:  * accompanying controller was actually a dead abort(403) stub that
 20:  * was never reachable.
 21:  */
 22: class RegistrationDisabledTest extends TestCase
 23: {
 24:     // ==================================================================

 26:     // ==================================================================
 27:

 29:     {

 31:             Route::has('register'),
 32:             "The 'register' named route must not exist. "
 33:             .'Public registration is disabled by design.'
 34:         );
 35:     }

 38:     {
 39:         $this->get('/register')->assertNotFound();
 40:     }
 41:

 45:             'name' => 'Attacker',

 49:         ])->assertNotFound();
 50:     }

 57:     {

 59:             'name' => 'Attacker',

 61:             'password' => 'password123',
 62:             'password_confirmation' => 'password123',
 63:         ]);
 64:

 66:         $this->assertDatabaseMissing('users', ['email' => 'attacker@test.com']);
 67:     }

 70:     // 3. DEAD CONTROLLER IS GONE
 71:     // ==================================================================
 72: 
 73:     public function test_registered_user_controller_does_not_exist(): void
 74:     {
 75:         $path = app_path('Http/Controllers/Auth/RegisteredUserController.php');
 76: 
 77:         $this->assertFileDoesNotExist(
 78:             $path,
 79:             'The RegisteredUserController was a dead abort(403) stub with '
 80:             .'no route attached. It must not be reintroduced — user '
 81:             .'creation belongs to SuperAdmin\\UserController and '
 82:             .'UserManagementController.'
 83:         );

 87:     // 4. NO BLADE FILE LINKS TO REGISTER
 88:     // ==================================================================
 89: 
 90:     public function test_no_blade_file_references_register_route(): void
 91:     {
 92:         $offenders = [];
 93: 
 94:         foreach (File::allFiles(resource_path('views')) as $file) {
 95:             if (! str_ends_with($file->getFilename(), '.blade.php')) {
 96:                 continue;
 97:             }
 98: 
 99:             $contents = File::get($file->getPathname());
100: 
101:             // Match both route('register') and url('/register') forms.
102:             if (preg_match("/route\(\s*['\"]register['\"]/", $contents)
103:                 || preg_match("/url\(\s*['\"]\/?register['\"]/", $contents)) {
104:                 $offenders[] = str_replace(
105:                     base_path().DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR,
106:                     '',
107:                     $file->getPathname()
108:                 );
109:             }
110:         }
111: 
112:         $this->assertEmpty(
113:             $offenders,
114:             "These blade files link to the non-existent register route:\n - "
115:             .implode("\n - ", $offenders)
116:         );
117:     }

129:         $response->assertDontSee('register"', false);
130:     }
131:     // ==================================================================

 3: namespace Tests\Feature\Auth;

12: /**
13:  * Regression guard for a bug where AuthenticatedSessionController
14:  * called Auth::login() a second time inside the first-time-SuperAdmin
15:  * branch, after LoginRequest::authenticate() had already logged the
16:  * user in. That fired the Login event twice and produced duplicate
17:  * "SuperAdmin logged in" audit entries.
18:  */

20: {

22: 
23:     public function test_super_admin_without_mfa_fires_login_event_exactly_once(): void

26:             'email' => 'sa@test.com',
27:             'password' => Hash::make('password'),
28:             'role' => 'super_admin',
29:             'is_active' => true,
30:         ]);
31: 
32:         Event::fake([Login::class]);
33: 
34:         $this->post('/login', [
35:             'email' => 'sa@test.com',
36:             'password' => 'password',
37:         ]);
38: 
39:         Event::assertDispatchedTimes(Login::class, 1);
40:     }
41: 
42:     public function test_super_admin_with_mfa_fires_login_event_only_after_totp(): void
43:     {
44:         $sa = User::factory()->create([
45:             'email' => 'sa@test.com',
46:             'password' => Hash::make('password'),
47:             'role' => 'super_admin',
48:             'is_active' => true,
49:         ]);
50: 
51:         // Configure MFA so the login is deferred.
52:         $sa->forceFill([
53:             'two_factor_secret' => app(\App\Support\TwoFactor\TwoFactorManager::class)->generateSecret(),
54:             'two_factor_confirmed_at' => now(),
55:         ])->save();
56: 
57:         Event::fake([Login::class]);
58: 
59:         // Password step — the user is logged out and Login is NOT fired
60:         // (authenticate() runs Auth::attempt but then we log out).
61:         $this->post('/login', [
62:             'email' => 'sa@test.com',
63:             'password' => 'password',
64:         ]);
65: 
66:         // One Login event from the initial authenticate() call — but
67:         // the user is logged back out before the response is returned.
68:         // No *second* Login event is dispatched by the controller.
69:         Event::assertDispatchedTimes(Login::class, 1);
70:
