<file path="tests/Feature/Auth/TimingAttackDefenseTest.php">
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: namespace Tests\Feature\Auth;
  4: 
  5: use App\Models\User;
  6: use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
  7: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
  8: use Tests\TestCase;
  9: 
 10: class TimingAttackDefenseTest extends TestCase
 11: {
 12:     use RefreshDatabase;
 13: 
 14:     // ==================================================================
 15:     // 1. API LOGIN — response time profile must be uniform
 16:     // ==================================================================
 17: 
 18:     public function test_api_login_nonexistent_user_runs_bcrypt_check(): void
 19:     {
 20:         // Even for a nonexistent user the API must run a bcrypt
 21:         // comparison. We verify this indirectly: the DUMMY_HASH constant
 22:         // in the controller contains a valid bcrypt string, and the
 23:         // response for a nonexistent user is byte-identical to the
 24:         // response for a real user with a wrong password.
 25:         $realUser = User::factory()->create([
 26:             'email' => 'real@test.com',
 27:             'password' => Hash::make('real-password'),
 28:             'role' => 'user',
 29:             'is_active' => true,
 30:         ]);
 31: 
 32:         $responseReal = $this->postJson('/api/login', [
 33:             'email' => 'real@test.com',
 34:             'password' => 'wrong-password',
 35:         ]);
 36: 
 37:         $responseGhost = $this->postJson('/api/login', [
 38:             'email' => 'ghost@test.com',
 39:             'password' => 'wrong-password',
 40:         ]);
 41: 
 42:         // Both must return the same status and the same generic message.
 43:         $responseReal->assertStatus(422);
 44:         $responseGhost->assertStatus(422);
 45: 
 46:         $this->assertSame(
 47:             $responseReal->json('errors.email.0'),
 48:             $responseGhost->json('errors.email.0'),
 49:             'Nonexistent user and wrong password must return the identical error message'
 50:         );
 51:     }
 52: 
 53:     public function test_api_login_inactive_user_returns_same_error_as_wrong_password(): void
 54:     {
 55:         User::factory()->create([
 56:             'email' => 'inactive@test.com',
 57:             'password' => Hash::make('password'),
 58:             'role' => 'user',
 59:             'is_active' => false,
 60:         ]);
 61: 
 62:         User::factory()->create([
 63:             'email' => 'active@test.com',
 64:             'password' => Hash::make('password'),
 65:             'role' => 'user',
 66:             'is_active' => true,
 67:         ]);
 68: 
 69:         $inactiveResponse = $this->postJson('/api/login', [
 70:             'email' => 'inactive@test.com',
 71:             'password' => 'password',
 72:         ]);
 73: 
 74:         $wrongPasswordResponse = $this->postJson('/api/login', [
 75:             'email' => 'active@test.com',
 76:             'password' => 'wrong',
 77:         ]);
 78: 
 79:         // Account enumeration defense: inactive and wrong-password
 80:         // must not be distinguishable.
 81:         $this->assertSame(
 82:             $wrongPasswordResponse->json('errors.email.0'),
 83:             $inactiveResponse->json('errors.email.0'),
 84:         );
 85:     }
 86: 
 87:     // ==================================================================
 88:     // 2. PIN LOGIN — same generic error for all failure modes
 89:     // ==================================================================
 90: 
 91:     public function test_pin_login_nonexistent_code_returns_generic_error(): void
 92:     {
 93:         $response = $this->post('/login/pin', [
 94:             'employee_code' => 'EMP-GHOST',
 95:             'pin' => '1234',
 96:         ]);
 97: 
 98:         $response->assertSessionHasErrors('employee_code');
 99:         $this->assertSame(
100:             __('auth.failed'),
101:             session('errors')->first('employee_code')
102:         );
103:     }
104: 
105:     public function test_pin_login_wrong_pin_returns_generic_error(): void
106:     {
107:         User::factory()->create([
108:             'role' => 'user',
109:             'employee_code' => 'EMP-REAL',
110:             'pin' => Hash::make('1234'),
111:             'pin_is_default' => false,
112:             'is_active' => true,
113:         ]);
114: 
115:         $response = $this->post('/login/pin', [
116:             'employee_code' => 'EMP-REAL',
117:             'pin' => '9999',
118:         ]);
119: 
120:         $response->assertSessionHasErrors('pin');
121:         $this->assertSame(
122:             __('auth.failed'),
123:             session('errors')->first('pin')
124:         );
125:     }
126: 
127:     // ==================================================================
128:     // 3. No timing-specific leaks in log messages
129:     // ==================================================================
130: 
131:     /**
132:      * Regression guard: the API login failure path must never log
133:      * the submitted password or any MFA-related field.
134:      *
135:      * Instead of reading the log FILE (which fails on Windows when
136:      * the file is locked by another process), we spy on the Log
137:      * facade and inspect the recorded calls in memory. This is both
138:      * platform-independent AND faster — no disk I/O at all.
139:      */
140:     public function test_api_login_failure_does_not_log_sensitive_data(): void
141:     {
142:         \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log::spy();
143: 
144:         $this->postJson('/api/login', [
145:             'email' => 'nobody@test.com',
146:             'password' => 'secret-guess-1234',
147:         ]);
148: 
149:         // Collect every value passed to Log::warning() during this
150:         // request and assert that none of them contains the password
151:         // or any MFA secret field name.
152:         \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log::shouldHaveReceived('warning')
153:             ->withArgs(function ($message, array $context = []) {
154:                 $encoded = json_encode([$message, $context]);
155: 
156:                 $this->assertStringNotContainsString(
157:                     'secret-guess-1234',
158:                     $encoded,
159:                     'Submitted password must not appear in log context'
160:                 );
161: 
162:                 $this->assertStringNotContainsString(
163:                     'two_factor_secret',
164:                     $encoded,
165:                     'MFA secret field must not appear in log context'
166:                 );
167: 
168:                 return true;
169:             });
170:     }
171: }

 3: namespace Tests\Feature\Auth;

 5: use App\Models\User;
 6: use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
 7: use Tests\TestCase;
 8: use Tests\Traits\MakesSuperAdminWithMfa;
 9: 
10: class TokenRevocationOnDeactivationTest extends TestCase
11: {
12:     use MakesSuperAdminWithMfa;
13:     use RefreshDatabase;
14: 
15:     /**
16:      * Regression guard for the observer pattern.
17:      *
18:      * Before UserObserver existed, deactivating a user via a direct
19:      * Eloquent call (console command, tinker, future bulk action)
20:      * left every API token alive. This test fails on that old
21:      * behavior and passes with the observer in place.
22:      */
23:     public function test_direct_model_update_revokes_tokens(): void
24:     {
25:         $user = User::factory()->create(['is_active' => true]);
26:         $user->createToken('device-a');
27:         $user->createToken('device-b');
28: 
29:         $this->assertEquals(2, $user->tokens()->count());
30: 
31:         $user->update(['is_active' => false]);
32: 
33:         $this->assertEquals(
34:             0,
35:             $user->fresh()->tokens()->count(),
36:             'All API tokens must be revoked on direct model deactivation'
37:         );
38:     }
39: 
40:     public function test_reactivating_user_does_not_revoke_tokens(): void
41:     {
42:         $user = User::factory()->create(['is_active' => false]);
43: 
44:         // Reactivate
45:         $user->update(['is_active' => true]);
46: 
47:         // Issue a token AFTER reactivation
48:         $user->createToken('post-reactivation');
49: 
50:         // No spurious revocation.
51:         $this->assertEquals(1, $user->fresh()->tokens()->count());
52:     }
53: 
54:     public function test_name_only_update_does_not_revoke_tokens(): void
55:     {
56:         $user = User::factory()->create(['is_active' => true]);
57:         $user->createToken('device-a');
58: 
59:         $user->update(['name' => 'Renamed User']);
60: 
61:         $this->assertEquals(1, $user->fresh()->tokens()->count());
62:     }
63: 
64:     public function test_super_admin_controller_still_revokes_tokens(): void
65:     {
66:         $superAdmin = $this->makeSuperAdminWithMfa();
67: 
68:         $target = User::factory()->create(['is_active' => true]);
69:         $target->createToken('device-a');
70: 
71:         $this->actingAs($superAdmin)
72:             ->put(route('super-admin.users.update', $target), [
73:                 'name' => $target->name,
74:                 'email' => $target->email,
75:                 'is_active' => 0,
76:             ]);
77: 
78:         $this->assertEquals(0, $target->fresh()->tokens()->count());

316:     public function test_soft_deleted_user_cannot_use_recovery_code(): void
317:     {
318:         $sa = $this->makeSuperAdminWithMfa();
319: 
320:         $plainCode = 'ABCDE-FGHIJ';
321:         $sa->forceFill([
322:             'two_factor_recovery_codes' => [Hash::make($plainCode)],
323:         ])->save();
324: 
325:         $sa->delete(); // soft delete
326: 
327:         // Attempting to consume a recovery code on a soft-deleted
328:         // user must fail — the query respects the SoftDeletes scope.
329:         $result = $sa->useRecoveryCode($plainCode);
330: 
331:         $this->assertFalse($result);
332: 
333:         // The code must still be present in the (soft-deleted) row.
334:         //
335:         // We read through Eloquent with withTrashed() so the
336:         // `encrypted:array` cast decrypts the value for us — a raw
337:         // DB read returns the ciphertext and json_decode() would
338:         // simply return null.
339:         $softDeleted = User::withTrashed()->find($sa->id);
340: 
341:         $this->assertNotNull($softDeleted);
342:         $this->assertCount(1, $softDeleted->two_factor_recovery_codes);

213:     {
214:         $bus = $this->makeBus();
215:         $this->addKm($bus, '2026-09-20', 100000);
216:         $this->addKm($bus, '2026-09-23', 104750);
217:         $this->addKm($bus, '2026-09-24', 105000);
218: 
219:         $response = $this->actingAs($this->admin)
220:             ->withSession($this->garageSession())
221:             ->get(route('buses.show', $bus));
222: 
223:         $response->assertOk();
224: 
225:         $response->assertViewHas('kmRecords', function ($paginator) {
226:             $items = $paginator->items();
227: 
228:             return count($items) === 3
229:                 && $items[0]->daily_km === 250
230:                 && $items[1]->daily_km === 4750
231:                 && $items[2]->daily_km === null;
232:         });
233:     }

239:         $this->addKm($bus, '2026-09-24', 105000);
240: 
241:         $response = $this->actingAs($this->admin)
242:             ->withSession($this->garageSession())
243:             ->get(route('buses.show', $bus));

245:         $response->assertOk();
246:         $response->assertSee(__('messages.buses.col_daily_km'), false);
247:     }
248: 
249:     // ==================================================================
250:     // 4. Pagination — diff must compute across page boundary
251:     // ==================================================================
252: 
253:     public function test_pagination_computes_diff_across_page_boundary(): void
254:     {
255:         $bus = $this->makeBus();
256: 
257:         // 35 records — 30 on page 1, 5 on page 2.
258:         // Dates ascend from 34 days ago to today; KM values increase
259:         // by 100 per day, so every daily diff must be exactly 100.
260:         for ($i = 0; $i < 35; $i++) {
261:             $date = now()->subDays(34 - $i)->toDateString();
262:             $this->addKm($bus, $date, 100000 + ($i * 100));
263:         }
264: 
265:         // Request page 1. The LAST item on this page has no sibling
266:         // record on the same page, so the controller must fetch its
267:         // previous record from page 2 to compute the daily diff.
268:         $response = $this->actingAs($this->admin)
269:             ->withSession($this->garageSession())
270:             ->get(route('buses.show', $bus));
271: 
272:         $response->assertOk();
273:         $response->assertViewHas('kmRecords', function ($paginator) {
274:             $items = $paginator->items();
275:             $last = end($items);
276: 
277:             // All records grow by 100 per day, so the page-boundary
278:             // item must also have a diff of exactly 100 — proving the
279:             // controller fetched the previous record from page 2.
280:             return $last->daily_km === 100;
281:         });
282:     }
283: }

106:     public function test_detail_ids_are_preserved_when_quantity_changes(): void
107:     {
108:         $this->makeWarehouse('D-001', 'Filter', 100);
109:         $this->makeWarehouse('D-002', 'Bolt', 100);
110:         $this->makeWarehouse('D-003', 'Nut', 100);
111: 
112:         // İlk complaint — 3 detal
113:         $complaint = $this->service->create($this->baseData(), [
114:             $this->detailPayload('D-001', 2),
115:             $this->detailPayload('D-002', 3),
116:             $this->detailPayload('D-003', 4),
117:         ], ['Problem A']);
118: 
119:         $originalIds = $complaint->details()->orderBy('id')->pluck('id')->all();
120: 
121:         // İndi D-003-ün miqdarını 4 → 10 edək
122:         $this->service->update($complaint, $this->baseData(), [
123:             $this->detailPayload('D-001', 2),
124:             $this->detailPayload('D-002', 3),
125:             $this->detailPayload('D-003', 10),  // dəyişdi
126:         ], ['Problem A']);
127: 
128:         $newIds = $complaint->fresh()->details()->orderBy('id')->pluck('id')->all();
129: 
130:         // ✅ ID-lər qorunmalıdır (əvvəlki kod bunu pozurdu)
131:         $this->assertEquals($originalIds, $newIds, 'Detail IDs must be preserved on update');
132: 
133:         // ✅ Yalnız 3 aktiv detal olmalıdır
134:         $this->assertEquals(3, $complaint->fresh()->details()->count());
135: 
136:         // ✅ Soft-deleted heç bir sətir olmamalıdır
137:         $this->assertEquals(
138:             0,
139:             ComplaintDetail::onlyTrashed()->where('complaint_id', $complaint->id)->count(),
140:             'No soft-deleted details should accumulate on in-place updates'
141:         );
142: 
143:         // ✅ D-003-ün miqdarı dəyişmiş olmalıdır
144:         $d3 = $complaint->fresh()->details()->where('code', 'D-003')->first();
145:         $this->assertEquals(10, $d3->used_quantity);
146:     }

148:     public function test_no_soft_deleted_rows_accumulate_across_many_updates(): void
149:     {
150:         $this->makeWarehouse('D-010', 'A', 100);
151:         $this->makeWarehouse('D-011', 'B', 100);
152: 
153:         $complaint = $this->service->create($this->baseData(), [
154:             $this->detailPayload('D-010', 1),
155:             $this->detailPayload('D-011', 1),
156:         ], ['Problem']);
157: 
158:         // 10 dəfə update et — hər dəfə fərqli miqdar
159:         for ($i = 2; $i <= 11; $i++) {
160:             $this->service->update($complaint, $this->baseData(), [
161:                 $this->detailPayload('D-010', $i),
162:                 $this->detailPayload('D-011', $i),
163:             ], ['Problem']);
164:         }
165: 
166:         // ✅ 10 update-dən sonra heç bir soft-deleted sətir yığılmamalıdır
167:         $this->assertEquals(
168:             0,
169:             ComplaintDetail::onlyTrashed()->where('complaint_id', $complaint->id)->count(),
170:             'Repeated updates must not accumulate soft-deleted rows'
171:         );
172: 
173:         // ✅ Yalnız 2 aktiv detal
174:         $this->assertEquals(2, $complaint->fresh()->details()->count());
175:     }

256:     public function test_removing_all_details_soft_deletes_all_and_restores_stock(): void
257:     {
258:         $w1 = $this->makeWarehouse('D-040', 'A', 100);
259:         $w2 = $this->makeWarehouse('D-041', 'B', 100);
260:

262:             $this->detailPayload('D-040', 5),

267:         $this->assertEquals(95, $w1->fresh()->quantity);
268:         $this->assertEquals(93, $w2->fresh()->quantity);
269: 
270:         // İndi bütün detalları sil
271:         $this->service->update($complaint, $this->baseData(), [], ['Problem']);
272: 
273:         // ✅ Stok geri qaytarılmalıdır
274:         $this->assertEquals(100, $w1->fresh()->quantity);
275:         $this->assertEquals(100, $w2->fresh()->quantity);
276: 
277:         // ✅ Bütün detallar soft-deleted
278:         $this->assertEquals(0, $complaint->fresh()->details()->count());

280:             2,
281:             ComplaintDetail::onlyTrashed()->where('complaint_id', $complaint->id)->count()

289:     public function test_update_with_single_change_produces_minimal_audit_logs(): void
290:     {
291:         $this->makeWarehouse('D-050', 'A', 100);
292:         $this->makeWarehouse('D-051', 'B', 100);
293:         $this->makeWarehouse('D-052', 'C', 100);
294: 
295:         $complaint = $this->service->create($this->baseData(), [
296:             $this->detailPayload('D-050', 1),
297:             $this->detailPayload('D-051', 1),
298:             $this->detailPayload('D-052', 1),
299:         ], ['Problem']);
300: 
301:         // Detallar üçün audit logları say
302:         $initialLogs = \App\Models\AuditLog::where('auditable_type', ComplaintDetail::class)
303:             ->whereIn('auditable_id', $complaint->details()->pluck('id'))
304:             ->count();
305: 
306:         // Yalnız bir detalın miqdarını dəyişdir
307:         $this->service->update($complaint, $this->baseData(), [
308:             $this->detailPayload('D-050', 1),
309:             $this->detailPayload('D-051', 5),  // yalnız bu dəyişdi
310:             $this->detailPayload('D-052', 1),
311:         ], ['Problem']);
312: 
313:         // Yeni audit loglarını say
314:         $newLogs = \App\Models\AuditLog::where('auditable_type', ComplaintDetail::class)
315:             ->whereIn('auditable_id', $complaint->details()->pluck('id'))
316:             ->count();
317: 
318:         $diff = $newLogs - $initialLogs;
319: 
320:         // ✅ Yalnız 1 audit log (1 update) olmalıdır
321:         // Köhnə kod: 3 deleted + 3 created = 6 log yaradardı
322:         $this->assertEquals(
323:             1,
324:             $diff,
325:             'Single detail change must produce exactly 1 audit log, not 6'
326:         );
327:     }

333:     public function test_stock_diff_still_works_with_in_place_sync(): void
334:     {
335:         $w1 = $this->makeWarehouse('D-060', 'A', 100);
336:         $w2 = $this->makeWarehouse('D-061', 'B', 100);
337: 
338:         $complaint = $this->service->create($this->baseData(), [
339:             $this->detailPayload('D-060', 5),
340:             $this->detailPayload('D-061', 3),
341:         ], ['Problem']);
342: 
343:         $this->assertEquals(95, $w1->fresh()->quantity);
344:         $this->assertEquals(97, $w2->fresh()->quantity);
345: 
346:         // A: 5 → 8 (daha çox istifadə), B: 3 → 1 (daha az istifadə)
347:         $this->service->update($complaint, $this->baseData(), [
348:             $this->detailPayload('D-060', 8),
349:             $this->detailPayload('D-061', 1),
350:         ], ['Problem']);
351: 
352:         // A: 100 - 8 = 92, B: 100 - 1 = 99
353:         $this->assertEquals(92, $w1->fresh()->quantity);
354:         $this->assertEquals(99, $w2->fresh()->quantity);
355:     }

357:     // ==================================================================
358:     // 6. UPDATE → CREATE → UPDATE → DELETE AXINI
359:     // ==================================================================
360: 
361:     public function test_full_lifecycle_does_not_leak_soft_deleted_rows(): void
362:     {
363:         $this->makeWarehouse('L-001', 'A', 100);
364:         $this->makeWarehouse('L-002', 'B', 100);
365:         $this->makeWarehouse('L-003', 'C', 100);
366: 
367:         // Create: 2 detal
368:         $complaint = $this->service->create($this->baseData(), [
369:             $this->detailPayload('L-001', 1),
370:             $this->detailPayload('L-002', 1),
371:         ], ['Problem']);
372: 
373:         // Update 1: 3 detal (bir əlavə)
374:         $this->service->update($complaint, $this->baseData(), [
375:             $this->detailPayload('L-001', 1),
376:             $this->detailPayload('L-002', 1),
377:             $this->detailPayload('L-003', 1),
378:         ], ['Problem']);
379: 
380:         // Update 2: 1 detal (ikisi silinir)
381:         $this->service->update($complaint, $this->baseData(), [
382:             $this->detailPayload('L-001', 2),
383:         ], ['Problem']);
384: 
385:         // Update 3: 2 detal (biri yenidən əlavə)
386:         $this->service->update($complaint, $this->baseData(), [
387:             $this->detailPayload('L-001', 2),
388:             $this->detailPayload('L-002', 1),
389:         ], ['Problem']);
390: 
391:         // Yalnız 2 aktiv detal
392:         $this->assertEquals(2, $complaint->fresh()->details()->count());
393: 
394:         // Soft-deleted sətir sayı: 4 (2 update + 2 delete)
395:         // Əslində: Update 1 → 0 silinmə, Update 2 → 2 silinmə,
396:         // Update 3 → 0 silinmə. Cəmi 2 soft-deleted.
397:         $this->assertEquals(
398:             2,
399:             ComplaintDetail::onlyTrashed()->where('complaint_id', $complaint->id)->count(),
400:             'Soft-deleted count should reflect only actual removals, not full rewrites'
401:         );
402:     }
403: }

  7: use App\Models\Complaint;
  8: use App\Models\ComplaintItem;
  9: use App\Models\Employee;
 10: use App\Models\Garage;
 11: use App\Services\Complaint\ComplaintService;
 12: use App\Services\GarageContext;
 13: use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
 14: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
 15: use Tests\TestCase;
 16: 
 17: /**
 18:  * Regression tests for the stale PDF bug:
 19:  *
 20:  * A complaint's PDF is a snapshot of its state at a specific point
 21:  * in time. When the underlying complaint is updated or deleted, the
 22:  * on-disk PDF must be invalidated so the operator never downloads
 23:  * an outdated legal document.
 24:  */
 25: class ComplaintPdfInvalidationTest extends TestCase
 26: {
 27:     use RefreshDatabase;
 28: 
 29:     protected Company $company;
 30: 
 31:     protected Garage $garage;
 32: 
 33:     protected Bus $bus;
 34: 
 35:     protected Employee $employee;
 36: 
 37:     protected ComplaintService $service;
 38: 
 39:     protected function setUp(): void
 40:     {
 41:         parent::setUp();
 42: 
 43:         // Use an in-memory disk so we can assert against the "akt"
 44:         // directory without touching the real filesystem.
 45:         Storage::fake('local');
 46: 
 47:         $this->company = Company::factory()->create();
 48:         $this->garage = Garage::factory()->create(['company_id' => $this->company->id]);
 49: 
 50:         GarageContext::set($this->garage->id, $this->company->id);
 51: 
 52:         $this->bus = Bus::factory()->create([
 53:             'garage_id' => $this->garage->id,
 54:             'company_id' => $this->company->id,
 55:         ]);
 56: 
 57:         $this->employee = Employee::factory()->create([
 58:             'garage_id' => $this->garage->id,
 59:             'company_id' => $this->company->id,
 60:         ]);
 61: 
 62:         $this->service = app(ComplaintService::class);
 63:     }
 64: 
 65:     protected function tearDown(): void
 66:     {
 67:         GarageContext::clear();
 68:         parent::tearDown();
 69:     }
 70: 
 71:     // ==================================================================
 72:     // HELPERS
 73:     // ==================================================================
 74: 
 75:     protected function makeComplaint(): Complaint
 76:     {
 77:         return Complaint::create([
 78:             'bus_id' => $this->bus->id,
 79:             'garage_id' => $this->garage->id,
 80:             'company_id' => $this->company->id,
 81:             'yer' => 'garage',
 82:             'status' => 'pending',
 83:             'complaint_type' => 'breakdown',
 84:             'km' => 1000,
 85:         ]);
 86:     }
 87: 
 88:     protected function pdfPath(Complaint $complaint): string
 89:     {
 90:         return "akt/akt-{$complaint->id}.pdf";
 91:     }
 92: 
 93:     protected function seedFakePdf(Complaint $complaint): void
 94:     {
 95:         Storage::disk('local')->put($this->pdfPath($complaint), 'fake-pdf-content');
 96:     }
 97: 
 98:     protected function pdfExists(Complaint $complaint): bool
 99:     {
100:         return Storage::disk('local')->exists($this->pdfPath($complaint));
101:     }
102: 
103:     protected function baseData(): array
104:     {
105:         return [
106:             'bus_id' => $this->bus->id,
107:             'yer' => 'garage',
108:             'status' => 'pending',
109:             'complaint_type' => 'breakdown',
110:             'km' => 1000,
111:         ];
112:     }
113: 
114:     // ==================================================================
115:     // 1. UPDATE invalidates the PDF
116:     // ==================================================================
117: 
118:     public function test_update_deletes_stale_pdf(): void
119:     {
120:         $complaint = $this->makeComplaint();
121:         $this->seedFakePdf($complaint);
122: 
123:         $this->assertTrue($this->pdfExists($complaint), 'Setup: fake PDF must exist');
124: 
125:         $this->service->update($complaint, $this->baseData(), [], ['Updated complaint']);
126: 
127:         $this->assertFalse(
128:             $this->pdfExists($complaint),
129:             'Stale PDF must be deleted after a successful update'
130:         );
131:     }
132: 
133:     public function test_update_without_existing_pdf_does_not_crash(): void
134:     {
135:         $complaint = $this->makeComplaint();
136: 
137:         // No PDF seeded — invalidate should be a silent no-op.
138:         $this->service->update($complaint, $this->baseData(), [], ['Update']);
139: 
140:         $this->assertFalse($this->pdfExists($complaint));
141:     }
142: 
143:     // ==================================================================
144:     // 2. UPDATE failure does NOT invalidate
145:     // ==================================================================
146: 
147:     public function test_update_failure_does_not_delete_pdf(): void
148:     {
149:         $complaint = $this->makeComplaint();
150:         $this->seedFakePdf($complaint);
151: 
152:         // Force the inner transaction to fail AFTER the complaint row
153:         // is updated. syncItems() creates ComplaintItem rows, so a
154:         // `creating` listener is the most reliable injection point.
155:         ComplaintItem::creating(function () {
156:             throw new \RuntimeException('Simulated failure');
157:         });
158: 
159:         try {
160:             $this->service->update(
161:                 $complaint,
162:                 $this->baseData(),
163:                 [],
164:                 ['This will fail']
165:             );
166:             $this->fail('Expected RuntimeException was not thrown');
167:         } catch (\RuntimeException $e) {
168:             $this->assertSame('Simulated failure', $e->getMessage());
169:         }
170: 
171:         $this->assertTrue(
172:             $this->pdfExists($complaint),
173:             'PDF must survive when the update transaction rolls back'
174:         );
175:     }
176: 
177:     // ==================================================================
178:     // 3. DELETE invalidates the PDF
179:     // ==================================================================
180: 
181:     public function test_delete_deletes_stale_pdf(): void
182:     {
183:         $complaint = $this->makeComplaint();
184:         $this->seedFakePdf($complaint);
185: 
186:         $this->assertTrue($this->pdfExists($complaint));
187: 
188:         $this->service->delete($complaint);
189: 
190:         $this->assertFalse(
191:             $this->pdfExists($complaint),
192:             'Stale PDF must be deleted after a successful delete'
193:         );
194:     }
195: 
196:     public function test_bulk_delete_deletes_all_pdfs(): void
197:     {
198:         $c1 = $this->makeComplaint();
199:         $c2 = $this->makeComplaint();
200: 
201:         $this->seedFakePdf($c1);
202:         $this->seedFakePdf($c2);
203: 
204:         $this->service->bulkDelete([$c1->id, $c2->id]);
205: 
206:         $this->assertFalse($this->pdfExists($c1), 'PDF for c1 must be deleted');
207:         $this->assertFalse($this->pdfExists($c2), 'PDF for c2 must be deleted');
208:     }
209: 
210:     // ==================================================================
211:     // 4. CLOSE does not delete the PDF directly
212:     //    (CloseComplaintAction regenerates it via save())
213:     // ==================================================================
214: 
215:     public function test_close_does_not_delete_existing_pdf(): void
216:     {
217:         $complaint = $this->makeComplaint();
218:         $this->seedFakePdf($complaint);
219: 
220:         $this->service->close($complaint, [
221:             'end_date' => now()->toDateString(),
222:             'end_time' => now()->format('H:i'),
223:             'work_done' => 'Fixed.',
224:         ]);
225: 
226:         $this->assertTrue(
227:             $this->pdfExists($complaint),
228:             'close() must not delete the PDF — CloseComplaintAction regenerates it'
229:         );
230:     }
231: }
</file>

<file path="tests/Feature/ComplaintStockDeadlockOrderTest.php">
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: namespace Tests\Feature;
  4: 
  5: use App\Models\Bus;
  6: use App\Models\Company;
  7: use App\Models\Employee;
  8: use App\Models\Garage;
  9: use App\Models\ServiceVehicle;
 10: use App\Models\ServiceVehicleStock;
 11: use App\Models\Warehouse;
 12: use App\Services\Complaint\ComplaintStockService;
 13: use App\Services\GarageContext;
 14: use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
 15: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
 16: use Tests\TestCase;
 17: 
 18: /**
 19:  * Regression guard for the deadlock bug in ComplaintStockService.
 20:  *
 21:  * deductStock() acquires row-level locks via lockForUpdate(). If two
 22:  * concurrent transactions lock the same rows in different orders,
 23:  * PostgreSQL aborts one with a deadlock error.
 24:  *
 25:  * The fix sorts the input array by `code` before entering the loop,
 26:  * guaranteeing a deterministic lock order across all transactions.
 27:  *
 28:  * These tests verify the ORDER, not the deadlock itself — the actual
 29:  * deadlock can only be triggered with two real concurrent DB sessions,
 30:  * which the Laravel test runner cannot easily simulate.
 31:  */
 32: class ComplaintStockDeadlockOrderTest extends TestCase
 33: {
 34:     use RefreshDatabase;
 35: 
 36:     protected Company $company;
 37: 
 38:     protected Garage $garage;
 39: 
 40:     protected Bus $bus;
 41: 
 42:     protected Employee $employee;
 43: 
 44:     protected ComplaintStockService $stockService;
 45: 
 46:     protected function setUp(): void
 47:     {
 48:         parent::setUp();
 49: 
 50:         $this->company = Company::factory()->create();
 51:         $this->garage = Garage::factory()->create(['company_id' => $this->company->id]);
 52: 
 53:         GarageContext::set($this->garage->id, $this->company->id);
 54: 
 55:         $this->bus = Bus::factory()->create([
 56:             'garage_id' => $this->garage->id,
 57:             'company_id' => $this->company->id,
 58:         ]);
 59: 
 60:         $this->employee = Employee::factory()->create([
 61:             'garage_id' => $this->garage->id,
 62:             'company_id' => $this->company->id,
 63:         ]);
 64: 
 65:         $this->stockService = new ComplaintStockService;
 66:     }
 67: 
 68:     protected function tearDown(): void
 69:     {
 70:         GarageContext::clear();
 71:         parent::tearDown();
 72:     }
 73: 
 74:     // ==================================================================
 75:     // HELPERS
 76:     // ==================================================================
 77: 
 78:     protected function makeWarehouse(string $code, int $qty = 100): Warehouse
 79:     {
 80:         return Warehouse::withoutGlobalScopes()->create([
 81:             'garage_id' => $this->garage->id,
 82:             'company_id' => $this->company->id,
 83:             'code' => $code,
 84:             'name' => "Part {$code}",
 85:             'quantity' => $qty,
 86:         ]);
 87:     }
 88: 
 89:     protected function detail(string $code, int $qty = 1): array
 90:     {
 91:         return [
 92:             'shikayet_index' => 0,
 93:             'code' => $code,
 94:             'used_quantity' => $qty,
 95:             'employee_id' => $this->employee->id,
 96:             'notes' => 'Test',
 97:         ];
 98:     }
 99: 
100:     /**
101:      * Capture the order in which the row-level locks were acquired.
102:      *
103:      * A `lockForUpdate()` query can carry the target `code` in any
104:      * binding position — for warehouses it is binding 0, for
105:      * service_vehicle_stocks the WHERE clause starts with
106:      * `service_vehicle_id` and `code` becomes binding 1. To stay
107:      * robust, we scan every binding of every "for update" query and
108:      * pick the string values that match the parts we are testing.
109:      *
110:      * @param  array<int, string>  $codesOfInterest
111:      * @return array<int, string>
112:      */
113:     protected function captureLockOrder(callable $action, array $codesOfInterest): array
114:     {
115:         $locks = [];
116: 
117:         DB::listen(function ($query) use (&$locks, $codesOfInterest) {
118:             if (! str_contains(strtolower($query->sql), 'for update')) {
119:                 return;
120:             }
121: 
122:             foreach ($query->bindings as $binding) {
123:                 if (is_string($binding) && in_array($binding, $codesOfInterest, true)) {
124:                     $locks[] = $binding;
125:                 }
126:             }
127:         });
128: 
129:         $action();
130: 
131:         return $locks;
132:     }
133: 
134:     // ==================================================================
135:     // 1. WAREHOUSE — lock order is alphabetical
136:     // ==================================================================
137: 
138:     public function test_deduct_stock_locks_warehouse_rows_in_sorted_order(): void
139:     {
140:         $this->makeWarehouse('A-001', 100);
141:         $this->makeWarehouse('M-001', 100);
142:         $this->makeWarehouse('Z-001', 100);
143: 
144:         // Pass the details in REVERSE alphabetical order — the fix
145:         // must reorder them internally.
146:         $codes = $this->captureLockOrder(function () {
147:             $this->stockService->deductStock([
148:                 $this->detail('Z-001'),
149:                 $this->detail('M-001'),
150:                 $this->detail('A-001'),
151:             ]);
152:         }, ['A-001', 'M-001', 'Z-001']);
153: 
154:         $this->assertSame(
155:             ['A-001', 'M-001', 'Z-001'],
156:             $codes,
157:             'Warehouse locks must be acquired in alphabetical order by code'
158:         );
159:     }
160: 
161:     public function test_deduct_stock_preserves_lock_order_for_two_codes(): void
162:     {
163:         $this->makeWarehouse('B-002', 100);
164:         $this->makeWarehouse('A-001', 100);
165: 
166:         $codes = $this->captureLockOrder(function () {
167:             $this->stockService->deductStock([
168:                 $this->detail('B-002'),
169:                 $this->detail('A-001'),
170:             ]);
171:         }, ['A-001', 'B-002']);
172: 
173:         $this->assertSame(['A-001', 'B-002'], $codes);
174:     }
175: 
176:     // ==================================================================
177:     // 2. SERVICE VEHICLE — lock order is alphabetical
178:     // ==================================================================
179: 
180:     public function test_deduct_stock_locks_service_vehicle_rows_in_sorted_order(): void
181:     {
182:         $vehicle = ServiceVehicle::withoutGlobalScopes()->create([
183:             'garage_id' => $this->garage->id,
184:             'company_id' => $this->company->id,
185:             'name' => 'Test Vehicle',
186:             'is_active' => true,
187:         ]);
188: 
189:         foreach (['A-001', 'M-001', 'Z-001'] as $code) {
190:             ServiceVehicleStock::withoutGlobalScopes()->create([
191:                 'service_vehicle_id' => $vehicle->id,
192:                 'garage_id' => $this->garage->id,
193:                 'company_id' => $this->company->id,
194:                 'code' => $code,
195:                 'name' => "Part {$code}",
196:                 'quantity' => 50,
197:             ]);
198:         }
199: 
200:         $codes = $this->captureLockOrder(function () use ($vehicle) {
201:             $this->stockService->deductStock(
202:                 [
203:                     $this->detail('Z-001'),
204:                     $this->detail('M-001'),
205:                     $this->detail('A-001'),
206:                 ],
207:                 location: 'road',
208:                 serviceVehicleId: $vehicle->id,
209:             );
210:         }, ['A-001', 'M-001', 'Z-001']);
211: 
212:         $this->assertSame(['A-001', 'M-001', 'Z-001'], $codes);
213:     }
214: 
215:     // ==================================================================
216:     // 3. OUTPUT is still correct (regression)
217:     // ==================================================================
218: 
219:     public function test_deduct_stock_still_returns_correct_processed_rows(): void
220:     {
221:         $this->makeWarehouse('C-003', 50);
222: 
223:         $processed = $this->stockService->deductStock([
224:             $this->detail('C-003', 5),
225:         ]);
226: 
227:         $this->assertCount(1, $processed);
228:         $this->assertSame('C-003', $processed[0]['code']);
229:         $this->assertSame(5, $processed[0]['used_quantity']);
230:         $this->assertSame('warehouse', $processed[0]['source_type']);
231: 
232:         $this->assertSame(
233:             45,
234:             Warehouse::withoutGlobalScopes()->where('code', 'C-003')->value('quantity')
235:         );
236:     }
237: 
238:     // ==================================================================
239:     // 4. INSPECTION ROWS do not break the sort
240:     // ==================================================================
241: 
242:     public function test_sort_handles_mixed_consumption_and_inspection_rows(): void
243:     {
244:         // Both warehouse rows must exist before the deduction runs.
245:         $this->makeWarehouse('A-001', 100);
246:         $this->makeWarehouse('B-001', 100);
247: 
248:         // Input order: inspection, warehouse, inspection, warehouse
249:         $processed = $this->stockService->deductStock([
250:             $this->detail('B-002', 0),   // inspection
251:             $this->detail('A-001', 3),   // warehouse
252:             $this->detail('A-002', 0),   // inspection
253:             $this->detail('B-001', 2),   // warehouse
254:         ]);
255: 
256:         // Result is in sorted order: A-001, A-002, B-001, B-002
257:         $this->assertSame(
258:             ['A-001', 'A-002', 'B-001', 'B-002'],
259:             array_column($processed, 'code')
260:         );
261: 
262:         $this->assertSame('warehouse', $processed[0]['source_type']);
263:         $this->assertSame('inspection', $processed[1]['source_type']);
264:         $this->assertSame('warehouse', $processed[2]['source_type']);
265:         $this->assertSame('inspection', $processed[3]['source_type']);
266:     }
267: 
268:     // ==================================================================
269:     // 5. Empty / null codes are still skipped
270:     // ==================================================================
271: 
272:     public function test_sort_does_not_break_empty_code_handling(): void
273:     {
274:         $this->makeWarehouse('A-001', 100);
275: 
276:         $processed = $this->stockService->deductStock([
277:             ['code' => '', 'used_quantity' => 5, 'notes' => 'empty'],
278:             ['code' => 'A-001', 'used_quantity' => 2, 'employee_id' => $this->employee->id, 'notes' => 'ok'],
279:         ]);
280: 
281:         $this->assertCount(1, $processed);
282:         $this->assertSame('A-001', $processed[0]['code']);
283:     }
284: }

 19: 
 20: /**
 21:  * Zero-quantity complaint details are treated as "inspection" rows.
 22:  *
 23:  * Behavior (see migration 2026_09_17_174409):
 24:  *   - used_quantity > 0  → warehouse or service_vehicle deduction
 25:  *   - used_quantity <= 0 → inspection row (source_type='inspection'),
 26:  *                          no stock mutation
 27:  *   - DB CHECK constraint: used_quantity >= 0
 28:  */
 29: class ComplaintZeroQuantityTest extends TestCase
 30: {
 31:     use RefreshDatabase;
 32: 
 33:     protected Company $company;
 34: 
 35:     protected Garage $garage;
 36: 
 37:     protected Bus $bus;
 38: 
 39:     protected Employee $employee;
 40: 
 41:     protected ComplaintService $service;
 42: 
 43:     protected ComplaintStockService $stockService;
 44: 
 45:     protected function setUp(): void
 46:     {
 47:         parent::setUp();
 48: 
 49:         $this->company = Company::factory()->create();
 50:         $this->garage = Garage::factory()->create(['company_id' => $this->company->id]);
 51: 
 52:         GarageContext::set($this->garage->id, $this->company->id);
 53: 
 54:         $this->bus = Bus::factory()->create([
 55:             'garage_id' => $this->garage->id,
 56:             'company_id' => $this->company->id,
 57:         ]);
 58: 
 59:         $this->employee = Employee::factory()->create([
 60:             'garage_id' => $this->garage->id,
 61:             'company_id' => $this->company->id,
 62:         ]);
 63:

 65:         $this->service = new ComplaintService(
 66:             $this->stockService,
 67:             new ComplaintItemService,
 68:             new ComplaintStatusTransitionService
 69:         );
 70:     }
 71: 
 72:     protected function tearDown(): void
 73:     {
 74:         GarageContext::clear();
 75:         parent::tearDown();
 76:     }
 77: 
 78:     private function makeWarehouse(string $code, int $quantity): Warehouse
 79:     {
 80:         return Warehouse::factory()->create([
 81:             'garage_id' => $this->garage->id,
 82:             'company_id' => $this->company->id,
 83:             'code' => $code,
 84:             'name' => "Part {$code}",
 85:             'quantity' => $quantity,
 86:         ]);
 87:     }
 88: 
 89:     private function baseData(): array
 90:     {
 91:         return [
 92:             'bus_id' => $this->bus->id,
 93:             'yer' => 'garage',
 94:             'status' => 'pending',
 95:             'complaint_type' => 'breakdown',
 96:             'km' => 1000,
 97:         ];
 98:     }
 99: 
100:     // ==================================================================
101:     // 1. ZERO QUANTITY → INSPECTION ROW (SERVICE LEVEL)

 96: 
 97:     public function test_dashboard_policy_file_does_not_exist(): void
 98:     {
 99:         // The DashboardController has no model and no gate — it is
100:         // protected exclusively by route middleware. This guard fails
101:         // if anyone reintroduces a policy binding for a controller
102:         // class, which is a common anti-pattern.
103:         //
104:         // Note: we check file existence rather than class_exists() so
105:         // the test does not trigger Composer's autoloader for a class
106:         // that is intentionally absent.
107:         $path = app_path('Policies/DashboardPolicy.php');
108: 
109:         $this->assertFileDoesNotExist(
110:             $path,
111:             'DashboardPolicy must not be reintroduced. Access to the '
112:             .'dashboard is enforced by the auth + garage.selected '
113:             .'route middleware, not by a (no-op) policy.'
114:         );
115:     }
116: 
117:     public function test_no_policy_is_bound_to_a_controller_class(): void
118:     {
119:         // Walk the registered policies and assert that none of them
120:         // map from an App\Http\Controllers\* class. Policies should
121:         // only be bound to Eloquent models.
122:         $policies = app(\Illuminate\Contracts\Auth\Access\Gate::class)
123:             ->getPolicyFor(\App\Http\Controllers\DashboardController::class);
124: 
125:         $this->assertNull(
126:             $policies,
127:             'A policy was bound to a controller class. '
128:             .'Policies must be bound to models, not controllers. '
129:             .'Use route middleware for controller-level authorization.'
130:         );
131:     }
132: }

<file path="tests/Feature/DeadCodeGuardTest.php">
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: namespace Tests\Feature;
  4: 
  5: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\File;
  6: use Tests\TestCase;
  7: 
  8: /**
  9:  * Guards against two families of dead-code / misplacement bugs:
 10:  *
 11:  * 1. Files under app/Http/Requests declaring a namespace that is NOT
 12:  *    under App\Http\Requests — usually leftovers from incomplete
 13:  *    refactors where a controller was supposed to be converted to a
 14:  *    FormRequest but the old code was never removed.
 15:  *
 16:  * 2. Two files in the SAME namespace declaring the same class name —
 17:  *    a genuine duplicate that Composer would silently pick one of,
 18:  *    causing nondeterministic behavior depending on file discovery.
 19:  *
 20:  * NOTE: It is legal for Laravel applications to have classes with the
 21:  * same short name in different namespaces (e.g. App\Http\Controllers\BusController
 22:  * and App\Http\Controllers\Api\BusController). This test therefore
 23:  * compares full namespace-qualified class names, not just the class
 24:  * basename.
 25:  */
 26: class DeadCodeGuardTest extends TestCase
 27: {
 28:     /**
 29:      * Every file under app/Http/Requests must declare a namespace
 30:      * under App\Http\Requests. Any misplaced controller, model, or
 31:      * service will fail the build.
 32:      */
 33:     public function test_requests_directory_only_contains_requests(): void
 34:     {
 35:         $offenders = [];
 36: 
 37:         foreach (File::allFiles(app_path('Http/Requests')) as $file) {
 38:             $contents = File::get($file->getPathname());
 39: 
 40:             if (preg_match('/^namespace\s+([^;]+);/m', $contents, $matches)) {
 41:                 $namespace = trim($matches[1]);
 42: 
 43:                 if (! str_starts_with($namespace, 'App\\Http\\Requests')) {
 44:                     $relative = str_replace(
 45:                         base_path().DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR,
 46:                         '',
 47:                         $file->getPathname()
 48:                     );
 49:                     $offenders[] = "{$relative} (namespace: {$namespace})";
 50:                 }
 51:             }
 52:         }
 53: 
 54:         $this->assertEmpty(
 55:             $offenders,
 56:             'Files under app/Http/Requests must declare a namespace '
 57:             ."under App\\Http\\Requests. Misplaced files:\n - "
 58:             .implode("\n - ", $offenders)
 59:         );
 60:     }
 61: 
 62:     /**
 63:      * No two files under app/ may declare the SAME fully-qualified
 64:      * class name. Different namespaces with the same short name are
 65:      * perfectly fine (Laravel's standard Web/API/SuperAdmin split).
 66:      */
 67:     public function test_no_duplicate_fully_qualified_class_names_in_app_directory(): void
 68:     {
 69:         $byFqcn = [];
 70: 
 71:         foreach (File::allFiles(app_path()) as $file) {
 72:             if (! str_ends_with($file->getFilename(), '.php')) {
 73:                 continue;
 74:             }
 75: 
 76:             $contents = File::get($file->getPathname());
 77: 
 78:             // Extract namespace (default to empty string if none).
 79:             $namespace = '';
 80:             if (preg_match('/^namespace\s+([^;]+);/m', $contents, $nsMatch)) {
 81:                 $namespace = trim($nsMatch[1]);
 82:             }
 83: 
 84:             // Extract every class declared in the file.
 85:             if (preg_match_all(
 86:                 '/\b(?:abstract\s+|final\s+)?class\s+(\w+)/',
 87:                 $contents,
 88:                 $classMatches
 89:             )) {
 90:                 foreach ($classMatches[1] as $shortName) {
 91:                     $fqcn = $namespace !== '' ? $namespace.'\\'.$shortName : $shortName;
 92: 
 93:                     $byFqcn[$fqcn][] = str_replace(
 94:                         base_path().DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR,
 95:                         '',
 96:                         $file->getPathname()
 97:                     );
 98:                 }
 99:             }
100:         }
101: 
102:         $duplicates = array_filter(
103:             $byFqcn,
104:             fn ($paths) => count($paths) > 1
105:         );
106: 
107:         $this->assertEmpty(
108:             $duplicates,
109:             "Duplicate fully-qualified class names detected in app/:\n"
110:             .collect($duplicates)
111:                 ->map(fn ($paths, $fqcn) => "  {$fqcn}:\n    - ".implode("\n    - ", $paths))
112:                 ->implode("\n")
113:         );
114:     }
115: 
116:     /**
117:      * Guard against orphaned view files.
118:      *
119:      * A view is "orphaned" if no controller renders it via
120:      * view('reports.coming-soon') and no other view includes it via
121:      *
122:      * @include or @extends. Orphaned views bloat the repo, cause
123:      * confusion, and can hide missing features (a placeholder that
124:      * was never replaced).
125:      *
126:      * This check is intentionally conservative — it only inspects the
127:      * explicit "coming-soon" style placeholder view, whose name makes
128:      * the expectation clear. Adding a general orphan-view detector is
129:      * possible but prone to false positives (partials, layouts, and
130:      * dynamic view names are all legitimate).
131:      */
132:     public function test_coming_soon_placeholder_view_is_not_orphaned(): void
133:     {
134:         $viewPath = resource_path('views/reports/coming-soon.blade.php');
135: 
136:         $this->assertFileDoesNotExist(
137:             $viewPath,
138:             'The reports/coming-soon.blade.php placeholder was created as a '
139:             .'stub before the real report views existed. All reports are '
140:             .'now implemented, so the placeholder must not be reintroduced.'
141:         );
142:     }
143: }
</file>

 14:

 16: {
 17:     use RefreshDatabase;
 18: 
 19:     protected Company $company;
 20: 
 21:     protected Garage $garage;
 22: 
 23:     protected function setUp(): void
 24:     {
 25:         parent::setUp();
 26: 
 27:         $this->company = Company::factory()->create();
 28:         $this->garage = Garage::factory()->create(['company_id' => $this->company->id]);
 29: 
 30:         GarageContext::set($this->garage->id, $this->company->id);
 31:     }
 32: 
 33:     protected function tearDown(): void
 34:     {

 36:         parent::tearDown();
 37:     }
 38: 
 39:     protected function garageSession(): array
 40:     {

 43:             'current_company_id' => $this->company->id,

 54:         $user->garages()->attach($this->garage->id, [

 61:             ->get(route('dashboard'))

<file path="tests/Feature/ExceptionHandlingTest.php">
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: namespace Tests\Feature;
  4: 
  5: use App\Models\User;
  6: use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
  7: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\File;
  8: use Tests\TestCase;
  9: 
 10: /**
 11:  * Verifies that after removing the redundant exception renderers
 12:  * in C5, the following still behave correctly:
 13:  *
 14:  *   1. Laravel's built-in exception handling produces the expected
 15:  *      status codes and JSON shape (validation, auth, 404, 403).
 16:  *   2. The project's own custom exception handlers continue to run.
 17:  *   3. The removed renderers are not silently re-added.
 18:  */
 19: class ExceptionHandlingTest extends TestCase
 20: {
 21:     use RefreshDatabase;
 22: 
 23:     // ==================================================================
 24:     // 1. LARAVEL DEFAULTS — regression guards after C5 cleanup
 25:     // ==================================================================
 26: 
 27:     public function test_validation_errors_return_422_with_laravel_shape(): void
 28:     {
 29:         $response = $this->postJson('/api/login', []);
 30: 
 31:         $response->assertStatus(422)
 32:             ->assertJsonStructure([
 33:                 'message',
 34:                 'errors' => ['email', 'password'],
 35:             ]);
 36:     }
 37: 
 38:     public function test_unauthenticated_api_request_returns_401(): void
 39:     {
 40:         $this->getJson('/api/user')->assertStatus(401);
 41:     }
 42: 
 43:     public function test_unknown_api_route_returns_404(): void
 44:     {
 45:         $this->getJson('/api/this-route-does-not-exist')
 46:             ->assertStatus(404);
 47:     }
 48: 
 49:     public function test_unauthenticated_web_request_redirects_to_login(): void
 50:     {
 51:         $this->get('/dashboard')
 52:             ->assertRedirect('/login');
 53:     }
 54: 
 55:     public function test_unauthorized_web_request_returns_403(): void
 56:     {
 57:         // The /super-admin/* routes are protected by the SuperAdmin
 58:         // middleware. To isolate that middleware we bypass the
 59:         // garage.selected guard, which would otherwise redirect this
 60:         // user before the SuperAdmin check ever runs.
 61:         $this->withoutMiddleware([
 62:             \App\Http\Middleware\EnsureGarageSelected::class,
 63:         ]);
 64: 
 65:         $user = User::factory()->create(['role' => 'user']);
 66: 
 67:         $this->actingAs($user)
 68:             ->get('/super-admin/dashboard')
 69:             ->assertStatus(403);
 70:     }
 71: 
 72:     // ==================================================================
 73:     // 2. CUSTOM HANDLERS ARE STILL REGISTERED
 74:     // ==================================================================
 75: 
 76:     /**
 77:      * Custom exception renderers live in bootstrap/app.php. This test
 78:      * asserts that the handlers for our three custom exceptions are
 79:      * still present. The actual runtime behavior of each handler is
 80:      * covered by dedicated test files:
 81:      *   - GarageAccessDeniedException      → covered implicitly via
 82:      *                                        middleware tests
 83:      *   - StockInsufficientException       → ComplaintStockTest
 84:      *   - MissingGarageContextException    → MissingGarageContextTest
 85:      */
 86:     public function test_bootstrap_app_keeps_custom_exception_renderers(): void
 87:     {
 88:         $contents = File::get(base_path('bootstrap/app.php'));
 89: 
 90:         // Custom handlers that must remain.
 91:         $this->assertStringContainsString(
 92:             'GarageAccessDeniedException',
 93:             $contents,
 94:             'GarageAccessDeniedException handler must remain in bootstrap/app.php'
 95:         );
 96:         $this->assertStringContainsString(
 97:             'StockInsufficientException',
 98:             $contents,
 99:             'StockInsufficientException handler must remain in bootstrap/app.php'
100:         );
101:         $this->assertStringContainsString(
102:             'MissingGarageContextException',
103:             $contents,
104:             'MissingGarageContextException handler must remain in bootstrap/app.php'
105:         );
106:     }
107: 
108:     /**
109:      * After C5 cleanup, the only renderers in bootstrap/app.php should
110:      * be the ones that carry project-specific behavior. The following
111:      * are handled by Laravel out of the box and must not reappear as
112:      * custom closures.
113:      *
114:      * The match strings target the render-closure parameter signature
115:      * so the reportable() closure — which still references the same
116:      * class names — does not trigger a false positive.
117:      */
118:     public function test_bootstrap_app_has_no_redundant_exception_renderers(): void
119:     {
120:         $contents = File::get(base_path('bootstrap/app.php'));
121: 
122:         $forbidden = [
123:             'ValidationException $e, Request $request',
124:             'ModelNotFoundException $e, Request $request',
125:             'NotFoundHttpException $e, Request $request',
126:             'AuthenticationException $e, Request $request',
127:             'AuthorizationException $e, Request $request',
128:         ];
129: 
130:         foreach ($forbidden as $needle) {
131:             $this->assertStringNotContainsString(
132:                 $needle,
133:                 $contents,
134:                 "Redundant exception renderer detected: '{$needle}'. "
135:                 .'Laravel 11+ handles this exception correctly out of the box.'
136:             );
137:         }
138:     }
139: }

49:     public function test_drivers_export_sanitizes_formula_injection(): void
50:     {
51:         $company = Company::factory()->create();
52:         $garage = Garage::factory()->create(['company_id' => $company->id]);
53:         $user = User::factory()->create(['role' => 'super_admin']);
54: 
55:         // Driver with a malicious code that would become a formula in Excel
56:         Driver::withoutGlobalScopes()->create([
57:             'garage_id' => $garage->id,
58:             'company_id' => $company->id,
59:             'code' => 'DRV-SAFE-1',
60:             'first_name' => '=cmd|\'/c calc\'!A1', // ← Formula injection attempt
61:             'last_name' => '@SUM(1+1)',
62:             'notes' => '+HYPERLINK("http://evil.com","click")',
63:             'is_active' => true,
64:         ]);
65: 
66:         $export = new DriversExport;
67:         $row = $export->map(Driver::withoutGlobalScopes()
68:             ->where('code', 'DRV-SAFE-1')
69:             ->first());
70: 
71:         // Values starting with dangerous characters must be prefixed with '
72:         $this->assertSame("'=cmd|'/c calc'!A1", $row[1]);
73:         $this->assertSame("'@SUM(1+1)", $row[2]);
74:         $this->assertSame("'+HYPERLINK(\"http://evil.com\",\"click\")", $row[6]);
75: 
76:         // Safe values must remain untouched
77:         $this->assertSame('DRV-SAFE-1', $row[0]);
78:     }
79: }

177:     public function test_filter_headers_removes_dangerous_headers(): void
178:     {
179:         $middleware = new \App\Http\Middleware\IdempotencyMiddleware;
180: 
181:         $reflection = new \ReflectionMethod($middleware, 'filterHeaders');
182:         $reflection->setAccessible(true);
183: 
184:         $input = [
185:             'Content-Type' => ['application/json'],
186:             'Set-Cookie' => ['session=secret; HttpOnly; Path=/'],
187:             'Cookie' => ['foo=bar'],
188:             'Date' => ['Thu, 10 Sep 2026 12:00:00 GMT'],
189:             'Content-Length' => ['1234'],
190:             'Transfer-Encoding' => ['chunked'],
191:             'X-Custom-Header' => ['keep-this'],
192:         ];
193: 
194:         $result = $reflection->invoke($middleware, $input);
195: 
196:         // Təhlükəli header-lər çıxarılmalıdır
197:         $this->assertArrayNotHasKey('Set-Cookie', $result, 'Set-Cookie must be filtered (session fixation risk)');
198:         $this->assertArrayNotHasKey('Cookie', $result);
199:         $this->assertArrayNotHasKey('Date', $result, 'Date must be filtered (stale timestamps)');
200:         $this->assertArrayNotHasKey('Content-Length', $result);
201:         $this->assertArrayNotHasKey('Transfer-Encoding', $result);
202: 
203:         // Təhlükəsiz header-lər qalmalıdır
204:         $this->assertArrayHasKey('Content-Type', $result);
205:         $this->assertArrayHasKey('X-Custom-Header', $result);
206:         $this->assertEquals(['application/json'], $result['Content-Type']);
207:         $this->assertEquals(['keep-this'], $result['X-Custom-Header']);
208:     }

210:     public function test_cache_hit_does_not_duplicate_cookie_headers(): void
211:     {
212:         // Qeyd: Laravel-in öz session middleware-i hər sorğuya YENİ
213:         // XSRF-TOKEN əlavə edir — bu bizim cavabımız deyil, framework-ün.
214:         // Biz yalnız öz cache-imizdən Set-Cookie replay olunmadığını
215:         // yoxlaya bilərik — bu isə filter_headers testində sübut olunur.
216:         //
217:         // Bu test isə cache hit-in düzgün işlədiyini təsdiqləyir.
218: 
219:         $key = 'cookie-cache-test';
220:         $payload = ['dqn' => 'COOKIE-2', 'is_active' => 1];
221: 
222:         // İlk sorğu — real işlənir
223:         $first = $this->actingAs($this->user)
224:             ->withSession($this->garageSession())
225:             ->withHeaders(['X-Idempotency-Key' => $key])
226:             ->post(route('buses.store'), $payload);
227: 
228:         $this->assertNull($first->headers->get('X-Cache-Lookup'));
229: 
230:         // İkinci sorğu — cache hit
231:         $second = $this->actingAs($this->user)
232:             ->withSession($this->garageSession())
233:             ->withHeaders(['X-Idempotency-Key' => $key])
234:             ->post(route('buses.store'), $payload);
235: 
236:         // Cache hit olmalı
237:         $this->assertEquals('HIT-IDEMPOTENT', $second->headers->get('X-Cache-Lookup'));
238: 
239:         // Yalnız 1 bus yaradılıb (idempotency işləyir)
240:         $this->assertEquals(1, Bus::where('dqn', 'COOKIE-2')->count());
241:     }

328:             'Oversized idempotency keys must be ignored (DoS protection)'

 48:     // ==================================================================

 50:     // ==================================================================
 51: 
 52:     public function test_import_uses_session_when_context_is_empty(): void
 53:     {
 54:         // No Context set — the controller must resolve the garage from
 55:         // the session, which the EnsureGarageSelected middleware
 56:         // populates for real web requests.
 57:         $response = $this->actingAs($this->admin)
 58:             ->withSession([
 59:                 'current_garage_id' => $this->garageA->id,
 60:                 'current_company_id' => $this->company->id,
 61:             ])
 62:             ->post(route('buses.import.store'), [
 63:                 'file' => UploadedFile::fake()->create('dummy.xlsx', 100),
 64:             ]);
 65: 
 66:         // The empty Excel will produce a "import_error" flash, but the
 67:         // important thing is that the request reached the controller
 68:         // and did NOT redirect to garage.selection.
 69:         $response->assertRedirect(route('buses.index'));
 70:     }
 71: 
 72:     // ==================================================================
 73:     // 2. AUTH-USER-BASED RESOLUTION (queue/CLI fallback)
 74:     // ==================================================================
 75: 
 76:     public function test_import_uses_auth_user_when_session_is_missing(): void
 77:     {
 78:         // Simulate a state where Context is empty AND session is empty,
 79:         // but the authenticated user has a persisted current_garage_id.
 80:         $this->admin->update([
 81:             'current_garage_id' => $this->garageA->id,
 82:             'current_company_id' => $this->company->id,
 83:         ]);
 84: 
 85:         $this->admin->refresh();
 86: 
 87:         // Bypass the middleware layer so that the request reaches the
 88:         // controller with an empty session — this is the state a queue
 89:         // job or CLI command would be in.
 90:         $this->withoutMiddleware([
 91:             \App\Http\Middleware\EnsureGarageSelected::class,
 92:             \App\Http\Middleware\RoleMiddleware::class,
 93:         ]);
 94: 
 95:         $response = $this->actingAs($this->admin)
 96:             ->withSession(['current_garage_id' => null])
 97:             ->post(route('buses.import.store'), [
 98:                 'file' => UploadedFile::fake()->create('dummy.xlsx', 100),
 99:             ]);
100: 
101:         // Controller must NOT redirect to garage.selection because
102:         // resolveGarageId() found the garage on the user model.
103:         $response->assertRedirect(route('buses.index'));

153:             ]);
154:

156:         // inside the try-block, not from the guard) proves the guard
157:         // was satisfied with a positive garage id.
158:         $response->assertRedirect(route('drivers.index'));
159:     }

<file path="tests/Feature/Localization/TranslationCoverageTest.php">
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: namespace Tests\Feature\Localization;
  4: 
  5: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\File;
  6: use Tests\TestCase;
  7: 
  8: /**
  9:  * Guards against missing translation keys.
 10:  *
 11:  * The application ships with four locales (en, az, tr, ru).
 12:  *
 13:  * STRICT LOCALES — en, az
 14:  *   These two locales are the primary supported languages. Any key
 15:  *   that exists in one but not the other is a hard failure. A missing
 16:  *   key leaks the raw identifier into the UI (e.g. the user sees
 17:  *   "messages.complaints.new" instead of "New Card"), which is
 18:  *   unacceptable on a production deploy or in a customer demo.
 19:  *
 20:  * INFORMATIONAL LOCALES — tr, ru
 21:  *   These locales are being brought up to parity. Their diff status
 22:  *   is written to a diagnostic file (storage/logs/translation-coverage.log)
 23:  *   so the translator can work through the backlog, but they do NOT
 24:  *   fail the test suite. Once a locale reaches parity, it can be
 25:  *   promoted to STRICT_LOCALES.
 26:  *
 27:  * English is the reference for all comparisons because it is the
 28:  * fallback locale declared in config/app.php.
 29:  */
 30: class TranslationCoverageTest extends TestCase
 31: {
 32:     /**
 33:      * Locales that must be perfectly in sync with English.
 34:      * A missing or extra key here fails the test.
 35:      */
 36:     protected const STRICT_LOCALES = ['en', 'az'];
 37: 
 38:     /**
 39:      * Locales that are still being translated. Their status is
 40:      * logged but does not fail the test.
 41:      */
 42:     protected const INFORMATIONAL_LOCALES = ['tr', 'ru'];
 43: 
 44:     protected const REFERENCE_LOCALE = 'en';
 45: 
 46:     protected const LOG_PATH = 'logs/translation-coverage.log';
 47: 
 48:     // ==================================================================
 49:     // 1. Every locale has all the same files as English
 50:     // ==================================================================
 51: 
 52:     public function test_all_locales_have_same_translation_files(): void
 53:     {
 54:         $allLocales = array_merge(self::STRICT_LOCALES, self::INFORMATIONAL_LOCALES);
 55:         $referenceFiles = $this->translationFiles(self::REFERENCE_LOCALE);
 56: 
 57:         foreach ($allLocales as $locale) {
 58:             if ($locale === self::REFERENCE_LOCALE) {
 59:                 continue;
 60:             }
 61: 
 62:             $localeFiles = $this->translationFiles($locale);
 63: 
 64:             $missing = array_diff($referenceFiles, $localeFiles);
 65: 
 66:             $this->assertEmpty(
 67:                 $missing,
 68:                 "Locale [{$locale}] is missing translation files: "
 69:                 .implode(', ', $missing)
 70:             );
 71:         }
 72:     }
 73: 
 74:     // ==================================================================
 75:     // 2. Strict locales have all top-level keys
 76:     // ==================================================================
 77: 
 78:     public function test_strict_locales_have_same_top_level_keys(): void
 79:     {
 80:         $referenceKeys = $this->translationKeys(self::REFERENCE_LOCALE);
 81:         $allMissing = [];
 82: 
 83:         foreach (self::STRICT_LOCALES as $locale) {
 84:             if ($locale === self::REFERENCE_LOCALE) {
 85:                 continue;
 86:             }
 87: 
 88:             $localeKeys = $this->translationKeys($locale);
 89:             $missing = array_diff($referenceKeys, $localeKeys);
 90: 
 91:             if (! empty($missing)) {
 92:                 $allMissing[$locale] = array_values($missing);
 93:             }
 94:         }
 95: 
 96:         // Always assert — even when there is nothing missing — so the
 97:         // test does not become "risky" for lack of assertions.
 98:         $this->assertSame(
 99:             [],
100:             $allMissing,
101:             $this->formatMissingReport($allMissing)
102:         );
103:     }
104: 
105:     // ==================================================================
106:     // 3. Strict locales have no extra keys
107:     // ==================================================================
108: 
109:     public function test_strict_locales_have_no_extra_keys(): void
110:     {
111:         $referenceKeys = $this->translationKeys(self::REFERENCE_LOCALE);
112: 
113:         foreach (self::STRICT_LOCALES as $locale) {
114:             if ($locale === self::REFERENCE_LOCALE) {
115:                 continue;
116:             }
117: 
118:             $localeKeys = $this->translationKeys($locale);
119:             $extra = array_diff($localeKeys, $referenceKeys);
120: 
121:             $this->assertEmpty(
122:                 $extra,
123:                 "Locale [{$locale}] has ".count($extra).' keys that do not '
124:                 ."exist in [{$locale}]'s reference (en):\n - "
125:                 .implode("\n - ", array_slice($extra, 0, 20))
126:             );
127:         }
128:     }
129: 
130:     // ==================================================================
131:     // 4. Informational locales — log status, never fail
132:     // ==================================================================
133: 
134:     public function test_informational_locales_are_analyzed_without_failure(): void
135:     {
136:         $referenceKeys = $this->translationKeys(self::REFERENCE_LOCALE);
137:         $report = [];
138: 
139:         foreach (self::INFORMATIONAL_LOCALES as $locale) {
140:             $localeKeys = $this->translationKeys($locale);
141: 
142:             $missing = array_diff($referenceKeys, $localeKeys);
143:             $extra = array_diff($localeKeys, $referenceKeys);
144: 
145:             $report[$locale] = [
146:                 'reference_keys' => count($referenceKeys),
147:                 'locale_keys' => count($localeKeys),
148:                 'missing' => count($missing),
149:                 'extra' => count($extra),
150:                 'missing_sample' => array_slice(array_values($missing), 0, 20),
151:                 'extra_sample' => array_slice(array_values($extra), 0, 20),
152:             ];
153:         }
154: 
155:         // Write the report so translators have a worklist.
156:         $logPath = storage_path(self::LOG_PATH);
157:         $logDir = dirname($logPath);
158: 
159:         if (! is_dir($logDir)) {
160:             @mkdir($logDir, 0755, true);
161:         }
162: 
163:         $lines = [
164:             'Translation Coverage Report — '.now()->toIso8601String(),
165:             str_repeat('=', 70),
166:             '',
167:         ];
168: 
169:         foreach ($report as $locale => $data) {
170:             $lines[] = sprintf(
171:                 '[%s] reference=%d, locale=%d, missing=%d, extra=%d',
172:                 strtoupper($locale),
173:                 $data['reference_keys'],
174:                 $data['locale_keys'],
175:                 $data['missing'],
176:                 $data['extra']
177:             );
178: 
179:             if (! empty($data['missing_sample'])) {
180:                 $lines[] = '  Missing (first 20):';
181:                 foreach ($data['missing_sample'] as $key) {
182:                     $lines[] = '    - '.$key;
183:                 }
184:             }
185: 
186:             if (! empty($data['extra_sample'])) {
187:                 $lines[] = '  Extra (first 20):';
188:                 foreach ($data['extra_sample'] as $key) {
189:                     $lines[] = '    + '.$key;
190:                 }
191:             }
192: 
193:             $lines[] = '';
194:         }
195: 
196:         @file_put_contents($logPath, implode(PHP_EOL, $lines).PHP_EOL);
197: 
198:         // This test always passes — the report above is informational.
199:         // The assertion below just documents the intent: the test
200:         // writes a report and does not gate the build on locale parity.
201:         $this->assertTrue(true);
202: 
203:         // If you ever want to see the report in the test output,
204:         // uncomment the following line:
205:         // $this->markTestIncomplete('See storage/logs/translation-coverage.log for the backlog.');
206:     }
207: 
208:     // ==================================================================
209:     // HELPERS
210:     // ==================================================================
211: 
212:     /**
213:      * List every .php translation file in lang/{locale}/.
214:      *
215:      * @return array<int, string> e.g. ['auth.php', 'messages.php']
216:      */
217:     protected function translationFiles(string $locale): array
218:     {
219:         $path = lang_path($locale);
220: 
221:         if (! File::isDirectory($path)) {
222:             return [];
223:         }
224: 
225:         return collect(File::files($path))
226:             ->filter(fn ($f) => $f->getExtension() === 'php')
227:             ->map(fn ($f) => $f->getFilename())
228:             ->sort()
229:             ->values()
230:             ->all();
231:     }
232: 
233:     /**
234:      * Flatten every translation key in a locale into dot notation.
235:      *
236:      * Example:
237:      *   lang/en/messages.php with ['complaints' => ['new' => 'New']]
238:      *   → ['messages.complaints.new']
239:      *
240:      * @return array<int, string>
241:      */
242:     protected function translationKeys(string $locale): array
243:     {
244:         $path = lang_path($locale);
245: 
246:         if (! File::isDirectory($path)) {
247:             return [];
248:         }
249: 
250:         $keys = [];
251: 
252:         foreach (File::files($path) as $file) {
253:             if ($file->getExtension() !== 'php') {
254:                 continue;
255:             }
256: 
257:             $namespace = $file->getFilenameWithoutExtension();
258:             $data = require $file->getPathname();
259: 
260:             if (! is_array($data)) {
261:                 continue;
262:             }
263: 
264:             $this->flatten($data, $namespace, $keys);
265:         }
266: 
267:         sort($keys);
268: 
269:         return $keys;
270:     }
271: 
272:     /**
273:      * Recursively flatten a nested translation array into dot notation.
274:      *
275:      * @param  array<int|string, mixed>  $data
276:      * @param  array<int, string>  $keys
277:      */
278:     protected function flatten(array $data, string $prefix, array &$keys): void
279:     {
280:         foreach ($data as $key => $value) {
281:             $fullKey = $prefix.'.'.$key;
282: 
283:             if (is_array($value)) {
284:                 $this->flatten($value, $fullKey, $keys);
285:             } else {
286:                 $keys[] = $fullKey;
287:             }
288:         }
289:     }
290: 
291:     /**
292:      * Format a "missing keys per locale" map for the assertion message.
293:      *
294:      * @param  array<string, array<int, string>>  $allMissing
295:      */
296:     protected function formatMissingReport(array $allMissing): string
297:     {
298:         if (empty($allMissing)) {
299:             return 'All strict locales are in sync with English.';
300:         }
301: 
302:         $lines = ['Missing translation keys detected:'];
303: 
304:         foreach ($allMissing as $locale => $keys) {
305:             $lines[] = sprintf('  [%s] — %d keys:', strtoupper($locale), count($keys));
306: 
307:             foreach (array_slice($keys, 0, 30) as $key) {
308:                 $lines[] = '    - '.$key;
309:             }
310: 
311:             if (count($keys) > 30) {
312:                 $lines[] = '    ... and '.(count($keys) - 30).' more';
313:             }
314:         }
315: 
316:         return implode(PHP_EOL, $lines);
317:     }
318: }
</file>
